text.title: 神射手
text.objectives: 把影踪派弩箭束交给鹰眼大师砮荣。
text.description: $n，带上这些弩箭束，把它们交给西南方向远戍哨站的鹰眼大师砮荣。$B$B砮荣百发百中，在悟道者中享有很高的声誉。正是因为他的努力，那条防线才能在过去的几个月中坚守下来。我希望你能和他并肩作战，亲自对他做出评判。他可能是我们在狩猎时所能找到的最后一个影踪派门人了。
text.progress: Another wave of fliers approaches. Be ready.
text.completion: There's a lot of movement on the other side of the chasm... something big is coming.
text.completed: Bring the crossbow bolt bundles to Nurong Featherbrew at Farwatch Overlook in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: In Skilled Hands
english.objectives: Bring the Shado-Pan Crossbow Bolt Bundle to Hawkmaster Nurong.
english.description: $n, take these crossbow bolts and then bring them to Hawkmaster Nurong at Farwatch Overlook to the southwest.$B$BNurong is praised among all the Wukao for being a flawless shot. His efforts are credited with holding the line here for these many months. I'm hoping you can work with him and judge for yourself. He may be the final Shado-Pan we need for the hunt.
english.progress: Another wave of fliers approaches. Be ready.
english.completion: There's a lot of movement on the other side of the chasm... something big is coming.
english.completed: Bring the crossbow bolt bundles to Nurong Featherbrew at Farwatch Overlook in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 恐惧废土之骇
text.objectives: 击败诺尔瓦凯斯，恐惧废土之骇。
text.description: 那东西太大了！$B$B驻守前线的影踪派从来没有接受过应付这种怪物的训练……让我们亲自上阵，把它解决掉吧。
text.completion: You. You're coming with me.$B$BI've never seen someone handle themselves on the battlefield like that. I need a strong $C like you with me when we face the Sha of Hatred.
text.completed: Return to Taran Zhu at the Gao-Ran Battlefront in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Terror of the Dread Wastes
english.objectives: Defeat Norvakess, the Terror of the Dread Wastes.
english.description: That thing is huge!$B$BThe Shado-Pan holding the battlefront were never trained for something like this... let's get down there and take it out ourselves.
english.completion: You. You're coming with me.$B$BI've never seen someone handle themselves on the battlefield like that. I need a strong $C like you with me when we face the Sha of Hatred.
english.completed: Return to Taran Zhu at the Gao-Ran Battlefront in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 沿着南部前线
text.objectives: 骑上坐骑，和祝踏岚还有陶矢一同前往黯光枯木。
text.description: 我正和陶矢向西行，沿途物色最强壮的战士来帮我们抵御恨之煞。$B$B我希望你能跟我一起去。
text.completion: Let's get this taken care of so we can get down to the bridge.

english.title: Along the Southern Front
english.objectives: Ride with Taran Zhu and Taoshi to Dusklight Hollow.
english.description: I'm heading westward with Taoshi to gather the strongest I can find to confront the Sha of Hatred.$B$BI would like you to come with me.
english.completion: Let's get this taken care of so we can get down to the bridge.

text.title: 第4回合：风裘大师
text.objectives: 击败风裘大师。
text.description: 干得好，挑战者。你已进入到决胜局。$b$b你最终的对手是强大的风之骄子。多少年来他一直守护着他的人民，并且在竞技场上屡屡获胜。$b$b等你准备好，就去主竞技场迎战风裘大师吧。$b$b挑战者……祝你好运！
text.completion: Congratulations, champion! The day is yours.
text.completed: Speak with Xuen in the Tiger Temple of Kun-Lai Summit.
text.giverWindow: 黎明之花镇长

english.title: Round 4: Master Windfur
english.objectives: Defeat Master Windfur.
english.description: Well done, challenger. You have reached the final round.$b$bYour last opponent is a powerful master of the winds. He has defended his people for many years and stood as champion on more than one occasion.$b$bFace this Master Windfur in the main arena when you are ready.$b$bAnd challenger... good luck.
english.completion: Congratulations, champion! The day is yours.
english.completed: Speak with Xuen in the Tiger Temple of Kun-Lai Summit.
english.giverWindow: Mayor of Dawn's Blossom

text.title: 第4回合：以一敌三
text.objectives: 击败哈吉斯、希利斯和坦齐斯。
text.description: 现在是决胜局了！我为你挑选了三个对手。这对弱者而言是不太公平，但是你并不是弱者，不是吗？$b$b快去大殿，站上大竞技场，打败这三个对手吧。向我们证明你比他们三个加起来还要强！$b$b祝你好运，挑战者！
text.completion: Superb! What a battle!$B$BYou have proven yourself champion of this day's tournament. Well done!$B$BYou must return and put on such a show of strength in the future.
text.completed: Speak with Xuen in the Tiger Temple of Kun-Lai Summit.
text.giverWindow: 他们每一个都有自己的看家本领。
text.giverTarget: 哈吉斯、希利斯和坦齐斯。

english.title: Round 4: The P.U.G.
english.objectives: Defeat Hackiss, Healiss and Tankiss.
english.description: And now the final round. I have selected three challengers for you to face. This may seem unfair... to a weakling. You are not a weakling, correct?$b$bGo to the main temple, stand in the grand arena, and face these three challengers. Prove you are stronger than their combined power!$b$bGood luck, Challenger!
english.completion: Beautiful! That's the fight! You're rightfully winning the championship in today's competition. Be sure to come back to us and show your strength again.
english.completed: Speak with Xuen in the Tiger Temple of Kun-Lai Summit.
english.giverWindow: Each has a strength they lend to the fight.

text.title: 绿石村
text.objectives: 营救所有村民。
text.description: 请救救我们。$B$B我们出钱聘请了一些冒险者帮我们赶走了元素之灵，现在他们竟回来报仇了！

english.title: Greenstone Village
english.objectives: Rescue all the villagers.
english.description: Please help!$B$BWe paid some adventurers to run off all the elemental spirits and now they're back for revenge!

text.title: 仇灰的复仇
text.objectives: 打败仇灰。
text.description: 虽然有点难以启齿，但为了绿石村……可以麻烦你为我们去对付仇灰吗……？
text.giverWindow: [PH]殺!

english.title: Hui's Vengeance
english.objectives: Defeat Vengeful Hui.
english.description: I am ashamed to ask, but for Greenstone's sake... might we now trouble you to face Vengeful Hui on our behalf...?
english.giverWindow: [PH] KILL!

text.title: 螳螂妖的动机
text.objectives: 击败科里维斯的螳螂妖，以便泰侯可以从它们的尸体上寻找线索。
text.description: $C。你应该能够帮上忙。$b$b影踪派想知道螳螂妖为什么会如此疯狂地进攻。我们有自己的猜测，但还不能确定。况且，我们不想让螳螂妖知道我们正在进行调查。$b$b这就是我们让你来的原因。$b$b我希望你前往北面的科里维斯，杀死那里的螳螂妖。我会一路尾随你，从它们的尸体上搜寻线索。
text.completion: The abundance of yak hair on that mantid's body suggests one thing... it came from Niuzao Temple. Our journey continues westward, $C.
text.completed: Return to Tai Ho at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Motives of the Mantid
english.objectives: Slay mantid in Kri'vess so Tai Ho can look for clues on their bodies.
english.description: $C. You may be of assistance.$b$bThe Shado-Pan wishes to know why the mantid are attacking so violently. We have our suspicions, but we cannot be sure. Furthermore, we do not want the mantid to know that we are investigating them.$b$bThat's where you come in.$b$bI need you to kill the mantid of Kri'vess, in the north. I will lurk behind you in the shadows, and search for clues on their bodies.
english.completion: The abundance of yak hair on that mantid's body suggests one thing... it came from Niuzao Temple. Our journey continues westward, $C.
english.completed: Return to Tai Ho at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 纯天然抗菌剂
text.objectives: 获得5份饱满的穆山兽膀胱。
text.description: 影踪派人数不多、精英荟萃，投入的训练成本相当高昂，要补充兵源非常困难。我们绝不能因为淬毒的武器或者伤口感染而损失兵力了。这就是为什么我要让你找样……东西。$b$b我就直说了吧。穆山兽的尿液是极佳的天然抗菌剂。它们每次排放的量很大，这是件大好事……因为我们的需求量也很大。
text.progress: It's messy work, certainly.$B$BNowhere near as messy as digging graves.
text.completion: Your messy work may have saved a few lives today, $R.
text.completed: Return to Provisioner Bamfu at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Natural Antiseptic
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Full Mushan Bladders.
english.description: The Shado-Pan are rare, elite, and quite expensive to train and replace. We can't afford to have any falling to a poisoned weapon or an infected cut. That's why I need you to get... something.$b$bLet me be blunt. Mushan urine is a great, natural antiseptic. They produce a large amount of it, which is lucky... because we tend to use a lot.
english.progress: It's messy work, certainly.$B$BNowhere near as messy as digging graves.
english.completion: Your messy work may have saved a few lives today, $R.
english.completed: Return to Provisioner Bamfu at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 拖住螳螂妖
text.objectives: 使用火药桶引爆科里维斯的科里提克武器和科里提克补给品。
text.description: 每一天，螳螂妖都在增运军火，用来攻打它们的敌人。仅凭你我二人无法制止它们……但至少可以拖延一阵。$b$b<泰侯递给你一些炸药。>$b$b我不便亲自动手。你愿意担此重任吗？
text.completion: We are in your debt, $R.
text.completed: Return to Tai Ho at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Set the Mantid Back
english.objectives: Use Gunpowder Casks to explode the Kri'thik Weapons and the Kri'thik Supplies in Kri'vess.
english.description: Every day, the mantid build up munitions for use on their enemies. We cannot stop them, just you and I... but we can set them back.$b$b<Tai Ho hands you some explosives.>$b$bI need to keep a low profile. Would you do the honors?
english.completion: We are in your debt, $R.
english.completed: Return to Tai Ho at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 砮皂的智慧
text.objectives: 去螳螂高原的砮皂寺和小傲古谈一谈。
text.description: 玄牛砮皂就栖息在西面的寺院里，他也许知道螳螂妖进攻的原因。$b$b事实上，他或许知道更多的内幕。$b$b我会在砮皂寺跟你碰头，$c。
text.completion: Your Shado-Pan associate has spoken with me. Yes, Niuzao knows why the mantid are attacking. But he is not ready to tell you.$B$BNot yet.

english.title: The Wisdom of Niuzao
english.objectives: Speak with Ogo the Younger at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.
english.description: Niuzao, the Black Ox, rests in the temple to the west. He may know why the mantid are attacking.$b$bHe may, in fact, know much more than that.$b$bI will rendezvous with you at Niuzao Temple, $c.
english.completion: Your Shado-Pan associate has spoken with me. Yes, Niuzao knows why the mantid are attacking. But he is not ready to tell you.$B$BNot yet.

text.title: 砮皂的价码
text.objectives: 击败瑟拉提克入侵地的螳螂妖，以便于泰侯在它们的尸体上寻找砮皂的雕像碎片。
text.description: 砮皂有一尊他视若至宝的雕像：一尊按照他的样子雕刻的小雕像，是很久以前就牺牲的一位哨兵做给他的。这尊雕像最近被瑟拉提克的螳螂妖偷走了，并带回了它们的营地，就在我们的北面。$b$b找回这尊雕像。然后我们会告诉你——还有你的影踪派同伴想知道的答案。
text.completion: Niuzao will be pleased.$B$BDespite his size, our patron is a beast of grace and compassion. He treasured this icon... just as he treasures each of his followers.
text.completed: Return to Ogo the Younger at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Niuzao's Price
english.objectives: Kill the mantid of the Sra'thik Incursion so that Tai Ho can search their bodies for pieces of Niuzao's statuette.
english.description: Niuzao owns a statuette which he values greatly: a small icon, in his image, sculpted by one of his long-since fallen sentinels. This statuette was recently stolen by the Sra'thik mantid, and taken to their encampment to our north.$b$bBring back this statuette. Then we will give you - and your Shado-Pan associate - the answers you seek.
english.completion: Niuzao will be pleased.$B$BDespite his size, our patron is a beast of grace and compassion. He treasured this icon... just as he treasures each of his followers.
english.completed: Return to Ogo the Younger at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 可怕的真相
text.objectives: 探查砮皂陵，击败藏匿在其中的恐惧之影。
text.description: 我确认了你们的猜测，这让我很郁闷。螳螂妖确实是被惧之煞操纵了。$b$b本来将这个怪物囚禁在寺院中是我们义不容辞的责任。很不幸，由于我们放松了警惕，疏于防范，让煞魔逃了出去。现在它跟螳螂妖混在一起。$b$b你可以亲眼去看看。螳螂妖在我们岛屿的西侧挖洞藏身。
text.completion: Let me make this clear... that creature was NOT the Sha of Fear. Simply a shadow... a fraction of the sha's true power.$B$BNo, the Sha of Fear is with the mantid now. The elders of my order need to be informed of this immediately.$B$BI will handle the rest from here. Thank you for your assistance, $R. Once again, your kind proves to be an asset to Pandaria.
text.completed: Speak with Tai Ho within the Niuzao Catacombs in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Terrible Truth
english.objectives: Investigate the Niuzao Catacombs, then slay the Dread Shadow that dwells within.
english.description: It is with a heavy heart that I confirm your suspicions. The mantid are indeed under the sway of the Sha of Fear.$b$bIt was OUR sworn duty to confine that creature beneath our temple. Unfortunately, our vigil faltered, our defenses buckled, and the sha escaped. It is with the mantid now.$b$bSee for yourself. The mantid burrowed into the western side of our island.
english.completion: Let me make this clear... that creature was NOT the Sha of Fear. Simply a shadow... a fraction of the sha's true power.$B$BNo, the Sha of Fear is with the mantid now. The elders of my order need to be informed of this immediately.$B$BI will handle the rest from here. Thank you for your assistance, $R. Once again, your kind proves to be an asset to Pandaria.
english.completed: Speak with Tai Ho within the Niuzao Catacombs in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 让他们安息
text.objectives: 让10个恐惧附体的哨兵得以瞑目并面朝大地，使他们得到安息。
text.description: 我无意中听说，我们的秘密被揭开了。$b$b当我得知螳螂妖在我们寺院的下方打洞时，我立刻采取了行动。我派出了几十个卫兵前去防守，但他们准备不足。他们被恐惧所吞噬，一去不返。$b$b熊猫人本应入土为安，长逝如眠……而非横尸荒野，因恐惧而死不瞑目。拜托了，$n。让他们得到应有的安息吧。
text.completion: Thank you, $C.$B$B$B$BI should have been among them.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Commander Qipan at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Give Them Peace
english.objectives: Give peace to 10 Fear-Stricken Sentinels by closing their eyes and placing them on their bellies.
english.description: I overheard. Our secret is out, then.$b$bWhen I learned that the mantid had burrowed beneath our temple, I reacted hastily. I sent dozens of guardians to defend what they could, but they were not prepared. They succumbed to fear, and never returned.$b$bA pandaren deserves to die embracing the ground, as he does in sleep... not flat on his back with his eyes transfixed in terror. Please, $n. Give them the peace they deserve.
english.completion: Thank you, $C.$B$B$B$BI should have been among them.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Commander Qipan at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 让恐惧附体的哨兵安息

text.title: 恐惧的余孽
text.objectives: 击败砮皂陵里的12只恐惧孽生。
text.description: 你现在知道砮皂的秘密了。我们不仅看守着这座寺院……也看守着埋藏于寺院之下的惧之煞。$b$b煞能的本体可能已经逃走了……不过它留下了一些余孽。如果你真的潜入到墓穴里，你就应该在它们逃跑并造成更大问题之前消灭那些余孽。
text.completion: We already have mantid, mogu, and yaungol to worry about. This sha problem needs to be nipped in the bud before even we are overrun.
text.completed: Return to Yak-Keeper Kyana at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: A Trail of Fear
english.objectives: Kill 12 Dreadlings within the Niuzao Catacombs.
english.description: You now know Niuzao's secret. We are not only the wardens of this temple... we were the wardens of the Sha of Fear that was buried beneath it.$b$bThe Sha itself may have escaped... but it left traces behind. If you're truly going down into the catacombs, you should eliminate those traces, before they escape and cause greater problems than those we already face.
english.completion: We already have mantid, mogu, and yaungol to worry about. This sha problem needs to be nipped in the bud before even we are overrun.
english.completed: Return to Yak-Keeper Kyana at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 坏牦牛
text.objectives: 帮助蓝马鞍更换他的劣等牦牛。
text.description: 这里就是他们更换劣等牦牛的地方吗？$b$b有人来帮帮我吗？
text.completion: I think we made a pretty convincing argument. They'll HAVE to replace my yak now.
text.completed: Speak with Bluesaddle at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Bad Yak
english.objectives: Help Bluesaddle replace his defective yak.
english.description: Is this the place where they replace defective yaks?$b$bCan anybody help me out, here?
english.completion: I think we made a pretty convincing argument. They'll HAVE to replace my yak now.
english.completed: Speak with Bluesaddle at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 选牦牛
text.objectives: 使用牦牛套索套住野生高原牦牛，然后驯服它们，看是否适合蓝马鞍。
text.description: 这里真找不出一头能看上眼的牦牛了。所有牦牛都很差！$b$b不是太臭，就是太野，要么就是胆小。$b$b你看上去倒像是个运气不错的$r。来，拿上套索。看你能不能帮我找到一头上等牦牛。
text.completion: Well, well! A good yak!$B$BTell you what, $n. I take this GOOD yak, and you can do whatever you want with this bad, bad one.
text.completed: Return to Bluesaddle at the Fields of Niuzao in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Pick a Yak
english.objectives: Use the Yak Lasso on Wild Townlong Yaks, then fight against them to see if they are suitable for Bluesaddle.
english.description: I can't find a single good yak here. ALL the yaks are bad!$b$bSome are too stinky, some too fight-y, others just scared.$b$bYou look like a lucky $r. Here, take a lasso. See if you can find a good yak for me.
english.completion: Well, well! A good yak!$B$BTell you what, $n. I take this GOOD yak, and you can do whatever you want with this bad, bad one.
english.completed: Return to Bluesaddle at the Fields of Niuzao in Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到合适的野生高原牦牛

text.title: 我父亲的十字弓
text.objectives: 获得姚枯的十字弓。
text.description: 我原本是到寺院来探望我父亲的。我一到这儿就看到了最可怕的一幕。$b$b有一只螳螂妖从我身边走过，它居然扛着我父亲的十字弓。$b$b我父亲一定出事了！我们必须搞清楚发生了什么事……但首先，我们要夺回父亲的十字弓。我看见螳螂妖朝寺院后的西面去了。
text.progress: Did... did you find it?
text.completion: Yeah, this is dad's.$B$BLet's head on over to the temple. They'll know what...$B$B<Ku-Mo's voice catches.>$B$B...what happened to him.
text.completed: Return to Ku-Mo in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: My Father's Crossbow
english.objectives: Obtain Ku-Yao's Crossbow.
english.description: I came here to visit my dad at the temple. As soon as I got here, I saw the most terrifying thing I've ever seen.$b$bIt was a mantid, walking right past me, carrying my father's crossbow.$b$bSomething's happened to my dad! We've got to find out what it is... but first, we'll need his crossbow back. I saw him heading west, behind the temple.
english.progress: Did... did you find it?
english.completion: Yeah, this is dad's.$B$BLet's head on over to the temple. They'll know what...$B$B<Ku-Mo's voice catches.>$B$B...what happened to him.
english.completed: Return to Ku-Mo in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 父亲的脚步
text.objectives: 找到父亲的铺盖卷、父亲的盾牌、哈查和哨兵尤罗。
text.description: 是的，那男孩的父亲——哨兵姚枯失踪了。他可能在好些地方……这些日子我们的敌人有增无减。$b$b如果你愿意的话，请随便看看吧。你可以先从他的牦牛开始找起，或者问问哨兵尤罗看他知道些什么。
text.completion: No shield, no crossbow, no yak... something bad has happened to dad.
text.completed: Return to Ku-Mo at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Father's Footsteps
english.objectives: Find Father's Bedroll, Father's Shield, Ha-Cha, and Sentinel Yalo.
english.description: Yes, the boy's father - Sentinel Ku-Yao - has gone missing. He could be any number of places... we have no shortage of enemies these days.$b$bYou're free to look around, if you wish. You might start by looking for his yak, or by asking Sentinel Yalo what he knows.
english.completion: No shield, no crossbow, no yak... something bad has happened to dad.
english.completed: Return to Ku-Mo at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 寻找父亲
text.objectives: 寻找哨兵姚枯。
text.description: 我找遍了各处……但还是没有找到我的父亲。我知道他还活着。只要他手里还有十字弓……他就不会有问题的。$b$b我听说你们影踪派有时会在瑟拉维斯和螳螂妖作战。我没办法去那里。如果你去那里，可以帮我找下我父亲吗？
text.completion: <Ku-Mo doesn't seem to notice you.>
text.completed: Return to Ku-Mo at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Seeking Father
english.objectives: Search for Sentinel Ku-Yao.
english.description: I've searched everywhere... but I haven't found my father. I KNOW he's alive still. He just needs his crossbow... then he'll be OK.$b$bI've heard that you Shado-Pan guys sometimes fight the mantid on Sra'vess. I don't have any way of getting there. If you ever go over there, can you look for my dad?
english.completion: <Ku-Mo doesn't seem to notice you.>
english.completed: Return to Ku-Mo at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 标准效果测试任务
text.objectives: 和任务目标进行互动，确保它们的图标有用。
text.description: 你好，朋友！我们来做一些测试，好吗？$b$b点击装置！$b和泡泡聊天！$b治疗绿色烟火！$b杀死该杀目标！$b点击装置尸体！$b$b扬声器会播报你的进度。$b$b每达成一个目标，你都会爆炸。$B$B（最后一点我很抱歉。）
text.completed: 回去找游学者周卓。

english.title: Criteria Effects Test Quest
english.objectives: Interact with the quest objectives and make sure their icons work.
english.description: Hello friend! Let's test some things, shall we?$b$bClick on the gear!$bChat with the bubble!$bHeal the Green Sparkle!$bKill the kill target!$bClick on the gearbody's corpse!$b$bThe loudspeaker should announce your progress.$b$bAfter each objective, you will explode.$B$B(Sorry about that last bit.)
english.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho.

text.title: 渔夫的故事
text.objectives: 和米师交谈，前往征服者之路。你可以在语云山找到信·语云。
text.description: 卓金村的村民是昆莱地区最了解海岸的人。如果赞达拉部族藏在其中某个小岛上，他们肯定会知道。$b$b米师将会带你到帝王之路。我会前去和村里的长老谈一谈。$b$b沿着通往语云山的道路前进。信·语云将会帮助你到达村庄。
text.completion: The elders have agreed to help us figure out where the Zandalari have hidden the Thunder King's remains.$B$BThey have a few conditions though...
text.completed: Speak to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

english.title: Fisherman's Tale
english.objectives: Speak with Mishi to travel to the Path of Conquerors. From there find Shin Whispercloud at Whispercloud Rise.
english.description: The villagers of Zouchin know the coast better than anyone in Kun-Lai. If the Zandalari are hiding on one of the islands, they will know.$b$bMishi will take you as far as Emperor's Path. I will go ahead to speak with the village elders.$b$bFollow the path to Whispercloud Rise. Shin Whispercloud will help you reach the village.
english.completion: The elders have agreed to help us figure out where the Zandalari have hidden the Thunder King's remains.$B$BThey have a few conditions though...
english.completed: Speak to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

objectiveDetails.description: 与雷神之墓外的米师交谈
与信·语云交谈进入卓金界

text.title: Preparing Zouchin Village
text.objectives: Assist Elder Shu and Steelbender Doshu in preparing Zouchin Village for battle.
text.description: The village elders seem to think the Thunder King's remains are being kept nearby. They have also expressed some concern with our presence here. They fear this will provoke another attack on their village.$b$bWhile our priority is in getting the remains back we cannot leave the villagers defenseless. Speak with Elder Shu and Steelbender Doshu and see what can be done to help.
text.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

english.title: Preparing Zouchin Village
english.objectives: Assist Elder Shu and Steelbender Doshu in preparing Zouchin Village for battle.
english.description: The village elders seem to think the Thunder King's remains are being kept nearby. They have also expressed some concern with our presence here. They fear this will provoke another attack on their village.$b$bWhile our priority is in getting the remains back we cannot leave the villagers defenseless. Speak with Elder Shu and Steelbender Doshu and see what can be done to help.
english.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

text.title: 传授武功
text.objectives: 去卓金界击败4个阿曼尼散兵，4个古拉巴什妖术师和3个达卡莱织霜者。
text.description: 嘘！说话小声点！我爸可能会听见的。$b$b<朔弥指了指折钢者杜术。>$b$b我爸他尽胡思乱想！我们村庄正在遭受攻击，而他居然还觉得我应该去研究茶道。这也太荒谬了！论勇气，我可是不输给任何人的。我只是不懂怎么战斗……暂时不懂。$b$b这就是要用到你的地方，就让我跟你一起闯荡江湖吧！我学东西可快了，而且绝不会拖累你，我发誓！$b$b求你了！$b$b如果我们走散了，那我就回村子等你。
text.progress: I'll show my father he's wrong about me!
text.completion: I told you I was a fast learner! I will head back to the village to start training others. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Shomi in Zouchin Village.

english.title: Make A Fighter Out of Me
english.objectives: Kill 4 Amani Skirmishers, 4 Gurubashi Hexxers, and 3 Drakkari Frostweavers in Zouchin Province.
english.description: Shhh! Don't speak so loudly! My father might hear you.$b$b<Shomi gestures to Steelbender Doshu.>$b$bMy father is delusional! He thinks I should be studying my tea pouring while our village is under attack. It's ridiculous! I have just as much courage as any man. I just don't know how to fight... yet.$b$bThat's where you come in. Let me travel with you! I'm a fast learner and I won't get in the way I promise!$b$bPleaseeeeee!$b$bIf we get separated I'll meet you back in the village.
english.progress: I'll show my father he's wrong about me!
english.completion: I told you I was a fast learner! I will head back to the village to start training others. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Shomi in Zouchin Village.

text.title: 小心轻放
text.objectives: 为朱长老带去50朵爆烈花。
text.description: 来犯的入侵者人数众多，我们要想取得胜利绝非易事。我肯定有一种东西可以帮助我们赢得优势。$b$b在村子附近生长着一种植物，可以用来制成一种相当有效的爆炸性液体。如果你能采来足够多的那种植物，我就可以开始制作那种混合物。$b$b你要寻找的植物有一个适合它的名字——爆烈花。要小心轻放，$c。
text.progress: Were you able to find a suitable amount of volatile blooms?
text.completion: These are perfect! Now, I would go wash your hands a few times $C.$B$BI would also continue to avoid open flames for a few days...
text.completed: Return to Elder Shu in Zouchin Village.

english.title: Handle With Care
english.objectives: Bring Elder Shu 50 Volatile Blooms.
english.description: I've seen the numbers these invaders have brought with them, this will not be an easy victory. I do know of one thing that may help us gain an advantage.$b$bThere is a plant that grows around the village that can be used to make a rather effective explosive liquid. If you can gather enough I can begin brewing the mixture.$b$bThe plant you are looking for is appropriately named volatile bloom. Handle it with care, $c.
english.progress: Were you able to find a suitable amount of volatile blooms?
english.completion: These are perfect! Now, I would go wash your hands a few times $C.$B$BI would also continue to avoid open flames for a few days...
english.completed: Return to Elder Shu in Zouchin Village.

text.title: 全村出动
text.objectives: 换下在哨岗的筋疲力尽的防御者。
text.description: 从第一波攻击打响到现在，村民们都在全力保卫卓金村。他们已筋疲力尽，许多人还受伤了。$b$b如果那些赞达拉巨魔再次进攻，我们可不想看到肩负保卫职责的村民睡着了。$b$b把他们从哨岗上替换下来，让他们有时间去疗伤，与家人见见面。$b$b他们就驻守在村子四周。
text.completion: Very good, $C! With the villagers rested we may yet stand a chance against the Zandalari.
text.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

english.title: It Takes A Village
english.objectives: Relieve the Exhausted Defenders from their guard posts.
english.description: The villagers have been guarding Zouchin since the first attack. They are exhausted and many are injured.$b$bIf the Zandalari attack again the last thing we need is for the defenders to fall asleep on the job.$b$bRelieve them of their posts so that they might have time to heal and see their families.$b$bYou'll find them stationed around the village.
english.completion: Very good, $C! With the villagers rested we may yet stand a chance against the Zandalari.
english.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

objectiveDetails.description: 换下筋疲力尽的防御者

text.title: 你的就是我的
text.objectives: 从赞达拉入侵者手里夺回6件失窃的武器。
text.description: 村里的长者希望我们进行抵抗？我们又不是武僧，$c；如果我们要战斗，就需要武器！$B$B帮我从野蛮人那里找些武器回来，我应该能用它们熔铸出一些更适于村民战斗的武器。$b$b尽可能多带一些回来，剩下的事情就交给我了。
text.progress: We'll need more than luck to get us through this. I hope you found something I can work with.
text.completion: Well, these are better than I had anticipated! I can make four spears for every one of their blades.$B$BDon't you worry, I'll make sure the villagers are armed when the time comes.
text.completed: Return to Steelbender Doshu in Zouchin Village.

english.title: What's Yours Is Mine
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Stolen Weapons from the Zandalari Invaders.
english.description: The elders want us to mount a defense? We're not monks, $c; we need weapons if we hope to fight!$B$BScavenge some arms from those barbarians for me. I should be able to melt them down and make something more suitable for our villagers to fight with.$b$bBring me as many as you can carry and I'll take care of the rest.
english.progress: We'll need more than luck to get us through this. I hope you found something I can work with.
english.completion: Well, these are better than I had anticipated! I can make four spears for every one of their blades.$B$BDon't you worry, I'll make sure the villagers are armed when the time comes.
english.completed: Return to Steelbender Doshu in Zouchin Village.

text.title: 揭开真相
text.objectives: 和赞达拉囚徒谈一谈。
text.description: 那个囚犯就关押在楼上，$n。想从他嘴里得到点信息可不容易，但哪怕只有一点和他们位置相关的细枝末节，对我们都很有帮助。$b$b长老们已经开始对他进行审讯了。通过他们的协助，我们就能确定下一步的行动了。$b$b去找他谈谈，看看能不能套出一些有用的信息。
text.completion: We cannot dwell on this setback, $n. Prophet Khar'zul must be dealt with.$B$BEvery member of the Thunder King's forces we are able to destroy brings us one step closer to victory.
text.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

english.title: Revelations
english.objectives: Speak with the Zandalari Prisoner.
english.description: The prisoner is being kept upstairs, $n. It will be difficult to get information from him, but even the slightest detail about their location will help.$b$bThe elders have begun questioning him already. With their help we should be able to figure out our next move.$b$bGo speak with him and see if he has any useful information.
english.completion: We cannot dwell on this setback, $n. Prophet Khar'zul must be dealt with.$B$BEvery member of the Thunder King's forces we are able to destroy brings us one step closer to victory.
english.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

text.title: 无休止的围攻
text.objectives: 在砮皂寺击败12名瑟拉提克攻击者。
text.description: 螳螂妖继续对我们发起进攻。他们的数量时多时少，但却没有停手的意思。$b$b无所谓。牦牛的耐力无穷无尽。我们不可能屈服。我们誓要保卫他的家园。$b$b你能帮我们吗？
text.completion: You fight like you are one of us.
text.completed: Return to Ogo the Elder at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Unending Siege
english.objectives: Defeat 12 Sra'thik attackers at Niuzao Temple.
english.description: The mantid continue to attack us. Their numbers ebb and flow, but they do not stop.$b$bIt is no matter. The yak is stamina embodied. We will not bend to them.  We will defend his home forever.$b$bWill you help us?
english.completion: You fight like you are one of us.
english.completed: Return to Ogo the Elder at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 虚弱的戒卫
text.objectives: 治疗8个受伤的砮皂戒卫，让他们恢复50%以上的生命力。你可以使用牦牛乳膏或自己的魔法和能力。
text.description: 我们的戒卫能够连续战斗数天，但即使这样，他们的体力也有极限。由于螳螂妖大兵压境，许多戒卫早已体力不支。$b$b请尽你所能去帮帮他们吧。如果你没办法亲自治疗他们，可以给他们补充点这个。喝一口营养丰富的牦牛奶可以让他们恢复一些体力。
text.completion: In times like these, we must trust in the power and protection of Niuzao. Should things get any worse, he will protect us.$B$BHe always does.
text.completed: Return to Yak-Keeper Kyana at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Fallen Sentinels
english.objectives: Heal 8 Wounded Niuzao Sentinels above 50% health. You may use the Yak's Milk Flasks or your own healing spells and abilities.
english.description: Our sentinels can fight for days on end, but even they have their limits. Since the mantid swarm began, too many of them have pushed themselves beyond their abilities.$b$bPlease, aid them in whatever way you can. If you are unable to heal them yourself, you may give them some of this. A mouthful of nutritious yak's milk will give them the strength they need.
english.completion: In times like these, we must trust in the power and protection of Niuzao. Should things get any worse, he will protect us.$B$BHe always does.
english.completed: Return to Yak-Keeper Kyana at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 敌人的刀也是刀
text.objectives: 缴获10件瑟拉提克武器。
text.description: 现在没时间墨守陈规了。石匠粗糙的双手已磨出血来，颤抖不已。铁匠铸造武器的速度还赶不上哨兵折断它们的速度。$b$b现在要用脑子去战斗。$b$b许多螳螂妖带着武器过来，当它们死了后，武器就草草地扔在战场上。白白浪费掉这些武器也太说不过去了。
text.progress: Our men are accustomed to fighting with maces and clubs. Unfortunatly, we have little time for customs.
text.completion: I will see to it that these are properly distributed. What's more - I'll make sure our blacksmiths get a rest. Niuzao knows they deserve it.
text.completed: Return to Ogo the Younger at the Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: A Blade is a Blade
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Sra'thik Weapons.
english.description: This is no time to hold to tradition. Our masons' calloused hands bleed and tremble. Our blacksmiths cannot forge weapons as quickly as our sentinels can break them.$b$bIt is time to fight smart.$b$bMany of the mantid come bearing weapons, and when they die, they simply leave them on the battlefield. It would be a shame to see them go to waste.
english.progress: Our men are accustomed to fighting with maces and clubs. Unfortunatly, we have little time for customs.
english.completion: I will see to it that these are properly distributed. What's more - I'll make sure our blacksmiths get a rest. Niuzao knows they deserve it.
english.completed: Return to Ogo the Younger at the Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 进贡
text.objectives: 获得6份砮皂食品存粮。你的砮皂勇夫会帮你运送食品。
text.description: 我们的老主顾砮皂就像是座流动的大山……动起来难，停下来就更难了。我认为：一旦我们让他动起来，螳螂妖肯定会想方设法地阻挠他前进。$b$b让他动起来最简单的办法就是把食物摆在他面前。我们很幸运，即便在打仗时寺院里面也食物充足。$b$b我会派一位勇夫与你同行，帮你扛些重物。
text.completion: He will get up. Soon. Maybe not today, but soon.$B$BAnd when he does...$B$B<A smile grows on Paosha's face.>
text.completed: Return to High Adept Paosha at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Paying Tribute
english.objectives: Obtain 6 stores of Niuzao Food. Your Niuzao Strongarm will carry the food for you.
english.description: Our patron Niuzao is a mountain on wheels... very difficult to move, even more difficult to stop. My point: once we get him moving, the mantid will have their arms full trying to slow him down.$b$bThe easiest way to get him moving is to put food in front of him. Luckily for us, food in our temple is plentiful... even in wartime.$b$bI will send one of my strongarms with you, to shoulder the load.
english.completion: He will get up. Soon. Maybe not today, but soon.$B$BAnd when he does...$B$B<A smile grows on Paosha's face.>
english.completed: Return to High Adept Paosha at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 重重包围
text.objectives: 在砮皂寺击败25名瑟拉提克攻击者。
text.description: 今天的螳螂妖部队是我见到过的最凶残的一支。幸好有砮皂跟我们并肩战斗。$b$b帮他一把，$c。回到庭院，加入到寺院的保卫战中。
text.completion: Look at him, $C.$B$BNothing can stop Niuzao. Only Niuzao can stop Niuzao.
text.completed: Return to Ogo the Elder at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Siege Swells
english.objectives: Defeat 25 Sra'thik attackers at Niuzao Temple.
english.description: Today's mantid swarm is among the worst I've seen. We are lucky to have Niuzao join us in battle.$b$bHelp him, $c. Return to the courtyard, and join in the defense of our temple.
english.completion: Look at him, $C.$B$BNothing can stop Niuzao. Only Niuzao can stop Niuzao.
english.completed: Return to Ogo the Elder at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 蜂拥而至
text.objectives: 击败4只瑟拉提克恐虫。
text.description: 由我来统率砮皂哨兵。城外的每一名守卫都能坚守岗位，抵御螳螂妖部队。$b$b但恐虫要另当别论了。$b$b它们数量众多，凶残恶毒，毫无疑问会对哨兵的安全构成最大的威胁。仅仅砮皂有机会战胜它们。砮皂……也许你也能。
text.completion: Put on our armor, and you'd be indistinguishable from any of the other sentinels out there.$B$BGood fighting, $R.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Commander Qipan at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Overwhelming Swarm
english.objectives: Defeat 4 Sra'thik Kunchong.
english.description: I command the sentinels of Niuzao. Every defender out there can hold his own against the mantid swarm.$b$bThe kunchong, however, are something different.$b$bThey are massive, violent, and without a question the biggest threat to my sentinels' lives. Only Niuzao stands a chance against them. Niuzao... and perhaps you.
english.completion: Put on our armor, and you'd be indistinguishable from any of the other sentinels out there.$B$BGood fighting, $R.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Commander Qipan at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 战争的阴影
text.objectives: 将10块松动的石头扔给砮皂石匠。
text.description: 砮皂能够参战真是万幸……无论是他的战斗力还是其他方面。$b$b由于他吸引了敌人的注意力，我们的石匠才有机会重建破碎的院墙。他们需要你的帮助。$b$b把你发现的任何松动的砖块都扔给石匠。动作要快！砮皂的冲杀不可能持续太久。
text.completion: It looks like the walls are beginning to take shape again. In time, the Temple will be whole again.
text.completed: Return to Yak-Keeper Kyana at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: In Battle's Shadow
english.objectives: Throw 10 Loose Stones up to Niuzao Stonemasons.
english.description: Niuzao's appearance on the battlefield is a blessing... in more ways than one.$b$bWith the distraction that he's caused, our stonemasons have seized the opportunity to build up our crumbling walls. They could use your help.$b$bToss any loose bricks you find up their way. And hurry! Niuzao will not rampage forever.
english.completion: It looks like the walls are beginning to take shape again. In time, the Temple will be whole again.
english.completed: Return to Yak-Keeper Kyana at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 摧毁战车
text.objectives: 破坏3辆瑟拉提克战车。
text.description: 螳螂妖正在用它们的地狱战车包围寺院，越快扫除这些威胁就对我们越有利。你可以使用自己的武器和魔法去摧毁它们，不过用这个应该更有效。$b$b<傲古递给你几桶简陋包装的炸药。>$b$b当心战车爆炸后，里面的螳螂妖会出来跟你拼命。事实上，我宁愿离那些东西越远越好。
text.completion: Good, you're back in one piece.$B$BWe hope to be seeing more of you in the future, $R.
text.completed: Return to Ogo the Younger at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Big Guns
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Sra'thik War Wagons.
english.description: The mantid now surround the Temple with their infernal war wagons. The sooner we are rid of those things, the better. You could destroy them with your own weapons and spells, but this will work much faster.$b$b<Ogo hands you a few small casks of hastily-packed explosives.>$b$bBeware of retaliation from mantid that remain be inside the war wagon when it explodes. In fact, I'd stay as far away from those things as possible.
english.completion: Good, you're back in one piece.$B$BWe hope to be seeing more of you in the future, $R.
english.completed: Return to Ogo the Younger at Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 小径归来
text.objectives: 去高岚阵向祝踏岚报告。
text.description: 我还要留在这条小路上收拾一下——仍有一些螳螂妖妄想溜进来。你真是我们手上的制胜法宝呀，我知道祝踏岚也不想看到我留你这么久却只做些打杂的活儿。$B$B祝踏岚应该还在大本营里，和高家军在一起。你回去报告一下，我稍后与你会合。
text.completion: Welcome back. I heard about the breaches in the eastern pass. It sounds like I put the right people on the job.

english.title: Returning from the Pass
english.objectives: Report in to Taran Zhu at the Gao-Ran Battlefront.
english.description: I still have some cleanup to do here in the pass - there are some mantid still making it through. You're a valuable person to have at hand though, and I know Taran wouldn't appreciate me keeping you longer for such basic work.$B$BTaran should still be in the main camp with Gao-Ran. Report back in. I'll catch up with you a bit later.
english.completion: Welcome back. I heard about the breaches in the eastern pass. It sounds like I put the right people on the job.

text.title: Savior of the Inkgill
text.objectives: Speak with Waterspeaker Gorai at the southwestern edge of Jinyu Mere.
text.description: I will go now to return to my kinsmen. Please visit us back at the southwestern edge of the Mere, so that we may thank you.

english.title: Savior of the Inkgill
english.objectives: Speak with Waterspeaker Gorai at the southwestern edge of Jinyu Mere.
english.description: I will go now to return to my kinsmen. Please visit us back at the southwestern edge of the Mere, so that we may thank you.

text.title: 战场铸甲师
text.objectives: 获得120块神真龟壳碎片。
text.description: 影踪派能征善战。正因如此，他们的盔甲经常会被划开、戳坏、磨破和烧毁。我的工作就是修复盔甲。$b$b我虽不是铸甲师，但只要盔甲上的破洞不大，我都可以修好。$b$b我喜欢使用龟壳碎片来修复盔甲，那些乌龟就生活在东北面的野外。找一些给我，我可以让更多影踪派门人重新披上盔甲，上阵杀敌。
text.progress: I refuse to let one of our kind fall just because of a broken set of armor.
text.completion: Excellent. I'll get to repairing the armor tonight, once most everyone's returned.
text.completed: Return to Provisioner Bamfu at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Field Armorer
english.objectives: Obtain 120 Rankbite Shell Fragments.
english.description: The Shado-Pan fight. As such, their armor often gets cut, scratched, torn, and burned. And it's my job to repair it.$b$bI'm no armorer, but I can repair a broken piece of mail as long as the hole's not too big.$b$bI prefer to use shell fragments from the tortoises that live in the wild fields to the northeast. Get some for me, and I can keep more Shado-Pan armored and alive.
english.progress: I refuse to let one of our kind fall just because of a broken set of armor.
english.completion: Excellent. I'll get to repairing the armor tonight, once most everyone's returned.
english.completed: Return to Provisioner Bamfu at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 合适的药膏
text.objectives: 采集11棵茅草。
text.description: 除了不让虫子爬进伤口以外，干燥的绷带简直没什么用。在一些营地，这是你能期待的最佳治疗方法了。$b$b但我这儿可不信这一套。$b$b我更倾向于找到些镇定舒缓的草药，然后制成药膏敷在绷带里。这里能找到的最具镇定舒缓功效的草药就是茅草了，它们生长在东北面的田地里。如果你看见就带回来。
text.progress: Any luck out there, $n?
text.completion: These will do.$B$BThe Shado-Pan appreciates your work, $n.
text.completed: Return to Provisioner Bamfu at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: A Proper Poultice
english.objectives: Obtain 11 Mao-Willows.
english.description: A dry bandage doesn't do much good, other than maybe keeping bugs out of the wound. In some camps, that's the best you can hope for.$b$bNot in my camp, though.$b$bI prefer to make a paste from whatever soothing herbs I can find, and layer that between bandages. The most soothing herbs I've been able to find in the field are the Mao-Willows from the fields in the northeast. If you run into any, bring them back.
english.progress: Any luck out there, $n?
english.completion: These will do.$B$BThe Shado-Pan appreciates your work, $n.
english.completed: Return to Provisioner Bamfu at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: Herding Cats
text.objectives: Collect 8 Litters of Xuen.
text.description: Xuen trusted me to watch kittens. I like kittens. They are small things and funny.$b$bBut I lost kittens. They are strong and many.$b$bXuen sure to say I can no longer watch kittens. I must find kittens. Will you help?$b$bTake my special cage and it will put them in a safe place.
text.completed: Speak with Groundskeeper Ponch at the Tiger Temple in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Herding Cats
english.objectives: Collect 8 Litters of Xuen.
english.description: Xuen trusted me to watch kittens. I like kittens. They are small things and funny.$b$bBut I lost kittens. They are strong and many.$b$bXuen sure to say I can no longer watch kittens. I must find kittens. Will you help?$b$bTake my special cage and it will put them in a safe place.
english.completed: Speak with Groundskeeper Ponch at the Tiger Temple in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 解救叛逆者
text.objectives: 营救墨鳃潭里的6名墨鳃叛逆者。
text.description: 并非所有的村民都被腐化了。许多人听从了我的警告，没有喝下被煞魔污染的水。$b$b他们正在守卫的威胁下惊恐地东躲西藏。$b$b请你去告诉他们，希望依然存在！快去北面的村子，与他们交谈，并让他们来找我吧。
text.completion: Though we may not seem like much, from these inauspicious beginnings I know we will rebuild. Thank you, friend.
text.completed: Return to Waterspeaker Gorai at Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Free the Dissenters
english.objectives: Rescue 6 Inkgill Dissenters in Inkgill Mere.
english.description: Not all of my fellow villagers from Inkgill are corrupted. Many heeded my warnings and did not drink of the sha-tainted waters.$b$bThey are in hiding, terrified, and intimidated by the guards.$b$bPlease, tell them there is hope! Go into the village to the north. Speak with them and send them to me.
english.completion: Though we may not seem like much, from these inauspicious beginnings I know we will rebuild. Thank you, friend.
english.completed: Return to Waterspeaker Gorai at Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 恨之煞
text.objectives: 击败恨之煞。
text.description: 猎捕行动能否终结取决于我们。我们已经集结了影踪派最优秀的战士，加上有你助我们一臂之力，我们一定能打败恨之煞，涤荡他在世间所造的罪孽。$B$B在进入隧道后，不要分散，听我的命令行事。打败煞魔几乎是不可能完成的任务，但我已制定周全的计划，确保万无一失。$B$B跟你并肩作战是我的荣幸，$n。
text.completion: Defeating a Sha... is not an easy thing. It is a miracle that we came out of this unscathed.$B$BTaran still blames himself for letting his hatred get the best of him and setting this beast loose upon the land. It may take some time for him to come to terms with this, but it is important that he does, lest he be vulnerable again.$B$BWe accomplished a great thing this day, a thing that will not soon be forgotten.$B$BAnd neither shall you for your hand in this. Thank you.
text.completed: Speak to Taoshi inside of the Sik'vess Lair in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Sha of Hatred
english.objectives: Defeat the Sha of Hatred.
english.description: The end of our hunt is upon us. We have gathered the strongest the Shado-Pan have to offer, and with your strength to aid us, we will defeat the Sha of Hatred and choke out its influence on the world.$B$BWhen we enter the tunnel, stay close, and keep hatred clear from your heart. The fight ahead will put all of us to the test.$B$BWhatever happens, it has been an honor traveling beside you, $n.
english.completion: Defeating a Sha... is not an easy thing. It is a miracle that we came out of this unscathed.$B$BTaran still blames himself for letting his hatred get the best of him and setting this beast loose upon the land. It may take some time for him to come to terms with this, but it is important that he does, lest he be vulnerable again.$B$BWe accomplished a great thing this day, a thing that will not soon be forgotten.$B$BAnd neither shall you for your hand in this. Thank you.
english.completed: Speak to Taoshi inside of the Sik'vess Lair in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 新的敌人
text.objectives: 从怒焰裂谷的教徒身上收集5块腐化徽章。
text.description: 这些黑暗萨满的邪恶力量吸引了众多附庸，$n。部落以前的成员现在也心怀鬼胎而暗自行动着。$b$b在另一个暮光之锤形成以前，我们应该惩戒他们以儆效尤。$b$b杀死你见到的所有教徒，把他们的徽章带回来给我。
text.progress: Have you collected the insignia?
text.completion: Good work, $n. This will make it very clear how Garrosh is going to deal with failures...
text.completed: Return to Invoker Xorenth inside Ragefire Chasm

english.title: A New Enemy
english.objectives: Collect 5 Corrupted Insignia from any cultist in Ragefire Chasm.
english.description: The power of these Dark Shaman has attracted many allies, $n. Former members of the Horde that now work towards some dark purpose.$b$bWe need to make an example of them before we have another twilight's hammer on our hands.$b$bKill any cultist you come across and bring me their insignia.
english.progress: Have you collected the insignia?
english.completion: Good work, $n. This will make it very clear how Garrosh is going to deal with failures...
english.completed: Return to Invoker Xorenth inside Ragefire Chasm

text.title: 憎恨的怒火
text.objectives: 击败9只灼热裂肢蝎。
text.description: 这些蝎子被煞魔控制了。它们怀着对入侵者的满腔仇恨，倾巢而出直奔我们的营地而来。$B$B我们得收拾掉这些蝎子，确保营地的安全。把它们全都击败。
text.completion: Good. What's left of the camp will be a bit safer.
text.completed: Return to Taoshi at Dusklight Hollow in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Enraged By Hatred
english.objectives: Kill 9 Seething Fleshrippers.
english.description: These scorpions are infected with sha. It seems to have driven them out of their hole and into our camp, seething with hatred at invaders in their territory.$B$BWe need to clear the scorpions and secure the camp. Kill any you find.
english.completion: Good. What's left of the camp will be a bit safer.
english.completed: Return to Taoshi at Dusklight Hollow in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 添加库存
text.objectives: 收集120支影踪派火箭。
text.description: 我是受命回营地来为我们驻守大桥的射手收集一些沥青箭支的，没想到却目睹了如此悲惨的一幕。这里大部分的熊猫人都跟我相识……我实在难以接受他们的离去。$B$B不过，大桥上的射手仍需要我们的帮助。如果你能帮我从残骸中收集一些箭矢，我们或许还能从这次灾难中挽回一点损失。
text.progress: The pandaren at the bridge are depending on us...
text.completion: I... you... er, thank you. You didn't have to help, but you did. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Initiate Pao-Me at Dusklight Hollow in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Taking Stock
english.objectives: Gather 120 Shado-Pan Fire Arrows.
english.description: I was dispatched back to camp to gather pitch-tipped arrows for our archers at the bridge, and this is what I came to. I trained with most of these pandaren... I wasn't prepared for this.$B$BStill, the archers at the bridge need our help. If you could help gather arrows from the wreckage, then maybe we can salvage something from this horror.
english.progress: The pandaren at the bridge are depending on us...
english.completion: I... you... er, thank you. You didn't have to help, but you did. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Initiate Pao-Me at Dusklight Hollow in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 加入战斗
text.objectives: 将一袋影踪派火箭交给黯光桥上的铁腹老陈。
text.description: 那边大桥上老陈的射手们正需要这些箭矢。你能带给他们吗？
text.progress: Welcome to the mess.
text.completion: Taran Zhu told me what became of my camp. I would have stopped it if I could, but the attacks from the bridge have not let up.$B$BThank you for bringing these arrows - my archers will make good use of them.

english.title: Joining the Fight
english.objectives: Bring the Quiver of Shado-Pan Fire Arrows to Lao-Chin the Iron Belly at Dusklight Bridge.
english.description: Lao-Chin's archers will need these arrows down at the bridge. Can you bring them?
english.progress: Welcome to the mess.
english.completion: Taran Zhu told me what became of my camp. I would have stopped it if I could, but the attacks from the bridge have not let up.$B$BThank you for bringing these arrows - my archers will make good use of them.

text.title: 火攻
text.objectives: 利用老陈的酒桶击败10只库尔提克噬木者。
text.description: 出现在大桥上的螳螂妖都有厚厚的甲壳，我们大部分的进攻对它们都不起作用。不过它们也有弱点：怕火。$B$B老陈的人把酒桶带到战场上来就是为了这个目的。把酒桶踢到螳螂妖的阵地上去，然后老陈的射手就会引爆这些酒桶。$B$B火攻应该可以轻易消灭它们。
text.completion: We have the added benefit that the mantid will leave with broken morale after watching their brethren burn to death. Grim, but many lives will be spared if they simply stop pressing our lines.
text.completed: Return to Taran Zhu at Dusklight Bridge in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Up In Flames
english.objectives: Kill 10 Kor'thik Timberhusks with the aid of Lao-Chin's kegs.
english.description: The mantid coming across the bridge have thick carapaces that shrug off most of our attacks. They have a weakness though: fire.$B$BLao-Chen's men brought kegs to the battlefield for exactly this purpose.  Kick the kegs into groups of mantid, and Lao-Chin's archers will light them up.$B$BThey should be easy to finish off from there.
english.completion: We have the added benefit that the mantid will leave with broken morale after watching their brethren burn to death. Grim, but many lives will be spared if they simply stop pressing our lines.
english.completed: Return to Taran Zhu at Dusklight Bridge in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: Raising Spirits
text.objectives: Throw 8 Iron Belly Spirits to nearby Dusklight Skirmishers and Dusklight Rangers.
text.description: The kegs are full of my worst stock. Good for burning, crap for drinking.$B$BI've broken out some tankards of my best spirits and had them carried out amongst the kegs though - those are for my well-deserving men!  Spirits to raise their spirits after endless, grueling fighting.$B$BWould you be up for spreading the good cheer?
text.completed: Return to Lao-Chin the Iron Belly at Dusklight Bridge in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Raising Spirits
english.objectives: Throw 8 Iron Belly Spirits to nearby Dusklight Skirmishers and Dusklight Rangers.
english.description: The kegs are full of my worst stock. Good for burning, crap for drinking.$B$BI've broken out some tankards of my best spirits and had them carried out amongst the kegs though - those are for my well-deserving men!  Spirits to raise their spirits after endless, grueling fighting.$B$BWould you be up for spreading the good cheer?
english.completed: Return to Lao-Chin the Iron Belly at Dusklight Bridge in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 占领黯光桥
text.objectives: 帮助铁腹老陈防守黯光桥的远端。
text.description: 让我们把这些昆虫杀回桥下，打到它们落花流水！$B$B听我指挥。
text.completion: The mantid aren't likely to return soon after a beating like that... and now Lao-Chin is free to join us in the hunt.
text.completed: Speak to Taran Zhu at the Dusklight Bridge in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Taking of Dusklight Bridge
english.objectives: Help Lao-Chin the Iron Belly hold the far side of the Dusklight Bridge.
english.description: Let's press these insects back across the bridge and break their spirits!$B$BFollow my lead.
english.completion: The mantid aren't likely to return soon after a beating like that... and now Lao-Chin is free to join us in the hunt.
english.completed: Speak to Taran Zhu at the Dusklight Bridge in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 加入狩猎
text.objectives: 骑上坐骑，和祝踏岚、陶矢还有老陈一同前往任塞道口。
text.description: 我们是个强大的整体。你的帮助功不可没。$B$B让我们前往任塞道口，找寻队伍里的最后一位成员吧。
text.completion: We are close. I can feel the unnatural hatred surging.$B$BIt's a testament to the training of the Shado-Pan that the forces here have not been consumed by its influence.

english.title: Joining the Hunt
english.objectives: Ride with Taran Zhu, Taoshi, and Lao-Chin to Rensai's Watchpost.
english.description: We are one stronger. Your help is invaluable.$B$BLet's move on westward to Rensai's Watchpost to find the last member for our party.
english.completion: We are close. I can feel the unnatural hatred surging.$B$BIt's a testament to the training of the Shado-Pan that the forces here have not been consumed by its influence.

text.title: 落地欢迎
text.objectives: 击败12个落地的库尔提克疾翼战士。
text.description: 我所有的手下都派去西南面的远戍哨站了，全力阻止那些企图飞越裂谷的螳螂妖。只要我的神射手手上还有可用之箭，任何飞过裂谷的螳螂妖都难逃一劫。$B$B如果你是来帮忙的话，我需要更多的人手趁着螳螂妖落地之际将它们彻底消灭。你愿意去吗，$c？
text.completion: Your efforts are appreciated, $C. Even a few more moment's breath between attacks are a relief these days.
text.completed: Return to Rensai Oakhide at Rensai's Watchpost in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Grounded Welcome
english.objectives: Kill 12 grounded Kor'thik Fleetwings.
english.description: All of my men are down at Farwatch Overlook to the southwest, holding off mantid that are trying to fly across the chasm. As long as my marksmen have arrows, they'll ground any mantid that clear the chasm.$B$BIf you're here to help, I could use some more men clearing the mantid out once they're on the ground. Are you willing, $c?
english.completion: Your efforts are appreciated, $C. Even a few more moment's breath between attacks are a relief these days.
english.completed: Return to Rensai Oakhide at Rensai's Watchpost in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 愤怒的天空
text.objectives: 击落50个库尔提克集结者和沃尔斯萨里克。
text.description: 该是我们大干一场的时候了……$B$B如果你愿意，去那边拿起火炮，加入战斗。这里绝对不会缺少目标的。
text.completion: Excellent shooting!$B$BI'm pretty sure that big bug survived the fall though...
text.completed: Return to Hawkmaster Nurong at Farwatch Overlook in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Hostile Skies
english.objectives: Shoot down 50 Kor'thik Swarmers and Voress'thalik.
english.description: We're about to get hit hard... $B$BPick up that cannon there and lend a hand, if you would.  There will be no shortage of targets.
english.completion: Excellent shooting!$B$BI'm pretty sure that big bug survived the fall though...
english.completed: Return to Hawkmaster Nurong at Farwatch Overlook in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 毁灭
text.objectives: 在鹰眼大师砮荣的协助下打败沃尔斯萨里克。
text.description: 咱们俩到下面去，结果了那只大家伙吧。
text.completion: Where have you been all my life?! That was amazing!$B$BI'd be proud to fight beside you any day.

english.title: Devastation Below
english.objectives: Defeat Voress'thalik with the aid of Hawkmaster Nurong.
english.description: Let's get down there and finish that big bug off, you and I.
english.completion: Where have you been all my life?! That was amazing!$B$BI'd be proud to fight beside you any day.

text.title: 影踪派的英雄
text.objectives: 和鹰眼大师砮荣一起回任塞道口找祝踏岚。
text.description: 你说祝踏岚来到了螳螂高原，而且还要找我？一定是出了什么大事……
text.completion: I like that I can always depend on you. You have the spirit of a true Shado-Pan.

english.title: Heroes of the Shado-Pan
english.objectives: Return with Hawkmaster Nurong to Taran Zhu at Rensai's Watchpost.
english.description: You said that Taran Zhu is in Townlong and was asking for me?  Must be something important...
english.completion: I like that I can always depend on you. You have the spirit of a true Shado-Pan.

text.title: 陶矢和考维克西斯
text.objectives: 在陶矢的协助下击败考维克西斯。
text.description: 陶矢正在希克维斯的南侧埋伏一名螳螂妖首领。她的任务是找回他的水晶，好让我们打开大门。$B$B人多力量大。我希望你前往那里，确保一切顺利。
text.completion: The first crystal is ours...
text.completed: Meet with Taran Zhu outside of the Sik'vess Lair in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Taoshi and Korvexxis
english.objectives: Kill Korvexxis with the aid of Taoshi.
english.description: Taoshi is setting up an ambush for one of the mantid leaders on the south side of Sik'vess. She is tasked with retrieving his crystal so that we can use it to open the door.$B$BTwo are stronger than one. I want you there to make sure it goes smoothly.
english.completion: The first crystal is ours...
english.completed: Meet with Taran Zhu outside of the Sik'vess Lair in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 动物控制
text.objectives: 杀死阿达罗格和焰喉。
text.description: 这条裂谷里到处都是烈焰猎犬和熔岩虫，他们依靠庞大的穴居人种群的肉为食维持着他们无限的繁衍生息。$b$b这种情况必须在它们破坏城市之前得到处理。你看起来可以独自解决这个问题，$n。$b$b我要你在那群野兽中杀出一条路来，而且务必要解决掉最大的麻烦——阿德杰里斯和焰喉。
text.completion: Good work, $n. Who knows what kind of destruction those beasts would have caused.
text.completed: 回怒焰裂谷里找指挥官巴格兰。

english.title: Animal Control
english.objectives: Kill Adarogg and Slagmaw.
english.description: The chasm is overrun with flame hounds and lava worms, and they will be entrenched indefinitely with such a large supply of trogg flesh for food.$b$bThis infestation needs to be taken care of now, before they endanger the city. You look like you can handle yourself, $n.$b$bI want you to clear a path through the beasts and make certain to take out the largest threats, Adjules and Magnaw.
english.completion: Good work, $n. Who knows what kind of destruction those beasts would have caused.
english.completed: Return to Commander Bagran inside Ragefire Chasm.

text.title: 黑暗萨满
text.objectives: 击败黑暗萨满柯兰萨和熔岩守卫戈多斯。
text.description: 这些黑暗萨满盘踞在下边已经几个月了，他们豢养野兽，还举行各种黑暗的仪式。$b$b我不知道他们做这些是想达到什么目的，但是很明显他们不是部落的朋友。而这就是我们需要你的原因，$n。$b$b在裂谷里杀出一条路来，干掉黑暗萨满柯兰萨和熔岩守卫戈多斯。
text.completion: It would seem that the dark shaman experiments drove Gordoth insane.$B$BHopefully we've seen the last of this, $n.
text.completed: Return to Invoker Xorenth in Ragefire Chasm.

english.title: The Dark Shaman
english.objectives: Defeat Dark Shaman Koranthal and Lava Guard Gordoth.
english.description: These dark shaman have been down here for months, raising beasts and performing dark rituals.$b$bI don't know what they aim to achieve with all of this, but it's clear that they are no friend of the Horde. That's where you come in, $n.$b$bFight your way through the chasm and kill Dark Shaman Koranthal and Lava Guard Gordoth.
english.completion: It would seem that the dark shaman experiments drove Gordoth insane.$B$BHopefully we've seen the last of this, $n.
english.completed: Return to Invoker Xorenth in Ragefire Chasm.

text.title: 不丢下一个兽人
text.objectives: 去怒焰裂谷营救5个库卡隆斥候。
text.description: 这本是例行的肃清工作，$n。收拾掉一些穴居人，确保城市不会受到威胁，然后中午去旅店。$b$b但我有一队斥候却不见了踪影，烈焰猎犬从裂谷倾泻而出，克索伦斯还在那唠叨着“另一个暮光之锤”。$b$b<指挥官巴格兰啐了一口唾沫>$b$b你去探探情况，找回我的斥候，这样才知道下面到底发生了什么事情。
text.completion: That's all that survived?$B$BI don't know who these Dark Shaman are working for, but they are going to pay for this.
text.completed: Return to Commander Bagran inside Ragefire Chasm.

english.title: No Orc Left Behind
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Kor'kron Scouts in Ragefire Chasm.
english.description: This was supposed to be a routine sweep, $n. Clean up a few troggs, make sure there is no threat to the city and then be in the tavern by midday.$b$bInstead I've a group of scouts missing, flame hounds pouring out of the chasm and Xorenth going on about "the next twilight's hammer."$b$b<Commander Bagran spits>$b$bGo in there and get my scouts back so we can figure out what is going on down here.
english.completion: That's all that survived?$B$BI don't know who these Dark Shaman are working for, but they are going to pay for this.
english.completed: Return to Commander Bagran inside Ragefire Chasm.

text.title: 上古魔古地穴
text.objectives: 杀死被附体的影踪派首领，净化生命之池。
text.description: 我们的斥候小队被消灭了。救命啊！

english.title: Ancient Mogu Crypt
english.objectives: Kill the possessed Shado-Pan Leader and cleanse the Pool of Life.
english.description: Our scouting party got DESTROYED.  Help!

text.title: 加入联盟
text.objectives: 与暴风要塞中的安度因·乌瑞恩国王交谈。
text.description: 我们有一份使命，$n。$b$b我们要将土水之道传至迷踪岛之外的世界……要履行这份使命，联盟的中心——暴风城，就是一个绝佳的起点。$b$b去找到他们的领袖，我们需要盟友。
text.completion: Pandaren... you're here.$b$bGood.

english.title: Joining the Alliance
english.objectives: Speak with King Anduin Wrynn at Stormwind Keep.
english.description: We have a duty, $n.$b$bIt is our responsibility to spread the Tushui philosophy beyond the edges of the Wandering Isle... and there is no better place to start doing that than here: Stormwind City, heart of the Alliance.$b$bLet's find out who their leader is. We need allies.
english.completion: Pandaren... you're here.$b$bGood.

text.title: 联盟之道
text.objectives: 跟着瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王。
text.description: 我对你们一族知之甚少，除了有人告诉过我，说是你们中有一些人会来到我们这边。如果你们愿意加入我们的阵线，那么我也会很高兴地接纳你们作为盟友。$b$b$n，你跟我过来。
text.completion: Before you go, $n - I have one more thing to discuss with you.
text.completed: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.

english.title: The Alliance Way
english.objectives: Walk with King Varian Wrynn.
english.description: I only recently received word that some of your kind might be coming our way. I'd be glad to call you an ally, if you're willing to join our cause.$b$bWalk with me, $n.
english.completion: Before you go, $n - I have one more thing to discuss with you.
english.completed: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.

text.title: 比武高手
text.objectives: 与瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王过招。
text.description: 我需要知道你是否是个合格的战士。今后也许你会受我召唤奔赴沙场，我想知道你是否有能力保护我的王国。$b$b我早已耳闻过熊猫人的“武术”技巧，却未得亲眼一见。$b$b你准备好了吗？
text.completion: You've more than proven your worth, in battle and in heart. Few would be willing to leave their homeland to join the Alliance. Fewer still would be willing to face the King of Stormwind in combat.$b$bYou, and the rest of your people, are welcome among our ranks. Welcome to the Alliance, $n.
text.completed: 去找暴风要塞中的瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王。

english.title: An Old Pit Fighter
english.objectives: Spar with King Varian Wrynn.
english.description: I need to know if you can fight. There may come a time where you will be called upon for military matters, and I need to know that you can protect my kingdom.$b$bI've heard stories about pandaren fighting techniques, but I've never seen them in person.$b$bShall we?
english.completion: You've more than proven your worth, in battle and in heart. Few would be willing to leave their homeland to join the Alliance. Fewer still would be willing to face the King of Stormwind in combat.$b$bYou, and the rest of your people, are welcome among our ranks. Welcome to the Alliance, $n.
english.completed: Return to King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep.

text.title: 侧翻的酒桶！
text.objectives: 拿起老陈身边的一个酒桶，朝山下那些野牛人滚过去，并在接近目标时点燃它，消灭4部奥苏尔投树车和50个奥苏尔入侵者。
text.description:
在接受酒仙的训练时，我从未想到会这样使用自己的知识……

你知不知道啤酒遇火能燃烧？好吧，再混入些野牛人油脂，它就成了地地道道的炸药。

我已经在这些酒桶里混入了油脂。把这些酒桶滚向门边的野牛人，然后在接近目标时点燃它们。

这些酒桶会在几秒后爆炸，但当它爆炸时……

好吧，我可不想呆在那儿。

所以我会呆在这里。哀悼这些美酒的逝去。
text.completion: Whoo, that was an explosion! Several, in fact.$B$BSad my beer had to go, but at least we're safe, for now.
text.completed: Return to Lao-Chin the Iron Belly at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Do a Barrel Roll!
english.objectives: Pick up a keg near Lao-Chin, roll it downhill at the yaungol, and ignite it near them to destroy 4 Osul Treelaunchers and 50 Osul Invaders.
english.description:
When I trained as a Brewmaster, I didn't expect to use my knowledge like this...

Did you know beer catches fire when lit? Well, with yaungol oil mixed in, it's downright explosive.

I've mixed the oil in with these kegs. Roll them at the yaungol over by the gate, and ignite them when you get close. 

It'll take a few seconds for the keg to blow, but when it does...

Well, let's just say I wouldn't want to be over there.

Which is why I'll be over here. Mourning the loss of this brew.
english.completion: Whoo, that was an explosion! Several, in fact.$B$BSad my beer had to go, but at least we're safe, for now.
english.completed: Return to Lao-Chin the Iron Belly at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 终结！
text.objectives: 结束玄牛关的战斗。
text.description:
我们收到了孙娜来自长城的回报。事情有些蹊跷……

看来他们准备要孤注一掷了。是时候结束这一切了，朋友。
text.completion: Well, their lieutenant is dead. I think we have finally pushed them out of Kun-Lai. $B$BBut at what cost? So many dead, Lin captured... I will not allow Taran Zhu to continue to ignore his charge.
text.completed: Speak with Ban Bearheart at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Finish This!
english.objectives: Finish the battle for the Ox Gate.
english.description:
We've heard back from Suna, on the wall. Something's going on...

It looks like they are preparing for their final push. It's time to finish this, friend.
english.completion: Well, their lieutenant is dead. I think we have finally pushed them out of Kun-Lai. $B$BBut at what cost? So many dead, Lin captured... I will not allow Taran Zhu to continue to ignore his charge.
english.completed: Speak with Ban Bearheart at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 我的援军在哪儿？
text.objectives: 和昆莱山影踪禅院外的班·熊心谈一谈。
text.description:
事态已经发展到很严重的地步了。我不能再坐视不管了。

根据这里发生的一切，再加上你在火树村的经历，我们必须到禅院去。

无论他们在那里干什么都得先放下！我们可以坐我的气球上山到禅院去。气球就在东北方的营地那里停着。
text.completion: Here we are, and now you know why we cannot let our brothers sit idly by.

english.title: Where are My Reinforcements?
english.objectives: Speak with Ban Bearheart outside the Shado-Pan Monastery in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
This has simply gone too far. I cannot ignore our abandonment any longer.

After all that's happened here, and all you've been through in Firebough, we must travel to the monastery.

Whatever they are doing in there can wait! We can take my balloon up the mountain to the Monastery. It's anchored back by the camp, to the northeast.
english.completion: Here we are, and now you know why we cannot let our brothers sit idly by.

objectiveDetails.description: 告诉班你准备好出发了
乘坐班的热气球前往影踪禅院

text.title: 老陈的金点子
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的冬花营，和那里的铁腹老陈谈一谈。
text.description:
很好。多亏了你，城墙已经在我们的控制之下了。干得好。

我还要在这里坚持一会儿，直到确保不再会有野牛人到城墙上来。

而你，应该回到下边去，看看老陈到底搞出了点什么名堂。我不愿意这样说，但或许他会有什么好点子……
text.completion: Good to see you made it back in one piece. Thanks to your help with the barrels, I've managed to brew up a good surprise for our yaungol friends at the front.

english.title: Lao-Chin's Gambit
english.objectives: Speak with Lao-Chin the Iron Belly at Winter's Blossom in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
Alright. Thanks to you, we have the wall under control. Good job. 

I'll stay up here for a little while and make sure no more yaungol get up onto the wall.

You, though, should go back down and see what Lao-Chin has cooked up. I hate to say it, but maybe he had a good idea after all...
english.completion: Good to see you made it back in one piece. Thanks to your help with the barrels, I've managed to brew up a good surprise for our yaungol friends at the front.

objectiveDetails.description: 与孙娜·默拳交谈并乘坐风筝去找铁腹老陈

text.title: 一个都不能少
text.objectives: 在怒焰裂谷内营救5名军情七处游侠。
text.description: 一小时前我派出了几名侦察兵，可他们一个都没回来。现在这些讨厌的恶犬正从裂谷中蜂拥而出。$b$b我不知道下面发生了什么，但在找回我的人之前我哪儿也不会去的。$b$b我希望你能进到那里去找找他们，$n，希望他们还都活着。
text.completion: That's all that survived?$B$BThe Horde is going to pay for this in blood.
text.completed: Return to SI:7 Field Commander Dirken inside Ragefire Chasm.

english.title: No Man Left Behind
english.objectives: Rescue 5 SI:7 Rangers in Ragefire Chasm.
english.description: I sent recon out over an hour ago and none of them have reported back. And now these damned hounds are pouring out of the chasm.$b$bI don't know what's going on down there, but I'm not going anywhere till I get my men back.$b$bI want you to head in there and find them, $n, preferably while they are still alive.
english.completion: No one else survived? $B$bThe horde will pay for it in blood.
english.completed: Return to SI:7 Field Commander Dirken inside Ragefire Chasm.

starters.name: 军情七处指挥官德尔肯

enders.name: 军情七处指挥官德尔肯

text.title: 黑暗萨满
text.objectives: 打败黑暗萨满柯兰萨和熔岩守卫戈多斯。
text.description: 这些黑暗萨满几个月前就潜伏于此，饲养野兽并举行黑暗仪式。$b$b我不知道他们做这一切的目的是什么，但很明显他们绝不是联盟的朋友。请帮我阻止他们，$n。$b$b在裂谷里杀出一条血路，最后杀死黑暗萨满柯兰萨和熔岩守卫戈多斯。
text.completion: It would seem that the dark shaman experiments drove Gordoth insane.$B$BHopefully we've seen the last of this, $n.
text.completed: Return to High Sorceress Aryna in Ragefire Chasm.

english.title: The Dark Shaman
english.objectives: Defeat Dark Shaman Koranthal and Lava Guard Gordoth.
english.description: These dark shaman have been down here for months, raising beasts and performing dark rituals.$b$bI don't know what they aim to achieve with all of this, but it's clear that they are no friend of the Alliance. And I need your help stopping them, $n. $b$bFight your way through the chasm and kill Dark Shaman Koranthal and Lava Guard Gordoth.
english.completion: Похоже, эксперименты с черной магией свели Гордота с ума.$b$bНадеюсь, $n, что на этом все закончится.
english.completed: Return to High Sorceress Aryna in Ragefire Chasm.

text.title: 削减战力
text.objectives: 杀死阿达罗格和焰喉。
text.description: 我很高兴你能来，$n。部落正在集结军队，而我也不打算等查明原委后再行动。$b$b我们要先发制人，去下面干掉几个他们的大型野兽。$b$b我希望你能在部落将阿达罗格和焰喉用作对抗我们的武器之前，把这两个家伙先处理掉。
text.completion: Good work, $n. Who knows what kind of destruction those beasts would have caused.
text.completed: 回怒焰裂谷内找军情七处指挥官德尔肯。

english.title: Animal Control
english.objectives: Kill Adarogg and Slagmaw.
english.description: I'm glad you're here, $n. The horde is amassing an army and I'm not going to wait to find out why.$b$bWe need to strike fast and take down some of the larger beasts they have down here.$b$bI want you to head in there and take care of Adarogg and Slagmaw before the horde can use them as weapons against us.
english.completion: Отлично, $n. Кто знает, каких бед натворили бы эти чудовища.
english.completed: Return to SI:7 Field Commander Dirken inside Ragefire Chasm.

starters.name: 军情七处指挥官德尔肯

enders.name: 军情七处指挥官德尔肯

text.title: 新的敌人
text.objectives: 从黑暗萨满教徒身上收集5个腐化徽章。
text.description: 部落正在用黑暗魔法控制这里的野兽，并腐化它们的同伴，$n。$b$b我想要阻止这一切，但首先我要了解我们的敌人。这正是你所要做的事情。$b$b杀进洞穴，收集教徒身上的徽记。有了这些徽记，我就能研究出在此处肆虐的究竟是何种魔法。
text.progress: Have you collected the insignia?
text.completion: Good work, $n. Now we can figure out what it is they were trying to achieve down here.
text.completed: Return to High Sorceress Aryna inside Ragefire Chasm

english.title: A New Enemy
english.objectives: Collect 5 Corrupted Insignia from the Dark Shaman cultists.
english.description: The horde is using dark magic to control beasts and corrupt their brethren down here, $n.$b$bI intend to put a stop to it, but first I need to know what it is we're fighting against. That's where you come in.$b$bFight through the caverns and collect the insignia that the cultists carry. With them, I can study what type of magic is at work here.
english.progress: Have you collected the insignia?
english.completion: Отлично, $n. Теперь мы узнаем, что им здесь было нужно.
english.completed: Return to High Sorceress Aryna inside Ragefire Chasm

text.title: 朝圣之旅
text.objectives: 和酒坛集的表叔苜蓿叶谈一谈。
text.description: 最艰难的道路往往教会我们很多，$c。追随少昊走过的道路无疑能让我学到更多东西。$b$b许多年以前，少昊曾前往昆莱之巅寻求青龙的指引，我也将前往探索者营地寻求智慧。$b$b你有兴趣与我同行么？如果你愿意，就去和表叔苜蓿叶谈一谈。他会帮你做准备工作的。
text.completion: Travel to Seeker's Point will require much good fortune, $C. Hopefully you have many lucky trinkets!

english.title: Path Less Traveled
english.objectives: Speak to Uncle Cloverleaf in Onekeg.
english.description: The toughest roads often have the most to teach us, $c. I will no doubt learn a great deal from following the path of Shaohao.$b$bMany years ago Shaohao traveled to the highest peak in Kun-Lai to seek the guidance of the Jade Serpent. I too will travel to Seeker's Point in search of wisdom.$b$bPerhaps you would be interested in a journey such as this? If so speak with Uncle Cloverleaf. He will help you prepare.
english.completion: Travel to Seeker's Point will require much good fortune, $c. Hopefully you have many lucky trinkets!

text.title: 恐惧空间
text.objectives: 去蟠龙脊和女射手李琪薇谈一谈。
text.description: 蟠龙脊上的影踪派神射手时时刻刻都在监视着恐惧废土。他们一定会欢迎像你一样训练有素的$c的协助。$B$B坐上风筝，去向女射手李琪薇报到吧。
text.completion: A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.$B$BPleased to meet you.
text.completed: 去蟠龙脊和女射手李琪薇谈一谈。

english.title: Dread Space
english.objectives: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine.
english.description: Shado-Pan marksmen keep a constant watch over the Dread Wastes from the top of the Serpent's Spine. They would surely welcome the aid of a skilled $c such as yourself.$B$BTake a kite and check in with Bowmistress Li.
english.completion: A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.$B$BPleased to meet you.
english.completed: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine.

text.title: 坠落
text.objectives: 使用影踪派绳索下到格尔桑平台并搜寻坠落的影踪派神射手。
text.description: 要顶住螳螂妖的进攻就已经够让人头大了，现在居然废墟下的蜘蛛又一窝蜂地冒出来。$B$B我最优秀的一名神射手被一股蛛丝缠住了腿，直接被拖了下去！$B$B我们觉得他应该还没死，但实在腾不出人手派去营救他了。我们在这边已忙得焦头烂额，$c。$B$B如果你想帮忙，我身后有捆绳索，你用它潜入废墟下面吧。你没恐高症吧？$B$B怕不怕蜘蛛？
text.completion: The fall wasn't that bad, actually. I've always had a knack for soft landings.$B$BThat I landed on a pile of spider corpses probably helped, too.
text.completed: Speak with Marksman Lann at the Terrace of Gurthan in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Falling Down
english.objectives: Use the Shado-Pan Rope to descend into the Terrace of Gurthan and search for the fallen Shado-Pan marksman.
english.description: It's bad enough trying to hold off the mantid, but now we've got spiders swarming up from the ruins below.$B$BOne of my best marksmen caught a blast of webbing around his leg and got pulled straight down!$B$BWe think he's alive, but I don't have the manpower to send anyone in after him. We're stretched thin up here, $c.$B$BIf you want to help, use the rope behind me to drop down into the ruins. You're not afraid of heights are you?$B$BHow about spiders?
english.completion: The fall wasn't that bad, actually. I've always had a knack for soft landings.$B$BThat I landed on a pile of spider corpses probably helped, too.
english.completed: Speak with Marksman Lann at the Terrace of Gurthan in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 绝不
text.objectives: 在格尔桑平台杀死6只恐惧织网小蜘蛛并使用影踪派龙枪来摧毁20个恐惧织网蛛的卵。
text.description: 我们正在坚守，但恐怕支撑不了多久了。如果你能想办法阻止从墙里爬出的大量恐惧织网蛛，那可真是帮了大忙了。$B$B想徒手打破蜘蛛卵？$B$B没那么容易。带上一支我们的龙枪，去下面烧掉它们。我希望能够把这些可恶的东西烧爆。
text.completion: Nice work with that dragon gun. I did what I could down here, but arrows are only so useful against these things.
text.completed: Locate the fallen Shado-Pan marksman in the Terrace of Gurthan.

english.title: Nope
english.objectives: Slay 6 Dreadspinner Tenders and use the Shado-Pan Dragon Gun to destroy 20 Dreadspinner Eggs in the Terrace of Gurthan.
english.description: We're holding, but just barely. Anything you can do to stem the tide of dreadspinners coming up the wall would be a big help.$B$BFeel like tearing open spider eggs one at a time by hand?$B$BI didn't think so. Take one of our dragon guns and light it up down there. I wanna hear those puppies pop.
english.completion: Nice work with that dragon gun. I did what I could down here, but arrows are only so useful against these things.
english.completed: Locate the fallen Shado-Pan marksman in the Terrace of Gurthan.

text.title: 疯狂螳螂妖
text.objectives: 在格尔桑平台调查螳螂妖混战。
text.description: 你绝对不会相信我看到了什么！有两只螳螂妖在里面对打，用强大的魔法互相攻击。$B$B其中一只的样子跟我见过的所有螳螂妖都不同，颜色和衣服完全不一样，就像某种……预言家之类的。另外一只则完全是个疯子，他就像一桶风暴烈酒陈酿一样到处泼洒煞能。$B$B你看，我得回岗位上去了，但那两个螳螂妖还在我身后的洞穴里打得不亦乐乎，我觉得这应该是件不得了的事。你去看看吧？
text.completion: <This mantid is severely wounded. He barely manages to choke forth his words between wheezing gasps for breath.>$B$BHold, $R...$B$BWe are... not your enemy.
text.completed: Speak wtih Klaxxi'va Tik in the Terrace of Gurthan.
text.giverWindow: 螳螂妖像使用武器一样使用煞的力量？这怎么可能？

english.title: Psycho Mantid
english.objectives: Investigate the mantid infighting at the Terrace of Gurthan.
english.description: You aren't going to believe what I saw! Two mantid fighting each other, whipping some serious magic back and forth.$B$BOne of them didn't look like any mantid I've ever seen. Completely different color and dress to him, like some kind of... oracle or something. The other one was a total psycho, splashing sha energy around like it was a keg of Stormstout Special.$B$BLook, I gotta get back to my post, but those two are still fighting in the cave behind me and I have a feeling it's a big deal. Check it out?
english.completion: <This mantid is severely wounded. He barely manages to choke forth his words between wheezing gasps for breath.>$B$BHold, $R...$B$BWe are... not your enemy.
english.completed: Speak wtih Klaxxi'va Tik in the Terrace of Gurthan.
english.giverWindow: A mantid wielding the power of sha like a weapon? How can this be?

text.title: 保存于琥珀中
text.objectives: 对格尔桑平台上的大块远古琥珀使用卡拉克西音叉。
text.description: 收下……这个……$B$B<垂死的螳螂妖挣扎着伸出手臂。在他严重变形的手掌中握着一把金属叉子，两根又细又长的叉齿，叉柄上装饰着华丽的珠宝。>$B$B唤醒……掠风者……$B$B这是消灭虫群的……唯一方法。
text.completion: The Klaxxi... call to me.
text.completed: Speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in the Terrace of Gurthan.

english.title: Preserved in Amber
english.objectives: Use the Klaxxi Tuning Fork on the Ancient Amber Chunk in the Terrace of Gurthan.
english.description: Take... this...$B$B<The dying mantid struggles to outstretch his arm. In his mangled grasp rests a metal fork with two long, thin prongs and an ornately jeweled handle.>$B$BAwaken... the Wind-Reaver...$B$BIt is the only way... to end the swarm.
english.completion: The Klaxxi... call to me.
english.completed: Speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in the Terrace of Gurthan.

objectiveDetails.description: 对琥珀使用卡拉克西音叉

text.title: 虚弱的觉醒
text.objectives: 将100份树萤残肢带给格尔桑平台的掠风者克尔鲁克。
text.description: 原谅我现在的虚弱状态，我已经沉睡了很多年。$B$B卡拉克西瓦应该也派人带着凯帕圣树的树脂参加了我的唤醒仪式……但你也得做点什么。$B$B我感应到南边有树脂萤火虫在嗡嗡作响。它们所饱食的营养树脂正是我所需要的，把它们带回来给我。
text.progress: Without nourishment, I will die where I stand.
text.completion: This will do.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in the Terrace of Gurthan.

english.title: Wakening Sickness
english.objectives: Bring 100 Sapfly Bits to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in the Terrace of Gurthan.
english.description: You will forgive my current state. I have slept for many years.$B$BA Klaxxi'va should have been here to attend my Wakening with kypari sap... but you will have to do.$B$BI sense the buzzing of sapflies to the south. They gorge on the nourishing sap I need. Bring them to me.
english.progress: Without nourishment, I will die where I stand.
english.completion: This will do.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in the Terrace of Gurthan.

text.title: 卡拉克西议会
text.objectives: 前往恐惧废土中部的卡拉克西维斯。你可以和格尔桑平台的掠风者克尔鲁克谈一谈，让他带你过去，或自己飞过去。
text.description: 我必须去向卡拉克西报告了。要不是事态紧急，他们是不会把我唤醒的。$B$B你还是有点用处的。因此，我就饶你一命。$B$B议会或许还用得着你。
text.completion: This is a sacred meeting place for the Klaxxi.$B$BIt would be wise of you to let me do the talking.
text.completed: Speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: The Klaxxi Council
english.objectives: Travel to Klaxxi'vess at the center of the Dread Wastes. You may speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in the Terrace of Gurthan for a ride, or travel on your own.
english.description: I must report to the Klaxxi. They would not have woken me unless the situation were dire.$B$BYou have not been entirely useless. For that, I will spare your life.$B$BThe council may even find a use for you.
english.completion: This is a sacred meeting place for the Klaxxi.$B$BIt would be wise of you to let me do the talking.
english.completed: Speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 超速生长
text.objectives: 在夏柯希尔之巢杀死6个夏柯希尔虫巢守卫。
text.description: 女皇之巢已经成了一个恶心的噩梦！虫巢守卫们正加紧研制新的聚生虫，在把它们送去城墙之前用邪恶的煞能感染它们。$B$B卡拉克西希望遏止住这些可怕的虫巢继续生产聚生虫。快去杀死那些守卫！
text.completion: A few less traitors for us to feed to the kunchong when the dust settles.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: The Dread Clutches
english.objectives: Slay 6 Shek'zeer Clutch-Keepers in the Clutches of Shek'zeer.
english.description: The imperial clutches have become an abomination!
