Clutch-Keepers rush the development of new swarmborn, saturating them in this vile "sha" energy before sending them away to the wall.$B$BThe Klaxxi wish to stem the tide of swarmborn production in these dread clutches. Put the keepers to death!
english.completion: A few less traitors for us to feed to the kunchong when the dust settles.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 琥珀武器
text.objectives: 从恐惧之心和夏柯希尔之巢附近的夏柯希尔誓刃者身上收集6把琥珀之刃。$B$B和卡拉克西维斯的掠风者克尔鲁克谈一谈，让他送你去恐惧之心。
text.description: 你！脏东西！$B$B你现在得为我工作！$B$B夏柯希尔誓刃者的琥珀之刃是整个帝国最精良的武器。$B$B如果你离开这儿以后没立刻被这些刀刃刺穿的话，就给我多带点这种刀回来，能带多少就带多少。我要确保我们有足够的备用武器，以备不时之需。
text.progress: The bladesworn carry their swords with pride. I want them on my weapon racks!
text.completion: If all goes as planned, the Klaxxi will stop the Empress without your help. Still, it is my role to be prepared.
text.completed: Return to Ambersmith Zikk in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Amber Arms
english.objectives: Gather 6 Amber Blades from Shek'zeer Bladesworn around the Heart of Fear and The Clutches of Shek'zeer.$B$BSpeak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess for a ride to the Heart of Fear.
english.description: You! Filth!$B$BYou work for me now!$B$BThe amber blades of the Shek'zeer Bladesworn are the finest weapons in the empire.$B$BIf you are not impaled upon them immediately after leaving here, bring me as many of the blades as you can carry! I want to make sure we have weapons in reserve, should we need them.
english.progress: The bladesworn carry their swords with pride. I want them on my weapon racks!
english.completion: If all goes as planned, the Klaxxi will stop the Empress without your help. Still, it is my role to be prepared.
english.completed: Return to Ambersmith Zikk in Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 死亡区域
text.objectives: 在恐惧之心的未激活的声波传送塔上使用卡拉克西共鸣水晶。$B$B和卡拉克西维斯的掠风者克尔鲁克谈一谈，让他送你去恐惧之心。
text.description: 一位卡拉克西瓦对塔低语。它将他们的低语传递到远方：传递给其他的塔、传递给螳螂妖、传递给英杰。当塔收到反馈的低语，卡拉克西就能听见它。$B$B通过这种方式，他们便能了解全局。$B$B宫殿附近的一座塔很安静。这可不行。它必须为卡拉克西歌唱。$B$B修塔本来是我的工作，但如果你效忠于卡拉克西，那你也应该为我服务。你来修塔，我在这儿等着！
text.completed: Speak with Kor'ik at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Dead Zone
english.objectives: Use the Klaxxi Resonating Crystal on the Inactive Sonic Relay at the Heart of Fear.$B$BSpeak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess for a ride to the Heart of Fear.
english.description: A Klaxxi'va whispers to the tower. It carries their whisper far; to other towers, to mantid, to paragons. The whisper bounces back, and the Klaxxi hear it.$B$BThis way, they see all.$B$BA tower near the palace is quiet. This will not do. It must sing for the Klaxxi.$B$BIt is my job to fix the tower, but if you serve the Klaxxi, you should serve me as well. You fix the tower, and I will wait here!
english.completed: Speak with Kor'ik at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 逃出魔掌
text.objectives: 在夏柯希尔之巢找到并唤醒螳螂妖英杰。
text.description: 水晶向卡拉克西发出了共鸣。它们感应到一位英杰，就在塔东面的虫巢里。$B$B虫巢守卫正试图腐化这位英杰，卡拉克西绝不容许这样的恶行发生。$B$B去吧，找到这位英杰。将你的手放在他的腔壁上，卡拉克西会通过你来传送他们的低语，将英杰释放出来。你要尽你所能，保护这位英杰。
text.completion: My slumber was interrupted by sudden dreams. Unspeakable nightmares.$B$BThen I awoke.$B$BThe Klaxxi have spoken to me. I have my orders. There is much to be done.
text.completed: Speak with Malik the Unscathed at Klaxxi'vess.
text.giverWindow: 我们在你附近的位置发现了一位英杰。

english.title: In Her Clutch
english.objectives: Locate and waken the mantid paragon in The Clutches of Shek'zeer.
english.description: The crystal sings to the Klaxxi. They sense a paragon in the clutch, east of the tower.$B$BClutch-keepers are trying to pollute this one. The Klaxxi will not permit this.$B$BGo and find the paragon. Place your hands on his chamber, and the Klaxxi will channel their whispers through you to break him free. Protect him if you can.
english.completion: My slumber was interrupted by sudden dreams. Unspeakable nightmares.$B$BThen I awoke.$B$BThe Klaxxi have spoken to me. I have my orders. There is much to be done.
english.completed: Speak with Malik the Unscathed at Klaxxi'vess.
english.giverWindow: We have found a paragon near your location.

text.title: 兵临城下
text.objectives: 击败10个阿曼尼狂战士、5头阿曼尼巨兽和3个古拉巴什血骑士。
text.description: 赞达拉已经开始进攻了！你必须帮助守卫这个村子！$b$b如果不能击退他们，我们将永远无法找到雷电之王的遗骸！
text.completion: The Zandalari have started to retreat, $n. This victory will mean a great deal to the villagers.$B$BIn the chaos I was able to capture one of the fighters. Perhaps we can get information from him.
text.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

english.title: Enemies At Our Door
english.objectives: Defeat 10 Amani Beserkers, 5 Amani Behemoths, and 3 Gurubashi Bloodriders.
english.description: The Zandalari have begun their attack! You must help defend the village!$b$bIf we can't push them back, we will never find the Thunder King's remains!
english.completion: The Zandalari have started to retreat, $n. This victory will mean a great deal to the villagers.$B$BIn the chaos I was able to capture one of the fighters. Perhaps we can get information from him.
english.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

text.title: 加入部落
text.objectives: 和奥格瑞玛的加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮谈一谈。
text.description: 我们到了，$n……奥格瑞玛，部落的心脏。$b$b我们在迷踪岛之外也将有用武之地，这里争端不断，我们可以大展拳脚。这也是尚喜师父希望看到的。$b$b有了部落的支持，此地便是我们崭露头角的不二之选。我们去看看他们的首领是谁。我们需要盟友。
text.completion: $R... you're here.$B$BGood.

english.title: Joining the Horde
english.objectives: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Here we are, $n... Orgrimmar, heart of the Horde.$b$bWe can be helpful beyond the edges of the Wandering Isle. There are innumerable problems out there, just waiting for us to solve them. This is what Master Shang Xi would have wanted.$b$bThere's no better place to start doing that than here, with the aid of the Horde. Let's find out who their leader is. We need allies.
english.completion: $R... you're here.$B$BGood.

text.title: 部落之道
text.objectives: 与加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮同行。
text.description: 我最近听说你的一些族人可能会加入我们。$b$b我近来一直致力于壮大部落的力量，多来一些熊猫人对我们很有帮助。$b$b跟我走走，$n。
text.completion: Ji. $n. You're here, good.$B$BLet's keep this moving.
text.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.

english.title: The Horde Way
english.objectives: Walk with Garrosh Hellscream.
english.description: I recently received word that some of your kind might be coming our way.$b$bI've recently been trying to bolster the strength of the Horde. A few pandaren might do us good.$b$bWalk with me, $n.
english.completion: Ji. $n. You're here, good.$B$BLet's keep this moving.
english.completed: Speak with Garrosh Hellscream in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.

objectiveDetails.description: 与加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮同行

text.title: 地狱咆哮之赐
text.objectives: 打败欧戈斯、加杜恩及冻血以完成加尔鲁什的测验
text.description: 我得知道你是否能够战斗……能够杀戮，并且活下来。也许有一天我会召唤你参战，我得确认你是否能被委以重任。$b$b如我之前说过的，我要赐给你一件礼物。而它就在这鲜血之环里。穿过我身后的门，到竞技场上去，我要试试你的功夫。
text.completion: You've more than proven your worth, in battle and in heart. Few would be willing to leave their homeland to join the Horde. Fewer still would be willing to face a charging magnataur in combat.$B$BYou, and the rest of your people, are welcome among our ranks. Welcome to the Horde, $n.
text.completed: Return to Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Hellscream's Gift
english.objectives: Complete Garrosh's test by defeating Oggax, Gadoon, and Frozengore.
english.description: I need to know if you can fight... that you can kill, and live. Eventually, each of you will be called upon for war, and I need to know that you can be counted on.$b$bI mentioned a gift earlier. It lies here, within the Ring of Valor. Step into the arena, right through this door behind me. I will test your skills.
english.completion: You've more than proven your worth, in battle and in heart. Few would be willing to leave their homeland to join the Horde. Fewer still would be willing to face a charging magnataur in combat.$B$BYou, and the rest of your people, are welcome among our ranks. Welcome to the Horde, $n.
english.completed: Return to Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 你的私人收藏
text.objectives: 打扫空书架
text.description: 潘达利亚有着丰富的历史、轶闻、故事和传说。我请求你在周游世界的时候，留心那些你觉得与我们此处工作有关的遗物和传说。$b$b当你获得足够的见闻，我们就可以将其编辑成一册书卷作为你的私人收藏。$b$b当然，你随时可以回来查看我们为你制作的书卷。
text.completion: Ah! Now that that is done we can start to place your collected research here. I look forward to seeing what you find.
text.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho in the Seat of Knowledge at the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Your Private Collection
english.objectives: Clean off the Empty Bookshelf.
english.description: Pandaria is rich with history, legends, stories, and lore of every sort. While you are traveling throughout the world I would ask that you keep an eye open for artifacts and pieces of information that you feel would be pertinent to our work here.$b$bWhen you accumulate enough knowledge, we will compile it in to a volume for your personal collection here.$b$bYou can, of course, return whenever you like to review the volumes we are making for you.
english.completion: Ah! Now that that is done we can start to place your collected research here. I look forward to seeing what you find.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho in the Seat of Knowledge at the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 游学者
text.objectives: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b我们在锦绣谷中发现了一些惊人的东西。一座尘封的宝库，里面藏满了各种书籍、卷轴和知识，其历史可追溯到魔古帝国时期。$b$b请尽快来见我们。你可以先到声名狼藉的魔古山宝库，然后飞到宝库入口上方的平台，在这里你就可以找到这座闻道之座。$b$b期待你的到来！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座向游学者周卓汇报。

english.title: The Lorewalkers
english.objectives: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: Dear $p,$b$bWe have uncovered something tremendous in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. A great repository of books, scrolls, and lore that has remained untouched since the days of the mogu empire.$b$bPlease, join us at your earliest convenience. You can find this Seat of Knowledge by traveling to the infamous Mogu'shan Vaults, and then flying to the landing just above the entrance.$b$bI look forward to your arrival!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completed: Report to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 《谦卑的土地精》
text.objectives: 将《谦卑的土地精》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b我们收到了你关于土地精的调查报告，并确信我们已对他们的起源和历史有了明确的认识。$b$b如果你能来闻道之座一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。

english.title: The Humble Grummle
english.objectives: Bring The Humble Grummle to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
english.description: Dear $p,$b$bWe have received your research on the grummles and believe we have a solid idea of their etimology and history.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Kowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 恐惧之心深处
text.objectives: 杀死副官伊克瓦姆、副官苏鲁兹、副官伊凯斯和副官茨克兹，并释放毒心者夏克里尔。
text.description: 卡拉克西已经侦测到了另一位英杰的存在，唤醒者。$B$B由于某些原因，这位英杰被妥善藏匿了起来。$B$B但女皇已经找到了它，她的副官此时正在想办法摧毁它。$B$B他们正在宫殿地下深处的密室内施展巫术。我们必须阻止他们。$B$B我们得守卫卡拉克西维斯。你必须代替我们去。在西边的山崖下可以找到通往他们密室的入口。
text.completion: You have done your duty well, Wakener.
text.completed: Speak to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at Venomous Ledge in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Beneath the Heart of Fear
english.objectives: Kill Adjunct Ek'vem, Adjunct Ikkess, Adjunct Suruz, and Adjunct Tsikzi, and then free Xaril the Poisoned Mind.
english.description: The Klaxxi have detected the existence of another paragon, Wakener.$B$BThis one was kept well-hidden from us, and for good reason.$B$BThe Empress already has possession of this one, and her adjuncts work to destroy it even now.$B$BThey are performing their sorcery in a chamber deep beneath the palace, and they must be stopped.$B$BWe hold Klaxxi'vess. You must go in our stead. Find the entrance to their chamber from the ledge to the west.
english.completion: You have done your duty well, Wakener.
english.completed: Speak to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at Venomous Ledge in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 琥珀即生命
text.objectives: 杀死7名雾刃撕裂者以及雾刃邪鳞领主。
text.description: 为了继续对抗螳螂妖帝国，我们需要更多的琥珀。$B$B在南边的湖底藏有大量的琥珀，但该地区已被一个野蛮的蜥蜴人部族占领了。$B$B我实在是匀不出人手。你必须前往湖区并试探那个部族的实力。削减他们的人数，杀死他们的首领。首领或许就藏在他的地下洞穴里。$B$B这对你来说不是什么难事吧？
text.completion: The whispers seem to be emanating from within this amber.$B$BCould there be another paragon sleeping within?
text.completed: Examine the Ancient Amber Chunk at the Lake of Stars in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Amber Is Life
english.objectives: Kill 7 Mistblade Rippers and the Mistblade Scale-Lord.
english.description: In order for our efforts against the mantid empire to continue, we require more amber.$B$BThere is a great deposit of amber underneath the lake to the south, but the area is inhabited by a savage saurok tribe.$B$BI cannot spare anyone else. You must go to the lake and test the tribe's strength. Thin their numbers and eliminate their leader, who is probably hiding in his underground cavern.$B$BSurely this is not too great a task for you?
english.completion: The whispers seem to be emanating from within this amber.$B$BCould there be another paragon sleeping within?
english.completed: Examine the Ancient Amber Chunk at the Lake of Stars in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 喂食
text.objectives: 杀死8只寒噬鳄鱼。
text.description: 我必须立即回到卡拉克西议会与其他英杰会合，但我连站起来的力气都没有。$B$B我必须吃东西，唤醒者。$B$B我感觉到湖北岸有生物的心跳。$B$B给我杀了它们，剩下的就交给我吧。
text.completion: I feel the strength returning to my body.
text.completed: Speak to your companion, Korven the Prime, at the Lake of Stars or Kypari Zar, in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Feeding the Beast
english.objectives: Kill 8 Coldbite Crocolisks.
english.description: I must join the Klaxxi Council and the other paragons immediately, but I am barely strong enough to stand.$B$BI must feed, Wakener.$B$BI sense the beating hearts of creatures on the northern bank of the lake.$B$BKill them for me, and I shall do the rest.
english.completion: I feel the strength returning to my body.
english.completed: Speak to your companion, Korven the Prime, at the Lake of Stars or Kypari Zar, in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 活力琥珀
text.objectives: 收集8块活力琥珀，并将它们喂给至尊者柯尔凡。
text.description: 液态琥珀是刚苏醒的英杰恢复力量时最有效的手段，通常是唤醒仪式必不可缺的环节。$B$B但不幸的是，你看来并没有接受过这方面的指点，我们只能临时补救一下了。$B$B我可以感觉到，我们下方的湖底有大量的化石琥珀。那些琥珀应该能用，但我太虚弱了，不能亲自把它挖出来。$B$B帮我个忙，我会记得给你奖赏的。
text.completion: Thank you, Wakener. That is enough for now.
text.completed: Speak to your companion, Korven the Prime, at the Lake of Stars or at Kypari Zar in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Living Amber
english.objectives: Collect 8 Living Amber, then feed them to Korven the Prime.
english.description: Liquid amber is most efficient for restoring a newly awakened paragon's strength, and is usually provided at a wakening ceremony.$B$BUnfortunately, it seems you did not receive these instructions, so we shall have to improvise.$B$BI can sense a vast quantity of fossilized amber in the lake below us. It will serve, but I am too weak to dig it up myself.$B$BDo this for me, and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
english.completion: Thank you, Wakener. That is enough for now.
english.completed: Speak to your companion, Korven the Prime, at the Lake of Stars or at Kypari Zar in the Dread Wastes.

objectiveDetails.description: 将活力琥珀喂给至尊者柯尔凡

text.title: 凯帕圣树·扎尔
text.objectives: 激活声波塔，并在至尊者柯尔凡检查圣树的时候保护他。
text.description: 西边山上的那棵树是什么？会是……凯帕圣树·扎尔吗？$B$B<至尊者柯尔凡陷入了沉默。>$B$B在我最后一次出征归来，还没有被擢升为英杰前，我有幸种下了这棵树。$B$B我看着它慢慢长成一棵伟大的凯帕圣树，但……什么地方好像出了问题。$B$B这棵树的基部有一座老旧的声波塔。带我去那儿，唤醒者。我可以通过塔台来近距离观察一下。
text.completion: Once, great rivers of amber coursed through this tree's veins. Now, it is but a dried husk.
text.completed: Speak to your companion, Korven the Prime, at the Lake of Stars or Kypari Zar in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Kypari Zar
english.objectives: Activate the Sonar Tower, then defend Korven the Prime as he examines the tree.
english.description: What is that tree on the hill to the west? Can it be... Kypari Zar?$B$B<Korven the Prime lapses into silence.>$B$BWhen I returned from my final ravage, before being elevated to a paragon, I was given the honor of planting that very tree.$B$BI see it has grown into a great kypari, but... it seems something is amiss.$B$BThere is an old sonar tower at the base of the tree. Take me there, Wakener. I can use the tower to take a closer look.
english.completion: Once, great rivers of amber coursed through this tree's veins. Now, it is but a dried husk.
english.completed: Speak to your companion, Korven the Prime, at the Lake of Stars or Kypari Zar in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 虫群遗物
text.objectives: 收集8件螳螂妖遗物。
text.description: 这个样子诡异的雕刻上写满了一种复杂的书面语，可能是螳螂语的源头。$B$B你发现还有不少遗物杂乱无章地散落在营地内和湖水中。$B$B或许卡拉克西的人会对这些遗物感兴趣的。$B$B谁知道呢？这或许能帮你赢得他们的感激。
text.progress: What do you have there?
text.completion: These relics describe the history of Kypari Vos and the nearby amber trees.$B$BI would like to study these.$B$BThank you, $C.
text.completed: Return to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Relics of the Swarm
english.objectives: Collect 8 Mantid Relics.
english.description: This strange-looking carving is covered in a complex written language that might be mantid in origin.$B$BYou notice more relics strewn carelessly among the camps and inside the lake.$B$BPerhaps the Klaxxi would be interested in examining these artifacts.$B$BWho knows? Perhaps it will earn you some favor.
english.progress: What do you have there?
english.completion: These relics describe the history of Kypari Vos and the nearby amber trees.$B$BI would like to study these.$B$BThank you, $C.
english.completed: Return to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 喂食恐虫
text.objectives: 收集4块肥厚的乌龟腰肉。
text.description: 随着科沃克的成长，我们得给予它同等的奖惩。$B$B我这儿的惩罚不少，但作为奖励的肉已经几乎吃光了。$B$B往南走，你会看到许多乌龟在群星湖和凯帕圣树·扎尔以北漫游。$B$B去猎杀一些乌龟吧。科沃克最喜欢乌龟肉的味道。
text.progress: What have you brought for Kovok?
text.completion: Yes, a worthy feast.$B$BWell done.
text.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Kunchong Treats
english.objectives: Collect 4 Meaty Turtle Haunches.
english.description: As Kovok grows, he will require equal parts discipline and reward.$B$BI lack no shortage of discipline, but our supply of meat is almost empty.$B$BTo the south, you will find turtles roaming north of the Lake of Stars and Kypari Zar.$B$BHunt them. Kovok likes the taste of their flesh.
english.progress: What have you brought for Kovok?
english.completion: Yes, a worthy feast.$B$BWell done.
english.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: Sweet Tooth
text.objectives: Collect 50 Starshade.
text.description: We cannot summon a god without a worthy offering.$B$BI have noticed a rare flower growing among the fields to the north.$B$BThe Starshade is a potent flower whose bloom holds a powerfully sweet, intoxicating liquor.$B$BA single taste of this heady substance invigorates and strengthens the body.$B$BSurely, this god will appreciate its worth.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Darkroot Hollow in the Dread Wastes.

english.description: We cannot summon a god without a worthy offering.$B$BI have noticed a rare flower growing among the fields to the north.$B$BThe Starshade is a potent flower whose bloom holds a powerfully sweet, intoxicating liquor.$B$BA single taste of this heady substance invigorates and strengthens the body.$B$BSurely, this god will appreciate its worth.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Darkroot Hollow in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 问题的根源
text.objectives: 杀死寒噬主母。
text.description: 凯帕圣树·扎尔正在枯萎。$B$B一种可怕的黑暗生物正从树根深处腐蚀着它。$B$B这棵树已经没救了，但至少我们能够减少它的痛苦。$B$B你看。这邪恶的生物挖了一条通往其巢穴的小径。我们只需要循着它下山，就在这座塔后面。
text.completion: Thank you, Wakener. Kypari Zar can now dream in peace.$B$BHowever, the beast was merely a vessel for the corruption.$B$BNo... the true corruption lies much deeper.
text.completed: Speak to your companion, Korven the Prime, at the Lake of Stars or Kypari Zar in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: The Root of the Problem
english.objectives: Kill the Coldbite Matriarch.
english.description: Kypari Zar is dying.$B$BA creature of terrible darkness corrupts it from deep beneath its roots.$B$BThe tree cannot be saved, but at least we can lessen its pain.$B$BLook. The vile creature has carved a path to its own lair. We need only follow it down the hill, just behind this tower.
english.completion: Thank you, Wakener. Kypari Zar can now dream in peace.$B$BHowever, the beast was merely a vessel for the corruption.$B$BNo... the true corruption lies much deeper.
english.completed: Speak to your companion, Korven the Prime, at the Lake of Stars or Kypari Zar in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: Paragon 5
text.objectives: Recover the fifth paragon.
text.description: The emanations are growing stronger, $c.$B$BI feel them coming from the cave below us.$B$BI wish to study the beast that you have slain, so I will grant you the honor of awakening the next paragon.$B$BAfter all, the danger should be past.$B$BGo now, wallstrider, before I change my mind.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Darkroot Hollow in the Dread Wastes.

english.objectives: Recover the fifth paragon.
english.description: The emanations are growing stronger, $c.$B$BI feel them coming from the cave below us.$B$BI wish to study the beast that you have slain, so I will grant you the honor of awakening the next paragon.$B$BAfter all, the danger should be past.$B$BGo now, wallstrider, before I change my mind.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Darkroot Hollow in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 进入禅院
text.objectives: 在影踪禅院内找到班·熊心。
text.description:
这……真是糟透了。如果这座禅院真的已经被煞占据了，那我们必须竭尽全力来净化禅院中堕落的武僧们。

召集你的盟友，到禅院里见我。
text.completion: You have come. Good. This is a calamitous situation.

english.title: Into the Monastery
english.objectives: Meet Ban Bearheart inside the Shado-Pan Monastery.
english.description:
This... is unspeakable. If the monastery has truly been taken over by the Sha, we will need a great effort to purge the monks inside of corruption.

Gather a group of your allies, and meet me inside the Monastery.
english.completion: You have come. Good. This is a calamitous situation.

text.title: 烟雾弥漫
text.objectives: 焚烧10具库尔提克疾翼战士的尸体。
text.description: 砮荣要我把火炬拿给他去焚化尸体。$B$B这些带翅膀的螳螂妖很脆弱，在滚烫的浓烟中撑不了多久。
text.completion: Your help is appreciated, stranger.
text.completed: Return to Marksman Ye at Farwatch Overlook in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Choking the Skies
english.objectives: Burn 10 Kor'thik Fleetwing corpses.
english.description: Nurong wants me to pass out torches for burning the bodies.$B$BThe flying mantid are fragile, and won't last long in the hot smoke.
english.completion: Your help is appreciated, stranger.
english.completed: Return to Marksman Ye at Farwatch Overlook in Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 点燃库尔提克疾翼战士的尸体

text.title: 下面的敌人
text.objectives: 和指挥官巴格兰谈一谈。
text.description: 部落的敌人就躲在这座城市下面，$c。$B$B燃刃氏族密谋夺取奥格瑞玛，他们已经占领了怒焰裂谷！我们必须攻打他们的部队，夺回我们的领土！$B$B去跟怒焰裂谷里面的指挥官巴格兰谈谈。他会给你进一步指示。
text.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

english.title: Enemies Below
english.objectives: Speak with Commander Bagran.
english.description: There are enemies of the Horde beneath this very city, $c.$B$BThe Searing Blade plots to take Orgrimmar for their own, and have already taken Ragefire Chasm! We need to storm their forces and retake what is ours!$B$BGo speak with Commander Bagran just inside Ragefire Chasm. He will have further orders for you.
english.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

text.title: 下面的敌人
text.objectives: 跟石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈。
text.description: 奥格瑞玛的怒焰裂谷已经被燃刃氏族占领了，$n，我们不能听之任之，让他们接着觊觎雷霆崖。$B$B去跟裂谷里的石头守卫库尔加克谈一谈。尽你所能帮助他，毕竟雷霆崖与奥格瑞玛唇齿相依。

english.title: Enemies Below
english.objectives: Speak with Stone Guard Kurjack.
english.description: Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Searing Blade. $n, we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Thunder Bluff.$B$BGo speak with Stone Guard Kurjack just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.

text.title: 下面的敌人
text.objectives: 和指挥官巴格兰谈一谈。
text.description: 奥格瑞玛的怒焰裂谷已经被黑暗萨满占领。$n，我们不能让他们逃脱惩罚，免得他们再盯上雷霆崖。$B$B去和怒焰裂谷中的指挥官巴格兰谈一谈。尽你所能地帮助他，因为我们的命运是紧密相连的。
text.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

english.objectives: Speak with Commander Bagran.
english.description: Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Dark Shaman. $n, we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Thunder Bluff.$B$BGo speak with Commander Bagran just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.
english.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

text.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

english.objectives: Speak with Commander Bagran.
english.description: Orgrimmar's Ragefire Chasm has been taken by the Dark Shaman. $n, we cannot allow this to pass unpunished, lest they next set their sights on Undercity.$B$BGo speak with Commander Bagran just inside the Chasm. Help him in any way you can, for our fates are intertwined.
english.completion: I've been expecting your arrival, $n.

text.title: 挑战者之环：雪华
text.objectives: 在挑战者之环中挑战并击败雪华。
text.description: 你的战绩已经传遍整个营地了，$n。$B$B雪华想在竞技场上考验一下你的能力。$B$B你得做好准备，$c。她可不是那么容易被打败的。$B$B如果能让她承认你的实力，你会赢得一份珍贵的友谊。
text.completion: Ahhhh, so you bested Snow Blossom in battle, did you?$B$BShe will be stinging from that loss for a while, I'd wager.$B$BHowever, you have done well to win her to your side.$B$BShe does not warm to strangers quickly, but through time, she will prove to be a loyal and dependable companion.
text.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Challenger's Ring: Snow Blossom
english.objectives: Challenge Snow Blossom and defeat her in the Challenger's Ring.
english.description: News of your feats has been traveling around the camp, $n.$B$BIn fact, Snow Blossom would like to test your skill in battle.$B$BYou had best prepare yourself, $c. She is not easily defeated.$B$BIf you can prove your worth to her, you will win a valuable friend.
english.completion: Ahhhh, so you bested Snow Blossom in battle, did you?$B$BShe will be stinging from that loss for a while, I'd wager.$B$BHowever, you have done well to win her to your side.$B$BShe does not warm to strangers quickly, but through time, she will prove to be a loyal and dependable companion.
english.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 魔古的威胁
text.objectives: 击败12个山泽缚龙者或山泽兽王。
text.description: 我们的斥候在西北方的山泽岛发现了一支魔古大军。$B$B这个岛应该是荒芜人烟的，所以他们的出现还挺蹊跷的。$B$B更让我不安的是，他们正在岛上进行邪恶实验。$B$B我需要一名能力出众的$c去探查一下情况。$B$B山泽部族可能会找你麻烦。如果真这样，就干掉他们。
text.completion: The Shan'ze are up to something. Well done, $n, but we must continue to monitor their actions.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Mogu Menace
english.objectives: Kill 12 Shan'ze Serpentbinders or Shan'ze Beastmasters.
english.description: Our scouts have discovered a heavy mogu force at Shan'ze Dao to the northwest.$B$BThe island was supposedly uninhabited, so their presence is disturbing news.$B$BEven more disturbing is the fact that they are performing sinister experiments on the island.$B$BI need a capable $c to check out the situation.$B$BThe Shan'ze are likely to give you trouble, and if they do, kill them.
english.completion: The Shan'ze are up to something. Well done, $n, but we must continue to monitor their actions.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败山泽缚龙者或山泽兽王

text.title: 狡诈的林精
text.objectives: 击败30个黒木精怪或黒木妖师。
text.description: 山泽岛的黒木林精已经沦为魔古族的奴隶。$B$B曾经狡猾的骗子现在彻头彻尾成了山泽部族的走狗。他们每一天都愈发地厚颜无耻，做尽鸡鸣狗盗、滥杀无辜的事来讨好他们的主子。$B$B必须将这伙人除掉，但也得小心行事。他们看起来无害，实则恶毒至极。
text.completion: Good work, $C. Left unchecked, the sprites would soon outnumber our entire army.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Spiteful Sprites
english.objectives: Kill 30 Darkwoods Pixies or Darkwoods Charmers.
english.description: The Darkwoods sprites on Shan'ze Dao have fallen to the mogu's domination.$B$BThe once sly tricksters are now the full servants of the Shan'ze. They grow bolder each day, stealing and killing to satisfy their masters.$B$BThey must be eliminated, but be careful. They may look harmless, but they are actually quite vicious.
english.completion: Good work, $C. Left unchecked, the sprites would soon outnumber our entire army.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败黑木小鬼或黑木法师

text.title: 拯救龙蛋！
text.objectives: 收集8枚腾云翔龙蛋。
text.description: 蛋。是的，你没听错。我说的蛋可不是那些吃的蛋。$B$B你见过云端翔龙的蛋吗？$B$B这些珍稀的龙蛋就如宝石般美丽，曾经贵比等重的黄金。$B$B北面的山泽岛原本是野生云端翔龙栖息地，但魔古族和林精却把它们的龙蛋看管得严严实实。$B$B我们要尽量多拯救一些这些珍贵的龙蛋。$B$B这件事就拜托你了，$n。
text.progress: Did you find any eggs? The serpents lay their eggs in nests on the beach, but the wood sprites are also known to steal them whenever they can.
text.completion: Gently, gently!$B$BThank you for recovering these eggs safely, $n.$B$BI know a few Serpent Riders in the Jade Forest who will take good care of these.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Egg Rescue!
english.objectives: Collect 8 Cloudrunner Eggs.
english.description: Eggs. Yes, you heard me right. I said eggs, and these aren't for eating.$B$BHave you ever seen a cloud serpent egg?$B$BThese rare eggs look like jewels, and were once worth their weight in solid gold.$B$BShan'ze Dao to the north normally teems with wild cloud serpents, but the mogu and the sprites have their eggs on lock-down.$B$BWe need to save as many of these precious eggs as we can.$B$BI'm counting on YOU, $n.
english.progress: Did you find any eggs? The serpents lay their eggs in nests on the beach, but the wood sprites are also known to steal them whenever they can.
english.completion: Gently, gently!$B$BThank you for recovering these eggs safely, $n.$B$BI know a few Serpent Riders in the Jade Forest who will take good care of these.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 玛瑙之心
text.objectives: 收集4颗玛瑙之心。
text.description: 山泽缚龙者已控制了野生云端翔龙的心智，但他们还在利用石头、金属、血液以及古老的巫术创造出他们自己的黑暗魔兽。$B$B他们创造的怪兽——玛瑙风暴爪在西北方镇守着这座岛屿。$B$B我想研究一下能束缚这些怪兽的魔法。把它们的心脏带给我，这样我才能更好地了解我们面对的是哪些巫术。
text.progress: The Onyx Stormclaws will never disobey their masters.
text.completion: These will do well, $n. Thank you.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Onyx Hearts
english.objectives: Collect 4 Onyx Hearts.
english.description: The Shan'ze Serpentbinders dominate the minds of wild cloud serpents, but they also create their own dark creatures from stone, metal, blood, and ancient sorcery.$B$BTheir creations, the Onyx Stormclaws, guard the island to the northwest.$B$BI wish to study the magic binding these creatures. Bring me their hearts, so that I can better understand what sorcery we are up against.
english.progress: The Onyx Stormclaws will never disobey their masters.
english.completion: These will do well, $n. Thank you.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 黑暗的艺术
text.objectives: 收集8块山泽石板。
text.description: 据说山泽岛曾经矗立着一座雄伟的魔古族神庙。$B$B山泽部族在那里研究和练习驱使亡灵和死尸的邪术。$B$B这些邪术仍然保存在西北面的岛屿上，埋藏在废墟之下。$B$B我们绝不能对这些邪术放任不管……一方面我们要把它从他们手上夺回来，另一方面也要弄懂他们那些实验究竟在搞什么。
text.progress: Knowledge is powerful. That is why the mogu are so dangerous.
text.completion: Well done, $n.$B$BWe'll begin deciphering the writing on these tablets at once.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Dark Arts
english.objectives: Collect 8 Shan'ze Tablets.
english.description: It is said that Shan'ze Dao was once home to a great mogu temple.$B$BThere, the Shan'ze studied and practiced the art of subjugating the dead or inanimate.$B$BMuch of their knowledge still remains on the island to the northwest, buried among the ruins.$B$BWe need to get our hands on their knowledge - both to keep it out of their hands, and to understand the nature of their experiments.
english.progress: Knowledge is powerful. That is why the mogu are so dangerous.
english.completion: Well done, $n.$B$BWe'll begin deciphering the writing on these tablets at once.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 青铜爪
text.objectives: 收集20个青铜爪。
text.description: 在山泽豢养的动物中，最凶猛又最忠心的莫过于魁麟了。$B$B这些猛兽一旦开始追击猎物就绝不会停下，除非抓住猎物，或把自己累死。$B$B我要你做的不仅是消灭一些猛兽，而且还要收集它们的青铜爪。$B$B它们的爪子又粗壮又锋利，正好可以拿来给我们的部队制造一些武器和钓钩。
text.progress: The quilen are fierce, but I see fierceness in your eyes as well.
text.completion: These claws will come in handy.$B$BGood work, $C.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Bronze Claws
english.objectives: Collect 20 Bronze Claws.
english.description: Among the Shan'ze's fiercest and most loyal creations are their quilen.$B$BThese beasts will hunt until they kill their prey, or die in the process.$B$BI need you to not only cull their numbers, but also to retrieve their bronze claws.$B$BTheir claws are strong and razor sharp, and we can use them to make weapons and hooks for our cause.
english.progress: The quilen are fierce, but I see fierceness in your eyes as well.
english.completion: These claws will come in handy.$B$BGood work, $C.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 往日的幻影
text.objectives: 击败3个山泽幻术师。
text.description: $C，我需要借助你的力量去消灭山泽岛上的山泽幻术师，他们就在西北面。$B$B叫你去完成如此困难的任务真让我左右为难。$B$B在山泽部族的顶级巫师中，幻术师绝对是最难对付的一类。$B$B这是一场硬仗，但我不知道还有哪位$c能更胜任这个任务。
text.completion: I knew you could do this, $n!$B$BWith fewer Shan'ze Illusionists to stand against us, our task here will be much easier.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Illusions Of The Past
english.objectives: Kill 3 Shan'ze Illusionists.
english.description: $C, I need your strength to eliminate the Shan'ze Illusionists on Shan'ze Dao, to the northwest.$B$BIt wearies me to ask of you this difficult task.$B$BThe illusionists are among the strongest of the Shan'ze's elite sorcerors.$B$BThey will not be easy to defeat, but I know no $c who is better suited to the task.
english.completion: I knew you could do this, $n!$B$BWith fewer Shan'ze Illusionists to stand against us, our task here will be much easier.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 小雏龙
text.objectives: 解救20只腾云雏龙。
text.description: 我看到山泽部族正在西北面的岛屿上进行一些残忍的实验。$B$B他们把翔龙宝宝从龙蛋里孵出来。然后又把它们关在狭窄的笼子里，四周满是邋遢污秽之物。$B$B狠心的狱卒不给它们饭吃，还要严刑拷打。$B$B我们必须尽量救出这些雏龙。我特许你惩处沿路遇到的任何魔古族！
text.completion: Those creatures will remember you as their savior.$B$BYou have done well, $n.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Little Hatchlings
english.objectives: Free 20 Cloudrunner Hatchlings.
english.description: I have seen the cruel experiments that the Shan'ze are performing on their island to the northwest.$B$BThe Shan'ze raise baby serpents from the egg. They keep the young in tiny cages, surrounded by squalor and filth.$B$BThe cruelest gaolers starve and torture them.$B$BWe must save as many hatchlings as we can. You have my full permission to punish any mogu that gets in your way!
english.completion: Those creatures will remember you as their savior.$B$BYou have done well, $n.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 生而自由
text.objectives: 打开6只野生腾云翔龙的锁链。
text.description: 你听过潘达利亚的巨型云端翔龙的故事吗，$n？$B$B你以后一定要听听那个故事。可惜，我今天没时间来跟你说了。$B$B你现在要知道的就是，螳螂高原的野生腾云翔龙正陷入麻烦。$B$B魔古族把野生翔龙都抓起来，侵蚀它们的头脑，迫使这些巨龙服从他们邪恶的意志。$B$B快到西北面的山泽岛去，打开成年翔龙的锁链，救出它们！
text.completion: Good work, $R. It gladdens me to see that the wild serpents are free once again.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Born Free
english.objectives: Free 6 Wild Cloudrunners from their chains.
english.description: Do you know the story of the great cloud serpents of Pandaria, $n?$B$BSomeday you must hear it. Unfortunately, there is no time to tell it now.$B$BWhat you must know is that the wild cloudrunner serpents of Townlong are in trouble.$B$BThe mogu are capturing wild serpents and corrupting their minds, bending them to their sinister will.$B$BGo to Shan'ze Dao, to the northwest. Free the adult serpents from their chains. Save them!
english.completion: Good work, $R. It gladdens me to see that the wild serpents are free once again.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 后果很严重
text.objectives: 击败24个山泽先祖。你可以在魔古族骨灰坛里找到山泽先祖。
text.description: 我们在山泽岛找到了一些古老的魔古族骨灰坛。$B$B本来是件寻常之事，但如果这些骨灰坛寄居着愤怒的魔古怨灵那就严重了。$B$B要是有哪个倒霉蛋不小心打开了骨灰坛，那肯会引发危险，要是骨灰坛落入坏人之手，那也会成为他们实施破坏活动的工具。$B$B我们必须将这些骨灰坛从山泽岛清理出去。
text.completion: Good riddance, I say! Those mogu ghosts were long past their expiration.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Grave Consequences
english.objectives: Kill 24 Shan'ze Ancestors. Shan'ze Ancestors may be found inside Mogu Burial Urns.
english.description: We've found ancient mogu burial urns among the ruins on Shan'ze Dao.$B$BThis is normally no problem, except these urns are home to angry mogu spirits.$B$BNot only do these urns pose a danger to anyone unlucky enough to find one, but they could be used for destruction if they were to fall into the wrong hands.$B$BWe must rid Shan'ze Dao of their presence.
english.completion: Good riddance, I say! Those mogu ghosts were long past their expiration.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 擒贼擒王
text.objectives: 击败黑木妖精。
text.description: 山泽岛的林精从来都是些喜怒无常的捣蛋鬼，但现在它们已经沦为魔古族的奴隶。$B$B就在我们说话这会儿，它们正在新的首领手下集结。$B$B绝不能任其发展。$B$B虽说它们只是爱调皮捣蛋，但集结后，它们黑暗魔法所具有的破坏力和危险性常人无法想像。$B$B在情况变得无法挽回前，干掉它们的首领。
text.completion: Good work, $n.$B$BThe wood sprites may look harmless, but that's what makes them so dangerous.
text.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: In Sprite Of Everything
english.objectives: Kill the Darkwoods Faerie.
english.description: The sprites of Shan'ze Dao have always been capricious tricksters, but now they have fallen under the mogu's influence.$B$BEven as we speak, they gather under a new leader.$B$BWe cannot allow this to happen.$B$BTheir mischievous pranks were one thing, but united, their dark magic is too powerful and too dangerous to comprehend.$B$BTake out their leader before it is too late.
english.completion: Good work, $n.$B$BThe wood sprites may look harmless, but that's what makes them so dangerous.
english.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 跟踪事件：已开始影踪派日常任务
《蜥蜴人与困境》
text.objectives: 将《蜥蜴人与困境》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b我们收到了你关于蜥蜴人的调查报告，并确信我们已经拼凑出蜥蜴人历史的线索。$b$b如果你能来闻道之座一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
text.completion: Before your research, I don't think pandarens ever really knew why the saurok were so vicious. We will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。

english.title: Between a Saurok and a Hard Place
english.objectives: Bring Between a Saurok and a Hard Place to Lorewalker Cho.
english.description: Dear $p,$b$bWe have received your research on the saurok and believe we have pieced together clues about their past.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completion: Before your research, I don't think pandarens ever really knew why the saurok were so vicious. We will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 丛林佳酿
text.objectives: 击败乌克头领。
text.description: 海盗！我们的海湾被潘达利亚有史以来最暴躁、最没教养、最不卫生、最差劲的一群猢狲占据了。更严重的是，他们宣誓效忠于传说中的乌克头领！$B$B我们眼睁睁看着他们在盎迦猴岛夜夜笙歌、酿造烈酒。$B$B要我说我们干脆把他们的酒抢过来以示报复！我觉得我甚至可以改进他们的配方。$B$B带几个朋友来盎迦猴岛南边见我。抢滩夺酒之战要开始啦！
text.completion: A fine punch! A fine punch indeed! The sort of punch that punches back. Well done, $C!
text.completed: Speak with Brewmaster Bo in Unga Ingoo or at Marista in Krasarang Wilds.

english.title: The Funky Monkey Brew
english.objectives: Defeat Captain Ook.
english.description: Pirates! Our shores have been scoured by the most ill-tempered, ill-mannered, ill-hygienic, and ill-good hozen that ever was found in Pandaria. And to make matters worse, they claim to serve the legendary Captain Ook!$b$bWe see them every night partying and brewing punch on their island Unga Ingoo.$b$b I say we take their brew for a change! I think I can even improve their mix.$b$bGather up some friends and meet me on the southern side of Unga Ingoo. It is time for a Brew Run!
english.completion: A fine punch! A fine punch indeed! The sort of punch that punches back. Well done, $C!
english.completed: Speak with Brewmaster Bo in Unga Ingoo or at Marista in Krasarang Wilds.

text.title: 暴风骑士
text.objectives: 利用青铜爪骑在8只山泽穿云翔龙的身上。攻击它们使其恢复心智。
text.description: 山泽部族的首领山怖，正在西北面岛屿的山顶上进行某种黑暗仪式。$B$B我们相信受他摆布的山泽穿云翔龙正在给这种魔法注入能量。至于如何注入能量，我们还不太清楚。$B$B但我们肯定山泽穿云翔龙还有希望摆脱控制它们思想的魔咒。$B$B带上这些青铜爪。利用这些青铜爪骑在山泽穿云翔龙的背上。$B$B再给它们迎头痛击。将它们的脑袋打清醒点！
text.completion: We do not fully understand what the Shan'ze are doing, or the nature of their domination over the wild serpents.$B$BBan's theory is that the only thing that can cut through the mind control is physical pain.$B$BOnce the Shan'ze Cloudrunners feel enough pain, it looses the corruption's hold, and they finally remember who they are.
text.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Riding the Storm
english.objectives: Use the Bronze Claws to mount 8 Shan'ze Cloudrunners. Attack them to free them of their corruption.
english.description: Shan Bu, the leader of the Shan'ze, is performing some kind of dark ritual at the summit of the island to the northwest.$B$BWe believe that the subjugated Shan'ze Cloudrunners are powering the spell. How, we still do not know.$B$BWe believe that the Shan'ze Cloudrunners can still be saved from the corruption that taints them.$B$BTake these bronze claws. Use them to mount the back of a Shan'ze Cloudrunner.$B$BAttack them. Beat some sense back into their heads!
english.completion: We do not fully understand what the Shan'ze are doing, or the nature of their domination over the wild serpents.$B$BBan's theory is that the only thing that can cut through the mind control is physical pain.$B$BOnce the Shan'ze Cloudrunners feel enough pain, it looses the corruption's hold, and they finally remember who they are.
english.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 亡语者
text.objectives: 击败山泽亡语者。
text.description: 山泽部族的实验是由一位力量强大的亡灵巫师主持的，人称山泽亡语者。$B$B擒贼先擒王，这样才能制止他们的恶行。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.$B$BI expected nothing less.
text.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: When The Dead Speak
english.objectives: Kill the Shan'ze Deathspeaker.
english.description: The Shan'ze's experiments are overseen by a powerful necromancer known as a Shan'ze Deathspeaker.$B$BIf we are to put an end to their operations, we must eliminate their leader.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.$B$BI expected nothing less.
english.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 老陈和塞勒沃克斯
text.objectives: 在铁腹老陈的协助下击败塞勒沃克斯。
text.description: 老陈正在希克维斯的北边入口上方与一个螳螂妖首领激战。他的任务是拿到能让我们进入螳螂妖隧道的第二枚水晶。$B$B快去助他一臂之力吧。
text.completion: We have the second crystal then. Good.
text.completed: Meet with Taran Zhu outside of the Sik'vess Lair in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Lao-Chin and Serevex
english.objectives: Kill Serevex with the aid of Lao-Chin the Iron Belly.
english.description: Lao-Chin is facing off against the leader just above the entrance in the tree, on the north side of Sik'vess. He is to bring back the second crystal that we need to get into the mantid tunnel.$B$BGo there and lend him your aid.
english.completion: We have the second crystal then. Good.
english.completed: Meet with Taran Zhu outside of the Sik'vess Lair in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 砮荣和罗塞克
text.objectives: 在鹰眼大师砮荣的协助下击败罗塞克。
text.description: 鹰眼大师砮荣已经前往希克维斯的西北方堵截最后一个螳螂妖首领。$B$B你快追上他，帮他干掉螳螂妖首领。在你帮他杀死敌人后，砮荣将带回最后一枚水晶。
text.completion: The final crystal is ours. We are on the doorstep of our final confrontation.
text.completed: Meet with Taran Zhu outside of the Sik'vess Lair in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Nurong and Rothek
english.objectives: Kill Rothek with the aid of Hawkmaster Nurong.
english.description: Hawkmaster Nurong has gone ahead to the northwest of Sik'vess to make sure the last mantid leader cannot escape.$B$BCatch up with him and help him kill the mantid leader. Nurong will bring back the final crystal once you've aided him in this.
english.completion: The final crystal is ours. We are on the doorstep of our final confrontation.
english.completed: Meet with Taran Zhu outside of the Sik'vess Lair in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 洞悉
text.objectives: 通过任塞道口的望远镜进行观察。
text.description: 陶矢在山脊边架设了一部望远镜，以便我了解她的斥候所发现的情况。$B$B你过去看看吧。
text.completion: Our tasks lay before us.
text.completed: Return to Taran Zhu at Rensai's Watchpost in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Buried Beneath
english.objectives: Look through the spyglass in Rensai's Watchpost.
english.description: Taoshi set up a spyglass on the ridge edge to show me what her scouting uncovered.$B$BGo over and take a look.
english.completion: Our tasks lay before us.
english.completed: Return to Taran Zhu at Rensai's Watchpost in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 黑暗中的嘶吼
text.objectives: 去凯帕圣树·沃尔杀死被侵蚀的英杰。
text.description: 这么说，你在女皇之巢里活了下来。你的命……真够硬的。$B$B卡拉克西在北方听到了另一个英杰的声音，在凯帕圣树·沃尔被煞能烧焦的树根之间。$B$B这个英杰的呼号中带着恐惧和愤怒，他没救了。$B$B卡拉克西要他死。去击败他，不然就别回来了。
text.completion: What?! How did you...$B$BThe Deathcaller was a legendary hero. He must not have been fully wakened.$B$BYou are fortunate.
text.completed: Return to Kor'ik at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: A Cry From Darkness
english.objectives: Slay the corrupted paragon at Kypari Vor.
english.description: So, you survived the imperial clutches. You are... resilient.$B$BThe Klaxxi hear another paragon to the north, among the sha-scorched roots of Kypari Vor.$B$BThis one cries out in terror and agony. It cannot be saved.$B$BThe Klaxxi want him put down. Go and defeat him or do not return here.
english.completion: What?! How did you...$B$BThe Deathcaller was a legendary hero. He must not have been fully wakened.$B$BYou are fortunate.
english.completed: Return to Kor'ik at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 战云密布
text.objectives: 击败艾兹克西·卡泰。
text.description: 螳螂妖从来就不让我省心，但他们现在太过分了。$B$B我们可以抵御库尔维斯的零星攻击，但现在……他们开始包围我们了。更糟糕的是，他们正在从我们的树上抽取琥珀原液。$B$B这可不行！我们需要那些琥珀！我们还得酿酒呢！$B$B他们已经在树的南边挖出了一个洞。我实在腾不出手来。你能帮我去对付他们吗？
text.completion: We're not here to hurt anybody. We just want to make a little bit of brew out of this tree sap. Is that too much to ask?
text.completed: Return to Sapmaster Vu at The Sunset Brewgarden in the Dread Wastes.
text.giverWindow: 一只坏螳螂。

english.title: The Heavens Hum With War
english.objectives: Slay Azzix K'tai.
english.description: The mantid don't ever make my job easy, but now they've gone too far.$b$bWe can fend off the occasional attack from Kor'vess, but now... now they're starting to surround us. What's worse, they're draining the amber from our tree.$b$bThis will not stand! We need that amber! To make beer!$b$bThey've dug a burrow into the south side of the tree. I'm short-handed here. Could you take care of them for me?
english.completion: We're not here to hurt anybody. We just want to make a little bit of brew out of this tree sap. Is that too much to ask?
english.completed: Return to Sapmaster Vu at The Sunset Brewgarden in the Dread Wastes.
english.giverWindow: One bad mantid.

text.title: 神圣配方
text.objectives: 将预言之卷带给落日酒坊的丽亚·十歌。
text.description: “当恐惧升腾$b天空中战云密布$b我们伟大的救世方舟$b必会支离破碎。”$b$b卷轴上还有几节文字。也许落日酒坊的某个人能破译这段神秘信息。
text.progress: Is that some sort of scroll?$B$BWould you mind if I took a look?
text.completion: <Lya reads the entirety of the message.>$B$BThis scroll, this... this prophecy...$B$BIt's terrifying!
text.completed: Report to Lya of Ten Songs at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Sacred Recipe
english.objectives: Bring the Scroll of Auspice to Lya of Ten Songs at The Sunset Brewgarden.
english.description: "When the horror comes a-rising$bAnd the heavens hum with war$bOur great vessel of salvation$bMust be broken from its core."$b$bThe scroll continues on for several stanzas. Perhaps somebody at The Sunset Brewgarden will be able to decipher its cryptic message.
english.progress: Is that some sort of scroll?$B$BWould you mind if I took a look?
english.completion: <Lya reads the entirety of the message.>$B$BThis scroll, this... this prophecy...$B$BIt's terrifying!
english.completed: Report to Lya of Ten Songs at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 融入阴影
text.objectives: 杀死落日酒坊附近的煞魔生物和野生动物，采集100滴阴影。
text.description: 关于你发现的那个卷轴……$b$b我特别关注第二节中的一行字——“融入木头和阴影”。“阴影”这个词让我特别感兴趣。$b$b我必须承认，我一直在考虑用一些这个地区残余的煞魔精华做为酿酒的原料。我想这就是我们配方里要求用的阴影。$b$b你会在我们这棵树的东南边找到大量煞能混合物……不过你也能从当地的野生动物身上获得一些。
text.completion: Beautiful. This will make a fine addition to our brew.$B$BThe most dangerous ingredients are quite often the most delicious.
text.completed: Return to Sapmaster Vu at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Bound With Shade
english.objectives: Harvest 100 drops of Shade by slaying sha creatures and wildlife near The Sunset Brewgarden.
english.description: About that scroll you found...$b$bI keep looking at that line in the second stanza - "bound with wood and shade". The "shade", in particular, intrigues me.$b$bI must admit, I've often considered taking some of the area's residual sha essence and incorporating it into a brew. I suspect that this is the shade which our recipe calls for.$b$bYou will find large amalgamations of sha to the southeast of our tree... though you may also be able to harvest some from the local wildlife.
english.completion: Beautiful. This will make a fine addition to our brew.$B$BThe most dangerous ingredients are quite often the most delicious.
english.completed: Return to Sapmaster Vu at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 巨兽之匕
text.objectives: 获取3颗巨型穆山兽牙。
text.description: 配方上写着：“巨兽的撕裂之匕”……$b$b<吴龙默念着这一行>$b$b穆山兽！没错！$B$B外面就有好多长着巨大牙齿的穆山兽……那些牙齿就跟匕首一样长。这就是配方上要求的东西。
text.progress: I wonder how we'll mix those things into the brew? Can't grind them up - that'd be too gritty.$B$BMaybe I'll just soak 'em for a while.
text.completion: I never thought of putting mushan teeth in a brew before.$B$BThat scroll's got some wacky ideas.
text.completed: Return to Olon at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Daggers of the Great Ones
english.objectives: Obtain 3 Large Mushan Teeth.
english.description: That recipe said: "rending daggers of the great ones"...$b$b<Olon ponders this line.>$b$bMushan! That's it!$b$bThere's plenty of mushan roaming out there with these great, big teeth... they're as long as daggers. That's gotta be what the recipe calls for.
english.progress: I wonder how we'll mix those things into the brew? Can't grind them up - that'd be too gritty.$B$BMaybe I'll just soak 'em for a while.
english.completion: I never thought of putting mushan teeth in a brew before.$B$BThat scroll's got some wacky ideas.
english.completed: Return to Olon at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 我辜负了大家
text.objectives: 找回丢失的酒桶、丢失的酒杯和丢失的野餐食品。
text.description: 我让共事的酿酒师们失望了。$b$b我把一些补给品带到大树东面的空地上……结果居然忘在那儿了。现在，煞魔已经侵蚀了这片大地，而且螳螂妖也是蠢蠢欲动，要我自己去拿就太危险了。$b$b如果你能帮我找到它们，也许我还能挽回一点颜面。
text.progress: Did you find them? Can it be?
text.completion: You have brought me joy, traveler.
text.completed: Return to Thirsty Missho at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: I Bring Us Great Shame
english.objectives: Find the Lost Keg, the Lost Mugs, and the Lost Picnic Supplies.
english.description: I have failed my fellow brewers.$b$bI took some supplies out to the clearing, east of our tree... and I left them there. Now, with the sha corrupting the land, and the mantid on the prowl, it is too dangerous for me to bring them back.$b$bIf you would help me look for them, perhaps I could regain some of my lost honor.
english.progress: Did you find them? Can it be?
english.completion: You have brought me joy, traveler.
english.completed: Return to Thirsty Missho at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 撕裂之匕
text.objectives: 获得克兹克兹克之刃和伊力卡克西之刃。
text.description: 忘了他们和他们那愚蠢的啤酒吧。我们有正事要做了。$b$b卷轴上提到了“造物者的撕裂之匕”。我觉得我知道到哪儿找它们。$b$b南边的恐惧先遣站那儿有两个螳螂妖中尉在巡逻。他们都带着一把仪式匕首。$b$b把他们的匕首给我带来，$n。我们可能要有重大发现了。
text.progress: I think I'm starting to understand the next few lines of this prophecy, $n.$B$BDo you have the daggers yet?
text.completion: These daggers, look!$B$B<Lya holds the blades hilt-to-hilt.>$B$BThey were built to fit together! But how to join them...?
text.completed: Return to Lya of Ten Songs at The Sunset Brewgarden in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Rending Daggers
english.objectives: Obtain the Blade of Kz'Kzik and the Blade of Ilikkax.
english.description: Forget about them, and forget their BREW. We've got real work to do.$b$bThe scroll mentions "rending daggers of the great ones". I've got a feeling I know where to find them.$b$bA pair of mantid lieutenants patrol the Horrid March, to the south. Each one carries a ceremonial dagger.$b$bBring those daggers back here, $n. We may be on the brink of something big.
english.progress: I think I'm starting to understand the next few lines of this prophecy, $n.$B$BDo you have the daggers yet?
english.completion: These daggers, look!$B$B<Lya holds the blades hilt-to-hilt.>$B$BThey were built to fit together! But how to join them...?
english.completed: Return to Lya of Ten Songs at The Sunset Brewgarden in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 融入木头
text.objectives: 收集8块芬芳的芯材。
text.description: <吴暮盯着配方。>$b$b嗯……“融入木头”。我们通常并不用木头酿酒。$b$b在少数情况下，我们会在饮料中加入西边树人的芯材。大多数树人都死在了螳螂妖手中……不过，他们的遗骸应该就能满足配方的要求了。
text.progress: We don't brew with wood here. It gives the brew a harsh, insipid flavor, not unlike that of wine.$B$B<Vu spits.>
text.completion: I'll get these pieces prepared.$B$BWe've already gathered quite a few of these ingredients! I'll have to get a pot boiling soon.
text.completed: Return to Sapmaster Vu at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Bound With Wood
english.objectives: Obtain 8 pieces of Fragrant Corewood.
english.description: <Vu eyes the recipe.>$b$bHmm... "bound with wood". We don't typically brew with wood. Sap, yes... but not wood.$b$bWe have, on rare occasions, infused our drinks with corewood from the treants to the west of here. Most of them have fallen to the mantid... but their remains should suffice for our recipe.
english.progress: We don't brew with wood here. It gives the brew a harsh, insipid flavor, not unlike that of wine.$B$B<Vu spits.>
english.completion: I'll get these pieces prepared.$B$BWe've already gathered quite a few of these ingredients! I'll have to get a pot boiling soon.
english.completed: Return to Sapmaster Vu at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 木头和阴影
text.objectives: 找到女皇的印记和凯帕圣树·库尔的心源根。
text.description: “将撕裂之匕融入木头与阴影。”唔……$b$b我在这里的这段时间内，了解了很多关于库尔提克螳螂妖的事情。我知道他们的祭坛就在他们的巢穴，库尔维斯里。$b$b其中一个是他们居住的那棵树的主根。另一个是根黑色的柱子，是他们与女王之间的纽带。$b$b这些祭坛就是木头和阴影。如果我猜得没错……匕首会对它们产生反应的。
text.completion: $n, look! The daggers - they've bound together, into a forked blade.$B$BWe are on the right track. I knew this wasn't a beer recipe.
text.completed: Return to Lya of Ten Songs at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Wood and Shade
english.objectives: Find the Mark of the Empress and the Heartroot of Kypari Kor.
english.description: "Rending daggers of the great ones shall be bound with WOOD and SHADE."  Hmm.$b$bI've learned a lot about the Kor'thik mantid in my time here. I know that they maintain shrines within their settlement, Kor'vess.$b$bOne is a heartroot of the very tree that they inhabit. The other is a dark pillar, connecting them with their queen.$b$bThese shrines are the wood and shade. If my predictions are right... the daggers should react in their presence.
english.completion: $n, look! The daggers - they've bound together, into a forked blade.$B$BWe are on the right track. I knew this wasn't a beer recipe.
english.completed: Return to Lya of Ten Songs at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到凯帕圣树·库尔的心源根

text.title: 日落之王
text.objectives: 去里基屯村找树脂大师吴暮。
text.description: 吴龙想出了一个好主意。他认为我们应该去找西边的树精，问问他们手里是否有这些材料。这个配方里的某些材料看上去很……诡异。$b$b里基屯树精在库尔维斯西边建了个村子。我想让你去见见他们，$n。
text.completion: It's been a while since I brewed on the road.
text.completed: 去恐惧废土的里基屯村和树脂大师吴暮谈一谈。

english.title: Sunset Kings
english.objectives: Meet Sapmaster Vu at Rikkitun Village.
english.description: Olon had a clever idea. He thinks that we should visit the sprites to the west, and ask them if they have any of these ingredients. Some of the elements to this recipe are seeming... strange.$b$bThe Rikkitun sprites have a village to the west of Kor'vess. I hope to see you there, $n.
english.completion: It's been a while since I brewed on the road.
english.completed: Speak with Sapmaster Vu at Rikkitun Village in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 风暴烈酒的命运
text.objectives: 向落日酒坊的居民询问风暴烈酒族人的下落。
text.description: 你好，$r。我是陈·风暴烈酒。$b$b我在寻找我的家人。我听说有几个风暴烈酒家的人越过了长城，来帮忙抗击螳螂妖了。我想找到并加入他们。$b$b你在这儿见过叫风暴烈酒的人吗？你能帮我四处打听一下吗？
text.completion: <Chen listens intently.>$B$BBig Dan, Han, Evie, and Mama. I understand.$B$BIt seems like Dan will be safe here. I will go look for Evie, Han, and Mama Stormstout.$B$BTravel well, $n, and follow the Wanderer's Way.
text.completed: Return to Chen Stormstout at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Fate of the Stormstouts
english.objectives: Ask the inhabitants of The Sunset Brewgarden if they've seen any Stormstouts.
english.description: Greetings, $r. I am Chen Stormstout.$b$bI'm looking for my family. I am told that several Stormstouts came across the wall to help face the mantid threat. I mean to find them, and join them.$b$bHave you seen anyone named Stormstout come through here? Would you mind helping me ask around?
english.completion: <Chen listens intently.>$B$BBig Dan, Han, Evie, and Mama. I understand.$B$BIt seems like Dan will be safe here. I will go look for Evie, Han, and Mama Stormstout.$B$BTravel well, $n, and follow the Wanderer's Way.
english.completed: Return to Chen Stormstout at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

objectiveDetails.description: Speak with Lya of Ten Songs

text.title: 艾薇·风暴烈酒
text.objectives: 去落日酒坊和陈·风暴烈酒汇合，并听他念诵悼词。
text.description: 我来晚了。她是如此矮小……我也来得太晚了。$b$b应该为她举办一个隆重的葬礼。像她这样的小个子战士应该有更好的归宿。
text.progress: <Chen is in mourning.>
text.completion: <Chen is, for the moment, silent.>
text.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout at The Sunset Brewgarden.

english.title: Evie Stormstout
english.objectives: Meet Chen Stormstout at The Sunset Brewgarden, then listen to his eulogy.
english.description: I was too late. She was so small... and I was too late.$b$bShe should be given a proper burial. A little warrior like her deserves better than this.
english.progress: <Chen is in mourning.>
english.completion: <Chen is, for the moment, silent.>
english.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout at The Sunset Brewgarden.

text.title: 韩·风暴烈酒
text.objectives: 去库尔维斯下面的破晓大厅找到韩·风暴烈酒。
text.description: 我们以后有的是时间为死者哀悼。现在，我们得去找另一个风暴烈酒。$b$b我听说，韩·风暴烈酒最后一次现身时，正在探索库尔维斯。我怀疑他进入了路那边的螳螂妖巢穴。$b$b我们到下面汇合吧，$n。虽然几个螳螂妖还奈何不了我……但有你在身边，我会安心些。
text.progress: I think I see someone over there, but I can't seem to get across these amber beams.
text.completion: First Evie, now Han.$B$BI was too late again.
text.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout within the Morrowchamber beneath Kor'vess.

english.title: Han Stormstout
english.objectives: Find Han Stormstout in the Morrowchamber beneath Kor'vess.
english.description: There will be time for mourning later. For now, there are other Stormstouts to be found.$b$bThey say that Han Stormstout was last seen exploring Kor'vess. I suspect he headed into that mantid burrow, just across the way.$b$bYou should meet me down there, $n. I don't doubt that I can handle a few mantid by myself... but I'd feel better with you by my side.
english.progress: I think I see someone over there, but I can't seem to get across these amber beams.
english.completion: First Evie, now Han.$B$BI was too late again.
english.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout within the Morrowchamber beneath Kor'vess.

text.title: 恐怖升腾
text.objectives: 杀死7只蹒跚的雾行鬼和2只凯帕琥珀虫。
text.description: 我们是受到保护的，可以免受螳螂妖的侵袭。这是数千年前订下的契约。$b$b但在某些力量面前，我们并不安全。西边地下的凯帕琥珀虫会纠缠我们、追逐我们……甚至吃掉我们。雾行鬼也在不断蚕食我们的族人。$b$b帮帮我们吧，外族人。击败我们的敌人。
text.completion: It is good to have someone of your colossal size in our village.$B$BYou have many uses.
text.completed: Return to Boggeo at Rikkitun Village in Dread Wastes.

english.title: The Horror Comes A-Rising
english.objectives: Slay 7 Shuffling Mistlurkers and 2 Kyparites.
english.description: We are protected from the mantid. Such was the agreement made so many millennia ago.$b$bThere are forces from which we are not safe, however. The kyparites beneath the ground to the west will haunt us, chase us... even eat us. The mistlurkers eat our kind by the handful.$b$bHelp our people, outsider. Defeat our enemies.
english.completion: It is good to have someone of your colossal size in our village.$B$BYou have many uses.
english.completed: Return to Boggeo at Rikkitun Village in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 火焰之翼
text.objectives: 拍打里基利亚飞掠者，收集88份飞掠之尘。
text.description: 我记得那张纸上提到了“火焰之翼”。这里的那些小龙就长着翅膀。它们看上去就有些像火焰。$b$b你的动作比我快。去帮我抓一些龙回来吧……或者至少从它们身上弄些粉末下来。$b$b既然我们只是需要它们翅膀上那些闪光的火花，就没有必要杀死这些无辜的小龙了。
text.progress: I haven't been able to catch any of those things!
text.completion: YEAH!!! FLITTERLING DUST!!!$B$B<Olon throws the powder into the pot.>$B$BThis brew is turning out... strange, and pretty smelly. I'm starting to think maybe Lya was right.
text.completed: Return to Olon at Rikkitun Village in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Fiery Wings
english.objectives: Slap Rikkilea Flitterlings, then catch 88 flecks of Flitterling Dust.
english.description: I think that old paper said something about "fiery wings." Those little dragons around here have wings. They're kind of fiery, in a way.$b$bYou're quicker than me. Try catching some of those dragons... or at least slapping the powder off of them.$b$bNo point in killing a harmless little dragon, if all you want is the sparkle from their wings.
english.progress: I haven't been able to catch any of those things!
english.completion: YEAH!!! FLITTERLING DUST!!!$B$B<Olon throws the powder into the pot.>$B$BThis brew is turning out... strange, and pretty smelly. I'm starting to think maybe Lya was right.
english.completed: Return to Olon at Rikkitun Village in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 咒法妖精
text.objectives: 杀死阿古诺什和米古纳什。
text.description: 我认为我们需要这些树精的帮助。$b$b我们有两把魔法匕首，并融入了木头和阴影。现在我们需要有人对我们的神器施放古老的“咒法”。$b$b在我们请求帮助之前，得先向树精表达我们的善意。我听他们的首领提过两个雾行鬼绑架了一些村民。如果我们杀死那两个家伙……或许就能获得“咒法”作为回报了。
text.completion: Nice work. I've heard the sprites talking about us.$B$BWe're getting their attention.
text.completed: Return to Lya of Ten Songs at Rikkitun Village in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Incantations Fae and Primal
english.objectives: Slay Ahgunoss and Mygoness.
english.description: I suspect we are going to need the help of these sprites.$b$bWe have two enchanted daggers, bound together with wood and shade. Now we need someone to perform ancient "incantations" on our artifact.$b$bBefore we ask for favors, let's show the sprites that we mean well. I heard their leader talking about a pair of mistlurkers that kidnapped several of their villagers. If we slay these fog beasts... we may get the "incantation" we need in return.
english.completion: Nice work. I've heard the sprites talking about us.$B$BWe're getting their attention.
english.completed: Return to Lya of Ten Songs at Rikkitun Village in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 救赎方舟
text.objectives: 在里基屯吟咏者的协助下将3颗母种带回里基屯村的集种坑。$b$b如果你们走散了，可以用里基屯摇铃重新召唤吟咏者。
text.description: 我知道你和那个女熊猫人在找什么。在恰当的时机……我们可以为你们举行仪式。$b$b但首先，我需要帮助。我们伟大的母树正在掉种子。收集种子是我们的责任，即使是在这个危险的时期也一样。$b$b护送我的吟咏者们去找母种，他们会把种子带回集种坑的。
text.completion: Yes, good. The motherseeds are taken care of.$B$BNow, we may speak of your enchantment.
text.completed: Return to Chief Rikkitun at Rikkitun Village in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Great Vessel of Salvation
english.objectives: Bring 3 Motherseeds to the collection pit in Rikkitun Village, with the assistance of the Rikkitun Chanters.$b$bYou can use the Rikkitun Bell to re-summon your chanters if you become separated.
english.description: I know what you and the girl-panda seek. We can perform the rite for you... in time.$b$bFirst, I require aid. The seeds fall from our great mother-tree. It is our responsibility to collect them, even in dangerous times like these.$b$bEscort my chanters to the motherseeds, that they may bring them back to the collection pit.
english.completion: Yes, good. The motherseeds are taken care of.$B$BNow, we may speak of your enchantment.
english.completed: Return to Chief Rikkitun at Rikkitun Village in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 一诺千金
text.objectives: 向恐惧废土的里基屯村的里基屯酋长报到。
text.description: 这只生物刚死，一群奇怪的林精就出现了，还把它的珍珠拿走了。$b$b那些林精在附近有个村庄，叫里基屯村。或许你应该去调查一下。
text.completion: This shinyseed... it was your doing? I already had one shinyseed... but two is better.$B$BWe need only the seed, not the casing. If you like, you can keep.

english.title: Promises of Gold
english.objectives: Report to Chief Rikkitun at Rikkitun Village in Dread Wastes.
english.description: As soon as the creature died, a strange group of sprites appeared and took its pearl away.$b$bThe sprites have a village nearby, called Rikkitun Village. Perhaps you should investigate.
english.completion: This shinyseed... it was your doing? I already had one shinyseed... but two is better.$B$BWe need only the seed, not the casing. If you like, you can keep.

text.title: 施法
text.objectives: 让里基屯酋长为分叉之刃施法。
text.description: 已经很久很久没有人来请求我们部落举行这个仪式了。我会尽力而为的。
text.completion: The blade is prepared.$B$BNow, only one task remains: you must use it.
text.completed: Return to Chief Rikkitun at Rikkitun Village in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Bind the Glamour
english.objectives: Allow Chief Rikkitun to enchant the Forked Blade.
english.description: It has been a very, very long time since our tribe has been called on to perform this rite. I will do the best I can.
english.completion: The blade is prepared.$B$BNow, only one task remains: you must use it.
english.completed: Return to Chief Rikkitun at Rikkitun Village in Dread Wastes.

objectiveDetails.description: 让里基屯酋长为分叉之刃施法

text.title: 远古的血与火
text.objectives: 对明澈者伊约库克使用毁灭之叉，然后保护他逃脱。
text.description: 我们找到了叉刃，在其中融入了木头与阴影，还用古代咒法祝福了它。如果我没有猜错的话，现在该使用它了。$b$b树精们提到，在螳螂妖女皇的宫殿附近有一座名叫琥珀之冬的洞穴，里面有一块远古树脂。那肯定就是预言中提到的“远古之血”。$b$b无论那块树脂里有什么，肯定都非常重要。祝你好运，$n。
text.completion: There was a... a mantid inside that amber? I never would have thought that the solution to our war on the mantid would be... another mantid.$B$BThere are still many things that I have left to learn, but I do know this: that CERTAINLY wasn't a beer recipe.
text.completed: Return to Lya of Ten Songs at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Fires and Fears of Old
english.objectives: Use the Ruining Fork on Iyyokuk the Lucid, then protect him until he is able to escape.
english.description: We've found the blades, bound them together with wood and shade, and blessed them with an ancient incantation. If I'm not mistaken, it's time to use this thing.$b$bThe sprites spoke of an ancient piece of sap within the Amber Hibernal, a mantid cave near their empress' palace. That must be the "Blood of Ancients" that the prophecy spoke of.$b$bWhatever's inside that sap must be important. Good luck, $n.
english.completion: There was a... a mantid inside that amber? I never would have thought that the solution to our war on the mantid would be... another mantid.$B$BThere are still many things that I have left to learn, but I do know this: that CERTAINLY wasn't a beer recipe.
english.completed: Return to Lya of Ten Songs at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

objectiveDetails.description: 对明澈者伊约库克使用毁灭之叉
保护明澈者伊约库克逃脱

text.title: 远古之血
text.objectives: 获得一大块固化琥珀。
text.description: 丽亚和我都认同一件事：“远古之血”几乎可以肯定，就是当地的大树流出的树脂。我早该想到这一点的——我整天用那玩意儿酿酒。$b$b这里最古老的树就是螳螂妖女皇夏柯希尔的老巢，现在被称为恐惧之心的那棵树。帮我从那棵树上弄点琥珀回来，我们的酒就可以完成了。
text.progress: Any luck?
text.completion: That should do it! Recipe... complete.$B$BNow let's see how this beer tastes.
text.completed: Return to Sapmaster Vu at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Blood of Ancients
english.objectives: Obtain a Chunk of Solidified Amber.
english.description: Lya and I agree on one thing: "Blood of Ancients" is almost certainly the sap from the great trees of the area. I should know - I brew with the stuff all the time.$b$bThe most ancient tree of all is the one that Grand Empress Shek'zeer calls her home, now known as the Heart of Fear. Find some amber from that tree, and our brew should be complete.
english.progress: Any luck?
english.completion: That should do it! Recipe... complete.$B$BNow let's see how this beer tastes.
english.completed: Return to Sapmaster Vu at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 扩大范围
text.objectives: 激活珀光裂谷的共鸣信标。
text.description: 卡拉克西瓦听到了另一个英杰的声音。他的呼号微弱且消弭于黑暗之中，必须要加强信号。$b$b在珀光裂谷中有一座沉默已久的信标塔。卡拉克西要求它必须复原！$b$b这次我会跟你一起去，你得帮我修好它。$b$b拿上这块共鸣水晶，我们在珀光裂谷见。
text.completion: It is good you showed up when you did.$B$BPerhaps you are not as useless as I thought...$B$BThe Klaxxi'va sing to the paragon now. Soon they will know where to send you. For now there are other tasks.
text.completed: Speak with Kor'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

english.title: Extending Our Coverage
english.objectives: Activate the Resonating Beacon in Amberglow Hollow.
english.description: The Klaxxi'va hear another paragon. His cries are weak and lost in darkness. The signal must be strengthened.$b$bThere is a tower in Amberglow Hollow that has been silent for many years. It must sing; the Klaxxi demand it!$b$bThis time I will go with you. You will help me repair it.$b$bTake the resonating crystal and meet me in Amberglow.
english.completion: It is good you showed up when you did.$B$BPerhaps you are not as useless as I thought...$B$BThe Klaxxi'va sing to the paragon now. Soon they will know where to send you. For now there are other tasks.
english.completed: Speak with Kor'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

objectiveDetails.description: 对静默信标使用共鸣水晶

text.title: 罪与罚
text.objectives: 在刺芒小径杀死8个伊克提克收割者。
text.description: 刺芒小径里种植着年轻的凯帕圣树。女皇很早就开始吸收这些树苗了，外来者。在其琥珀能够被采摘之前，它们必须要继续生长。$b$b卡拉克西瓦要求对这一罪行进行惩罚！如果你能杀死那些琥珀收割者们，卡拉克西瓦会非常满意的。
text.completion: The Klaxxi are pleased with our work, outsider. You have proven to be more resourceful than we thought.
text.completed: Speak with Kor'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

english.title: Crime and Punishment
english.objectives: Kill 8 Ik'thik Harvesters on the Stinging Trail.
english.description: The Stinging Trail nurtures young Kypari trees. The empress drains the saplings too early, outsider. They must grow before the amber can be taken.$b$bThe Klaxxi'va demand punishment for this crime! It will please them if you rain death on the Ik'thik harvesters.
english.completion: The Klaxxi are pleased with our work, outsider. You have proven to be more resourceful than we thought.
english.completed: Speak with Kor'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

text.title: 大海的庇佑，一去不返
text.objectives: 对海水侵蚀的岩石使用卡拉克西音叉来唤醒英杰。
text.description: 卡拉克西瓦在对我低语，外来者。在盐碱泥滩藏匿着一位英杰，他的位置已经暴露了。$b$b蜥蜴人包围了他，决不能让英杰落入他们手中。$b$b你得找到他，你得唤醒他。搞不定就别回来见我！$b$b如果你能办到，卡拉克西会对我们另眼相看的。
text.completion: What... what sort of creature are you?$B$BHow have you awoken me?
text.completed: Speak with Kaz'tik the Manipulator.

english.title: By the Sea, Nevermore
english.objectives: Use the Klaxxi Tuning Fork on the Ocean-Worn Rocks to awaken the paragon.
english.description: The Klaxxi'va have spoken to me, outsider. The paragon is hidden in the Briny Muck only, he is not so hidden anymore.$b$bThe lizard men surround him. He cannot fall into their scaly hands.$b$bYou will find him; you will awaken him. Do not return without him!$b$bIf you do this the Klaxxi will be pleased with us.
english.completion: What... what sort of creature are you?$B$BHow have you awoken me?
english.completed: Speak with Kaz'tik the Manipulator.

text.title: 越陈越香
text.objectives: 在刺芒小径从琥珀采集器上收集7个装满琥珀的罐子。
text.description: 收割年轻的凯帕圣树是犯罪，但浪费琥珀更是罪大恶极。$b$b嫩琥珀不够好，但卡拉克西需要琥珀来继续战斗。我们给他们多带些琥珀，他们会赞扬我的！$b$b收集嫩琥珀。我们把它存起来，直到它变得成熟可食为止。
text.progress: I would go with you to gather amber, but my talents are more useful here.
text.completion: Even this raw amber will be of use. We can't afford to be picky in times like these.$B$BThe Klaxxi'va will be glad I thought of this. I will tell them you helped!
text.completed: Speak with Kor'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

english.title: Better With Age
english.objectives: Gather 7 Amber-Filled Jars from the Amber Collectors on the Stinging Trail.
english.description: It is a crime to harvest the young trees, but a much bigger crime to waste the amber.$b$bYoung amber is not as strong, but the Klaxxi need it to continue the fight. We will bring them more and they will sing my praises!$b$bGather the young amber. We will store it until it is aged and can be consumed.
english.progress: I would go with you to gather amber, but my talents are more useful here.
english.completion: Even this raw amber will be of use. We can't afford to be picky in times like these.$B$BThe Klaxxi'va will be glad I thought of this. I will tell them you helped!
english.completed: Speak with Kor'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

text.title: 物归原主
text.objectives: 在操纵者卡兹提克寻找他最强大的武器时，帮助他。
text.description: 你看看我，我不是什么了不起的勇士。为什么我会被选中做英杰？不是所有的武器都是有形的，唤醒者。凡事不应该只看外表。$b$b在我进一步深入解说之前，我得了解你是否值得信任。$b$b在我被封存起来的时候，某个珍贵的东西也被藏了起来。没有那东西，我什么也不是。$b$b在我寻找我最强大的武器时保护好我，然后你就能获得我的信任了。
text.completion: Kovok is just as impressive as the last time I saw him. He will ensure great victories for the Klaxxi.
text.completed: Speak with Kaz'tik the Manipulator in the Briny Muck.

english.title: Reunited
english.objectives: Assist Kaz'tik the Manipulator as he unearths his greatest weapon.
english.description: You look at me and see I am no great warrior. Why was I chosen to be a Paragon? Not all weapons can be seen, Wakener. One should not judge by appearance alone.$b$bBefore I explain further, I need to know that you are trustworthy.$b$bSomething precious to me was hidden at the time of my preservation. I am nothing without it.$b$bDefend me as I unearth my greatest weapon, and you will have my trust.
english.completion: Kovok is just as impressive as the last time I saw him. He will ensure great victories for the Klaxxi.
english.completed: Speak with Kaz'tik the Manipulator in the Briny Muck.

objectiveDetails.description: 操纵者卡兹提克抵达封印之土
找到卡兹提克最强大的武器

text.title: 要么喂它，要么被吃掉
text.objectives: 给科沃克喂食6块多汁的乌龟肉片以开始对它的训练。你可以在盐碱泥滩的盐水壳钳嘴龟身上找到这种肉。
text.description: 和恐虫打了多年交道后，我总结出一个理论：从小养育一条恐虫会加强你与它之间的羁绊，同时也加强了它与音波的联系。$b$b当我被封存起来的时候，我才刚刚开始训练科沃克。它还很小，需要通过刻苦训练才能激发出全部的潜能。$b$b我把科沃克交给你了，但要注意，一旦它受到任何伤害，你的性命也会岌岌可危。$b$b首先，你要喂它吃东西来赢取信任。这附近的乌龟就很合它的胃口。
text.completion: Very good! I had half expected Kovok to just eat you. What a pleasant surprise to see you both in one piece,$B$BPerhaps Kunchong raising is in your blood.
text.completed: Speak with Kaz'tik the Manipulator in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Feed or Be Eaten
english.objectives: Begin Kovok's training by feeding him 6 Succulent Turtle Filets found on the Brineshell Snappers in the Briny Muck.
english.description: After years of working with the Kunchong I developed a theory; raising one from infancy would strengthen the bond and therefore strengthen the sonic connection.$b$bI had just begun training Kovok when I was chosen for encasement. He is still very young and will need diligent training to reach his full potential.$b$bI'm entrusting Kovok to you, but be warned; if any harm comes to him your life is forfeit.$b$bFirst, you must feed him to gain his trust. The turtles in the area should be suitable for this.
english.completion: Very good! I had half expected Kovok to just eat you. What a pleasant surprise to see you both in one piece,$B$BPerhaps Kunchong raising is in your blood.
english.completed: Speak with Kaz'tik the Manipulator in Klaxxi'vess.

objectiveDetails.description: 将多汁的乌龟肉片喂给科沃克

text.completion: Hozen are, by their very nature, a rambunctious lot.$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.

text.objectives: 将《鱼尾传》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b我已彻底研读了你那份关于锦鱼人的调查报告。这是一个神奇，并且十分聪明的种族。$b$b如果你能来闻道之座一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
text.completion: This is a real treat. I always did enjoy the jinyu. Such a peaceful people with a real appreciation for wisdom.$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。
