english.description: Dear $p,$b$bI have thoroughly enjoyed reading your research in to the jinyu. A fascinating people and quite clever too.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completion: This is a real treat. I always did enjoy the jinyu. Such a peaceful people with a real appreciation for wisdom.$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.

text.objectives: 将《魔古的黑心》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b我们一直都知道魔古族十分邪恶凶狠，而你的调查报告则表明他们比想象中更糟糕。$b$b如果你能来闻道之座一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓

Your research however would imply that they are far worse.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho

text.objectives: 将《螳螂群之心》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。

english.title: The Song of the Yaungol
english.objectives: Bring The Song of the Yaungol to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
english.description: Dear $p,$b$bYour research in to the yaungol has proven most insightful.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completion: The yaungol are a warring people strengthened by their exile beyond the wall. We will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 《酒中仙传奇》
text.objectives: 将《酒中仙传奇》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b你那份关于酒中仙的调查报告非常……令人垂涎。$b$b如果你能来闻道之座一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。

english.title: Legends of the Brewfathers
english.objectives: Bring Legends of the Brewfathers to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
english.description: Dear $p,$b$bYour research in to the Brewfathers has proven most... thirstifying.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Kowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 《少昊的七罪责》
text.objectives: 将《少昊的七罪责》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b看上去好像你发现了少昊的所有故事，他是潘达利亚王朝的末代皇帝。$b$b如果你能来锦绣谷的闻道之座一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
text.completion: This is a story I have long sought to uncover. Ever since the Sha was released I have felt in my belly that this tale was at the heart of it all.$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。

english.title: The Seven Burdens of Shaohao
english.objectives: Bring The Seven Burdens of Shaohao to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
english.description: Dear $p,$b$bIt would seem you have discovered the full tale of Shaohao, the last emperor of Pandaria.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completion: This is a story I have long sought to uncover. Ever since the Sha was released I have felt in my belly that this tale was at the heart of it all.$B$BWe will add this knowledge to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 《刘浪之歌》
text.objectives: 将《刘浪之歌》带给闻道之座的游学者周卓。
text.description: 亲爱的$p，$b$b多亏了你的调查，我们得到了全本的《刘浪之歌》。$b$b如果你能来锦绣谷的闻道之座一趟，我们就可以将这一成果加入你的私人收藏。$b$b感谢你的努力！$b$b此致，$b$b游学者周卓
text.completion: The long lost story of Lou Lang and his Wandering Isle. This is a superb addition to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。

english.title: The Ballad of Liu Lang
english.objectives: Bring The Ballad of Liu Lang to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.
english.description: Dear $p,$b$bAt long last thanks to your research we have the full Ballad of Liu Lang.$b$bIf you visit us at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms we can add this contribution to your personal collection.$b$bThank you for your diligence!$b$bSincerely,$b$bLorewalker Cho
english.completion: The long lost story of Lou Lang and his Wandering Isle. This is a superb addition to your collection. If you wish me to narrate this for you, simply point at the correct volume in your Private Collection.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Kowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 挑战者之环：雅丽亚·圣言者
text.objectives: 挑战雅丽亚·圣言者，并在挑战者之环击败她。
text.description: 影踪派的兄弟姐妹们都在私下议论你的事迹，$n。$B$B其实，雅丽亚对你的功夫也很感兴趣。$B$B她希望在训练之环向你发起挑战。$B$B你可以露两手让她领教一下。如果你赢了，她将来或许会帮你一把。
text.completion: You did it! You bested Yalia!$B$BYou have most definitely earned her favor, $R.
text.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Challenger's Ring: Yalia Sagewhisper
english.objectives: Challenge Yalia Sagewhisper and defeat her in the Challenger's Ring.
english.description: The Shado-Pan brothers and sisters continue to whisper of your deeds, $n.$B$BIn fact, Yalia herself has taken quite an interest in your studies.$B$BShe wishes to challenge you in the training ring.$B$BYou would do well to impress her. If you do, she just may be willing to help you in the future.
english.completion: You did it! You bested Yalia!$B$BYou have most definitely earned her favor, $R.
english.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 魔古的威胁
text.objectives: 击败12个山泽缚龙者或山泽兽王。
text.description: 我们的斥候在西北方的山泽岛发现一股强大的魔古势力。$B$B这个岛本应是荒无人烟的，所以他们的出现是个让人不安的消息。$B$B而更让我不安的是他们正在岛上进行邪恶的实验。$B$B我需要一名能力出众的$c去探查一下情况。$B$B山泽部落可能会给你带来麻烦，如果真是这样，就干掉他们。
text.completion: The Shan'ze are up to something. Well done, $n, but we must continue to monitor their actions.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Mogu Menace
english.objectives: Kill 12 Shan'ze Serpentbinders or Shan'ze Beastmasters.
english.description: Our scouts have discovered a heavy mogu force at Shan'ze Dao to the northwest.$B$BThe island was supposedly uninhabited, so their presence is disturbing news.$B$BEven more disturbing is the fact that they are performing sinister experiments on the island.$B$BI need a capable $c to check out the situation.$B$BThe Shan'ze are likely to give you trouble, and if they do, kill them.
english.completion: The Shan'ze are up to something. Well done, $n, but we must continue to monitor their actions.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败山泽缚龙者或山泽兽王

objectiveDetails.description: 击败山泽缚龙者或山泽兽王

text.title: 新帝国的公民
text.objectives: 去凯帕圣树·沃尔收集10个沃提克虫卵。
text.description: 在夏柯希尔的统治下，凯帕圣树·沃尔的凯帕圣树已被扭曲成了一根恐怖图腾。$B$B正如宫殿外的情况一样，附近的虫巢如今被用来腐化我们的后代。$B$B在沃提克虫卵被腐化前夺回它们，我们要在这里孵化它们。它们将成为新帝国的公民，远离煞魔的威胁。
text.progress: Kypari Vor was beautiful once. Rich with amber and surrounded by prime hunting grounds.
text.completion: They are large. They will hatch soon.$B$BGood. We may need them.
text.completed: Return to Malik the Unscathed at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Citizens of a New Empire
english.objectives: Gather 10 Vor'thik Eggs from Kypari Vor.
english.description: At Shek'zeer's command, the great kypari tree of Kypari Vor was twisted into a totem of horror.$B$BLike those outside of the palace, the clutch nearby is now used to corrupt our swarmborn.$B$BRecover the eggs of the Vor'thik before they are tainted. We shall raise them here. They will be the citizens of a new empire, free from the sha.
english.progress: Kypari Vor was beautiful once. Rich with amber and surrounded by prime hunting grounds.
english.completion: They are large. They will hatch soon.$B$BGood. We may need them.
english.completed: Return to Malik the Unscathed at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 密集的恐惧
text.objectives: 从凯帕圣树·沃尔的沃提克塑恐者身上收集4块恐惧琥珀焦镜。
text.description: 琥珀就是能量，它带来了生命。$B$B你带给我的这块……恐惧琥珀，已经被腐蚀了，它现在充满了恐惧。$B$B沃提克对此物非常熟悉，他们的凯帕圣树已经完全被煞魔所侵蚀了，他们还用这些恐惧琥珀来喂养他们的虫群。$B$B把沃提克塑恐者用在仪式上的水晶带回来给我，卡拉克西会着手研究并拟定应对方案的。
text.progress: Do you have the crystals?
text.completion: What would happen, I wonder, if you ate one? What would it do to your soft, pink insides?
text.completed: Return to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Concentrated Fear
english.objectives: Gather 4 Dread Amber Foci from Vor'thik Fear-Shapers at Kypari Vor.
english.description: Amber is power. It brings life.$B$BThis... dread amber you brought me has been twisted. It is concentrated fear.$B$BThe Vor'thik know this well. Their kypari has been completely engulfed by sha, and they use the dread amber to quicken their own swarmborn.$B$BBring me the crystals used by the Vor'thik fear-shapers in their rituals. The Klaxxi will study them and decide on a protocol for disposal.
english.progress: Do you have the crystals?
english.completion: What would happen, I wonder, if you ate one? What would it do to your soft, pink insides?
english.completed: Return to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 血洗虫群
text.objectives: 在夏柯希尔之巢杀死40只夏柯希尔螳螂妖。和掠风者克尔鲁克谈一谈，进行空降。
text.description: 女皇还在不断地集结大军。如不加以阻止，他们将越过城墙——哪怕这需要踏过无数聚生虫的尸体。$B$B让我们给这些尸体找个更好的去处吧。$B$B你准备好前往虫巢后就跟我说一下——我会很乐意把你丢下去的。
text.completion: This will do, for now.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Culling the Swarm
english.objectives: Slay 40 Shek'zeer Mantid in the Clutches of Shek'zeer. Speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver for an air-drop.
english.description: The Empress continues to amass her forces. Without intervention, they WILL overrun that wall - even if it means smothering it in the corpses of a million swarmborn.$B$BLet us find a better place for those corpses.$B$BLet me know when you are ready to depart for the clutches - I will gladly drop you in from above.
english.completion: This will do, for now.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 穿过传送门
text.objectives: 收集1000份远古魔粉。
text.description: 啊，你就是我要找的$c！$B$B我们终于搞清楚为什么传送门会失灵了。我们需要更多的魔粉！$B$B如果用船运到我们这儿，那要花几个月的时间，幸好这岛上的魔古族为他们的魔法仪式准备了很多魔粉。$B$B他们常常使用一些古老过时的东西，所以我们要多弄一点来。
text.progress: Did you find the powders?
text.completion: Excellent! Excellent!$B$BThis is just the stuff, $n.$B$BWe'll get to work right away. I have no doubt we'll be done very soon.
text.completed: Return to Moshu the Arcane at Shan'ze Dao in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Through the Portal
english.objectives: Collect 1000 Ancient Arcane Powder.
english.description: Ah, just the $c I wanted to see!$B$BWe've finally figured out why the portal is not working. We need more arcane powder!$B$BIt would take us months to get a shipment sent out to us, but luckily, the mogu on this island carry plenty for their own spells.$B$BThey tend to use some older stuff, so we're going to need a lot of it.
english.progress: Did you find the powders?
english.completion: Excellent! Excellent!$B$BThis is just the stuff, $n.$B$BWe'll get to work right away. I have no doubt we'll be done very soon.
english.completed: Return to Moshu the Arcane at Shan'ze Dao in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 清剿扎尼提克
text.objectives: 在扎尼维斯杀死6个扎尼提克穿刺者和6个扎尼提克操纵者。
text.description: 毋庸置疑，扎尼维斯的战士是整个帝国最可怕和值得尊重的对手。$B$B穿刺者对长柄武器的使用非常精湛，肯定是玛里克曾经在扎尼提克训练过他们。他们的操纵者可以轻松掌控可怕的音波力量和呼吸的精要秘诀。$B$B这两种敌人都必须被消灭掉。
text.completion: I will admit, Wakener, I am impressed.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Eradicating the Zan'thik
english.objectives: Kill 6 Zan'thik Impalers and 6 Zan'thik Manipulators in Zan'vess.
english.description: The warriors of Zan'vess are some of the most feared and respected in the empire, for good reason.$B$BImpalers are unmatched in their mastery of the polearm - no doubt Malik trained among the Zan'thik in his time. Their manipulators command terrifying sonic power with the ease and subtlety of a breath.$B$BBoth will need to be dealt with.
english.completion: I will admit, Wakener, I am impressed.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 问题变得棘手了！
text.objectives: 从水精身上收集5份应急补给。
text.description: 这个箱子里曾经装满了急需的补给品，但却遭到了洗劫。$b$b我们在迅速搜索这个区域后发现了盗贼留下的踪迹。冰荆棘，东边海岸线上的水精身上就长着这些东西。$b$b对于你们这群幸存者来说，这是个生死攸关的情况。你必须把这些补给品从这些小偷那里夺回来，并带回到营地。
text.progress: You manage to get your hands on them supplies, pal?
text.completion: Look at that!$B$BThese supplies should keep us kickin' for a few more days.$B$BAnd my boots! Ya managed not to blow 'em up. Way ta go, $n!
text.completed: Speak to Rivett at Hellscream's Fist.

english.title: They're So Thorny!
english.objectives: Collect 5 Emergency Supplies from the Water Sprites.
english.description: The crate, once full of desperately needed supplies, has been thoroughly pillaged.$b$bA quick scan of the area shows evidence left behind by the thieves. Icy thorns, just like the ones on the water sprites on the shoreline to the east.$b$bThis is a life or death situation for your band of survivors. Those supplies need to be retrieved from these thieving pests and returned to camp.
english.progress: Ну как, дружище, удалось тебе добраться до украденных вещичек?
english.completion:
Только взгляните!

Эти вещицы помогут нам продержаться еще несколько дней.

И мои ботинки! Они целы! Отличная работа, Тобру!
english.completed: Speak to Rivett at Hellscream's Fist.

text.title: 突袭铠胄火营
text.objectives: 击败16个铠胄野牛人、铠胄地语者或铠胄投火者。
text.description:
野牛人一直都是我们的威胁，而东北边铠胄火营的野牛人在最近的昆莱山入侵事件中与奥苏尔野牛人狼狈为奸。

我们一定要让这些侵略者付出代价。

我要你去突袭铠胄火营。我们得让他们疲于应付，免得他们再次威胁玄牛关。
text.completion: Well - that should certainly deter any attack for a while. Good work, $n.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Assault Fire Camp Gai-Cho
english.objectives: Kill 16 Gai-Cho Yaungol, Earthtalkers or Pitchthrowers.
english.description:
The Yaungol are a constant nuisance, but the group at Fire Camp Gai-Cho, to the northeast, conspired with the Osul yaungol in their recent incursion into Kun-Lai.

We cannot allow such an incursion to go unpunished.

Go, attack Fire Camp Gai-Cho. We need to make sure they remain occupied, so that they cannot rise up and threaten The Ox Gate again.
english.completion: Well - that should certainly deter any attack for a while. Good work, $n.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败铠胄野牛人、地语者或投火者

text.title: 突袭死语者高地
text.objectives: 击败8个死语渎尸者和1个死语碾压者。
text.description:
我们从来没有去招惹过死语者。长久以来，他们只负责维护野牛人神圣的陵园。

而现在，他们却在施放黑暗魔法，亵渎那些已故氏族成员的尸体……

我不知道他们从哪儿学来的黑暗魔法，也不知道他们为什么不再尊重死者，但是我们已经没时间去讨论这个了。

我们必须阻止他们。
text.completion: By conspiring to use these dark magics, the Deadtalkers have given up their rights to protection. Your actions should deter them from their current course, I hope.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Assault Deadtalker's Plateau
english.objectives: Kill 8 Deadtalker Corpsedefilers and 1 Deadtalker Crusher.
english.description:
We have always left the Deadtalkers alone. For so long, they were just responsible for maintaining the sacred burial grounds of the yaungol tribes.

Now, though, they are practicing dark magic, defiling the corpses of their former clanmates... 

I know not where they learned those dark magics, or why they no longer treat their dead with respect, but we do not have time to find out. 

We need to stop them.
english.completion: By conspiring to use these dark magics, the Deadtalkers have given up their rights to protection. Your actions should deter them from their current course, I hope.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 灵魂尘
text.objectives: 在螳螂高原的死语者高地，将8个灵魂尘注入到遗骸中。
text.description:
野牛人从他们先祖遗骸中捕获的灵魂里仍存有一些生命精华。

如果你在战斗中打败了先祖灵魂，你便可以收集这些精华并凝炼为灵魂尘，然后将其注入到遗骸中，让这些灵魂最终得以投胎转世。

这也是唯一能够弥补死语者过失的办法了。这也有助于保护我们自身的安全。
text.completion: Good, you have helped right this terrible wrong.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Spirit Dust
english.objectives: Return 8 spirits to their remains at the Deadtalker Plateau in Townlong Steppes.
english.description:
The spirits that the Yaungol are entrapping from the remains of their ancestors still have a bit of the essence of life within them. 

If you defeat the spirits in battle, you can collect essence from the spirits as dust, and then return it to the corpses in the area, which will send the spirits, finally, to the next life.

This is the only way to set right what the Deadtalkers have done. It will also help keep us safe.
english.completion: Good, you have helped right this terrible wrong.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 乌奴克！
text.objectives: 去螳螂高原的死语者高地击败乌奴克。
text.description: 乌奴克是螳螂高原的野牛人中的死语者。打败他之后，你的任务才算真正地完成。快去干掉他吧！
text.completion: Uruk is dead! This threat has subsided, at least for today. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.
text.giverWindow: 螳螂高原的野牛人中堕落的死语者。

english.title: Uruk!
english.objectives: Kill Uruk at Deadtalker's Plateau in Townlong Steppes.
english.description: Uruk is the Deadtalker of the Townlong yaungol. Your mission will not be truly complete until you defeat him. Go to it!
english.completion: Uruk is dead! This threat has subsided, at least for today. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.
english.giverWindow: The corrupted Deadtalker of the Townlong yaungol.

text.title: 顺藤摸瓜
text.objectives: 从死语者高地的野牛人那里收集缚魂仪式卷轴。
text.description:
我们得搞清楚死语者出了什么问题。

多年以来，死语者只是负责维护陵园，以及为死去的战士举行葬礼。

在最近一次行动中，我们发现了一块石板。上面显然用暗语写了些东西，但之前我们从未接触过类似东西。如果你能从死语者身上搞到一个暗语卷轴，我们就可以对这些暗语进行解码工作，看看到底发生了什么事。
text.progress: Did you find something?
text.completion: Aha! Show me that.$B$BHmm... we will send this to the monastery for analysis. As we find which of these symbols are most common in their writing, we can begin to understand the meaning of these writings.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Deadtalker Cipher
english.objectives: Collect a Scroll of Spiritbinding Rites from the yaungol at Deadtalker's Plateau.
english.description:
We need to understand what went wrong with the Deadtalkers. 

For so many years, the Deadtalkers were simply responsible for maintaining the burial grounds and holding funerals for fallen warriors.

From a recent raid, we've recovered a tablet from the grounds that is clearly written using a cipher, but it isn't one we've encountered before. If you can gather a ciphered scroll from one of the Deadtalkers, we can begin to put together the cypher and understand what's happened.
english.progress: Did you find something?
english.completion: Aha! Show me that.$B$BHmm... we will send this to the monastery for analysis. As we find which of these symbols are most common in their writing, we can begin to understand the meaning of these writings.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 我敌人的敌人……还是我的敌人！
text.objectives: 在铠胄战线使用野牛人高爆油桶击败100个螳螂妖或野牛人。
text.description:
螳螂妖是我们的敌人。铠胄火营的野牛人也是。

万幸的是，这两伙人也是死对头。科里维斯的螳螂妖经常袭击铠胄野牛人，而后者则将他们死死挡在了大门外。

我要你去火上浇油。从铠胄营地“借”一些高爆油桶，然后空投到战场上。

我不管你杀死的是哪一边的敌人，尽量多消灭一点就行。
text.completion: Ha! Good work. Teaches both of them to make enemies of the Shado-Pan.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Enemy of My Enemy... Is Still My Enemy!
english.objectives: Use Highly Explosive Yaungol Oil Barrels to kill 100 mantid or yaungol on the Gai-Cho Battlefield.
english.description:
The mantid are our enemies. As are the yaungol at Fire Camp Gai-Cho.

It is fortunate, then, that they are also each other's enemies. Mantid from Kri'vess constantly attack the Gai-Cho yaungol, who hold them off at their front gates.

I want you to wreak havoc. "Borrow" some highly explosive oil barrels from camp Gai-Cho, and toss them down onto the battlefield from the air.

I don't care which ones you kill, just kill a lot of them.
english.completion: Ha! Good work. Teaches both of them to make enemies of the Shado-Pan.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败铠胄战线的战斗人员

text.title: 成柏！
text.objectives: 去螳螂高原的铠胄火营击败成柏。
text.description:
成柏是铠胄火营的战争使者。你已经大大削弱了他们的有生力量，现在该是给他们致命一击的时候了。

去杀死战争使者吧！
text.completion: With Cheng Bo subdued, we can refocus our efforts on our other enemies. Your efforts earn you much respect, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.
text.giverWindow: 铠胄野牛人的战争使者。

english.title: Cheng Bo!
english.objectives: Kill Cheng-Bo at Fire Camp Gai-Cho in Townlong Steppes.
english.description:
Cheng Bo is the Warbringer of Fire Camp Gai-Cho. While you've made a dent in their operations, you now have an opportunity to strike a major blow. 

Slay the Warbringer!
english.completion: With Cheng Bo subdued, we can refocus our efforts on our other enemies. Your efforts earn you much respect, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.
english.giverWindow: The Warbringer of the Gai-Cho yaungol.

text.title: 驻足聆听
text.objectives: 与周卓一起品茶。
text.description: 跑跑跑——你们这些人总是这么风风火火的吗？$b$b坐下来陪我喝口茶，我们来探讨一下你遇到的困境。$b$b<游学者周卓的脸上挂着耐心的笑容。>
text.completion: I will help you, traveler, but first I would like to learn a little about this Horde of yours...
text.completed: Speak to Lorewalker Cho.

english.title: Stay a While, and Listen
english.objectives: Drink from Cho's Teapot.
english.description: Rush rush rush - are your people always in such a hurry?$b$bSit and have some tea with me a moment, and we will discuss your plight.$b$b<Lorewalker Cho's features settle into a patient smile.>
english.completion: I will help you, traveler, but first I would like to learn a little about this Horde of yours...
english.completed: Speak to Lorewalker Cho.

text.title: 挑战者之环：魔音贯耳超风
text.objectives: 挑战魔音贯耳超风，然后在螳螂高原的影踪卫戍营中打败她。
text.description:
看来你是个不错的战士，$p。

超风听说你的事迹之后，就一直念叨着要怎样踢爆你的……

嗯，我觉得你应该挑战她一下，赢得她的尊重。
text.completion: I'm sure there's no hard feelings. She just loves a good fight.$B$BYou should talk to her next time I have some missions for you. She's quite an able fighter, as I'm sure you saw.
text.completed: Return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
text.giverWindow: 体格强健（又喜欢夸夸其谈）的影踪派黑衣卫。

english.title: The Challenger's Ring: Chao the Voice
english.objectives: Challenge Chao the Voice, and then defeat her in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
english.description:
It looks like you're quite the fighter, $p.

Chao heard about it, and she's been talking about how she'd kick your...

Well, let's just say I think you should challenge her and try to get her respect.
english.completion: I'm sure there's no hard feelings. She just loves a good fight.$B$BYou should talk to her next time I have some missions for you. She's quite an able fighter, as I'm sure you saw.
english.completed: Return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
english.giverWindow: An able bodied (and loud mouthed) Blackguard of the Shado-Pan.

text.title: 挑战者之环：铁腹老陈
text.objectives: 挑战铁腹老陈，然后在螳螂高原的影踪卫戍营中打败他。
text.description:
老陈最近好像有点不知所谓……或者说是被啤酒冲昏了头脑。

经过最近几次战斗之后，他就好像着了魔一样，整天研究着如何酿出一种战斗美酒。

那也没什么大不了，但我们需要他去战斗！

你应该去挑战他一下，看能不能把他打醒。

如果你能打败他，他就可能会为了胜过你而重新投入战斗！
text.completion: Wow, you must have impressed Lao-Chin. He can't stop talking about how excited he is to go out and fight with you. Good work.
text.completed: Return to Master Snowdrift at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Challenger's Ring: Lao-Chin the Iron Belly
english.objectives: Challenge Lao-Chen the Iron Belly and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
english.description:
Lao-Chin seems to have his head in the clouds... or, rather, in his beer.

After all of his recent battles, he seems completely obsessed with with trying to develop the perfect brew for fighting. 

That's well and good, but we need him to actually do some fighting!

You should go challenge him, see if you can snap him out of his rut. 

If you beat him, he'll probably want to go out and help fight just to try to one-up you!
english.completion: Wow, you must have impressed Lao-Chin. He can't stop talking about how excited he is to go out and fight with you. Good work.
english.completed: Return to Master Snowdrift at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 风暴烈酒的命运
text.objectives: 向落日酒坊的居民询问风暴烈酒族人的下落。
text.description: $p！看你远道而来，却如此神采奕奕，真让我高兴。看来我俩所走的道路交集真多。$b$b我来这儿寻找我的家人。我听说有几个风暴烈酒家的人越过了长城，来帮忙抗击螳螂妖了。我想找到并加入他们。$b$b你在这儿见过叫风暴烈酒的人吗？你能帮我四处打听一下吗？
text.completion: <Chen listens intently.>$B$BBig Dan, Han, Evie, and Mama. I understand.$B$BIt seems like Dan will be safe here. I will go look for Evie, Han, and Mama Stormstout.$B$BTake care, $n.
text.completed: Return to Chen Stormstout at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Fate of the Stormstouts
english.objectives: Ask the inhabitants of The Sunset Brewgarden if they've seen any Stormstouts.
english.description: $p! It is so great to see you healthy, and traveling so far. It would seem that our paths are quite tightly intertwined.$b$bI'm here looking for my family. I am told that several Stormstouts came across the wall to help face the mantid threat. I mean to find them, and join them.$b$bHave you seen anyone named Stormstout come through here? Would you mind helping me ask around?
english.completion: <Chen listens intently.>$B$BBig Dan, Han, Evie, and Mama. I understand.$B$BIt seems like Dan will be safe here. I will go look for Evie, Han, and Mama Stormstout.$B$BTake care, $n.
english.completed: Return to Chen Stormstout at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 拜访游学者周卓
text.objectives: 帮助游学者周卓收拾房间，跟他成为朋友：帮他修剪树木，粉刷墙壁，给他的小鸟喂食。
text.description: 陌生人，我也许能帮你找到你们的王子。但首先，我想多了解一下你和你的人民。$B$B过来，帮我做点杂务活，然后我们再聊聊。$B$B虽然你看起来像个身经百战的老兵，但你肯定不会吝啬几分钟的时间，来帮一个像我这样的熊猫人书呆子收拾一下房间的，对吧？
text.completion: Despite your many years of combat, you've still got an eye for beauty, $n. I like that about you!$B$BNow, let's find this missing prince of yours.
text.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Dreamer's Pavilion in the Jade Forest.

english.title: A Visit with Lorewalker Cho
english.objectives: Befriend Lorewalker Cho by assisting him around his house: Trim his tree, paint his wall, and feed his birds.
english.description: Stranger, I may be able to help you find your prince. But first, I would like to know a little more about you and your people.$B$BCome, help me with my chores, and we will chat.$B$BYou have the look of a grizzled war veteran, but certainly you have a few minutes to help a bookish Pandaren like myself putter around the house, yes?
english.completion: Despite your many years of combat, you've still got an eye for beauty, $n. I like that about you!$B$BNow, let's find this missing prince of yours.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at the Dreamer's Pavilion in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 琼花湖
text.objectives: 和琼花湖的禾·软足谈一谈。
text.description: 报告显示琼花湖今天异常平静，但我还是派了任·火舌与禾·软足去确认一下。$B$B如果你想助一臂之力的话，那就去琼花湖的西边跟禾碰面，帮助他解决任何可能的威胁，确保那里的安全。
text.completion: <He Softfoot smiles at you as you approach.>

english.title: Whitepetal Lake
english.objectives: Speak to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake.
english.description: Reports suggest that things are quiet at Whitepetal Lake today, but I've dispatched Ren Firetongue and He Softfoot to make sure it stays they way.$B$BIf you want to aid the effort further, head to the west to the lake, meet up with He, and help him keep things secure from any hostile threats.
english.completion: <He Softfoot smiles at you as you approach.>

text.title: 设身处地
text.objectives: 和骨之环的游学者周卓谈一谈。
text.description: 哦，请恕我无礼。严格来说，我应该是这里的主人。$b$b在向你提出问题前，请允许我先介绍一下我自己和我的族人。
text.completion: I suppose the best way to explain what a Lorewalker is all about is to show you...

english.title: A Mile in My Shoes
english.objectives: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Circle of Bone.
english.description: Oh, where have my manners gone? Technically, I suppose I am the host here.$b$bAllow me to tell you a little bit about myself and my people before asking questions of you.
english.completion: I suppose the best way to explain what a Lorewalker is all about is to show you...

text.title: 库尔提克的侵袭
text.objectives: 在库尔维斯杀死17只库尔提克螳螂妖。
text.description: 我可不是酿酒师——光看这堆得像山一样的原料，我就开始头晕了。酿完后把酒放在我面前就好了，谢谢你。$b$b你有所不知，我在这里的任务其实是保证酿酒师在酿造绝世好酒的过程中不被人劈成两半，这可不是件容易活。$b$b盆地对面的库尔提克螳螂妖每晚都会攻击我们。如果你准备前往那边，不如帮我们消灭一些螳螂妖作为回报，怎么样？
text.completion: You've got the makings of a fine brewgarden guard, $R. Let me know if you ever get tired of the whole "$C" thing.
text.completed: Return to Defender Azzo at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

english.title: Kor'thik Aggression
english.objectives: Slay 17 Kor'thik Mantid at Kor'vess.
english.description: I'm no brewer - just looking at all those heaps of ingredients makes my head spin. Just put the brew in front of me when it's finished, thank you.$b$bNo, I'm here to make sure that the brewers don't get cut in half while they're trying to make that perfect brew. It's not an easy job.$b$bThe Kor'thik mantid across this basin have been attacking us nightly. If you're already heading over there, why don't you return the favor and attack a few of them?
english.completion: You've got the makings of a fine brewgarden guard, $R. Let me know if you ever get tired of the whole "$C" thing.
english.completed: Return to Defender Azzo at The Sunset Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.

text.title: 顽石开口
text.objectives: 在骨之环使用巨石。
text.description: 这是一片非常古老的土地，旅行者。$b$b直到最近我才拼凑出了一种方法来破译出石头上所雕刻的那些失落的文字。$b$b哦，新发现真让人兴奋！我向你保证，发现的热情永远不会淡漠。$b$b在这里，你是客人。你应该享有这份殊荣。我是认真的。$b$b使用这把钥匙，解开石头中暗藏的秘密吧。
text.completion: That is enough translating for one day, I think.$B$BThis experience has been an enlightening one, I hope.
text.completed: Speak to Loremaster Cho at the Circle of Bone.

english.title: If These Stones Could Speak
english.objectives: Use the Stone Monoliths at the Circle of Bone.
english.description: This is a very ancient place, traveler.$b$bOnly recently have I pieced together a method of translating the forgotten language carved into these stones.$b$bOh, the thrill of discovery! This never gets old, I assure you.$b$bHere, you are the guest. You do the honors. I insist.$b$bUse this key to unlock the secrets the stones contain.
english.completion: That is enough translating for one day, I think.$B$BThis experience has been an enlightening one, I hope.
english.completed: Speak to Loremaster Cho at the Circle of Bone.

text.title: 诺莫瑞根的未来
text.objectives: 到新工匠镇去找侏儒之友西希。
text.description: 每帮助一个幸存者逃出饱受污染的诺莫瑞根大厅，对我们来说都是一场胜利。诺莫瑞根未来的希望就寄托在像你这样的$C身上。因此，我们的领袖大工匠梅卡托克组建了一支培训团队，帮助你们学习本职业的技能。$B$B侏儒之友西希从遥远的大陆来拜访我们，并且会帮助你们进行训练并适应地表生活。她正在大道另一边的小训练场上等你呢。
text.completion: Why, you look great! I've heard bad things about what happens down there.$B$BWell, are you ready to start your training in the ways of the $C?

english.title: The Future of Gnomeregan
english.objectives: Meet with Xi, Friend of the Small in New Tinkertown.
english.description: It's a victory for us every time we're able to help another survivor escape from the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan. $Cs like you will play an important part in the future of Gnomeregan. To that end, our leader, High Tinker Mekkatorque, has assembled a team of trainers to help you learn your arts.$B$BXi, Friend of the Small has visited us from a faraway land and will help oversee your training and adjustment to life on the surface. She's waiting for you on the small practice field across the road.
english.completion: Why, you look great! I've heard bad things about what happens down there.$B$BWell, are you ready to start your training in the ways of the $C?

text.title: 晋见大工匠
text.objectives: 在新工匠镇里，向大工匠梅卡托克进行自我介绍。
text.description: 我不知道你是否还记得梅卡托克。内温和其他侏儒曾提到过，你这类幸存者们普遍患有失忆症。$B$B不管怎样，大工匠梅卡托克是所有侏儒的领袖。他有个习惯，就是要亲自接见每一位被拯救的幸存者。你应该向他引荐你自己。他就在镇中心的帐篷里，跟他的军事参谋们在一起。
text.completion: It's good to meet you, $n. You've probably heard others speaking of Operation: Gnomeregan. Let me tell you a bit about what happened and why we left the dwarven city of Ironforge.
text.completed: 在新工匠镇里，向大工匠梅卡托克进行自我介绍。

english.title: Meet the High Tinker
english.objectives: Introduce yourself to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.
english.description: I don't know if you'll remember Mekkatorque or not. Nevin and the other gnomes have mentioned that memory loss is pretty common for you survivors.$B$BAnyways, High Tinker Mekkatorque is the leader of all the gnomes. He has made a habit of meeting with every rescued survivor personally. You should introduce yourself to him. He'll be with his war council beneath the tent in the center of town.
english.completion: It's good to meet you, $n. You've probably heard others speaking of Operation: Gnomeregan. Let me tell you a bit about what happened and why we left the dwarven city of Ironforge.
english.completed: Introduce yourself to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 武僧之道
text.objectives: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。学成之后，在新工匠镇的训练假人身上使用两次。
text.description: 通过战斗，你的技能将有所提高。随着技能的提高，你将开始领悟出新的招式。去吧，去探险，去学习，然后向我展示你学到了什么。
text.completion: You picked that one up quickly. I can't wait to show you some of my other favorite tricks.
text.completed: 去新工匠镇找侏儒之友西希。

english.title: The Arts of a Monk
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Once you've learned it, use it twice at a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown.
english.description: When you fight, you grow in skill. As you grow in skill, you will begin to figure out new moves. Go, explore, learn, and show me what you figure out.
english.completion: You picked that one up quickly. I can't wait to show you some of my other favorite tricks.
english.completed: Return to Xi, Friend of the Small in New Tinkertown.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Tiger Palm

text.title: 击退敌人！
text.objectives: 杀死6只黑石战狼。
text.description: 你就是来自暴风城的新兵？我是治安官玛克布莱德，这支驻防部队的指挥官。欢迎你前来报到……$B$B<玛克布莱德翻阅着文件。>$B$B$n。你是$n吧？$B$B来得正是时候。黑石兽人从山脉断口处潜入了北郡。驻防部队的士兵们正在竭力奋战，一次次地击退敌人的进攻，但是我担心他们支持不了多久了。$B$B前往西北方的森林，杀死入侵的黑石战狼！帮帮我们吧！
text.progress: Have you beaten back the Blackrock worgs?
text.completion: You've bought us a little time, $n, but we've got even bigger problems to deal with now.
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 黑石战狼是凶猛的掠食者。

english.title: Beating Them Back!
english.objectives: Kill 6 Blackrock Worgs.
english.description: So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...$B$B<McBride looks through some papers.>$B$B$n. It is $n, right?$B$BYou've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.$B$BHead northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!
english.progress: Have you beaten back the Blackrock worgs?
english.completion: You've bought us a little time, $n, but we've got even bigger problems to deal with now.
english.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: Blackrock Battle Worgs are fierce predators.

text.title: 狮入羊口
text.objectives: 消灭8名黑石间谍。
text.description: 入侵的兽人可不傻。他们密切关注着我们的动向，想要抓住有利的时机发起进攻。$B$B黑石间谍就躲藏在西北方的森林里。他们利用望远镜偷窥我们的一举一动，耐心地等待着。我要你除掉他们！$B$B杀死黑石间谍！让这帮家伙明白，我们知道他们在打什么如意算盘，而且我们做好了准备！
text.progress: Kill the spies!
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. You've turned out to be quite an asset to this garrison. It's time for you to train!
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 这是一名男性黑石间谍。黑石间谍中不乏女性成员。

english.title: Lions for Lambs
english.objectives: Kill 8 Blackrock Spies.
english.description: The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage.$B$BIn the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them!$B$BKill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!
english.progress: Kill the spies!
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. You've turned out to be quite an asset to this garrison. It's time for you to train!
english.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a male Blackrock orc spy. There are females amongst them as well.

text.title: 手写书信
text.objectives: 阅读手写书信，然后和北郡修道院的阿宝谈一谈。
text.description: 有人托我在你处理完黑石间谍的事情之后把这个东西交给你，$n。看起来像是一封用阿宝的印章密封的书信，阿宝是从远方来到这里的一个熊猫人。我想在你处理修道院的其他事情之前尽快读一下这封信。
text.progress: Ah, you got my letter, $n... good.$BI've come from afar to teach your people the ways of the $C.
text.completion: I have come from very far to train you in the ways of our people. Do not hesitate to come to me for training whenever you like.
text.giverWindow: 阿宝在北郡修道院的武器大厅中，他站在治安官玛克布莱德的身后。

english.title: Calligraphed Letter
english.objectives: Read the Calligraphed Letter and speak to Bao in Northshire Abbey.
english.description: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from dealing with the Blackrock spies, $n. It appears to be a letter sealed with the insignia of Bao, a pandaren who is visiting us from a faraway land. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.
english.progress: Ah, you got my letter, $n... good.$BI've come from afar to teach your people the ways of the $C.
english.completion: I have come from very far to train you in the ways of our people. Do not hesitate to come to me for training whenever you like.
english.giverWindow: Bao can be found at the Hall of Arms inside Northshire Abbey, directly behind Marshal McBride.

text.title: 猛虎之掌
text.objectives: 将等级提升至3级后学习“猛虎掌”，然后在北郡修道院入口南面的训练假人身上进行练习。
text.description:
既然你已有机会在战斗中测试自己的能力，那么是时候向你解释我们如此重视训练的另一个原因了。$B$B随着经验的增长，你将能够学习超出自己想象的新技能。

去吧，再积累一些经验，学习一项新技能，然后找一个训练假人进行练习。
text.completion: You're a quick learner, $n.
text.completed: 去北郡修道院武器大厅找阿宝。

english.title: Palm of the Tiger
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then practice using it on a Training Dummy south of the entrance to Northshire Abbey.
english.description:
Now that you've had the chance to test your abilities in battle, it's time to explain one more reason why training is so important.$B$BAs you get more experience, you'll be able to do new techniques you never thought of.

Go, get some experience, learn a new skill, and demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.
english.completion: You're a quick learner, $n.
english.completed: Return to Bao in the Hall of Arms at Northshire Abbey.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Tiger Palm

text.title: 加入战斗！
text.objectives: 向艾尔文森林北郡修道院后的维里副队长报到。
text.description: 我收到了来自维里副队长的紧急消息。原来黑石兽人雇佣了地精刺客。他们在修道院后面偷袭我们了的军队。维里让我派一名英雄去帮他。就是你了，$n！$B$B到修道院北边的指挥营帐去找维里副队长。出发！
text.completion: It's true, we were ambushed. I don't dare send any more soldiers out there and risk losing them too. I need a volunteer. Someone willing to risk their life!
text.giverWindow: 你可以在北郡修道院后的指挥营帐找到维里副队长。

english.title: Join the Battle!
english.objectives: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, $n!$B$BFind Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!
english.completion: It's true, we were ambushed. I don't dare send any more soldiers out there and risk losing them too. I need a volunteer. Someone willing to risk their life!
english.giverWindow: Sergeant Willem can be found at the command tent behind Northshire Abbey.

text.title: 他们派来了刺客
text.objectives: 杀死8名地精刺客。
text.description: 你见过地精吗，$n？这些邪恶的绿皮小怪物只喜欢两件东西：金币和他们自己。$B$B黑石兽人招募了一批地精刺客，屠杀我们的士兵。他们就潜伏在北面的草丛中，肉眼很难察觉。$B$B我要你去那里，杀死你撞见的所有地精。得给他们上一课，联盟不是好惹的！
text.progress: Kill the goblin assassins
text.completion: That will teach those monsters! They'll think twice before taking another mercenary job for orcs.
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 是地精刺客。邪恶的小怪物！

english.title: They Sent Assassins
english.objectives: Kill 8 Goblin Assassins.
english.description: Have you ever seen a goblin, $n? They're wretched little green-skinned monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves.$B$BThe Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass.$B$BI need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!
english.progress: Kill the goblin assassins
english.completion: That will teach those monsters! They'll think twice before taking another mercenary job for orcs.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a goblin assassin. Nasty little monster!

text.title: 后方已经安全
text.objectives: 向艾尔文森林北郡修道院前的治安官玛克布莱德报到。
text.description: 干得好，$n！后面已经安全。剩下的散兵就交给我们来对付吧。我要你返回南面的北郡修道院前，向治安官玛克布莱德复命，告诉他滋事的地精已经被清理了。$B$B再见，$c。
text.completion: With your help we have managed to secure the northern and western sectors of Northshire. We still have a rather large contingency of Blackrock orcs to the east and they've begun burning down the forest!

english.title: The Rear is Clear
english.objectives: Report to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: Excellent work, $n! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control.$B$BFarewell, $c.
english.completion: With your help we have managed to secure the northern and western sectors of Northshire. We still have a rather large contingency of Blackrock orcs to the east and they've begun burning down the forest!

text.title: 潦草的卷轴
text.objectives: 阅读精致的卷轴，然后和丧钟镇的铁胆海胃丁绿衫谈一谈。
text.description: 呃，当你在外面对付那些愚蠢的天灾军团时，我们收到一个寄给你的卷轴，是个叫丁绿衫的熊猫人寄的。或许你们武僧能看懂这种乱七八糟的东西，反正我看不懂。你应该和她谈一谈，她在街对面的旅馆里。
text.progress: Oh, yes, I sent that for you. I hope to prove that Forsaken can learn the arts of the $C - perhaps you can help?
text.completion: Yes, you can come to me to learn more about our people and our ways, especially when it comes to the arts of the $C.

english.title: Scribbled Scroll
english.objectives: Read the Elegant Scroll and speak to Ting, Strong of Stomach in Deathknell.
english.description: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. The pandaren visitor, Ting, sent it for you. Maybe you monks can read this garbage, but I can't. You should go talk to her. She's in the Inn across the way.
english.progress: Oh, yes, I sent that for you. I hope to prove that Forsaken can learn the arts of the $C - perhaps you can help?
english.completion: Yes, you can come to me to learn more about our people and our ways, especially when it comes to the arts of the $C.

text.title: 猛虎掌
text.objectives: 等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌，然后在训练假人身上练习运用掌法。
text.description: 在你克服并突破身心内外的桎梏时，你会释放潜藏在体内的新能力。去吧，深入并掌控自我，打开通往猛虎掌绝技的大门。然后去找一个训练假人来练练手。
text.completion: Ah, it's my favorite pupil! I'm going to go ahead to Undercity and try to teach the way of the $C to some of the Deathguards. You should meet up with me there.
text.completed: 回提瑞斯法林地的丧钟镇找铁胆海胃丁绿衫。

english.title: Tiger Palm
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then practice using it on a Training Dummy.
english.description: As you overcome great challenges in your journey to master struggles both internal and external, you will begin to uncover new abilities hidden inside yourself. Go, now, and develop a mastery of yourself, such that you uncover the Tiger Palm technique. Then, go practice it on a training dummy.
english.completion: Ah, it's my favorite pupil! I'm going to go ahead to Undercity and try to teach the way of the $C to some of the Deathguards. You should meet up with me there.
english.completed: Return to Ting, Strong of Stomach at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Tiger Palm

text.title: Novice Elreth
text.objectives: Speak to Novice Elreth at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
text.description:
Actually, before I go - you should speak with Novice Elreth. She had some work for you, and you would do well to help others and improve your skills.

The next time you see me, I will be in Undercity.
text.completed: Speak to Novice Elreth at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Novice Elreth
english.objectives: Speak to Novice Elreth at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description:
Actually, before I go - you should speak with Novice Elreth. She had some work for you, and you would do well to help others and improve your skills.

The next time you see me, I will be in Undercity.
english.completed: Speak to Novice Elreth at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 精致符文
text.objectives: 阅读精致符文，然后和寒脊山谷的罗谈一谈。
text.description: $n，这些符文先是传给了我，现在又传给了你。有机会的时候要花些时间阅读。我想这些符文应该来自我们远方的客人，罗。请看一下这些符文，然后去安威玛尔找他。
text.progress: I like it here, $n. Your people have quite an appreciation for the finer things!
text.completion: Well, it is good to see you. I must say, as much as you learn from me, I think I will learn from your people. Your brews are quite different than mine!

english.title: Elegant Rune
english.objectives: Read the Elegant Rune and speak to Lo in Coldridge Valley.
english.description: $n, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from our visitor from afar, Lo. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar.
english.progress: I like it here, $n. Your people have quite an appreciation for the finer things!
english.completion: Well, it is good to see you. I must say, as much as you learn from me, I think I will learn from your people. Your brews are quite different than mine!

text.title: 挥拳，踢腿，心无杂念
text.objectives: 等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌，然后在安威玛尔入口处的训练假人身上练练手。
text.description:
事实上，你已经具备了学习新功夫的天赋和能力。我能做的就是帮你找到释放潜能之道。

首先，你必须加紧练习，直到对新功夫有所感悟。你要学习的第一门功夫就是猛虎掌。去吧，直到你释放自身的全部潜能，然后再去练习你的新掌法！

记住——要心无杂念！
text.completion: Ahh, good work. You may return any time you need another lesson from teacher.
text.completed: 回安威玛尔找罗。

english.title: Kick, Punch, It's All in the Mind
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm, then use it on one of the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.
english.description:
The truth is, you already have the talent and ability to learn what you need to. What I can help you do is show you where to unlock it.

First, you must practice until you begin to understand a new technique. The first technique you learn will be the Tiger Palm. Go, learn more until you have unlocked the potential within yourself, and then practice your new move!

Remember - it's all in the mind!
english.completion: Ahh, good work. You may return any time you need another lesson from teacher.
english.completed: Return to Lo in Anvilmar.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Tiger Palm

text.title: 窥探过去
text.objectives: 和石之环的游学者周卓谈一谈。
text.description: 稍等一下。让我收拾下东西。$b$b现在可不能落下这些笔记，对吧？尤其是你还为它出生入死过！$b$b好的，搞定。我们出发吧？$b$b我必须承认，在看到你解决了那只蜥蜴人之后，我觉得跟你一起旅行实在太安全了！
text.completion: I am most grateful for the knowledge my forebears have passed on to me.$B$BI stand upon their shoulders.

english.title: Peering Into the Past
english.objectives: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Circle of Stone.
english.description: Just a moment, now. Allow me to gather my things.$b$bWouldn't want me to lose these notes now, would we? Especially after you risked life and limb for them!$b$bThere, all set. Let us be off, shall we?$b$bI must say, I feel much safer traveling with you after seeing how you handled that saurok!
english.completion: I am most grateful for the knowledge my forebears have passed on to me.$B$BI stand upon their shoulders.

objectiveDetails.description: 护送游学者周卓抵达石之环

text.title: 智者的来信
text.objectives: 阅读手写羊皮纸，然后和试炼谷的贾徒谈一谈。
text.description: 呃，你不在的时候，我们收到了一封羊皮纸书信，$n。$B$B有时间的话看一下吧。如果我没有猜错，这封信是我们的熊猫人朋友贾徒寄来的。他云游四方，和我们分享他的智慧，向我们传授武僧的修行之道。要聆听他的教诲，不要让你们的族人蒙羞！
text.progress: Ahh, you have come.
text.completion: We will honor our respective peoples by learning from each other. You will become a great $C, if I have anything to say about it. And I will learn the ways of your people.

english.title: Calligraphed Parchment
english.objectives: Read the Calligraphed Parchment and speak with Gato in the Valley of Trials.
english.description: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $n.$B$BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from our Pandaren friend, Gato. He visits from afar to grant us the honor of his wisdom, and to teach the ways of the monk. Do not shame your people by failing at his lessons!
english.progress: Ahh, you have come.
english.completion: We will honor our respective peoples by learning from each other. You will become a great $C, if I have anything to say about it. And I will learn the ways of your people.

text.title: 猛虎掌
text.objectives: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。选定一个训练假人，然后对其使用2次猛虎掌。
text.description:
在你不断训练的过程中，你会逐渐发现自己体内蕴藏的能量，它们足以帮你领悟新技能。你甚至不需要我或其他经验更丰富的武僧来教导你——它们自然而然就会浮现在你心中。

但现在，你还得继续练习基本要领。积累更多经验，开发新的技能——学会后，你可以在附近的假人身上练习并熟练掌握。
text.completion: Good, good. Your first challenge surpassed. We will learn much from each other, I can see.
text.completed: Return to Gato at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Tiger Palm
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy and practice using Tiger Palm 2 times.
english.description:
As you walk the road of your training, you will begin to discover within yourself the power to unlock new techniques. You need not even learn them from me, or another more experienced monk - you will find that they come to you on their own.

For now, you should go and practice the basics. Gather more experience, and develop a new technique - once you have, you can practice it on the dummies nearby to master it.
english.completion: Good, good. Your first challenge surpassed. We will learn much from each other, I can see.
english.completed: Return to Gato at the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Tiger Palm

text.title: 基础教程：攻击目标
text.objectives: 摧毁6个蒂基面具假人。
text.description: 好了，伙计，我们先从简单的开始。首先我得确认你知道如何使用手里的武器。$B$B去拿那些蒂基面具假人练练手，慢点来，自然一点。我会观察你的表现，然后决定下一步要怎么做。
text.completion: Not bad, mon. Ya have a natural flow to ya punches - you may have a talent for dis.$B$BSome rough edges ta be sure, but we'll get dose ironed out here and I'll teach ya a few new tings as we go.
text.completed: Return to Zabrax at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: The Basics: Hitting Things
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Tiki Targets.
english.description: Alright, mon. We start with da basics. I need ta know dat you know how ta swing dat weapon you're totin' around.$B$BGo thrash dose tiki targets. Take it slowly. Natural-like. I'll watch ya fighting form and we'll go from dere.
english.completion: Nicht schlecht, Mann. Es liegt eine natürliche Grazie in Euren Schwüngen... Ihr habt womöglich Talent.$B$BEin paar Ecken und Kanten sind natürlich noch zu glätten, aber ich werde Euch noch einiges beibringen in nächster Zeit.
english.completed: Return to Zabrax at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 暗矛的崛起
text.objectives: 和暗矛训练场的扎布拉克斯碰面。
text.description: 暗矛部族一直都是受害者，被放逐者。我们不断地背井离乡……但这回，我们不是因逃难而来的。$B$B沃金英明地领导着我们，这让我们休养生息了这么久。现在，同样的智慧让我们获得了一个预兆，部落在加尔鲁什·地狱咆哮领导下将一片混乱。$B$B但这回我们不再逃跑。这回，我们将为一个气数未尽的家园而战。$B$B是时候开始你的训练了，$n。和东边的扎布拉克斯谈一谈。
text.completion: Anotha newblood, eh?$B$BYa actually look ta be in shape though. Steady hands. Fierce eyes. I may be able ta turn ya into a real $C.$B$BLets not waste anymore time 'den.

english.title: The Rise of the Darkspear
english.objectives: Meet with Zabrax in the Darkspear Training Grounds.
english.description: Tha Darkspear tribe have long been victims. Outcasts. We found ourselves fleein' our homes time 'n time again... but dis time, it's not fleein' dat drives us here.$B$BVol'jin has offered us leadership through wisdom, and it has kept us alive dis long. Now dat same wisdom offers portents of a chaotic future for tha Horde unda Garrosh Hellscream.$B$BNo, dis time we not fleein'. Dis time, we are fightin' for a home dat will last.$B$BIt's time to begin ya trainin', $n. Speak with Zabrax to the east.
english.completion: Noch so ein Jungblut, wie?$B$BObwohl, Ihr seht aus, als wärt Ihr gut in Form. Ruhige Hände. Scharfe Augen. Vielleicht wird aus Euch noch $gein echter:eine echte:c; $C.$B$BLasst uns keine Zeit mehr verschwenden.

text.title: 粗暴的开始
text.objectives: 收集6块蛮鬃豹皮。
text.description: 咱们来给你找点事做吧。先从简单的开始，伙计。$B$B岛上的豹子在猎杀我们的野猪。跟它们分享食物可不成！如果你今晚还想填饱肚子的话，就得想办法保证那些野猪还活着。$B$B岛上到处都是豹子。去把它们的毛皮给我拿来。
text.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
text.completion: Dese are some fine pelts, boy. We could make some hefty cloaks outta dese.
text.completed: Return to Zabrax at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: A Rough Start
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Wildmane Cat Pelts.
english.description: Lets put dose skills ta use. I'll start ya off easy, mon.$B$BThere be cats killing our boars. Dat food ain't for sharin'. Dose boars are gonna need ta be alive if ya be wanting food tonight.$B$BDey're all over the island. Bring me some cat pelts.
english.progress: I doubt dey too much of a challenge, mon, but they'll still claw up ya ankles if ya don't stay quick footed.
english.completion: Das sind nette Pelzchen, $GJunge:Mädel;. Die geben sicher 'n paar mächtige Mäntel ab.
english.completed: Return to Zabrax at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 试炼场
text.objectives: 同暗矛狱卒交谈，然后进入试炼场，杀死一名恶鳞斥候俘虏。
text.description: 你干得很不错，$c。我还可以再教你一些手段，但我不会再让你对着假人浪费时间了。$B$B现在我给你安排最后一项考验吧，伙计。到这个区域中间的试炼场去，跟一个真正的敌人交手——对方对你可是毫不留情的哟。等你准备好了，告诉那边的狱卒一声就行了。
text.completion: Ya handle yerself quite well. Ya gonna be quite powerful some day.
text.completed: Return to Zabrax at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

english.title: Proving Pit
english.objectives: Speak to a Darkspear Jailor, then enter the proving pit and kill a Captive Spitescale Scout.
english.description: Ya done quite well for ya'self, $c. I'm sure I could teach ya a trick or two here and dere, but I not be wastin' ya time on tiki targets no longer.$B$Bl put one last trial before ya den, mon. Head over to da provin' pit in the middle of dis area and fight a real baddy - one dat wants ta kill ya back. Just let the jailor by the pit know when ya ready.
english.completion: Ihr seid sehr gut in Form. Eines Tages werdet Ihr sehr mächtig sein.
english.completed: Return to Zabrax at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

text.title: 武僧之道
text.objectives: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。在那些蒂基面具假人身上练习一下猛虎掌。
text.description: 随着在战斗中的表现越来越好，你将开始发现一些你从没想过自己能做到的事情。$B$B想见识一下吗？去吧，多加练习，学习一些新事物。$B$B然后回到这里向我展示。
text.completion: Good work, mon! Dis stuff come easy to ya.
text.completed: 去回音群岛的暗矛训练场找扎布拉克斯。

english.title: The Arts of a Monk
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Practice using Tiger Palm against a Tiki Target.
english.description: As ya get bettah' at fightin', you'll start to find new tings that ya nevah knew you could do.$B$BWanna see? Go, train up some, and learn someting new.$B$B'Den come back and ya can show me.
english.completion: Gute Arbeit, Mann! Das schien Euch ja wirklich leicht zu fallen.
english.completed: Return to Zabrax at the Darkspear Training Grounds in the Echo Isles.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Tiger Palm

text.title: 喜出望外
text.objectives: 向暗矛要塞中的沃金报到。
text.description: 你真是令我们喜出望外，伙计。我敢说，你的天赋对我们肯定是大有帮助。你不用再跟这些新兵蛋子混在一起啦。$B$B到东南边的村子里去吧，闯出你自己的天地来。到处帮帮忙，我相信你很快就会出人头地的。
text.completion: Ya tha new recruit everyone's talkin' about, eh? Welcome ta tha Darkspear.

english.title: More Than Expected
english.objectives: Report to Vol'jin at Darkspear Hold.
english.description: Ya definitely more den expected, mon. I'm sure dere's more important stuff we can be usin' ya talents on now. Ya don't need ta hang out with da newbloods no more.$B$BHead down to da village to da southeast and make yaself known. Lend a hand here and there and I'm sure ya make yer way up to sometin' more prestigious quick enough.
english.completion: Ihr seid der neue Rekrut, von dem alle reden, hm? Willkommen bei den Dunkelspeeren.

text.title: 手写便笺
text.objectives: 阅读手写便笺，然后与纳拉其营地的烁雨谈一谈。
text.description: 刚才有一个信使来找过你，$n。我相信她是熊猫人访客烁雨派来的。你最好赶快看看上面都说了些什么。
text.progress: Ah, I am pleased to meet you.
text.completion: I am honored that Chief Hawkwind would allow me to train you and grant you your rite of passage. While I am a master in the ways of the $C, I am but a child in the ways of your people.

english.title: Calligraphed Note
english.objectives: Read the Calligraphed Note and speak to Shoyu in Camp Narache.
english.description: Just a moment ago a messenger was looking for you, $n. I believe she was sent by our Pandaren visitor, Shoyu. You should read it.
english.progress: Ah, I am pleased to meet you.
english.completion: I am honored that Chief Hawkwind would allow me to train you and grant you your rite of passage. While I am a master in the ways of the $C, I am but a child in the ways of your people.

text.title: 猛虎掌
text.objectives: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。在纳拉其营地里找一个训练假人，然后练习使用猛虎掌。
text.description:
你做得不错。在你的学艺不断精进之时，你会成长并学到以前从不敢想像的新技能。

你的第一课是经验的力量。去学习新技能，并证明给我看吧。
text.completion: You have done well, $n.
text.completed: 去找纳拉其营地的烁雨。

english.title: Tiger Palm
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy in Camp Narache and practice using it.
english.description:
You have done well. As you continue along your path, you will grow, learning new techniques that you couldn't have imagined before.

Your first lesson is the power of experience. Go, learn a new ability, and demonstrate it for me.
english.completion: You have done well, $n.
english.completed: Return to Shoyu at Camp Narache.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Tiger Palm

text.title: 族谱
text.objectives: 点燃石之环的熏香束。
text.description: 好吧，旅行者。说了这么多，我想你对于我们这个种族已经有了一定了解了，不是吗？$b$b那么，你们到底是什么东西？你们的人与我们有很大的不同吗？$b$b当然，我们之间一定有许多共同点。让我看看……
text.completion: Not so different, you and I.$B$BI believe we can become good friends.
text.completed: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Circle of Stone

english.title: Family Tree
english.objectives: Light the Incense Bundle at the Circle of Stone.
english.description: So there you have it, traveler, or as much of it as would make for a proper introduction, hmm?$b$bWhat of you, then? Are your people so much different than mine?$b$bSurely, there must be things we share in common. Let us see...
english.completion: Not so different, you and I.$B$BI believe we can become good friends.
english.completed: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Circle of Stone

text.title: 手写魔符
text.objectives: 与幽影谷中奥达希尔里面的劳希谈一谈。
text.description: 熊猫人访客劳希派了一位信使过来，给了我这个魔符。看来他想占用你几分钟时间谈一谈。你先看一下，接着再去他那边。
text.progress: Ah, you have come. Good.$B$BI am learning so much - your people have a wealth of knowledge unmatched anywhere I have seen. As much as I am humbled by that fact, I hope that I may teach you of our ways, as well.
text.completion: I was warned that not all of your people would be welcoming, but I have found quite the opposite - not only have I been welcomed, but I have learned so much from you.$B$BYou seem quite promising as a young $C, and I hope I can teach you much of our ways, as your people have taught me of yours.

english.title: Calligraphed Sigil
english.objectives: Speak to Laoxi inside Aldrassil in Shadowglen.
english.description: This sigil was given to me by a messenger from our Pandaren visitor, Laoxi. It seems he would have words with you when you have a moment. Read it and bring it to him afterwards.
english.progress: Ah, you have come. Good.$B$BI am learning so much - your people have a wealth of knowledge unmatched anywhere I have seen. As much as I am humbled by that fact, I hope that I may teach you of our ways, as well.
english.completion: I was warned that not all of your people would be welcoming, but I have found quite the opposite - not only have I been welcomed, but I have learned so much from you.$B$BYou seem quite promising as a young $C, and I hope I can teach you much of our ways, as your people have taught me of yours.

text.title: 武僧之道
text.objectives: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。找一个训练假人，在它身上练习使用猛虎掌。
text.description: 禅道的奥义在于释放隐藏在你身体里的知识与能量。$B$B出发吧，积累经验，去学习新的技能。然后找个训练假人演练一番。
text.completion: You've proven a capable student. When it is time to resume your training, return to me and I will show you other techniques.
text.completed: 去泰达希尔找劳希。

english.title: The Art of the Monk
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger's Palm. Look for a Training Dummy and practice using Tiger's Palm.
english.description: The true secret to the art of the monk is unlocking the knowledge and power hidden inside yourself.$B$BGo, get more experience, and learn a new skill. Then demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.
english.completion: You've proven a capable student. When it is time to resume your training, return to me and I will show you other techniques.
english.completed: Return to Laoxi in Teldrassil.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Tiger Palm

text.title: 武僧训练
text.objectives: 和逐日岛太阳之塔内的武僧职业训练师阿包谈一谈。
text.description: 既然你已经在你所选的职业上有所进步，那么你一定会希望能够获得更多来自职业训练师的指导。我们的熊猫人访客阿包是你的训练师，她负责训练所有在逐日岛一带的年轻武僧。去和她谈一谈吧，看看她能教会你些什么。$B$B阿包和其他逐日岛上的训练师一样，都在太阳之塔的下层。
text.completion: Ah, welcome. I have been teaching your people the ways of the $C, and they seem to be well suited for it. Perhaps you too will take to it as quickly as they.

english.title: Monk Training
english.objectives: Speak with Pao, the Monk class trainer, inside the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.
english.description: As you advance within your class, you will want to take advantage of the training that your class trainer can provide you.  For young monks here on Sunstrider Isle, your trainer is Pao, our Pandaren visitor.  Speak with her and see what training she has available for you.$B$BPao - as with all the trainers on Sunstrider Isle - is inside the Sunspire on the lower level.
english.completion: Ah, welcome. I have been teaching your people the ways of the $C, and they seem to be well suited for it. Perhaps you too will take to it as quickly as they.

text.title: 猛虎掌
text.objectives: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。在太阳之塔外面找一个训练假人，然后练习使用猛虎掌。
text.description: 很好，你开了个好头。路漫漫其修远兮，在你建功立业之时，你会发现自己能够做到以前从不敢想的事情。$B$B出发吧，积累经验，去学习新的技能。学完后，去找个训练假人演练一番。
text.completion: I think you've mastered the basics of the Tiger Palm technique, $n. Perhaps you will impress me, after all.
text.completed: 去逐日岛的太阳之塔里找阿包。

english.title: Tiger Palm
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Locate a Training Dummy outside the Sunspire and practice using it.
english.description: Good. You are off to a bright start. This road will be long, and as you become more accomplished, you will begin to discover that you can do things you could never have imagined before.$B$BGo, get more experience, and learn a new technique. Once you have, demonstrate it on one of the training dummies.
english.completion: I think you've mastered the basics of the Tiger Palm technique, $n. Perhaps you will impress me, after all.
english.completed: Return to Pao in the Sunspire on Sunstrider Isle.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Tiger Palm

text.title: 猛虎掌
text.objectives: 将等级提升至3级后学习猛虎掌。在坠毁点西北侧找一个训练假人，利用它进行练习。
text.description:
希望你的人安然无恙……坠毁的声音震耳欲聋！

<墨乔仔细打量着你，揣测你的潜力。>

对，你肯定行的。他们说需要更多人手加入战斗，他们不想我伤及自己。我并不怯战，但我也不想冒犯他们。所以，我要教你功夫。

可能你已经发现了，你的战斗经验可以进一步激发你内在的潜力。去吧，看你能否掌握新的技能，证明给我看。你会摸着窍门的。
text.completion: Keep that technique handy, $n. You can use it to finish off strong opponents, or just to feel awesome, like a tiger.
text.completed: 回坠毁点找莫劲·风暴烈酒。

english.title: The Tiger Palm
english.objectives: Reach level 3 to learn Tiger Palm. Find a Training Dummy on the northwest side of the Crash Site and practice using it.
english.description:
I hope your people are all alright... the crash was unbelievably loud and destructive!

<Mojo looks you over, evaluating your potential.>

Yes, you'll do fine. They've said that they need more people to fight, and they don't want me to hurt myself. I'm not afraid, but I don't want to intrude. So, I'll teach you.

As you may have discovered, your experiences in combat will unlock new potential within you. Go, see if you can master a new ability. Show it to me. You'll get the hang of things.
english.completion: Keep that technique handy, $n. You can use it to finish off strong opponents, or just to feel awesome, like a tiger.
english.completed: Return to Mojo Stormstout at the Crash Site.

objectiveDetails.description: Reach Level 3 to Learn Tiger Palm

text.title: 恐惧·沃斯
text.objectives: 杀死12个被奴役的琥珀挖掘者或沃斯提克鞭奴者，并释放英杰至尊者柯尔凡。
text.description: 又有一个英杰在召唤我们……$B$B这次，信息是来自恐惧沃斯，那是南面的一个远古湖泊。$B$B要找到他可能不太容易，因为那里有我们的敌人在把守。$B$B我要把这个任务交给你。如果你成功了，就可以活下来。$B$B如果失败了，我会派其他人过去。
text.completed: 去恐惧废土的恐惧·沃斯找至尊者柯尔凡谈一谈。

english.title: The Dread Vos
english.objectives: Kill 12 Enslaved Amberdiggers or Vos'thik Slavelashers, and release the paragon, Korven the Prime.
english.description: Another paragon calls to us..$B$BThis time, the emanations grow from The Dread Vos, an ancient lake to the south.$B$BFinding him will not be easy, for the way is guarded by our enemies.$B$BI give you this task. If you succeed, you will live.$B$BIf you fail, I will send another.
english.completed: Speak to Korven the Prime at The Dread Vos in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 觅血者斯基尔
text.objectives: 在水下洞穴唤醒觅血者斯基尔。
text.description: 我们在扎尼维斯前方守卫浅滩的努力得到了回报。$B$B我们已经发现了埋藏在西南方向水中包裹在琥珀里的另一位英杰。$B$B增加一位英杰对我们来说至关重要。另一位过去时代的勇士能够逆转我们的颓势。$B$B我想马上走，但不幸的是我必须留在这儿。$B$B你既然已经是一位唤醒者了，你就能够代替我前去执行这项任务。
text.completion: The hunger... they said it would be fierce, but I did not expect anything like this.$B$BIt is strange to feel so... weak.
text.completed: Speak to Skeer the Bloodseeker at Muckscale Grotto in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Skeer the Bloodseeker
english.objectives: Awaken Skeer the Bloodseeker in the underwater cave.
english.description: Our efforts to secure the shallows before Zan'vess have paid off.$B$BWe have spotted another paragon buried in amber, hidden in the waters to the southwest.$B$BAdding another paragon to our numbers is vital. Another champion from ages past could turn the tide in our favor.$B$BI would go immediately, but unfortunately, I am needed here.$B$BSince you are already a Wakener, you can carry out this task in my stead.
english.completion: The hunger... they said it would be fierce, but I did not expect anything like this.$B$BIt is strange to feel so... weak.
english.completed: Speak to Skeer the Bloodseeker at Muckscale Grotto in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 怪异的食欲
text.objectives: 收集12份海星肉。
text.description: 食物。我必须进食了。$B$B在我的时代，海星肉不仅让人力量充沛，而且还能保持头脑清醒。我必须吃这个。$B$B从附近的浅滩中给我找些回来。$B$B等太久的话，我就直接把你给吞了。
text.progress: The juices of the starfish will clear my mind.
text.completion: Yes, give it here! Well done, Wakener.
text.completed: Return to Skeer the Bloodseeker at Muckscale Grotto in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: A Strange Appetite
english.objectives: Collect 12 Starfish Meat.
english.description: Food. I must have food.$B$BIn my time, the meat of the starfish brought not only strength, but also clarity of mind. This is what I must eat.$B$BBring this to me from the nearby shallows.$B$BWait much longer, and I will devour you instead.
english.progress: The juices of the starfish will clear my mind.
english.completion: Yes, give it here! Well done, Wakener.
english.completed: Return to Skeer the Bloodseeker at Muckscale Grotto in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 丰盛大餐
text.objectives: 收集8条龙虾尾。
text.description: 在我有生之年，我曾是虫群中最伟大的战士。$B$B请帮助我重获力量，我将会展现给你看的。$B$B我闻到咸海就在附近，有海的地方就能找到咸水龙虾人。$B$B把它们的尾巴带来给我。我必须以它们的肉为食。
text.progress: I have much work to do. The sooner I can fight, the sooner I can return to the Council.
text.completion: Excellent. This shall give me the strength to vanquish my foes.
text.completed: Return to Skeer the Bloodseeker at Muckscale Grotto in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Fine Dining
english.objectives: Collect 8 Clacker Tails.
english.description: In my living years, I was the greatest warrior of the swarm.$B$BHelp me regain my strength, and I shall show you.$B$BI smell the salt sea nearby, and where you can find the sea, you will find briny clackers.$B$BBring me their tails. I must feast upon their flesh.
english.progress: I have much work to do. The sooner I can fight, the sooner I can return to the Council.
english.completion: Excellent. This shall give me the strength to vanquish my foes.
english.completed: Return to Skeer the Bloodseeker at Muckscale Grotto in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 以血为乐
text.objectives: 从恐惧鮣魚身上收集100份挥发性的血液。
text.description: 在尝过敌人的鲜血前，一名战士都不能算做好了战斗的准备。$B$B我还是太虚弱，没办法去狩猎，所以你必须代替我去。$B$B只有最凶猛的掠食者的血才有用。我能在洞外的水中闻到它们的气味！$B$B把它们的血带给我，然后你就会明白为什么他们都叫我觅血者。
text.progress: By drinking the blood of your enemies, you acquire their strength.
text.completion: Yes, this will do.
text.completed: Return to Skeer the Bloodseeker at Muckscale Grotto in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: A Bloody Delight
english.objectives: Collect 100 Volatile Blood from Dread Remoras.
english.description: A warrior is not ready for battle until he tastes the blood of his enemies.$B$BI am still too weak to hunt, so you must go in my stead.$B$BOnly the blood from the fiercest predators will do. I can smell their presence in the waters outside this cave!$B$BBring this to me, and then perhaps you shall see why they call me the Bloodseeker.
english.progress: By drinking the blood of your enemies, you acquire their strength.
english.completion: Yes, this will do.
english.completed: Return to Skeer the Bloodseeker at Muckscale Grotto in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 血之气息
text.objectives: 击败12个泥鳞食肉者和泥鳞蛇面者。
text.description: 你不在的时候，我恐怕不小心击败了几个蜥蜴人。$B$B不好意思，但我实在忍不住。现在，看看他们攻击我的样子。$B$B多么可悲！$B$B他们以为能为他们的死者报仇吗？他们想来挑战我？$B$B挑战身经百战的我？挑战以一当千的我？$B$B不，这些……蜥蜴人……全都会像着火的纸片一样倒在我的面前！$B$B我会让你看看我的力量，唤醒者。跟我并肩作战，看看我是怎么战斗的吧。$B$B他们来了！
text.completion: You have succeeded once again. Well done, Wakener.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: The Scent of Blood
english.objectives: Kill 12 Muckscale Flesheaters and the Muckscale Serpentus.
english.description: I'm afraid that I wet my hands with saurok blood while you were away.$B$BI'm sorry, but I could not help myself. Now, watch them attack me.$B$BPitiful!$B$BDo they think to take vengeance for their fallen? Do they come challenge ME?$B$BI, who have won a hundred wars? I, who stood alone against thousands and still shouted for my enemies to come?$B$BNo, these... saurok... will crumple before me like paper before the flame!$B$BI shall show you my might, Wakener. Fight alongside me and see.$B$BHere they come!
english.completion: You have succeeded once again. Well done, Wakener.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 新鲜的诱饵
text.objectives: 给荒寂海湾的10个空蟹笼添加诱饵。每个蟹笼需要2块海王鱼肉块。
text.description: 我们在那边有许多空蟹笼，需要往里面添加点新鲜的诱饵。$B$B现在，我们可以把它们一个一个拉过来，然后不慌不忙地往里面添诱饵。这把椅子坐着就很舒服，也许还能再来杯热茶让你暖和一下。听起来不错，对吧？$B$B做白日梦呢？$B$B快给我去西南方的荒寂海湾那儿，把新鲜的海王鱼肉块放到笼子里。我说的“新鲜”，是指在水中现杀的。$B$B哦，还有“笼子”就是陷阱。如果你想成为一名水手，你就得学会这些行话。
text.completion: Not bad, green, not bad.
text.completed: Return to Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

english.title: Fresh Pots
english.objectives: Bait 10 Empty Crab Pots in Lonesome Cove. Each pot requires 2 Sea Monarch Chunks.
english.description: We got a load of empty crab pots out there that need fresh bait.$B$BNow, we COULD pull them one at a time and bait them up here in comfort. A nice chair to sit on, maybe a hot cup of tea to keep you warm. Sounds nice, doesn't it?$B$BNever gonna happen.$B$BHead to Lonesome Cove, immediately southwest, and bait those pots with two chunks of fresh sea monarch. By "fresh" I mean killed right there in the water.$B$BOh, and by "pots" I mean traps. If you wanna be part of the crew, you'd better learn the lingo.
english.completion: Not bad, green, not bad.
english.completed: Return to Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

text.title: 原来是水獭
text.objectives: 用一袋蛤蜊喂食荒寂海湾的8只寒须水獭。
text.description: 你知道那些笼子里的诱饵去哪儿了吗？$B$B给水獭叼走了。这就是真相。$B$B它们偏爱新鲜的蛤蜊，但如果太饿的话，也会偷吃我们蟹笼里的诱饵。$B$B荒寂海湾的水獭受法律保护，而我们在这里的捕捞也是合法的。不过我挺喜欢这些小老鼠，所以还是算了吧，我们只要保证不让它们饥得去捣我们的螃蟹笼就行了。$B$B在你下海的时候，扔些蛤蜊安抚它们一下吧。
text.completion: That should keep their little whiskers out of our traps for awhile.
text.completed: Return to Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

english.title: You Otter Know
english.objectives: Use the Bag of Clams to feed 8 Coldwhisker Otters in Lonesome Cove.
english.description: You know what happened to the bait in those pots?$B$BOtters. That's what happened.$B$BThey prefer fresh clams, but they'll pick our crab traps clean if they're hungry enough.$B$BThe otters in Lonesome Cove are protected by law and we run a legitimate operation here. As much as I'd love to chum those little rats and call it a day, we just make sure they aren't hungry enough to raid the crab pots.$B$BToss 'em a few clams to keep them busy while you're out there.
english.completion: That should keep their little whiskers out of our traps for awhile.
english.completed: Return to Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

text.title: 会见船长
text.objectives: 去闷水壶的冒险码头和“闷水壶”苏道谈一谈。
text.description: 好吧，$p，我还有一份工作要交给你。$B$B你看到那头关在围栏里的海狮了吗？他的名字叫狗狗。他是闷水壶多年以来的宠物。$B$B狗狗最近有些闹情绪——我想是关在围栏里让他不开心了。你应该去找闷水壶谈谈，告诉他这件事。$B$B我觉得，现在也是时候让你去见船长了。
text.completion: New deckhand, eh? We'll see about that.$B$BI run a tight ship - even if she IS at the bottom of the sea.
text.completed: 去闷水壶的冒险码头和“闷水壶”苏道谈一谈。

english.title: Meet the Cap'n
english.objectives: Speak with "Soggy" Su-Dao in Soggy's Gamble.
english.description: Alright, $p, I got another job for ya.$B$BYou see that lion seal in the pen over there? Name's Dog. He's been Soggy's pet for years.$B$BDog's acting up lately - I think he's getting restless in that pen. Why don't you go talk to Soggy and let him know.$B$BI'd say it's about time you meet the cap'n anyway.
english.completion: New deckhand, eh? We'll see about that.$B$BI run a tight ship - even if she IS at the bottom of the sea.
english.completed: Speak with "Soggy" Su-Dao in Soggy's Gamble.

text.title: 往事与背叛
text.objectives: 在雾海飞跃者的残骸中找到航海图。
text.description: 你瞧，我没有理由相信你，但我没法把这个任务交给手下去做。$B$B我要你去搜索一下我那艘老船的残骸，雾海飞跃者，并把它的航海图带回来给我。它应该被装在一个手提箱里，封存在银色容器中。$B$B那份航海图，嗯……属于机密。所以我不能让我的船员去老船的残骸，免得被他们发现。她就沉在西面玛祖海床的某个地方。$B$B如果你的胃够强壮的话，我建议你跟着水流漂去那里。海床上到处都是这种激流。
text.progress: To be honest, I hope a grouper ate the old charter.$B$BWait, then it might end up here anyway. Dang it!
text.completion: That's the charter tube, alright. I guess you'd like to know what all the fuss is about, eh?$B$B<Soggy lets out a long sigh as he un-caps the tube.>$B$BMight as well get it over with.
text.completed: Return to Captain "Soggy" Su-Dao at Soggy's Gamble.

english.title: Old Age and Treachery
english.objectives: Recover the charter from the Wreck of the Mist-Hopper.
english.description: Look, I ain't got reason to trust you, but there's a task I can't give to my crew.$B$BI need you to search the wreck of our old ship, the Mist-Hopper, and bring back the charter. It'd be sealed up in a silver tube, in a footlocker.$B$BIt's sort of, uh... incriminating. I can't risk any of the crew finding it if they decide to visit the ol' girl. She's resting on the Shelf of Mazu, to the west.$B$BI'd suggest riding a rip current out there, if you got the stomach. They're all over the shelf.
english.progress: To be honest, I hope a grouper ate the old charter.$B$BWait, then it might end up here anyway. Dang it!
english.completion: That's the charter tube, alright. I guess you'd like to know what all the fuss is about, eh?$B$B<Soggy lets out a long sigh as he un-caps the tube.>$B$BMight as well get it over with.
english.completed: Return to Captain "Soggy" Su-Dao at Soggy's Gamble.

text.title: 带狗狗散步
text.objectives: 带狗狗游览玛祖海床上的间歇温泉，鲸鱼遗骸和雾海飞跃者的残骸。
text.description: 狗狗不是我的“宠物”。他是这里的一员，我最好的朋友。你知道吗，他救过我不止一次。$B$B但是我太老了，走不动了，但他还需要活动。替我带狗狗在海床周围转一下吧，好吗？$B$B他喜欢在浅滩东南方向的间歇温泉里游泳。$B$B他必须……呃……在海床最西边的死鲸鱼旁边“留些自己的标记”。$B$B哦，他也想要去看看我们那艘老船的残骸。他喜欢回忆。
text.completion: How did it go? I hope he didn't cause too much trouble!
text.completed: Return to Captain "Soggy" Su-Dao at Soggy's Gamble.

english.title: Walking Dog
english.objectives: Take Dog to visit the hot geysers, the whale corpse, and the wreck of the Mist-Hopper on the Shelf of Mazu.
english.description: Dog ain't my "pet." He's a member of this crew, and my best friend. Saved my life more than once, you know.$B$BBut I'm gettin' too old to walk him anymore, and he still needs his exercise. Take Dog for a trip around the shelf for me, would ya?$B$BHe loves to swim through the hot geysers just southeast of the shallows.$B$BHe absolutely has to... er... "leave his mark" on the dead whale at the far western edge of the shelf.$B$BOh, and he'll want to visit our old shipwreck, too. He likes to reminisce.
english.completion: How did it go? I hope he didn't cause too much trouble!
english.completed: Return to Captain "Soggy" Su-Dao at Soggy's Gamble.

objectiveDetails.description: 带狗狗前往淤泥间歇泉眼
带狗狗前往雾海飞跃者的残骸

text.title: 狗狗的食物
text.objectives: 帮助狗狗吃掉10只石壳龙虾人。
text.description: <狗狗用一头海狮能够想到的最好办法来表达不满，他无力地抬起一只鳍指向自己厚重的下巴。$B$B他饿了。$B$B玛祖海床上到处都是石壳龙虾人，狗狗应该喜欢吃这些东西。>
