text.progress: <This has got to be the most pathetic lion seal you've ever seen.>
text.completion: <Dog licks his chops happily, looking satisfied.>
text.completed: Speak with Dog at the Shelf of Mazu.

english.title: Dog Food
english.objectives: Help Dog to eat the remains of 10 Rockshell Snapclaws.
english.description: <Dog whines as best as a lion seal can, feebly lifting one flipper toward his massive jaws.$B$BHe's hungry.$B$BThe Shelf of Mazu is covered in rockshell makrura that should make a fine meal for him.>
english.progress: <This has got to be the most pathetic lion seal you've ever seen.>
english.completion: <Dog licks his chops happily, looking satisfied.>
english.completed: Speak with Dog at the Shelf of Mazu.

text.title: 收获螃蟹
text.objectives: 在玛祖海床上把雾海飞跃者浮标挂到8个装满的蟹笼上。
text.description: 我刚刚收到消息，我们今天早上放下去的一串笼子收获巨大。我们捕到了螃蟹！$B$B问题是，洋流越来越湍急，其中一些笼子丢失了。他们就任由那些装满了尖硬蓝色摇钱树的笼子飘在那儿！$B$B我要你回到那里去。把一个浮标挂到你找到的任意一个装满蟹的蟹笼上，帮我们把它送到水面。
text.completion: Nice work out there!
text.completed: Return to Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

english.title: On the Crab
english.objectives: Attach a Mist-Hopper Buoy to 8 Full Crab Pots on the Shelf of Mazu.
english.description: I just got word that a string of pots we dropped this morning hit it BIG. We're on the crab!$B$BProblem is, the rips are getting stronger and we lost track of some of the pots. They're just sitting out there, filled with spiky blue GOLD!$B$BI need you back out there. Hook one of these buoys up to any of the full traps you find and send it to the surface for us.
english.completion: Nice work out there!
english.completed: Return to Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

objectiveDetails.description: 将装满的蟹笼送到水面

text.title: 鲨鱼周
text.objectives: 前往玛祖海床并从长鳍长尾鲨嘴里拔出200枚长尾鲨利齿。
text.description: 捕蟹是我们的主要谋生手段，不过我们也会把各种其它货物送回长城。油料、植物，甚至稀有矿物——大海的恩泽在这里应有尽有！$B$B眼下市场上最风靡的商品是长尾鲨利齿。它们显然可以做成漂亮的项链是吧？$B$B长尾鲨遍布西面的玛祖海床。给我带大把大把的牙齿来！
text.progress: Having actually seen someone eaten by a thresher, I'm not sure why you'd willingly string their teeth around your neck, but whatever.
text.completion: Those are perfect, just put them down over there. I'd rather not touch them myself. Creeps me out.
text.completed: Return to Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

english.title: Shark Week
english.objectives: Collect 200 Thresher Teeth by pulling them from the jaws of Longfin Threshers on the Shelf of Mazu.
english.description: Crabbing is our big money-maker, but we send all kinds of goods back around the wall. Oils, plants, even rare minerals - the sea's bounty is rich out here!$B$BRight now the big craze in the markets back home is thresher teeth. Apparently they make great necklaces?$B$BThreshers are all over the Shelf of Mazu to the west. Bring me lots of teeth!
english.progress: Having actually seen someone eaten by a thresher, I'm not sure why you'd willingly string their teeth around your neck, but whatever.
english.completion: Those are perfect, just put them down over there. I'd rather not touch them myself. Creeps me out.
english.completed: Return to Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

text.title: 提供协助
text.objectives: 前往闷水壶的冒险码头协助钓鱼大师句连。
text.description: 我从没想到会有这么一天，自从……好吧，没有什么自从，钓鱼大师句连向这边求助了。$B$B显然大海今天发了疯，这使他乱了方寸。去瞧瞧你能否帮上忙。他正在此地南面垂钓。
text.completion: What happened out there?! I heard a scream and next thing I know these nasty things come rolling in on the next wave!
text.completed: Return to Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

english.title: Reeltime Strategy
english.objectives: Assist Master Angler Ju Lien in Soggy's Gamble.
english.description: I never thought I'd see the day, but for the first time since... well, EVER, Master Angler Ju Lien asked for some help with his lines.$B$BApparently the sea is going crazy today and he can't keep up. See if you can give him a hand. He's fishing just south of here.
english.completion: What happened out there?! I heard a scream and next thing I know these nasty things come rolling in on the next wave!
english.completed: Return to Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

text.title: 水手的复仇
text.objectives: 前往闷水壶的冒险码头并启动雾海飞跃者二世，用它干掉狡。
text.description: 我的船员正在被巨兽吞噬，老子可不想在该死的摇椅上坐以待毙！$B$B来，和我去码头弄艘小艇。我为这种情况做了特别准备。我的雾海飞跃者二世。$B$B我要让那家伙咽下一整箱鱼叉。
text.completion: Nice shooting out there!$B$BI knew we could do it. Never met anything that can't be killed with enough harpoons.
text.completed: Speak with Captain "Soggy" Su-Dao in Soggy's Gamble.

english.title: The Mariner's Revenge
english.objectives: Launch the Mist-Hopper Jr. from the dock in Soggy's Gamble and use it to bring down Jiao.
english.description: I'm not gonna sit in a damn rocking chair while my crew gets devoured by a leviathan!$B$BCome on, let's get to the dock and launch a dinghy. I got a special one set up just for this kind of situation. My own little Mist-Hopper Jr.$B$BWe'll give that thing a case of harpoon fever.
english.completion: Nice shooting out there!$B$BI knew we could do it. Never met anything that can't be killed with enough harpoons.
english.completed: Speak with Captain "Soggy" Su-Dao in Soggy's Gamble.

text.title: 镇压滑鳞氏族
text.objectives: 击败滑鳞蜥蜴领主。
text.description: 滑鳞氏族听命于他们的首领——滑鳞蜥蜴领主。你可以在临风岛的东南角找到他，他正在庆祝所谓的“胜利”。$B$B如果我们能消灭这个首领，那对滑鳞氏族将是一记沉重的打击。$B$B失去了主心骨，滑鳞氏族以后再想袭击东边的云端翔龙时，就要三思了。
text.completion: Wonderful! I knew you could triumph against the Slitherscale lord.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
text.giverWindow: 还有更大的威胁在等着我们。

english.title: Slitherscale Suppression
english.objectives: Kill the Slitherscale Lizard-Lord.
english.description: The Slitherscale take orders from their leader, the Slitherscale Lizard-Lord. He can be found celebrating his victories on the southeastern corner of Windward Isle.$B$BIf we can destroy this leader, we can deal their tribe a great blow.$B$BWithout their lord, the Slitherscale will think twice before attacking the gentle cloud serpents of the east.
english.completion: Wonderful! I knew you could triumph against the Slitherscale lord.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
english.giverWindow: A greater threat still awaits.

text.title: 瑟拉维斯的苦差事
text.objectives: 在瑟拉维斯附近杀掉15个非精英螳螂妖。
text.description:
螳螂妖的数量远远超过我们。我们一个人需要应付上百个螳螂妖。

他们从两侧把我们包围了，在南边，我们把他们挡在了高岚阵，但是在西边，他们继续大规模地涌出瑟拉维斯。

我们可不是傻子。我们不会全线出击。在多个战线，我们支持不住这种猛烈的战斗了。

所以我们要派你和一个悟道者去做一些苦力活。听起来很有趣，不是吗？
text.completion: Good work. I think it's always best to strike while they're unprepared.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Sra'vess Wetwork
english.objectives: Kill any 15 non-elite mantid near Sra'vess.
english.description:
The mantid outnumber us quite badly. Hundreds of them for each of us.

And, they surround us on two sides - at Gao-Ran in the south we're holding them off, but to the west, on the island they call Sra'vess, they continue to mass unabated.

We're not stupid. We're not going to launch a full scale attack on them. We can't sustain an intense battle on multiple fronts.

Instead, we're going to send you, and one of our Wu Kao, to do some dirty work. Sounds fun, doesn't it?
english.completion: Good work. I think it's always best to strike while they're unprepared.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败小型瑟拉提克螳螂妖

text.title: 大螳螂妖来了……
text.objectives: 杀掉瑟拉维斯的4个精英螳螂妖。
text.description:
杀小螳螂妖只是消遣的把戏。这迫使他们补充了些人手，他们意识到我们的攻势非常猛。

但对于大螳螂妖，我们只杀死了几个，但实际上扰乱了他们在岛上的行动。这给我们赢得了大量的时间。在螳螂妖帝国里，螳螂妖的大小和重要性直接相关。

所以当你出去的时候，要杀死几只大螳螂妖。
text.completion: Well done, well done. That should keep us safe for a few days, at least.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Bigger They Come...
english.objectives: Kill any 4 elite mantid at Sra'vess.
english.description:
Killing the smaller mantid works mostly as a distraction. It forces them to replenish their numbers before they consider any serious offensive.

The big ones, though - we kill a few of those, and we really disrupt operations on the island. That buys ourselves a substantial amount of time. With mantid, it's like their size is directly proportional to their importance in the empire.

So kill some of the big ones for me, while you're out there.
english.completion: Well done, well done. That should keep us safe for a few days, at least.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败大型瑟拉提克螳螂妖

text.title: 打击士气
text.objectives: 在瑟拉维斯摧毁南部、中部、东部和西部邪神像。
text.description:
螳螂妖在瑟拉维斯建有雕像，我们不知道那些雕像的确切用途。它们或许有某种宗教含义，或是为了加强彼此之间的音波通讯。

当你和敌人作战时，你不仅要破坏他们的身体，更要摧毁它们的意志。不管螳螂妖要拿那些雕像来做什么，看起来那些雕像对他们而言都至关重要。

这正是我要你去破坏雕像的原因。失去某些重要的东西对于士气来说，是一个沉重的打击。
text.completion: I'm sure they'll be upset without those statues. Right?
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: A Morale Victory
english.objectives: Destroy the Southern, Central, Eastern and Western Idols at Sra'vess.
english.description:
The mantid have statues built on Sra'vess. We don't know exactly what they use them for. They may have some sort of religious significance, or maybe they assist with their sonic communication.

When you fight your opponent, you don't just engage them physically, you also engage them mentally. Whatever they use them for, the fact is that those statues are important to them.

Which is why I want you to blow them up. Losing something important will be a substantial hit to morale.
english.completion: I'm sure they'll be upset without those statues. Right?
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 摧毁攻城武器！
text.objectives: 在螳螂高原的瑟拉维斯摧毁螳螂妖的4部攻城武器。
text.description:
螳螂妖不单单会成群结队地发起进攻。

他们很聪明。他们会使用炼金术、炸弹……还有最最糟糕的就是，他们会使用攻城武器。那些攻城武器拥有无比强大的破坏力，要让他们阴谋得逞可就糟了。

我们收到报告，它们正在西面的瑟拉维斯建起攻城武器。快去摧毁它们。
text.completion: Those siege weapons won't be a problem. They may rebuild, but we've bought ourselves some time.
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Destroy the Siege Weapons!
english.objectives: Destroy the four mantid siege weapons at Sra'vess in Townlong Steppes.
english.description:
The mantid don't just attack in swarms. 

They're smart. They use alchemy, bombs... and what's worst, they've got siege weapons. Those have the potential to be incredibly destructive if they attack with them.

We've got reports that they're building up a force of siege weapons to the west at Sra'vess. Go and destroy them.
english.completion: Those siege weapons won't be a problem. They may rebuild, but we've bought ourselves some time.
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: 摧毁南部大型攻城武器
摧毁南部小型工程武器
摧毁北部大型攻城武器
摧毁北部小型工程武器

text.title: 烟熏消毒
text.objectives: 在瑟拉维斯的5座目标建筑中放置影踪派瓦斯弹。
text.description:
我们的炼金术士制造了一些瓦斯弹，它们能阻止螳螂妖停留在投弹区域。

如果我们把它们放置在瑟拉维斯的重要建筑内，螳螂妖就不得不进行疏散。在敌人的据点播下混乱的种子，足以将他们的行动计划延缓数日。

搞定它，$n。
text.completion: Nice, I can see the smoke from here. That should definitely cause some confusion!
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Fumigation
english.objectives: Plant Shado-Pan Gas Bombs within the 5 targeted structures on Sra'vess.
english.description:
Our alchemists have cooked up a set of gas bombs that will discourage mantid from staying anywhere that we set them off. 

If we plant these in the critical structures of Sra'vess, they'll need to evacuate. That should sow some chaos and delay any action from the mantid there for days.

Get to it, $n.
english.completion: Nice, I can see the smoke from here. That should definitely cause some confusion!
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 朋友，不是食物！
text.objectives: 救出北方、中央和南方恐虫饲料洞中的影踪派受训者。
text.description:
我们的斥候送来了一条非常不好的消息。

我们丢失了三个学徒，但斥候找到了他们……

他们被螳螂妖抓住了，现在已经送往恐虫洞。

那是他们的恐虫“饲料”洞。幸运的是，恐虫通常不吃他们。

我需要你现在赶赴那里，给他们一些逃生风筝，把他们救出来！
text.completion: Oh, thank goodness. I was worried about them!
text.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Friends, Not Food!
english.objectives: Rescue a Shado-Pan Trainee in each of the north, central and south Kunchong feeding pits.
english.description:
Our scouts have sent a very troubling report. 

Three of our trainees have gone missing, and our scouts found them... 

They've been captured by the mantid and sent to their Kunchong pits. 

Their Kunchong FEEDING pits. We're lucky that the Kunchong don't eat that often.

I need you to get in there, give them these escape kites, and get them out!
english.completion: Oh, thank goodness. I was worried about them!
english.completed: Speak to your Shado-Pan companion in the field or return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in the Townlong Steppes.

objectiveDetails.description: Shado-Pan Trainee at Northern Feeding Pit freed
Shado-Pan Trainee at Central Feeding Pit freed
Shado-Pan Trainee at Southern Feeding Pit freed

text.title: 机会目标：瑟拉提克统群者
text.objectives: 在螳螂高原的瑟拉维斯击败瑟拉提克统群者。
text.description:
到这里时，我们还应该做一件事。

瑟拉提克统群者负责从空中指挥螳螂妖部队。如果我们让它活着，就会给守备部队带来麻烦。

所以我们不会让它活着。除掉它，$p。
text.completion: I heard you did a little... extra credit while you were out there. Good work, friend.$B$BCome back another day - I'm sure we'll have some more work for you.
text.completed: Return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Target of Opportunity: Sra'thik Swarmlord
english.objectives: Kill the Sra'thik Swarmlord at Sra'vess in Townlong Steppes.
english.description:
While we're here, we should do one more thing.

The Sra'thik Swarmlord is responsible for directing the mantid forces from the air. If we leave it alive, it's going to cause trouble for the garrison.

So we're not going to leave it alive. Let's take it out, $p.
english.completion: I heard you did a little... extra credit while you were out there. Good work, friend.$B$BCome back another day - I'm sure we'll have some more work for you.
english.completed: Return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 机会目标：瑟拉提克领巢者
text.objectives: 击败瑟拉提克领巢者。
text.description:
在瑟拉维斯东侧的海域附近，有一个通向四通八达的地下洞穴的洞口。

瑟拉提克领巢者在那里守护着瑟拉维斯，并密谋暗算我们。如果能除掉他，我们就可以让他们的行动混乱几天。

我们快出发吧。
text.completion: Well done, $n! Because you took on that extra work, you've bought us some respite from the mantid.$B$BI'm sure I'll have more work for you in the future, though. Come back later.
text.completed: Return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Target of Opportunity: Sra'thik Hivelord
english.objectives: Defeat the Sra'thik Hivelord.
english.description:
Near the ocean, on the eastern side of Sra'vess, there is a cavern that leads to a network of caves.

From there, the Sra'thik Hivelord maintains Sra'vess and plots against us. If we manage to take him out, we'll disrupt their operations for days.

Let's go to it.
english.completion: Well done, $n! Because you took on that extra work, you've bought us some respite from the mantid.$B$BI'm sure I'll have more work for you in the future, though. Come back later.
english.completed: Return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 杀戮熔炉竞技场：血眼斗士！
text.objectives: 进入杀戮熔炉竞技场，击败胡尔德普！
text.description: 我跟你说，伙计，这地方离碧野千里的纳格兰的大草原和血腥残酷的祖达克很远，但是呢，哪里有金币，哪里就有我！那么，欢迎来到暮高，朋友。$B$B你是刚来这座竞技场的，我就跟你简单明了地说吧。我是这里的竞技场组织者，旁边这位活泼的巨魔是我的保镖伍迪。你是这里的主角，当你想要作战的时候，告诉我一声，我就给你安排比赛。$B$B如果你已经准备就绪，还带来了一组伙伴，我们就可以开始了！你觉得呢？
text.completed: 去找暮光高地杀戮熔炉竞技场的巨魔仆从伍迪。
text.giverWindow: 血眼氏族对击溃对手颇有心得。

english.title: The Crucible of Carnage: The Bloodeye Bruiser!
english.objectives: Get in the arena at the Crucible of Carnage and defeat Hurp'derp!
english.description: I'll tell you what, buddy, this place is a far cry from the rolling plains of Nagrand or the bloodbowl in Zul'Drak, but hey, I go where the gold's at! So welcome to Twi-Hi, pal.$B$BYou're new to this pit, so let me set you straight. I'm the fight promoter and this feisty troll next to me is Wodin, my bodyguard. You're the entertainment. When you wanna fight, let me know and I'll set up the match.$B$BIf you're ready and got a group of friends with you, we can start! What do you say?
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Crucible of Carnage in the Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: The Bloodeye Clan's contribution to combatant crushing.

text.title: 破军比武场
text.objectives: 进入破军比武场并完成比赛。然后向巨魔仆从伍迪索要奖金。
text.description: 啊，我还记得在纳格兰泥坑里的激烈的战斗。真是时间如梭啊，对吧伍迪？$B$B我告诉你，这些白虎武僧最喜欢比试拳脚了，所以他们付给我很多钱，让我在这里开商店，帮助他们搜罗各地最强大的对手！$B$B怎么样？你跟你的朋友们要不要在破军比武场打上几个回合……？有大笔奖金和丰厚奖品在等着你呢！
text.completion: Gurgthock said you he'd make it worth your while, kid. Take your pick!
text.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Tiger Temple on Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Arena of Annihilation
english.objectives: Enter and complete the Arena of Annihilation scenario. Afterwards, collect your reward from Wodin the Troll-Servant.
english.description: Ah, I can still remember running fights out of a muddy hole in the ground back in Nagrand. We've come a long way, eh, Wodin?$B$BI tell you, there's nothing more these Tiger monks like than a good scrap. So much so that they've paid good coin for me to set up shop here and help draw the strongest fighters from all around!$B$BSo how about it? You and a couple friends up for a few rounds in the Arena of Annihilation...? Big money, big prizes!
english.completion: Gargtok said it was a glorious fight. Take your pick!
english.completed: Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant at the Tiger Temple on Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 邪恶意图
text.objectives: 收集8个剧毒蛰针。
text.description: 如果我们要对抗女皇，我们就必须用武器武装自己。我则喜欢特制的剧毒武器。$B$B在岩壁上横行的蝎子能产生致命的毒液并将其存储在它们的尾部。$B$B把它们的刺带给我，然后我会展示给你看看我是怎么赢得这个英杰的称号的。
text.progress: Did you feel the venomtail's sting? Such lovely pain.
text.completion: Well done, Wakener. I hope you handled these stingers carefully.$B$BThe natural poison from these scorpions is deadly, but slow.
text.completed: Return to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at the Venomous Ledge in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Venomous Intent
english.objectives: Collect 8 Venomous Stingers.
english.description: If we are to strike against the Empress, we must arm ourselves with weapons. My own choice of weapon is of a particularly toxic design.$B$BThe scorpions wandering the ledge produce a deadly venom that they store in their tails.$B$BBring me their stingers, and I will show you how I earned the title of paragon.
english.progress: Did you feel the venomtail's sting? Such lovely pain.
english.completion: Well done, Wakener. I hope you handled these stingers carefully.$B$BThe natural poison from these scorpions is deadly, but slow.
english.completed: Return to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at the Venomous Ledge in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 黑色翅膀，黑暗谋划
text.objectives: 收集150个甲虫翅膀。
text.description: 我还需要一种成分来制造我的第一份毒药，唤醒者。$B$B这种成分可以在附近的甲虫身上轻松找到。$B$B杀死它们，为我带回它们的翅膀。
text.progress: Scarab wings can be crushed to produce a very fine white, deadly powder.
text.completion: Yes, excellent, Wakener! These are perfect.$B$BHave you ever considered learning the poisoner's craft?
text.completed: Return to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at the Venomous Ledge in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Dark Wings, Dark Things
english.objectives: Collect 150 Scarab Wings.
english.description: I require another ingredient to create my first poison, Wakener.$B$BThis ingredient you can easily find on the scarabs nearby.$B$BKill them and bring me their wings.
english.progress: Scarab wings can be crushed to produce a very fine white, deadly powder.
english.completion: Yes, excellent, Wakener! These are perfect.$B$BHave you ever considered learning the poisoner's craft?
english.completed: Return to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at the Venomous Ledge in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 恐惧之影
text.objectives: 收集8株恐惧之影。
text.description: 最后一种成分可能是最致命的。$B$B附近的山上长满了恐惧之影。$B$B正是由于吃了这种带有剧毒的植物，这里的动物也变得含有剧毒。$B$B只需要一滴恐惧之影的花蜜，就能让恐虫死去。$B$B去帮我收集一些这种花朵。切记不要去尝它们。
text.progress: Sometimes, the most beautiful things are also the most dangerous.
text.completion: Many would not know the value of what you hold.$B$BYou have done well, Wakener.
text.completed: Return to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at the Venomous Ledge in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: A Shade of Dread
english.objectives: Collect 8 Dreadshade.
english.description: The last ingredient is perhaps the deadliest.$B$BThe dreadshade flower grows all along these hills.$B$BIt is by eating these poisonous plants that the local wildlife has become so venomous.$B$BA single drop of dreadshade nectar can stop a kunchong's heart.$B$BGo and bring me some of these flowers. Do not be tempted to taste them.
english.progress: Sometimes, the most beautiful things are also the most dangerous.
english.completion: Many would not know the value of what you hold.$B$BYou have done well, Wakener.
english.completed: Return to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at the Venomous Ledge in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 毒心者
text.objectives: 和毒心者夏克里尔谈一谈。然后和他结伴飞行并杀死200只螳螂妖和3只恐虫。
text.description: 在回卡拉克西维斯之前，我希望能观察一下帝国。$B$B卡拉克西议会告诉我说敌人在女皇的宫殿外集结。$B$B我的毒药已经准备好了，还有什么能比死亡和毁灭更有力地宣告我的回归呢？$B$B但要小心别把这两种毒液混合起来……至少在你还抓着的时候。$B$B准备好起飞时就过来找我。
text.completion: Thank you for returning me home, Wakener, but I fear the war has just truly begun.
text.completed: Speak to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: The Poisoned Mind
english.objectives: Speak to Xaril the Poisoned Mind. Kill 200 mantid and 3 kunchong while flying with him.
english.description: Before we return to Klaxxi'vess, I wish to look upon the empire.$B$BThe Klaxxi Council told me that the enemy gathers outside the Empress's palace.$B$BMy poisons are ready. What better way to announce my return than with death and destruction?$B$BJust be careful not to mix the two serums... at least not while you're holding the vessels.$B$BSpeak to me when you are ready to fly.
english.completion: Thank you for returning me home, Wakener, but I fear the war has just truly begun.
english.completed: Speak to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

objectiveDetails.description: 与毒心者夏克里尔交谈

text.title: 黑暗天空
text.objectives: 和毒心者夏克里尔一起飞行时，杀死200只螳螂妖和3只恐虫或恐惧巨兽。
text.description: 虫群开始行动了，唤醒者！螳螂妖在恐惧之心开始集结。$B$B他们的翅膀遮蔽了天空，他们的利爪撕裂着大地。看来不杀他们个尸横遍野，他们就不会停止这次黑暗的行军。$B$B我们很乐意这么干，我们将从上空展开攻击。在我飞行时，用我的毒物扼杀他们。$B$B在你攻击之前，不要把两种毒液混合起来，否则会产生剧烈的……化学反应。$B$B当你做好准备时就告诉我。
text.completion: Well done, Wakener. You have a destroyer's aim.
text.completed: Return to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Dark Skies
english.objectives: Kill 200 Mantid and 3 Kunchong or Dread Behemoths while flying with Xaril the Poisoned Mind.
english.description: The swarm begins, Wakener! The mantid amass at the Heart of Fear.$B$BAlready they fill the skies with their wings and rend the earth with their claws. They shall not stop the dark march until their bodies are laid open and bleeding upon the ground.$B$BThis we shall gladly do. We will attack them from above. While I fly, use my poisons to destroy their advance.$B$BDo not mix the two serums until you are ready to attack. The reaction can be quite... violent.$B$BSpeak to me when you are ready to go.
english.completion: Well done, Wakener. You have a destroyer's aim.
english.completed: Return to Xaril the Poisoned Mind at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

objectiveDetails.description: 与毒心者夏克里尔交谈

text.title: 挑战者之环：鹰眼大师砮荣
text.objectives: 在螳螂高原的影踪卫戍营中向鹰眼大师砮荣发起挑战并打败他。
text.description:
你已经在影踪派建立了足够的威信，$n。

砮荣想与你一较高下。

好消息是，如果你赢了，我就让他同你一起执行任务。

坏消息是，我真不觉得你会赢。
text.completion: Well, well, well. Looks like I was wrong.$B$BGood work. Nurong's looking forward to accompanying you on your missions.
text.completed: Return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
text.giverWindow: 一位身手不凡的悟道者，喜欢带着爱鹰白羽一块儿旅行。

english.title: The Challenger's Ring: Hawkmaster Nurong
english.objectives: Challenge Hawkmaster Nurong, and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
english.description:
You've really been building up respect with the Shado-Pan, $n.

Nurong's interested in trying out his skills against you.

The good news is, if you win, I'll allow him to go with you on your missions.

The bad news is, I really don't think you'll win.
english.completion: Well, well, well. Looks like I was wrong.$B$BGood work. Nurong's looking forward to accompanying you on your missions.
english.completed: Return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
english.giverWindow: A deadly Wu Kao who always travels with his beloved hawk, Whitefeather.

text.title: 挑战者之环：“赤烟”腾武
text.objectives: 在螳螂高原的影踪卫戍营中向“赤烟”腾武发起挑战并打败他。
text.description:
这么说……你受到了那个臭名昭著的“赤烟”腾武的挑战。

至少，他是这么称呼自己的。他是个厉害的角色，也是个出色的潜行者，但奇怪的是他偷偷接近你时总是不停地吹嘘自己。

不管怎样，我觉得你应该接受这个挑战。或许这能让他谦虚一点，或许不行。总之，要是你赢了，他很可能愿意陪你一起去完成任务。

而我也会有热闹看了。
text.completion: Wow! Well done. Glad to see you fought so well.$B$BMaybe if he's trying to keep up with your fighting it'll help keep his mouth shut.
text.completed: Return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
text.giverWindow: 一位身手不凡的悟道者盗贼，吹牛的功夫和他高超的战斗技巧有得一拼。

english.title: The Challenger's Ring: Tenwu of the Red Smoke
english.objectives: Challenge Tenwu of the Red Smoke, and then defeat him in combat at Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
english.description:
So... you've been challenged by the infamous Tenwu of the Red Smoke.

That's what he calls himself, at least. He's a good fighter, and a good rogue, but it's a wonder he manages to sneak up on anyone with how loudly he brags about himself.

Anyways, I think you should answer the challenge. Maybe it'll give him a touch of humility. Maybe not. Either way, if you win, he'll probably be willing to go with you on your missions. 

And I get some entertainment.
english.completion: Wow! Well done. Glad to see you fought so well.$B$BMaybe if he's trying to keep up with your fighting it'll help keep his mouth shut.
english.completed: Return to Ling of the Six Pools at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.
english.giverWindow: A deadly Wu Kao rogue, almost as skilled at bragging as he is at combat.

objectiveDetails.description: Challenge Tenwu of the Red Smoke
Defeat Tenwu of the Red Smoke

text.title: 先知克哈祖尔
text.objectives: 击败先知克哈祖尔。
text.description: 先知克哈祖尔是一个强大的施法者，但他也低估了你的能力。$b$b为了保护这个村庄，必须消灭克哈祖尔和他的爪牙。他的死会向雷电之王传达一个强有力的信息：我们是不可战胜的！$b$b你可以在末劫岛上找到他。
text.completion: These events should be learned from, $n.$B$BIt is important that we learn from our history. Had we paid attention to the histories, we may have been able to head this off before it got this far.$B$BEverything that has happened was already foretold, we just didn't know how to read it.
text.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

english.title: Prophet Khar'zul
english.objectives: Defeat Prophet Kharzul.
english.description: Prophet Khar'zul is a powerful caster, but he is also underestimating your abilities.$b$bKhar'zul and his forces must be destroyed to protect this village. His death will send a strong message to the Thunder King that we will not be defeated!$b$bYou'll find him on the Isle of Reckoning.
english.completion: These events should be learned from, $n.$B$BIt is important that we learn from our history. Had we paid attention to the histories, we may have been able to head this off before it got this far.$B$BEverything that has happened was already foretold, we just didn't know how to read it.
english.completed: Return to Lorewalker Cho in Zouchin Village.

text.title: 欢迎来到晨芳园
text.objectives: 和晨芳园的凯·游酒、风裘大师以及佩吉·金酿谈一谈。
text.description: 周卓已经准备要踏上另一次冒险之旅，而这次冒险需要大量玉石。我可能必须寻求一些人的帮助。$b$b你何不趁此机会向这里的居民介绍一下自己。$b$b凯·游酒和风裘大师都是值得结交的好人。哦，顺便替我问候客栈中的佩吉·金酿。$b$b从他们三人那里，你会体会到生活在晨芳园的感觉。
text.completion: Good, good, good. You're going to fit right in.
text.completed: Speak with Toya at Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Welcome to Dawn's Blossom
english.objectives: Speak with Kai Wanderbrew, Master Windfur, and Peiji Goldendraft in Dawn's Blossom.
english.description: Cho's off on another one of his adventures, and this one requires a big order of jade. I'm going to have to call in some favors.$b$bHow 'bout in the meantime you introduce yourself to some of the locals.$b$bKai Wanderbrew is a good guy to know, as is Master Windfur. Oh, and say hi to Peiji Goldendraft up at the inn.$b$bBetween the three of them, you should get the feel for life in Dawn's Blossom.
english.completion: Good, good, good. You're going to fit right in.
english.completed: Speak with Toya at Dawn's Blossom in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 根除恐惧织网蛛
text.objectives: 在格尔桑平台杀死8只恐惧织网小蜘蛛。和掠风者克尔鲁克谈一谈空投的事情。
text.description: 在你最初发现我的格尔桑平台上，影踪派神射手们还在花费大量精力对付恐惧织网蛛，如果能把他们从中解放出来，他们就能专注于对付那些卑鄙的虫群。$B$B彻底消灭那些蜘蛛，让城墙上的射手们缓口气。
text.completion: I never liked spiders. Filthy, mindless insects.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Dreadspinner Extermination
english.objectives: Slay 8 Dreadspinner Tenders in the Terrace of Gurthan. Speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver for an air-drop.
english.description: Back in Gurthani Terrace where you found me, dreadspinners continue to occupy the attention of Shado-Pan marksmen who could otherwise be thinning out this wretched swarm.$B$BEradicate those spiders and offer some relief to the archers on that wall.
english.completion: I never liked spiders. Filthy, mindless insects.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 远古帝国
text.objectives: 收集8块格萨尼石板。
text.description: 我的兄弟提起过一个远古的魔古帝国，那个帝国曾位于东面的废墟中。$B$B那时，魔古族部落掌握着关于巫术和镇压的不为人知的秘密。$B$B我有一颗好奇的心，唤醒者。我希望能够了解那些在我沉睡之后存在过的帝国。$B$B过去的知识将决定我们的未来。$B$B去那个废墟里搜索他们的远古石板。我会研究他们的秘密，并为我们所用。
text.progress: What knowledge do you bring?
text.completion: Good, Wakener. It will take me time to decipher these tablets, but all knowledge is worthy.
text.completed: Return to Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: An Ancient Empire
english.objectives: Collect 8 Gurthani Tablets.
english.description: My brothers speak of an ancient mogu empire that once dwelled in the ruins to the east.$B$BOnce, this tribe knew untold secrets of sorcery and subjugation.$B$BI have a curious mind, Wakener, and I wish to learn of the empires that ruled after my time.$B$BKnowledge of the past will determine our future.$B$BGo search the ruins for their ancient tablets. I will study their secrets and make them our own.
english.progress: What knowledge do you bring?
english.completion: Good, Wakener. It will take me time to decipher these tablets, but all knowledge is worthy.
english.completed: Return to Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 采集树脂
text.objectives: 收集6份琥珀汁液。
text.description: 我在东面发现了一片琥珀树小树林，唤醒者。$B$B我已经在树上放置了一些用于采集树脂的设备。但我太忙了，没有时间去收集树脂。$B$B我需要有人去找到那些提取器。启动那些设备，然后为我带回一些琥珀样本。
text.progress: These trees are still young. They are not yet kypari.$B$BTheir sap is like water, while the sap of a true kypari tree is like wine.$B$BThey must be allowed to grow.
text.completion: Ah yes, this is exactly what I needed.$B$BI will examine these samples. We must continue to monitor the health of these young kypari.
text.completed: Return to Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Sap Tapping
english.objectives: Collect 6 Amber Sap.
english.description: I found a grove of young amber trees to the east, Wakener.$B$BI've placed tapping devices on these trees, but I have been too busy to retrieve the sap.$B$BI need someone to find the extractors. Activate them, then bring me samples of the amber.
english.progress: These trees are still young. They are not yet kypari.$B$BTheir sap is like water, while the sap of a true kypari tree is like wine.$B$BThey must be allowed to grow.
english.completion: Ah yes, this is exactly what I needed.$B$BI will examine these samples. We must continue to monitor the health of these young kypari.
english.completed: Return to Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 完美的信息
text.objectives: 收集1颗泥泞兽信息囊。
text.description: 啊！唤醒者！你一定得帮帮我！（你一定要帮我，否则我就拿你做实验品！）$B$B我的试验需要更多的材料，是的是的！（信息信息，试验需要更多的信息！）$B$B在这里的西面，我看到过一些迷雾怪物。他们有着又大、又圆、又好的信息囊！$B$B现在就去，小唤醒者。给我带一颗回来！
text.progress: Ooooh, what wonderful, tasty parts have you brought me?
text.completion: Yes, yes! Wonderful! Oh, so delicious!
text.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Putting An Eye Out
english.objectives: Collect 1 Pristine Mire Beast Eye.
english.description: Ah! Wakener! You must help me! (You will help me, or else I will help myself to you!)$B$BI need more materials for my experiments, yes yes! (Blood and guts, hearts and brains, tongues and eyes, eyes, eyes!)$B$BTo the west, I have seen creatures of mist and fog. They possess such big, round, wonderful globes! Big for seeing, round and unblinking!$B$BGo now, little Wakener. Bring me back a single pristine eye!
english.progress: Ooooh, what wonderful, tasty parts have you brought me?
english.completion: Yes, yes! Wonderful! Oh, so delicious!
english.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 除虫良方
text.objectives: 使用影踪派龙枪在格尔桑平台摧毁20枚恐惧织网蛛的卵。
text.description: 我最近在城墙附近巡逻的时候捡到了这把武器。这把武器似乎很适合帮助你们影踪派处理格尔桑平台的侵扰问题。$B$B他们越是集中精力对付墙边的蜘蛛，越是没有时间对付令人毛骨悚然的聚生虫。
text.completion: A crude weapon, but it has its uses.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Nope Nope Nope
english.objectives: Use the Shado-Pan Dragon Gun to destroy 20 Dreadspinner Eggs in Gurthani Terrace.
english.description: I recovered this weapon on a recent scouting run near the wall. It would seem ideal for helping your Shado-Pan with their infestation problem in Gurthani Terrace.$B$BThe more they are focused on keeping spiders off the wall, the less time they are killing fear-gripped swarmborn.
english.completion: A crude weapon, but it has its uses.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 清理平台
text.objectives: 在格尔桑平台清理6只女皇之眼。杀死任何东西都可以让你获得信息素追踪的能力，以帮助你找到它们。
text.description: 如果这个女皇真的被恐惧和妄想控制了，那她一定会向这片土地的每个角落派出斥候，以巩固自己的统治。$B$B这些斥候蛆虫到处都是，但很难用肉眼看到。最好通过它们爬过时留下的信息素痕迹进行跟踪。$B$B我已经……在你身上使用了……一种应激毒素。这种毒素可以在你体验到胜利的喜悦后，显示信息素的痕迹。$B$B现在就去格尔桑平台，找出那些间谍吧。
text.completion: Information is power, $n. We cannot allow the Empess to monitor our movements.
text.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Debugging the Terrace
english.objectives: Stomp out 6 Eyes of the Empress around the Terrace of Gurthan. Killing anything will grant you Pheromone Tracking, helping you detect them.
english.description: If this Empress is truly possessed by fear and paranoia, she will have sent scouts to every corner of the land in order to cement her control.$B$BThese scout grubs are likely everywhere, but difficult to spot with the naked eye. Better to track them by the pheromone trails they leave behind.$B$BI've already... gifted you... a reactive toxin that will reveal these trails to you for a brief time after experiencing the thrill of victory.$B$BGo now to the Terrace of Gurthan and root out these spies.
english.completion: Information is power, $n. We cannot allow the Empess to monitor our movements.
english.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 健脑食品
text.objectives: 带4条穆山兽之舌给卡拉克西维斯的操纵者卡兹提克。
text.description: 科沃克正在加速生长，但他的大脑似乎跟不上生长的速度。他需要一种特殊的食物来确保大脑跟上身体的生长速度。$B$B穆山兽之舌富含营养，可以促进恐虫的大脑生长，但他们通常吞下整只野兽，迅速填饱肚子。如果我们每隔几天喂科沃克吃穆山兽之舌，应该能平衡他的生长。$B$B大群的穆山兽就在这里东面的山上游荡，距离格尔桑平台不远。
text.progress: Have you found a suitable meal for Kovok?
text.completion: Kovok was whining the whole time you were away. It was really quite pathetic.
text.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Brain Food
english.objectives: Bring 4 Mushan Tongues to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess.
english.description: Kovok is growing at an accelerated rate, but his brain may not be able to keep up. He'll require a special diet to ensure that he does not outgrow the capacity to control his own body.$B$BMushan tongue is rich in the nutrients that promote brain growth in kunchong, but they normally eat the beasts whole and fill up quickly. If we feed Kovok only mushan tongues every couple of days or so, it should balance out his growth.$B$BGreatback mushan graze the hills east of here, near the Gurthani Terrace.
english.progress: Have you found a suitable meal for Kovok?
english.completion: Kovok was whining the whole time you were away. It was really quite pathetic.
english.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 你叫什么名字名字？
text.objectives: 击败7个溪行锦鱼人。
text.description: 那么，你想当个猢狲。是不是，小子？$b$b猢狲从敌人手上保卫自己的土地，锦鱼人就是我们的敌人。$b$b卡哈卡哈和锦鱼人打了很多仗，每次都打赢了。$b$b猢狲只将名字名字授予优秀的古鲁金人。去教训教训那些锦鱼人，也许他们会叫你$n$n。$b$b锦鱼人就居住在河边。好好教训那些家伙！
text.completion: Ha ha! Wikket Grooked ookin' Jinyu!
text.completed: Speak to Chief Kah Kah at Grookin Hill.

english.title: What's in a Name Name?
english.objectives: Kill 7 Riverstride Jinyu.
english.description: So, you wanna be a hozen. Huh, wikket?$b$bHozen defend their lands from enemies, like jinyu.$b$bKah Kah fought many jinyu fights, and won them all.$b$bHozen only give name name to good grookers. Go grook jinyu and maybe they call you $n $n.$b$bJinyu creepin' down by the river. Ook 'em in the dooker!
english.completion: Ha ha! Wikket Grooked ookin' Jinyu!
english.completed: Speak to Chief Kah Kah at Grookin Hill.

text.title: 邪恶的无毛怪
text.objectives: 从疲惫的伞兵身上收集6枚联盟效力奖章。
text.description: 他们说……$n是个好无毛怪。$b$b他们说……$n帮助过猢狲。$b$b他们说，不要再欺负$n了。$b$b那好吧。瞧那边，邪恶的无毛怪纷纷倒下，我们准备好动手了！$b$b快去加入狂欢吧。但要记住，所有亮闪闪的战利品全归酋长卡哈卡哈！这是猢狲法则的第二条。$b$b<叽克叽克挠了挠头。>$b$b呃……猢狲的法则也只有第二条……
text.progress: Whatcha got, wikket?
text.completion: Wikket grookin' makin' hozen rich with shinies!$B$B$n makin' a good second impression. And for hozen, number two is most important!
text.completed: Speak to Chief Kah Kah at Grookin Hill

english.title: Wicked Wikkets
english.objectives: Collect 6 Alliance Service Medallions from Battleworn Paratroopers.
english.description: $n good wikket, they say...$b$b$n help hozen, they say...$b$bNo more grookin' $n, they say.$b$bThat ok. Look out there. Wicked wikkets fallin' like rain, ripe for the grookin'!$b$bGo, join the fun. But remember, Chief Kah Kah gets all the shinies! That's hozen rule number two.$b$b<Jeek Jeek scratches his head.>$b$bHmm, all hozen rules are number two...
english.progress: Whatcha got, wikket?
english.completion: Wikket grookin' makin' hozen rich with shinies!$B$B$n makin' a good second impression. And for hozen, number two is most important!
english.completed: Speak to Chief Kah Kah at Grookin Hill

text.title: 雾临村
text.objectives: 和雾临村的车·荒野行者谈一谈。
text.description: 我的斥候今天在雾临村附近没有侦察到任何魔古族，但我听说当地的野生动物和墓地里的灵魂受到了些骚扰。我委派车去了解一下情况，但他很想得到你的帮忙。$B$B朝西南边走到村庄去，跟车碰面。尽力而为吧。
text.completion: Leven sent me a good one today! I must thank him later.

english.title: Mistfall Village
english.objectives: Speak to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village.
english.description: My scouts have spotted no mogu near Mistfall Village today, but I've been hearing of some troubles with local wildlife and spirits in the graveyard. I dispatched Che to assess the situation, but he'll most likely need your help.$B$BFind your way southwest to the village and meet Che there. Do what you can.
english.completion: Leven sent me a good one today! I must thank him later.

text.title: 雾临村遭袭
text.objectives: 和雾临村的孙·柔心谈一谈。
text.description: 有人在西南方的雾临村见到了魔古族。我立刻派了鲁克和孙，但那边还得尽快再找一个得力的帮手。$B$B别磨蹭了。村民需要你。
text.completion: Oh, thank the celestials you're here! This is worse than we thought!

english.title: Attack on Mistfall Village
english.objectives: Speak to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village.
english.description: Mogu have been sighted at Mistfall Village to the southwest. I dispatched Rook and Sun immediately, but I need another capable hand there as soon as possible.$B$BDon't delay. The villagers need you.
english.completion: Oh, thank the celestials you're here! This is worse than we thought!

text.title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
text.objectives: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
text.description: I've instructed Anji and Kun to resume investigation of the Ruins of Guo-Lai. We have no reports of any significant mogu presence there today, but it seems to be one of their central interests here in the Vale, and want it under thorough watch consider their attack on the lake.$B$BThat's why I'm sending you as well.$B$BHead west, past the lake, to the ruins. Anji will instruct you further.
text.completion: If it isn't one of my favorite paladins. Glad to have you with us.

english.title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
english.objectives: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
english.description: I've instructed Anji and Kun to resume investigation of the Ruins of Guo-Lai. We have no reports of any significant mogu presence there today, but it seems to be one of their central interests here in the Vale, and want it under thorough watch consider their attack on the lake.$B$BThat's why I'm sending you as well.$B$BHead west, past the lake, to the ruins. Anji will instruct you further.
english.completion: If it isn't one of my favorite paladins. Glad to have you with us.

text.title: 残阳关卫戍营
text.objectives: 和残阳关卫戍营的安济·秋光谈一谈。
text.description: 从金色阶梯冲下来的魔古兵，还有他们在琼花湖的左右夹击，让我们损失了不少兵力。我们的战线日益薄弱。$B$B我正准备把安济和奎派到残阳关卫戍营去，帮助加快我们训练新兵的速度。我想让你跟他们一起去，$n。让他们见识一下什么才是真正的$c。
text.completion: Let's whip these recruits into shape.

english.title: Setting Sun Garrison
english.objectives: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison.
english.description: We've taken losses from the mogu forces descending the Golden Stair and their flanking attackers at Whitepetal Lake. Our lines are thin.$B$BI'm dispatching Anji and Kun to the Setting Sun Garrison to double our efforts at training new recruits. I'd like you there with them, $n. Show them what a true $c is made of.
english.completion: Let's whip these recruits into shape.

text.title: 绝世美肉！
text.objectives: 收集160份昆莱肉末。
text.description:
是的，没错。

所有人都觉得我们地精就只喜欢鼓捣些小发明。要么就是玩弄炸药。还有……嗯，你懂的，都是些上不了台面的事情。

但鲜为人知的是，我还是一个伟大的厨师！烧菜是我的一大嗜好。

你给我从周围弄点动物的肉块来，我保证给你烧出一锅全世界最好吃的菜来！

还有，我保证，我就只用百分之三或四的火箭燃料烧菜……
text.progress: The meaty bits, $n? We need 'em!
text.completion: You know what they say about cooking - GTL. Garnish, taste... and... laundry?
text.completed: Return to Rivett Clutchpop at Eastwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Best Meals Anywhere!
english.objectives: Collect 160 Kun-Lai Meaty Bits.
english.description:
Yeah, yeah.

Everyone knows us goblins do tinkering. And explosives. And... well, ya' know, the less reputable stuff.

But what nobody knows is that I'm really a great chef! It's a hobby of mine.

Gather us up some meaty bits from the creatures around here, and I'll cook us up the best meals ANYWHERE!

And I promise, I'll only use three or four percent rocket fuel.
english.progress: The meaty bits, $n? We need 'em!
english.completion: You know what they say about cooking - GTL. Garnish, taste... and... laundry?
english.completed: Return to Rivett Clutchpop at Eastwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 返回西风之息
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的西风之息找雇农小波。
text.description:
好吧，在我看来，我们会有很多重建工作要做。

我不是能够做什么大事的人，但说实话，我的雇农们在这儿已经帮不上什么忙了。而且，由于你帮助他们摆脱了困难，他们也希望加入你们的“联盟”。我又怎么会阻止他们呢？

让他们和你一起走吧，回到雇农小波那里。我会想念他们的，但跟你走对他们来说更有好处。
text.completion: You did good, bringing these guys back. We'll have 'em farming you up some food in no time!

english.title: Back to Westwind Rest
english.objectives: Return to Farmhand Bo at Westwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
Well, far as I figure, we've got quite a lot of rebuildin' to do.

I'm not one for joining any big causes, but my farmhands aren't gonna have much to do 'round here, to be honest. And, since you helped them out, they want to join your "Alliance." So, who am I to stop 'em?

Bring 'em with you, back to Farmhand Bo. I'll miss 'em, but they're better off with you.
english.completion: You did good, bringing these guys back. We'll have 'em farming you up some food in no time!

text.title: 返回东风之眠
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的东风之眠找雇农小寇。
text.description:
很好，根据我了解到的情况，我们还有很多重建工作要做。

我不是能够成就什么大事的人，可是说实话，我的雇农们在这里也没有什么事情可做。而且，因为你救了他们，他们愿意加入你的“部落”。那我何必阻止他们呢？

带他们一起去找雇农小寇吧。我会想念他们的，但他们和你在一起会更好。
text.completion: You did good, bringing these guys back. We'll have 'em farming you up some food in no time!

english.title: Back to Eastwind Rest
english.objectives: Return to Farmhand Ko at Eastwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
Well, far as I figure, we've got quite a lot of rebuildin' to do.

I'm not one for joining any big causes, but my farmhands aren't gonna have much to do 'round here, to be honest. And, since you helped them out, they want to join your "Horde". So, who am I to stop 'em?

Bring 'em with you, back to Farmhand Ko. I'll miss 'em, but they're better off with you.
english.completion: You did good, bringing these guys back. We'll have 'em farming you up some food in no time!

text.title: 昆莱之路
text.objectives: 穿过雾纱栈道并抵达滨岸村。
text.description: 哦！欢迎你，游学者周卓的朋友。我有一个消息要告诉你。$b$b<这个古怪的小家伙交给你一个破旧的卷轴盒子。>$b$b游学者阁下正在昆莱山等着你。通往那里的道路非常危险，是的，非常非常危险。$b$b你可以寻找沿路的向导来为你指路。
text.progress: More strangers? This day is testing my limits.
text.completion: Oh, you are a friend of Cho's? Welcome! Welcome!$B$BI would serve you a banquet but as you can see we are in dire straights at the moment.$B$BSay, would you be willing to lend us a hand?
text.completed: Travel up the Veiled Stair to speak with Mayor Bramblestaff at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Road to Kun-Lai
english.objectives: Travel through the Veiled Stair to Binan Village.
english.description: Ah! Greetings friend of Lorewalker Cho. I have a message for you.$b$b<The strange little creature hands you a battered scroll case.>$b$bThe Lorewalker waits for you in Kun-Lai. Very dangerous to travel there, yes, very dangerous.$b$bLook for guides along the road to help you find your way.
english.progress: More strangers? This day is testing my limits.
english.completion: Oh, you are a friend of Cho's? Welcome! Welcome!$B$BI would serve you a banquet but as you can see we are in dire straights at the moment.$B$BSay, would you be willing to lend us a hand?
english.completed: Travel up the Veiled Stair to speak with Mayor Bramblestaff at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 赶牛
text.objectives: 捕捉3头野生平原牦牛，将它们带到东风之眠。
text.description:
Lok'tar，$c。

我们已经取得了一些进展，但如果想要在昆莱山站稳脚跟，我们还需要加强部队的机动性。

我在这儿没看见过座狼、科多兽或其他类似的野兽。但我看到了牦牛。我们的熊猫人盟友说它们很适合当坐骑，所以只能这样了。

去捉一些牦牛回来交给我，这样我们就可以让我们的人骑上它们了。
text.completion: Well done! Well, they're plenty stubborn, I'll say that much. But they should do nicely.
text.completed: Return to General Nazgrim at Eastwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: Round 'Em Up
english.objectives: Round up 3 Wild Plains Yaks and return them to Eastwind Rest.
english.description:
Lok'tar, $c.

We've made progress, but we're going to need mobility if we want to maintain our foothold here in Kun-Lai.

I don't see many worgs, kodo, or the like around here. What I do see are yaks. Our pandaren allies have said they make good mounts, so they'll have to do.

Go round some up and return them here, so we can get our people riding them!
english.completion: Well done! Well, they're plenty stubborn, I'll say that much. But they should do nicely.
english.completed: Return to General Nazgrim at Eastwind Rest in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 唯利是图：查舍恩
text.objectives: 收集古代虎血。
text.description: 我正在全心酝酿一种新的诈骗手段！$b$b我在空中飞行时看到一个真正的远古母虎在地面上行走。$b$b你知道她的血在黑市上值多少钱吗？更不用说，要是我能让某些术士相信，这虎血可以使他们的召唤法术或某些其他技能变得更加强大……$b$b如果你能为我带回一些她的血液，我会分你一些好处的。她就在距离此地不远的都阳河远端出没。
text.progress: I thought about taking that tiger on myself but to be honest I like living...
text.completion: Impressive! Can you smell the money? Here's your end.
text.completed: Speak with Daggle Bombstrider in the Krasari Ruins of Krasarang Wilds.
text.giverWindow: 荒野女王

english.title: Profit Mastery: Chasheen
english.objectives: Collect Ancient Tiger's Blood.
english.description: I am totally on to another great scam!$b$bWhen I was flying overhead I saw a really ancient tigress prowling about.$b$bDo you know how much her blood would go for on the black market? Not to mention if I convince some warlocks it adds extra potency to their summoning spells or something.$b$bIf you bring me back some of her blood I will cut you in on the scam. She was prowling about on the far side of the Dojani River from here.
english.progress: I thought about taking that tiger on myself but to be honest I like living...
english.completion: Impressive! Can you smell the money? Here's your end.
english.completed: Speak with Daggle Bombstrider in the Krasari Ruins of Krasarang Wilds.
english.giverWindow: Queen of the Deepwild

text.title: 杰克船长的亡灵
text.objectives: 把杰克船长的遗物带给古鲁金猴山的酋长卡哈卡哈。
text.description: 就在你检查这个来之不易的战利品时，淤血从杰克船长的遗物里渗出，并神秘地渗入地面。$b$b这很奇怪，但现在没有时间调查这件事了。还有很多工作要做。$b$b你高超的技巧证明了你自己，新朋友们的酋长一定会因此对你刮目相看的。
text.completion: Ookin' grookin, wikket!

english.title: Captain Jack's Dead
english.objectives: Bring Captain Jack's head to Chief Kah Kah at Grookin Hill.
english.description: Gore from Captain Jack's head drips and mysteriously seeps into the ground as you examine your hard-won trophy.$b$bStrange, but no time to investigate that now. There's too much work to be done.$b$bThe chieftain of your newfound friends will doubtlessly be impressed with this proof of your grookin' skills.
english.completion: Ookin' grookin, wikket!

text.title: 猎鹤高手：针尖铁嘴
text.objectives: 取得针喙。
text.description: 现在，既然你已经知道了鹤是如何战斗的，那我就给你找一个极好的目标吧。$b$b针尖铁嘴！$b$b至少，我是这么叫他的，他是我见过的最大的鹤。他的喙极其锋利，就像一把剑。$b$b你可以在这里的西北方向找到一个大瀑布，那个瀑布流入了都阳河。针尖铁嘴喜欢在瀑布边逗留。$b$b去把它的喙作为战利品交给我，我会和你商讨前往奈辛瓦里的大计。
text.progress: I watched that bird stab a tiger through the face. What kind of place is this where birds are the predators for tigers?
text.completion: Now THAT is a trophy. Looks intimidating. Wait... is this your blood on it?
text.completed: Speak with Daggle Bombstrider at the Krasari Ruins in Krasarang Wilds.
text.giverWindow: 鸟群头领

english.title: Crane Mastery: Needlebeak
english.objectives: Acquire the Needlebeak.
english.description: So, now that you've got a vibe for how cranes fight, I've got a doozy for you.$b$bNeedlebeak!$b$bOr at least, that's what I'm calling him. Biggest crane I ever saw. And its beak is so sharp it's like a sword.$b$bNorthwest of here you'll find the big water fall that kicks off the Dojani River. Needlebeak likes to hang out by the waterfall.$b$bYou bring me its beak as a trophy and I will talk you up a good game to Nesingwary.
english.progress: I watched that bird stab a tiger through the face. What kind of place is this where birds are the predators for tigers?
english.completion: Now THAT is a trophy. Looks intimidating. Wait... is this your blood on it?
english.completed: Speak with Daggle Bombstrider at the Krasari Ruins in Krasarang Wilds.
english.giverWindow: Lord of the Flock

text.title: 玛祖的气息
text.objectives: 喝下玛祖的气息药水。
text.description: 你是来帮忙的，对吧？那么，我们先得完成一件头等大事。$B$B<阿林在她的口袋里找了一小会儿，拿出了一小瓶闪烁着蓝色光芒的液体。>$B$B给你！“玛祖的气息”，船长的独家配方。$B$B怎么？你以为我会不给你呼吸设备就让你下海吗？我需要的是水手，不是死尸！$B$B一口气干了它，新手。有了这个东西，你就能在海床上大展身手了。
text.completion: You'll thank me later.
text.completed: Speak with Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

english.title: Mazu's Breath
english.objectives: Drink the Potion of Mazu's Breath.
english.description: Here to help, are ya? Well, first thing's first.$B$B<Arie rummages through her pockets for a moment before producing a small vial of glowing blue fluid.>$B$BHere it is! "Mazu's Breath." Cap'n's own formula.$B$BWhat? You thought I'd send you out to sea without a means of breathin'? I need deckhands, not corpses!$B$BDown the hatch with it, green. This'll give you a fighting chance out there on the shelf.
english.completion: You'll thank me later.
english.completed: Speak with Deck Boss Arie in Soggy's Gamble.

text.title: 魔古大军入侵
text.objectives: 找到并击败山泽间谍大师。
text.description:
我们听说一支魔古军已经渗入了螳螂高原海岸。我不知道他们将要干什么。坦白说，我并不关心。

你证明了自己，因此我们决定把这个任务交给你。

接下来要做的事情是，你将要出发，找到他们，然后杀死他们。

我们的斥候报告说，第一支魔古军已在北方登陆，也就是这里和死语者高地之间的位置。去那里消灭他们。
text.completion: It was just a decoy! They've moved to attack Niuzao Temple!
text.completed: Return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Mogu Incursions
english.objectives: Find and kill the Shan'ze Spymaster.
english.description:
We've heard reports of a group of Mogu infiltrating the coast here in Townlong. I have no idea what they are doing. Frankly, I don't care. 

You've proven yourself, so we've decided to give this mission to you.

What's going to happen is this - you're going to go, find them, and kill them.

Our scouts reported the first group landed to the north, between here and Deadtalker's Plateau. Go there and wipe them out.
english.completion: It was just a decoy! They've moved to attack Niuzao Temple!
english.completed: Return to Master Snowdrift at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 雾刃覆灭
text.objectives: 杀死6个雾刃撕裂者。
text.description: 柯尔凡向我报告了他的发现。在群星湖底有一处巨大的琥珀矿脉。$B$B不幸的是，一个敌对的蜥蜴人部族生活在湖边，并将那些琥珀视为禁脔。$B$B他们不会让我们轻易进入他们的领地。$B$B快到南边的群星湖去杀死那些雾刃蜥蜴人，好让我们能更轻松地采集那里的琥珀。
text.completion: Well done. With access to this amber, we shall be able to craft weapons to our cause.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Mistblade Destruction
english.objectives: Kill 6 Mistblade Rippers.
english.description: Korven has told me of his findings. There is an enormous amber deposit sitting at the bottom of the Lake of Stars.$B$BUnfortunately, a hostile saurok tribe lives at the edge of the lake, and revere the amber as their own.$B$BThey will not allow us to enter their territory easily.$B$BGo south to the lake. Kill the Mistblade saurok, so that we can more easily harvest the nearby amber.
english.completion: Well done. With access to this amber, we shall be able to craft weapons to our cause.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 脑力劳动
text.objectives: 从伊克提克珀针蝎身上收集3个琥珀化的大脑。
text.description: 在南面很远的地方，虫群在培育一种毁灭性武器——体型庞大、外壳坚硬的琥珀巨蝎。$B$B和所有其他动物一样，他们也被控制了。但与其他动物不同的是，它们尚未被我控制意识。$B$B在可以支配这些蝎子供我们使用之前，有必要做一些深入的研究。$B$B我必须研究它们的大脑，你要为我收集一些样本。$B$B带上这个声波发射器。我发现它在对付野兽时非常管用。
text.progress: They continue to resist my sonic manipulation. I must understand why.
text.completion: My my, this is interesting indeed. They are unlike any other brains I have seen.$B$BI will study these carefully.
text.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: A Little Brain Work
english.objectives: Collect 3 Amber-Encrusted Brains from Ik'thik Amberstingers.
english.description: Far to the south, the swarm breeds weapons of destruction - enormous, nearly unbreakable amber scorpions.$B$BLike all other creatures, they are subject to manipulation, but unlike other creatures, they have not yet submitted to my mind control.$B$BIt appears that further research is necessary before I can dominate them for our own purposes.$B$BI must study their brains, and you must retrieve some specimens for me.$B$BTake this sonic emitter. I have found it to be quite effective against the beasts.
english.progress: They continue to resist my sonic manipulation. I must understand why.
english.completion: My my, this is interesting indeed. They are unlike any other brains I have seen.$B$BI will study these carefully.
english.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 邪鳞领主
text.objectives: 杀死雾刃邪鳞领主。
text.description: 群星湖附近的蜥蜴人听命于他们的邪鳞领主，他是一个恶毒无情的家伙，盘踞在自己的领地中。$B$B如果我们能消灭这个坏蛋，那我们就能安全抵达湖底的琥珀矿脉。$B$B去吧。他们的首领从地下的巢穴中发号施令，那个巢穴位于湖泊南侧的底部。
text.completion: Good. I am glad to hear that he is dead.
text.completed: Return to Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: The Scale-Lord
english.objectives: Kill the Mistblade Scale-Lord.
english.description: The saurok at the Lake of Stars take their orders from their Scale-Lord, a vicious, merciless leader who guards his territory fiercely.$B$BIf we can eliminate this leader, then we can gain access to the enormous amber lode beneath the lake.$B$BGo. Their leader gives his orders from his underground dwelling, at the southern edge of the lake.
english.completion: Good. I am glad to hear that he is dead.
english.completed: Return to Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 以暴制暴
text.objectives: 杀死15只恐鳞蝎。
text.description: 当我们在凯帕圣树·扎尔发现煞能的影响时，我还曾奢望能够消除他们所造成的腐蚀。$B$B但不幸的是，卡拉克西议会已证实惧之煞所带来的腐蚀正不断加深，并持续扩散。$B$B在南方，我观察到当地的野生动物被一种莫名的恐惧所吞噬。$B$B煞魔可以将受害者崩坏并扭曲至无法想象的恐慌之境。$B$B我们必须在情况恶化之前制止他们。找出被煞魔感染的恐鳞蝎，消灭它们。
text.completion: You have purged the hills of the infected creatures? Good.$B$BThe sha is a merciless enemy. Thus must we be merciless in return.
text.completed: Return to Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: The Fight Against Fear
english.objectives: Kill 15 Horrorscale Scorpid.
english.description: When we discovered the sha influence at Kypari Zar, I had hoped the corruption could still be cleansed.$B$BUnfortunately, the Klaxxi Council has confirmed that the sha of fear's corruption is deep-seated, and continues to spread.$B$BTo the south, I have observed some of the local wildlife consumed by an unnamed terror.$B$BThe sha can warp and twist its victims into unimaginable horrors.$B$BWe must stop the corruption before it becomes worse. Seek out the sha-infected Horrorscale Scorpids. Eliminate them.
english.completion: You have purged the hills of the infected creatures? Good.$B$BThe sha is a merciless enemy. Thus must we be merciless in return.
english.completed: Return to Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 恶毒基因
text.objectives: 杀死3个伊克提克基因操纵师和6个伊克提克护卵者。
text.description: 唤醒者，在南面很远的地方，女皇的基因操纵师正在进行阴险的试验。（非常阴险，但不足以和我的试验相提并论！）$B$B他们解剖附近的野生动物，让它们产生突变，变成他们想要的怪物。（他们的实验成果，将会变成我的！）$B$B绝不能让他们的阴谋得逞！（不，不！只有我才能拥有这种力量！）$B$B他们已经开始将突变的试验品投入到战争中了。去吧！不惜一切代价消灭它们！
text.completion: Yes, yes! They are dead!$B$BThank you, Wakener. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Bad Genes
english.objectives: Kill 3 Ik'thik Genemancers and 6 Ik'thik Egg-Drones.
english.description: Far to the south, Wakener, the Empress's genemancers set about their dark experiments. (Dark yes, but not as dark as mine!)$B$BThey dissect and mutate the nearby wildlife, breeding creatures of their own design. (Their design, which will become my design!)$B$BWe must not let them succeed! (No, no! Only I am allowed such power!)$B$BTheir mutations are already being unleashed for war. Go! Destroy them at any cost!
english.completion: Yes, yes! They are dead!$B$BThank you, Wakener. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 感染
text.objectives: 杀死6只被感染的野生动物。被感染的野生动物可能包括骨尘飞蛾、蓝皮穆山兽和变异巨蝎。
text.description: 女皇的基因操纵师正在进行危险的活动。$B$B在南面，他们正在用携带信息素的寄生虫感染那里的野生动物，企图制造可怕的畸形用于战争。$B$B他们已经把寄生虫放到了那里的生态系统中。$B$B如果放任不管，感染将会从一只动物传染到另一只，直到全面爆发。$B$B我会给你注射一种温和的毒素。有了这种毒素，你可以识别受到感染的动物。$B$B要毫不犹豫地杀死寄生虫携带者。
text.completion: So the infection was spreading. You halted the spread just in time, it seems.$B$BI doubt that the genemancers will stop their outrageous experimentation, but we must continue to thwart their efforts.
text.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Infection
english.objectives: Kill 6 infected wildlife. Infected wildlife may include Bonedust Moths, Bluehide Mushan, and Mutating Scorpid.
english.description: The Empress's genemancers play with dangerous toys.$B$BTo the south, they are injecting local wildlife with pheromone-laden parasites, in an attempt to create monstrous mutations for war.$B$BCarelessly, they have allowed their parasitic worms to escape into the local ecosystem.$B$BLeft unchecked, the infection will spread from one animal to another, until we have an outbreak.$B$BI will inject you with a mild toxin. With it, you will be able to identify infected creatures.$B$BKill the carriers at once.
english.completion: So the infection was spreading. You halted the spread just in time, it seems.$B$BI doubt that the genemancers will stop their outrageous experimentation, but we must continue to thwart their efforts.
english.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败被感染的野生动物

text.title: 突袭！
text.objectives: 去螳螂高原和砮皂寺外的班·熊心会合，然后携手抵御魔古族的突袭。
text.description:
那些该死的魔古……

那些斥候只是诱饵！当我们追猎他们的间谍时，魔古的主力对砮皂寺发动了突袭。堕落的毒蛇，到处都是魔古……我们大难临头了！

幸好，班和我方最强的精英成员一起穿越了他们的防线。如果你也能过去，就跟他会合。我们必须阻止这一切！
text.completion: Niuzao has been saved. The Mogu pushed back. And you, friend, have been found worthy of a great honor. $B$BWe shall induct you into the Shado-Pan.
text.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Surprise Attack!
english.objectives: Meet up with Ban Bearheart outside Niuzao Temple in Townlong Steppes, and put a stop to the Mogu Invasion there.
english.description:
Those damnable Mogu...

Those scouts were a distraction! While we were hunting their spies, the main force moved on Niuzao Temple. Corrupted serpents, Mogu everywhere... this is a disaster!

Thankfully, Ban was able to make it past their lines with the most elite members of our order. If you can slip past, too, meet up with him. We need to put a stop to this!
english.completion: Niuzao has been saved. The Mogu pushed back. And you, friend, have been found worthy of a great honor. $B$BWe shall induct you into the Shado-Pan.
english.completed: Return to Ban Bearheart at the Shado-Pan Garrison in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 弄清楚如何制作任务
text.objectives: 制作一个索引任务。
text.description: 好耶！你要学会如何制作一个索引任务！现在想想下面该做什么。

english.title: Figuring out how to make quests
english.objectives: Make a breadcrumb quest.
english.description: Whee!  You get to make a breadcrumb quest!  Now figure out what to do next.

text.title: 我对烹饪所有了解
text.objectives: 把信交给孙行·铁掌。她在半山市集教授厨艺。
text.description: 很高兴你喜欢我的食物。你对这些食谱感兴趣吗？如果感兴趣，你可以向我的老师学习这些食谱。他们在半山市集。我所有的厨艺都是从他们那里学到的。$b$b如果你正好经过那里，可不可以帮我把这封信交给孙行·铁掌？她是我最喜欢的老师，我想让她知道我很想她。
text.progress: You have a letter for me?
text.completion: My, that's so thoughtful. I love hearing from my old students.
text.completed: Deliver the Letter to Sungshin Ironpaw. She teaches in Halfhill Market.

english.title: Everything I Know About Cooking
english.objectives: Deliver the Letter to Sungshin Ironpaw. She teaches in Halfhill Market.
english.description: I'm so glad you enjoy my food. Are you interested in the recipes?  If so, you should learn them properly, from my teachers in Halfhill Market.  Everything I know about the kitchen, I learned from them.$b$bSay, if you happen to pass through there, would you deliver this note to Sungshin Ironpaw for me? She was my favorite teacher, and I want her to know that I miss her.
english.progress: You have a letter for me?
english.completion: My, that's so thoughtful. I love hearing from my old students.
english.completed: Deliver the Letter to Sungshin Ironpaw. She teaches in Halfhill Market.

text.title: Ways of Cooking
text.objectives: Learn the recipes for Charbroiled Tiger Steak, Jade Forest Fried Rice, Swirling Mist Soup, Shrimp Dumplings, Wildfowl Roast and Ginseng Tea from the masters in Halfhill Market.
text.description: There are many ways of cooking, and each creates dishes with unique properties. The Pandaren Ways of Cooking are the Ways of the Grill, the Wok, the Pot, the Steamer, the Oven and the Brew. You seem to already have the basics of each way, from your experience in faraway lands. If you wish to progress further, speak with my siblings and learn the first advanced recipe each of them teaches. Find out which Way suits you the best.
text.completed: Return to the Guide to the Ways.

The Pandaren Ways of Cooking are the Ways of the Grill, the Wok, the Pot, the Steamer, the Oven and the Brew. You seem to already have the basics of each way, from your experience in faraway lands. If you wish to progress further, speak with my siblings and learn the first advanced recipe each of them teaches. Find out which Way suits you the best.
