text.title: 这么说，你想当厨师……
text.objectives: 向引路人学习蜜桃片配方，然后制作5份蜜桃片给她。
text.description: 你想当厨师吗？只要有决心，哪怕是新手，我都可以发掘出你隐藏的潜能。$b$b如果你想学，至少得向我证明你能理解基本的指令。去学习如何切桃子，然后回来给我露两手。我这儿就有新鲜的熊猫人蜜桃出售，而且只收取象征性的费用。
text.progress: Show me that you can follow instructions.
text.completion: Very well. You are capable of learning. There is much I can teach you, and I have most of the ingredients you need to learn. Train with me.
text.completed: Give the 5 Sliced Peaches to the Guide to the Ways.

english.title: So You Want to Be a Chef...
english.objectives: Learn the recipe for Sliced Peaches from the Guide to the Ways and make 5 of them for her.
english.description: You wish to be a chef? If you are dedicated, I can unlock your hidden potential, no matter how inexperienced you are.$b$bIf you wish to learn, show me you can at least follow basic instructions. Learn how to slice peaches and show me what you've learned.  I have fresh pandaren peaches which I will sell to you at a token price.
english.progress: Show me that you can follow instructions.
english.completion: Very well. You are capable of learning. There is much I can teach you, and I have most of the ingredients you need to learn. Train with me.
english.completed: Give the 5 Sliced Peaches to the Guide to the Ways.

text.title: 標示－古代熊貓人釣魚竿
溪流漂流船
text.objectives: 乘坐溪流漂流船。
text.description: 没有人真正徒步去过远古之路。一不小心就会被蜥蜴人吃掉。$b$b实话告诉你，鸡蛋壳和我正准备沿着河流逆行而上去滨岸村。想要搭船吗？
text.completion: Wheh, we made it. Welcome to Binan Village.
text.completed: Speak with Brewmaster Boof at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Spring Drifter
english.objectives: Survive a trip on the Spring Drifter.
english.description: Nobody really travels up the Ancient Passage on foot. That is just asking for a faceful of saurok if you are not careful.$b$bTell you what, Egg Shell and I were just about to set off upriver to Binan Village. Want a lift?
english.completion: Wheh, we made it. Welcome to Binan Village.
english.completed: Speak with Brewmaster Boof at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 以暴制暴
text.objectives: 找回7份黑市货物。
text.description: 哦，一位$c。你的这身手艺可是能派上大用场了。$b$b一支车队在路上被打劫的蜥蜴人拦住了。那些强盗偷走了一些……货物……那些抢走的东西是属于郭雅夫人的，她本来打算卖掉那些货物。$b$b没人可以随意碰夫人的东西。$b$b如果你能够找回那些货物，我可以付给你一笔赏金。
text.progress: Saurok are seldom this bold.
text.completion: Ah, our merchandise. Madam Goya will be pleased. You have the gratitude of her ladyship.
text.completed: Speak with Len the Whisperer at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Robbing Robbers of Robbers
english.objectives: Recover 7 Black Market Merchandise.
english.description: Ah, a $c. I could make good use of your skills.$b$bA convoy was struck just up the road by a band of marauding saurok. These marauders made off with some... merchandise... her ladyship, the Madam Goya, had a mind to sell.$b$bOne does not steal from her ladyship.$b$bIf you recover these items I will gladly provide you a finders fee.
english.progress: Saurok are seldom this bold.
english.completion: Ah, our merchandise. Madam Goya will be pleased. You have the gratitude of her ladyship.
english.completed: Speak with Len the Whisperer at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 教训蜥蜴人
text.objectives: 击败吮指头。
text.description: 受人尊敬的郭雅夫人在保护着春之路。$b$b我们要“教育”一下蜥蜴人，他们在这里东北面的恨鳞地穴。我们以前警告过他们，但他们似乎记性不太好。$b$b去东北面的洞穴找到它们的萨满首领。杀死他，郭雅夫人会感谢你的。当然，还有不菲的赏金。
text.completion: The deed is done and a debt must be paid. Here is your reward. You have our gratitude.
text.completed: Speak with Len the Whisperer at Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
text.giverWindow: 恨鳞地穴的萨满

english.title: Educating Saurok
english.objectives: Defeat Leechfingers.
english.description: The Spring Road is under the protection of her ladyship, the esteemed Madam Goya.$b$bThe saurok of Hatescale Burrow northeast of here require "education" in this fact. We have warned them before but sadly they seem to have a very short memory.$b$bTravel northeast to this burrow and find their shaman leader. Eliminate him and you will have the gratitude of her ladyship. As well as an appropriate bounty.
english.completion: The deed is done and a debt must be paid. Here is your reward. You have our gratitude.
english.completed: Speak with Len the Whisperer at Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
english.giverWindow: Shaman of the Hatescale

text.title: 研究课题：魔古王朝
text.objectives: 获得20块魔古族考古碎片。
text.description: 啊，一个探险者。正好为我所用。我马上就要发现魔古族的黑暗秘密了。$b$b注意，不是所有的秘密。他们握有很多黑暗秘密。但我至少快要发现其中“一个”秘密了。$b$b如果你在旅途中发现了某些有关魔古族历史的碎片，请将它们带给我，我会给你相应的报酬。
text.progress: It is dangerous to forget our past.
text.completion: Ah! Some fine pieces here. Very fine pieces indeed. My thanks, adventurer.
text.completed: Speak with Master Liu at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Research Project: The Mogu Dynasties
english.objectives: Obtain 20 Mogu Archaeology Fragments.
english.description: Ah, an explorer. Just what I could use. I am on the verge of discovering the dark secrets of the mogu.$b$bNot all of the secrets, mind you. They kept a lot of dark secrets. But I am on the verge of discovering "a" secret at least.$b$bIf, in your travels, you come across some fragments of the mogu past, bring them to me and I will happily reimburse you for them.
english.progress: It is dangerous to forget our past.
english.completion: Ah! Some fine pieces here. Very fine pieces indeed. My thanks, adventurer.
english.completed: Speak with Master Liu at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 研究课题：熊猫人帝国
text.objectives: 获得20块熊猫人考古碎片。
text.description: 啊，冒险者。你来的还真是时候。我和女儿在调查我们族人的历史，刚好遇到了瓶颈。$b$b如果你碰巧见到一些有关熊猫人历史的古迹残片，请将它们带给我们。我们会从这些额外信息中获益不少。
text.progress: It is dangerous to forget our past.
text.completion: Ah! Some fine pieces here. Very fine pieces indeed. My thanks, adventurer.
text.completed: Speak with Master Liu at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Research Project: The Pandaren Empire
english.objectives: Obtain 20 Pandaren Archaeology Fragments.
english.description: Ah, adventurer. You come at a most opportune time. My daughter and I are researching the history of our people and have hit a roadblock in our research.$b$bShould you come across fragments of the pandaren past, please, bring them to us here. We would benefit greatly from the additional information.
english.progress: It is dangerous to forget our past.
english.completion: Ah! Some fine pieces here. Very fine pieces indeed. My thanks, adventurer.
english.completed: Speak with Master Liu at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 揭秘过去
text.objectives: 拼合一个来自潘达利亚的神器。
text.description: 有兴趣成为一名游学者？那就要不断地探究、阅读，然后再探究、再阅读。$b$b我会花好几天的时间盯着一个破碎的花瓶看个不停，想方设法把它还原成当初的样子。$b$b你应该试试看。去拼合一个熊猫人神器，希望你能跟我们分享经验。
text.completion: Wow! You got the pieces to meld together so well. The quality of this restoration is amazing.$b$bHow did you do it?
text.completed: Speak with Ms. Thai at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: Uncovering the Past
english.objectives: Solve 1 artifact from Pandaria.
english.description: Interested in being a Lorewalker? There is lots of digging and reading and digging and more reading.$b$bI have entire days where I stare at a broken vase trying to figure out how it goes back together.$b$bShould give it a try. Go solve one artifact of Pandaria and we will appreciate you sharing the knowledge of how you did it.
english.completion: Wow! You got the pieces to meld together so well. The quality of this restoration is amazing.$b$bHow did you do it?
english.completed: Speak with Ms. Thai at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 不速之客
text.objectives: 在雾临村击败8个韶天攻击者。
text.description: 莱文派鲁克来这里阻挡魔古军队，但是鲁克一个人杀不完。$B$B你能帮忙吗？鲁克会告诉莱文你帮忙了的。我保证。
text.completion: Rook can handle rest of mogu. Thanks for help. Good man.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的雾临村找鲁克·石趾。

english.title: Mogu Make Poor House Guests
english.objectives: Kill 8 Shado-Tien attackers in Mistfall Village.
english.description: Leven sent Rook here to stop mogu, but there are more than Rook can kill alone.$B$BYou help?  Rook will tell Leven you helped.  Promise.
english.completion: Rook can handle rest of mogu. Thanks for help. Good man.
english.completed: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
text.objectives: Speak to Angi Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
text.description: I have my heartfelt thanks for your continued aid. Anji awaits at the Ruins of Guo-Lai to northwest.$B$BGo with courage in your heart, young $c.
text.completion: Che sent you my way, did he? Good to have you.$B$BThe ruins are crawling with things to be squashed.

english.title: The Ruins of Guo-Lai
english.objectives: Speak to Angi Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
english.description: I have my heartfelt thanks for your continued aid. Anji awaits at the Ruins of Guo-Lai to northwest.$B$BGo with courage in your heart, young $c.
english.completion: Che sent you my way, did he? Good to have you.$B$BThe ruins are crawling with things to be squashed.

text.title: Setting Sun Garrison
text.objectives: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Training Camp.
text.description: The mogu will not be able to maintain this attack much longer. We should be able to handle it here, thanks to your kind aid.$B$BMight you be willing to find Anji at the Setting Sun Training Camp to the west? She's been tasked with preparing fresh-faced pandaren to aid the cause. You could show them a thing or two as well, I imagine.
text.completion: You I can work with. Let's show these trainees a thing or two about how a real $C fights.

english.title: Setting Sun Garrison
english.objectives: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Training Camp.
english.description: The mogu will not be able to maintain this attack much longer. We should be able to handle it here, thanks to your kind aid.$B$BMight you be willing to find Anji at the Setting Sun Training Camp to the west? She's been tasked with preparing fresh-faced pandaren to aid the cause. You could show them a thing or two as well, I imagine.
english.completion: You I can work with. Let's show these trainees a thing or two about how a real $C fights.

text.title: 大展宏图
text.objectives: 制作5碗八宝饭，然后把它们交给引路人。
text.description: 你好像很了解厨艺之道。向我展示你的技能，为我制作5碗八宝饭。
text.progress: I believe you have the potential to be a great chef, but the proof is in the pudding, so to speak.
text.completion: You are ready. You are now a zen master cook.
text.completed: Return to the Guide to the Ways.

english.title: Ready for Greatness
english.objectives: Make 5 Rice Pudding and give them to the Guide to the Ways.
english.description: You seem to know your way around the kitchen. Demonstrate to me your skills and make me 5 bowls of rice pudding.
english.progress: I believe you have the potential to be a great chef, but the proof is in the pudding, so to speak.
english.completion: You are ready. You are now a zen master cook.
english.completed: Return to the Guide to the Ways.

text.title: 破损的封印
text.objectives: 封印12个怒煞裂隙以放逐疑之煞。
text.description: <周卓带着难以置信的表情看着你。>$b$b我……我以为煞魔只是个神话——我们都是这么想的。只是教育孩子们远离争斗的睡前故事。$b$b现在没有时间闲聊了。那些裂隙——它们在给煞魔提供能量……到那时它会变得更加强大！$b$b我必须研究一下家族档案中的卷轴。你，带着这个火炮骑上米师。$b$b你必须想方设法去控制住那被释放出来的恐怖！
text.completion: I have much research to do in very little time.$b$bThe emperor's message only warned of the unique threat war would bring to our land - this... Sha.$b$bSadly, the time to heed his message has passed. And as for how to bring an end to the crisis, the Emperor's Omen is silent.
text.completed: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at Serpent's Heart

english.title: The Seal is Broken
english.objectives: Seal 12 Sha Fissures to banish the Sha of Doubt.
english.description: <Cho looks at you in disbelief.>$b$bI... I thought Sha of this immensity were a myth - we all did. Just a story to keep our children from fighting.$b$bNo time to talk now. Those fissures - they're feeding it... it grows stronger by the moment!$b$bI must research the scrolls from my family archives. You, take this cannon and ride Mishi.$b$bYou must find a way to contain this horror that has been unleashed!
english.completion: I have much research to do in very little time.$b$bThe emperor's message only warned of the unique threat war would bring to our land - this... Sha.$b$bSadly, the time to heed his message has passed. And as for how to bring an end to the crisis, the Emperor's Omen is silent.
english.completed: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at Serpent's Heart

text.title: The Way of the Grill
text.objectives: Make a Skewered Peanut Chicken and give it to the Master of the Grill.
text.description: If you wish to cook foods that make you stronger, go seek the Master of the Grill.  Cook him a skewered peanut chicken to show him that you have the basics.
text.completed: Give the Skewered Chicken to the Master of the Grill.

english.title: The Way of the Grill
english.objectives: Make a Skewered Peanut Chicken and give it to the Master of the Grill.
english.description: If you wish to cook foods that make you stronger, go seek the Master of the Grill.  Cook him a skewered peanut chicken to show him that you have the basics.
english.completed: Give the Skewered Chicken to the Master of the Grill.

objectiveDetails.description: Give 5 Rice Puddings to the Guide to the Ways

text.title: 探索者末路
text.objectives: 征服探索者末路，找到游学者周卓，并且在沿路的三个神龛稍停片刻，对自身进行一番反省。
text.description: 我肯定你的熊猫人朋友知道魔古族到底要找什么。$B$B他前几天独自上山去了，没有带向导，并且要求你自己去山上找他。他说得很详细：$B$B“$c必须独自完成这段艰难跋涉，让$g他:她;的思想指引前行之路。在山顶跟我碰面前，$g他:她;得拜祭每一个神龛。”$B$B上山的路径就在营地的西北边，已经用旗子标出来了。切记要小心！即使有老天保佑，探索者末路也是一段危险的路程。
text.completion: Ah, you made it, and you honored the shrines.$B$BI knew you could handle it.
text.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at Seeker's Point.

english.title: Seeker's Folly
english.objectives: Brave the path of Seeker's Folly to find Lorewalker Cho, stopping to reflect at the three shrines along the way.
english.description: I'm sure your pandaren friend has some ideas about what the mogu are after.$B$BHe headed up the mountain a few days ago without a guide, and asked that only you be sent up after him. He was very specific:$B$B"The $c must endure the trek alone, with only $ghis:her; thoughts. $gHe:She; will honor each shrine before meeting me at the top."$B$BThe path is just northwest of the camp, marked by flags. Please be careful! Seeker's Folly is a dangerous trek even on a lucky day.
english.completion: Ah, you made it, and you honored the shrines.$B$BI knew you could handle it.
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at Seeker's Point.

text.title: 驯服宠物
text.objectives: 赢得一场宠物战斗。
text.description: 既然你是一名宠物训练师，那么考验你技术的时候到了！$b$b前往森林并挑选一只战斗宠物进行决斗。记得使用你的“追踪宠物”技能，这样微缩地图上才会显示哪些是战斗宠物。赢了之后回来找我，我会继续你的训练。祝你好运！
text.completion: Nice work, $n! You're better with those pets than I thought!
text.completed: Return to Marcus Jensen in Goldshire and notify him of your victory!

english.title: Learning the Ropes
english.objectives: Win a pet battle.
english.description: Now that you are a pet trainer, it's time to test your skills!$b$bHead out into the forest and pick a fight with a battle pet.  Make sure to use your Track Pets skill so you can see pets you can fight on the minimap.  Come back to me after you have won and I will continue your training. Good luck!
english.completion: Nice work, $n! You're better with those pets than I thought!
english.completed: Return to Marcus Jensen in Goldshire and notify him of your victory!

text.title: 治疗宠物
text.objectives: 拜访兽栏管理员艾玛，治疗你的宠物。
text.description: 既然你已经赢得了一场战斗，我们就需要治疗你的宠物，这样它们才能继续战斗！拜访一下我们这里的兽栏管理员艾玛，治疗和复活你的宠物。
text.completion: Now those look like some healthy pets, $n. Remember, you can heal and revive your entire collection of pets at any time by visiting a stable master.
text.completed: Return to Marcus Jensen in Goldshire.
text.giverWindow: 艾玛是本地的兽栏管理员，她可以治疗和复活你的宠物。

english.title: On The Mend
english.objectives: Heal your pets to full health by visiting Erma the Stable Master.
english.description: Now that you have won a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day!  Visit Erma, our local stable master, to heal and revive your pets.
english.completion: Now those look like some healthy pets, $n. Remember, you can heal and revive your entire collection of pets at any time by visiting a stable master.
english.completed: Return to Marcus Jensen in Goldshire.
english.giverWindow: Erma, the local Stable Master, can heal and revive your pets.

text.title: 烧烤之道
text.objectives: 带5份生虎排给烧烤大师。
text.description: 熊猫人烧烤之道制作的食品能够增强你的力量。带一些生虎排给烧烤大师，他就会教你怎样处理它们。在翡翠林和卡桑琅丛林有很多老虎，但你也能在别处找到它们。
text.progress: If you wish to learn the Way of the Grill, bring me some raw tiger steaks.
text.completion: Good cuts.
text.completed: Give 5 Raw Tiger Steaks to the Master of the Grill.

english.title: Way of the Grill
english.objectives: Bring 5 Raw Tiger Steaks to the Master of the Grill.
english.description: The Pandaren Way of the Grill produces foods that increase your physical strength. Bring some raw tiger steaks to the Master of the Grill, and he will teach you what you can do with them. There are many tigers in the Jade Forest and the Krasarang Wilds, but you can also find them in other places.
english.progress: If you wish to learn the Way of the Grill, bring me some raw tiger steaks.
english.completion: Good cuts.
english.completed: Give 5 Raw Tiger Steaks to the Master of the Grill.

text.title: 陈旧的地图
text.objectives: 去四风谷的香蒲湖或是半山市集让玉儿·采苇看一看这张地图。
text.description: 这块陈旧褪色的皮革已经四分五裂，但其上的内容仍然依稀可辨。$B$B皮革上绘制着某种地图，还有以下几行字：$B$B$B四风呼啸幽谷深，$B金扇掩面佳人存。$B先祖阶梯脚下站，$B神秘低语暗中闻。
text.completion: Whoa! I think you found it, $n! You found the map to Old Man Thistle treasure!

english.title: The Old Map
english.objectives: Show the map to Fish Fellreed at Cattail Lake or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: The old, faded leather is falling apart, but still legible.$B$BScrawled on it is some kind of map, and the following lines:$B$B$BDeep in the valley where four winds blow,$BThe maiden laughs behind her golden fan.$BAt the feet of her ancestors' stair,$BShe whispers secrets into the echoing dark.
english.completion: Whoa! I think you found it, $n! You found the map to Old Man Thistle treasure!

text.title: 民间传说
text.objectives: 和拣谷工小裴、刻石者马克、闵大妈还有白须老头谈一谈。
text.description: 什么？！我一点也看不懂！<玉儿的脸耷拉下来。>$B$B这上面胡说些什么？佳人、先祖和一串阶梯？$B$B我从中看不出任何端倪，你能吗？$B$B好吧，附近有不少比你我年长的人，$n。$B$B你能不能去和半山的居民谈一谈？我觉得他们可能会知道些什么！
text.completion: Of course! It makes perfect sense. So the location of the treasure must be where the lake meets the mountains!
text.completed: Return to Fish Fellreed at Cattail Lake or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Just A Folk Story
english.objectives: Speak to Grainsorter Pei, Stonecarver Mac, Mama Min, and Old Man Whitewhiskers.
english.description: What!?! This don't make any sense! <Fish's face falls.>$B$BWhat's this mumber jumber about a maiden and an ancestor and a buncha stairs?$B$BI can't make any reason outta this, can you?$B$BWell, there are lotsa folks 'round here who're much older than you and me, $n.$B$BCan you go talk to the folks in Halfhill? I betcha they might know somethin'!
english.completion: Of course! It makes perfect sense. So the location of the treasure must be where the lake meets the mountains!
english.completed: Return to Fish Fellreed at Cattail Lake or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 老农阿蓟的宝藏
text.objectives: 找到洞穴入口并取得老农阿蓟隐藏的宝藏。
text.description: 上帝啊！我们要开始真正的寻宝了！$B$B北边肯定有个入口，就在山脉和猫尾湖的交界处。$B$B我们在入口碰头！宝藏等着我们呢！
text.completion: The chest's lid slides off with the lightest touch. You peer inside...
text.completed: Open the Hidden Treasure inside the Cavern of Endless Echoes in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Old Man Thistle's Treasure
english.objectives: Find the cave entrance and recover Old Man Thistle's hidden treasure.
english.description: Well high golly! This is turning into a real life treasure hunt!$B$BThere's gotta be some kind of entrance or opening to the north, where the mountains meet Cattail Lake.$B$BI'll meet ya at the entrance! Let's go get that treasure!
english.completion: The chest's lid slides off with the lightest touch. You peer inside...
english.completed: Open the Hidden Treasure inside the Cavern of Endless Echoes in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 汇风岭的遗产
text.objectives: 把老农阿蓟的历书带给四风谷中半山市集的种子保管人辛辛。
text.description: 在宝箱的最底层，你发现了一堆卷轴和一个装满种子的软皮袋。$B$B展开这些卷轴，你看到其中记录着详尽的耕作笔记、植物图鉴、数字和计算结果、附近水泉的分布情况以及数不胜数的其他信息。$B$B阡陌客中的某人可能会对这些东西感兴趣。
text.progress: What do you have there?
text.completion: Ah yes, I know the story of Old Man Thistle quite well, $R.$B$BThere are all sorts of crazy tales about his quest for treasure.$B$BBut the truth of the matter is that he was a bit of a recluse, a bit eccentric, and an excellent farmer.$B$BAs he grew near the end of his life, he retreated up into the mountains and was never seen again.$B$BHe was just a man, and it seems that you have found his legacy.$B$BBut don't tell Fish the truth. Some stories are best left tall in the telling.

english.title: The Heartland Legacy
english.objectives: Take Old Man Thistle's Almanac to Seedkeeper Shing Sing at Halfhill in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: At the very bottom of the treasure chest, you find a stack of scrolls and a soft leather sack with seeds.$B$BUnrolling the scrolls, you see they contain detailed farming notes, drawings of plants, numbers and calculations, locations of nearby water springs, and countless other snippets.$B$BThere might be someone at the Tillers Union who would like to see this.
english.progress: What do you have there?
english.completion: Ah yes, I know the story of Old Man Thistle quite well, $R.$B$BThere are all sorts of crazy tales about his quest for treasure.$B$BBut the truth of the matter is that he was a bit of a recluse, a bit eccentric, and an excellent farmer.$B$BAs he grew near the end of his life, he retreated up into the mountains and was never seen again.$B$BHe was just a man, and it seems that you have found his legacy.$B$BBut don't tell Fish the truth. Some stories are best left tall in the telling.

text.title: 宠物训练师茱莉亚
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败茱莉亚·史蒂文斯。
text.description: 我能看的出来，你一直在训练宠物的战斗技能，$n。我想是时候让你去面对真正的挑战了。$b$b茱莉亚·史蒂文斯就在暴风城南面的马科伦农场。她是一名前途远大的野生宠物训练师，我想是时候让你跟她切磋切磋了！
text.completion: You're better with those pets than I thought!
text.completed: Speak to Julia Stevens.
text.giverWindow: 去挑战茱莉亚来证明一下你的实力吧！

english.title: Julia, The Pet Tamer
english.objectives: Defeat Julia Stevens in a pet battle.
english.description: I can tell you have been honing your pet battle skills, $n.  I think it's time for you to take on a real challenge.$b$bJulia Stevens can be found at the Maclure Vineyards south of Stormwind.  She is an up and coming wild pet tamer and I think it's time you faced her in battle!
english.completion: You're better with those pets than I thought!
english.completed: Speak to Julia Stevens.
english.giverWindow: Put your skills to the test against Julia!

text.title: 紧急救援
text.objectives: 在海军上将泰勒、米希卡和苏利附近使用周卓的烟火。
text.description: 你的同伴们在我们的土地上可真是一点也不客气，一到这里就大打出手。$b$b我们还尚未了解他们造成的全部破坏。目前所知的情况……已经是难以言喻。$b$b然而，出于报复而遗弃你的朋友有悖于我们的处世之道。毫无疑问，所有幸存者都已经身负重伤，并需要紧急救护。$b$b这些烟火原本准备用于庆祝雕像的完工。请在你的同伴附近使用它们以便给米师发信号，她会把他们运到安全的地点。
text.completion: My thoughts will be with your fallen companions, traveler.$b$bMay their wounds mend well.
text.completed: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at Serpent's Heart.

english.title: Emergency Response
english.objectives: Use Cho's Fireworks near Admiral Taylor, Mishka and Sully.
english.description: Your companions have made themselves at home in our land, and brought with them a dangerous conflict.$b$bThe full extent of their destruction here we cannot yet know. Already it is... unspeakable.$b$bNevertheless, to forsake your friends out of spite would be against our way. Any that yet live are doubtlessly wounded and in desperate need of care.$b$bThese fireworks were to celebrate the statue's completion. Use them near your companions to signal Mishi, and she will bear them off to safety.
english.completion: My thoughts will be with your fallen companions, traveler.$b$bMay their wounds mend well.
english.completed: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at Serpent's Heart.

text.title: 给鱼买杯酒？
text.objectives: 将1瓶四风烧酒交给醉鬼贾古。四风烧酒可以在潘达利亚大多数调酒师那里买到。
text.description: 嗨，伙计，最近如何？要不要请我这个锦鱼人喝一杯？
text.progress: Thirsty...
text.completion: Thanksh, buddy.
text.completed: Return to Jogu the Drunk at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Buy A Fish A Drink?
english.objectives: Bring 1 Four Wind Soju to Jogu the Drunk. Four Wind Soju can be purchased from most bartenders in Pandaria.
english.description: Heeeey buddy, how'sh it goin'? You wanna buy a jinyu a drink?
english.progress: Thirsty...
english.completion: Thanksh, buddy.
english.completed: Return to Jogu the Drunk at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 给鱼买壶酒？
text.objectives: 将5瓶熊猫人青梅酒给醉鬼贾古。熊猫人青梅酒可以在潘达利亚大多数调酒师那里买到。
text.description: 嗨，我的朋友，$r！$B$B我猜你已经看到了我在四处闲逛，但我要说明一下，我可没喝醉。$B$B我的意思是，看看我！像只淡水鱼一样清醒！$B$B当然，我偶尔也会借酒消愁，可你没法灌醉一个锦鱼人！你倒不如试试淹死一条鱼！$B$B不，这些酒让我昏昏欲睡，当我熟睡时，我就能预见未来。$B$B$B$B酒的烈度越高，我的梦境就越真切！如果你请我喝酒，我会感谢你的。
text.progress: What do you mean I talk like I'm drunk? Thish ish how I shpeak!
text.completion: Oooh, this is the shtuff.
text.completed: Return to Jogu the Drunk at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Buy A Fish A Round?
english.objectives: Bring 5 Pandaren Plum Wine to Jogu the Drunk. Pandaren Plum Wine can be purchased from most bartenders in Pandaria.
english.description: Heeeey it's my friend, the $r!$B$BI guesh you've seen me hanging 'round, but I should 'splain that I'm not drunk.$B$BI mean, look at me now! Shober as a freshwater fish!$B$BSure I like to drown my sorrowsh in some good brew now and then, but you can't inebriate a jinyu! Might as well try to drown a fish!$B$BNo, the brewsh make me shleepy, and when I shleep, I have vishions of the future.$B$B$B$BThe shtronger the brew, the more potent my dreamsh! If you bring me a drink, I'll owe you one.
english.progress: What do you mean I talk like I'm drunk? Thish ish how I shpeak!
english.completion: Oooh, this is the shtuff.
english.completed: Return to Jogu the Drunk at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 给鱼买桶酒？
text.objectives: 将10瓶青玉巫婆的老酒给醉鬼贾古。青玉巫婆的老酒可以通过烹饪专业技能制作。
text.description: 最近，我的梦境变得越来越模糊，$r。$B$B我需要一些更带劲的东西来恢复状态！$B$B我听说有人最近在酿制一种美酒。$B$B这种酒叫青玉巫婆的老酒。$B$B我很想尝尝。
text.progress: Any luck?
text.completion: Oooh, that'sh got quite the kick! I'm growing shleepy...
text.completed: Return to Jogu the Drunk at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Buy A Fish A Keg?
english.objectives: Bring 10 Jade Witch Brew to Jogu the Drunk. Jade Witch Brew can be made using the cooking profession.
english.description: My dreams grow dim recently, $r.$B$BI need something powerful to kick myshelf back into gear!$B$BI heard there'sh a delishush drink that folksh are making nowadays.$B$BIt'sh called Jade Witch Brew.$B$BI'd sure like to taste some.
english.progress: Any luck?
english.completion: Oooh, that'sh got quite the kick! I'm growing shleepy...
english.completed: Return to Jogu the Drunk at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 给鱼买个酒坊？
text.objectives: 将20瓶疯酒师的早餐给醉鬼贾古。疯酒师的早餐可以通过烹饪专业技能制作。
text.description: 好吧，$n，为了继续预见未来，我必须有个自己的酒坊。$B$B……$B$B开个玩笑！你应该看看自己的表情！太可笑……笑了！$B$B说正经的，我听说出现了一种另类的新酒，我想要尝尝鲜。$B$B你听说过疯酒师的早餐吗？如果你能给我带来点这种酒，我这辈子都会当你是朋友。
text.progress: Have you tried it?
text.completion: Thank you, $n! I will be shaving these for a rainy day... hic!
text.completed: Return to Jogu the Drunk at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Buy A Fish A Brewery?
english.objectives: Bring 20 Mad Brewer's Breakfast to Jogu the Drunk. Mad Brewer's Breakfasts can be made using the cooking profession.
english.description: All right, $n, in order to continue my vishions, I must now have my own brewery.$B$B...$B$BJust kidding! You should have sheen your own face! Hilarioush... hic!$B$BAnyway, I heard of a new drink that is unlike any other, and I would like a tashte.$B$BHave you heard of the Mad Brewer'sh Breakfasht? If you can bring me some of thish shtuff, you will be my friend for life.
english.progress: Have you tried it?
english.completion: Thank you, $n! I will be shaving these for a rainy day... hic!
english.completed: Return to Jogu the Drunk at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 祖传秘方
text.objectives: 收集5份风暴烈酒秘方。
text.description: 我们的秘密配方！我正在收集它们。但是……猢狲？$B$B<大婶看起来很困惑。>$B$B高怎么酿酒？他需要那些配方，要不然可就完蛋了！
text.progress: Well, hello!
text.completion: Ho ho, what's this?$B$B<Uncle Gao jiggles his fat brew belly at the sight of the family's recipes.>$B$BOoh, I knew I was adding too much corn!
text.completed: Speak with Uncle Gao in The Tasting Room of the Stormstout Brewery.

english.title: Family Secrets
english.objectives: Collect 5 Stormstout Secrets.
english.description: Our secret recipes! I was gathering them up. But then... hozen?$B$B<Auntie looks very confused.>$B$BHow is Gao to brew anything? He needs those recipes or disaster is sure to strike!
english.progress: Well, hello!
english.completion: Хо-хо, а это еще что?$B$B<Пивное брюшко дядюшки Гао колышется, когда он видит фамильные рецепты.>$B$BЯ так и знал, что добавляю слишком много кукурузы.
english.completed: Speak with Uncle Gao in The Tasting Room of the Stormstout Brewery.

text.title: 极美的项链
text.objectives: 将项链带给位于四风谷郝瀚房子里或者半山市集的迪娜·泥爪。
text.description: 这条漂亮的项链只被猢狲的脏手弄污了一部分。$B$B四风谷只有一个人可能拥有如此漂亮的珠宝。
text.completion: Oh my, this is my favorite necklace! I didn't even know it was missing! Thank you, $n.

english.title: A Very Nice Necklace
english.objectives: Bring the necklace to Tina Mudclaw at Haohan's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: The beautiful necklace is only partly smudged by dirty hozen hands.$B$BThere's only one person in the Valley who would own such a beautiful piece of jewelry.
english.completion: Oh my, this is my favorite necklace! I didn't even know it was missing! Thank you, $n.

text.title: 迪娜的雅致头饰
text.objectives: 将雅致的头饰带给位于四风谷郝瀚房子里或者半山市集的迪娜·泥爪。
text.description: 这是一枚耀眼的钻石头饰。四风谷中谁富裕得能够拥有这样一件首饰呢？$B$B不管主人是谁，他们应该都愿意给个丰厚的奖赏。
text.completion: Oh, my tiara! It was missing, but wherever did you find it?

english.title: Tina's Tasteful Tiara
english.objectives: Bring the Tasteful Tiara to Tina Mudclaw at Haohan's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: It's a dazzling diamond tiara. Who in the valley would be wealthy enough to own such a piece of jewelry?$B$BWhoever it is, they might be willing to give a nice reward.
english.completion: Oh, my tiara! It was missing, but wherever did you find it?

text.title: 制造难题
text.objectives: 杀死破桶而出的炎诛。
text.description: 既然酿酒厂已经被猢狲和……谁知道还有什么鬼东西……占据了，那些酿酒师肯定也遇到麻烦了。$B$B你能帮我个忙去看看到底发生了什么吗，我的朋友？
text.completion: A giant creature made of brew?! Who could have imagined such a thing?$B$BYou have my thanks for saving Gao from his own misguided brewing experiments.
text.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout in The Tasting Room of the Stormstout Brewery.
text.giverWindow: 杀了他，以救出高老伯。

english.title: Trouble Brewing
english.objectives: Kill Yan-Zhu the Uncasked.
english.description: With the brewery infested by hozen and... and who knows what else, I'm sure that the brewers are in trouble.$B$BWould you mind helping me find out what's going on, my friend?
english.completion: Огромное существо из хмеля?! Как такое может прийти в голову?$B$BСпасибо, что спас Гао от его собственных экспериментов с хмелем.
english.completed: Speak with Chen Stormstout in The Tasting Room of the Stormstout Brewery.
english.giverWindow: Slay him to rescue Uncle Gao.

text.title: 一只精致的耳环
text.objectives: 将精致耳环带给位于四风谷郝瀚房子里或者带给半山市集的迪娜·泥爪。
text.description: 你将耳环从那毛茸茸家伙的耳朵上摘下来。看来他戴着那个晃悠悠的耳环还挺开心。开心过头了。$B$B也许这个雅致小玩意儿的主人希望找回它。你没必要告诉她你是在哪里找到的……或者有谁戴过它。
text.completion: Oh my earring! Why, it matches the one I'm wearing today!$B$B<Tina hooks the earring onto her ear.>$B$BThank you, $n!

english.title: An Exquisite Earring
english.objectives: Bring the Exquisite Earring to Tina Mudclaw at Haohan's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: You unhook the earring off the furry creature's ear. It looks like he was having some fun wearing the dangly hoop. TOO much fun.$B$BPerhaps the owner of this dainty bauble would like to see it returned. You don't have to tell her where you found it... or who was wearing it.
english.completion: Oh my earring! Why, it matches the one I'm wearing today!$B$B<Tina hooks the earring onto her ear.>$B$BThank you, $n!

text.title: 一枚美丽的胸针
text.objectives: 将美丽的胸针带给位于四风谷郝瀚房子里或者带给半山市集的迪娜·泥爪。
text.description: 这是一枚非常老旧、古韵十足的胸针，样式考究，并用金银丝镶边。看起来价值不菲。$B$B只有一个人总是被毛茸茸的小流氓偷去珠宝，她也许希望能将这件传家宝物归原主。
text.completion: My grandmother's brooch! Oh, thank you for finding this! It's a family treasure.

english.title: A Beautiful Brooch
english.objectives: Bring the Beautiful Brooch to Tina Mudclaw at Haohan's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: It is a very old, antique brooch with very detailed molding and filigree worked into the edges. It looks very valuable.$B$BThere's only one person who keeps losing jewelry to furry hooligans, and she would probably want to see this heirloom returned.
english.completion: My grandmother's brooch! Oh, thank you for finding this! It's a family treasure.

text.title: 弄清楚如何制作任务

text.description: 好耶！你要学会如何制作一个索引任务！现在想想下面该做什么。

english.objectives: Make a breadcrumb quest.
english.description: Whee!  You get to make a breadcrumb quest!  Now figure out what to do next.

text.progress: I hope I don't burn myself. Eep.

text.objectives: 为诺米的烹饪课准备5把金针菇。

text.progress: Ick.

text.progress: I can't wait to see how they turn out!
text.completion: Here it is! How did I do?
text.completed: Give 5 Rice to Nomi.

english.title: Lesson 5: Pounded Rice Cake
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Rice for Nomi's Lesson.
english.description: I love rice cakes.  I'll do my best to make good ones!
english.progress: I can't wait to see how they turn out!
english.completion: Here it is! How did I do?
english.completed: Give 5 Rice to Nomi.

text.title: 一点心意
text.objectives: 接受诺米的礼物。
text.description: 多谢你来看我，我很好！今天，我还给铁掌家打下手了，他们说我可以把这个送给你。
text.completion: You're my favorite teacher ever.

english.title: A Token of Appreciation
english.objectives: Receive Nomi's gift.
english.description: Thanks for checking to make sure I'm doing well!  I've been able to help out the Ironpaws today, and they said I could give this to you.
english.completion: You're my favorite teacher ever.

text.title: 失踪的咩咩羊
text.objectives: 找到咩咩羊并将它带回吱吱身边。
text.description: 吱吱心爱的绵羊——咩咩羊不见了！$B$B那只坏羊总是走丢。$B$B笨羊！我找遍了所有地方都没能找到它。$B$B你能帮帮我吗，$r？
text.progress: Did you find my Sheepie? Oh, I was so worried.
text.completion: Oh, you found him! Thank you!
text.completed: Return to Chee Chee at Chee Chee's House or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Lost Sheepie
english.objectives: Find Sheepie and return him to Chee Chee.
english.description: Chee Chee's prize sheep, Sheepie, is missing!$B$BThat bad sheep is always wandering off the farm.$B$BStupid sheep! I looked everywhere and couldn't find him.$B$BCan you help me, $r?
english.progress: Did you find my Sheepie? Oh, I was so worried.
english.completion: Oh, you found him! Thank you!
english.completed: Return to Chee Chee at Chee Chee's House or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 再次失踪的咩咩羊
text.objectives: 找到咩咩羊并将它带回吱吱身边。
text.description: 那只笨羊！它又走丢了！$B$B你能再次帮我把它找回来吗？
text.progress: Oh, poor Sheepie. He's probably so scared and alone...
text.completion: Sheepie, you make me so worried! Bad sheep! Chee Chee was so worried about you!
text.completed: Return to Chee Chee at Chee Chee's House or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Lost Sheepie... Again
english.objectives: Find Sheepie and bring him back to Chee Chee.
english.description: That stupid sheep! He wandered off again!$B$BCan you find him for me again?
english.progress: Oh, poor Sheepie. He's probably so scared and alone...
english.completion: Sheepie, you make me so worried! Bad sheep! Chee Chee was so worried about you!
english.completed: Return to Chee Chee at Chee Chee's House or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 哦，咩咩羊……
text.objectives: 找到咩咩羊。
text.description: 唉……你猜对了……咩咩羊又走丢了。$B$B笨羊！总是给我添麻烦！$B$B我都不好意思再开口求你了，但我保证这是最后一次。$B$B你能帮我把它找回来吗？
text.completion: What? Sheepie is... gone?$B$B<Chee Chee's lip begins to quiver.>
text.completed: Return to Chee Chee at Chee Chee's House or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Oh Sheepie...
english.objectives: Find Sheepie.
english.description: Sigh... you guessed it... Sheepie is gone... AGAIN.$B$BStupid sheep! Gives me so much trouble!$B$BI hate to ask you again, but I promise this will be the last time.$B$BCan you find him for me?
english.completion: What? Sheepie is... gone?$B$B<Chee Chee's lip begins to quiver.>
english.completed: Return to Chee Chee at Chee Chee's House or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 披着羊皮的狼
text.objectives: 在摩天山脊或昆森村的任意位置使用旧羊皮，然后击败库科。
text.description: 啊啊啊！！！我忍无可忍啦！$B$B山上那些蠢猢狲杀了我的咩咩羊！$B$B我知道是谁干的，现在到轮到我们报仇了。$B$B如果你愿意帮我，就拿上这张旧羊皮。$B$B在北边的山上用它来伪装你自己，等那小恶棍库科一从藏身处出来就敲碎他的骨头！
text.completion: Thank you, $n. It will not bring my Sheepie back, but at least this way, no more sheep will be lost.
text.completed: Return to Chee Chee at Chee Chee's House or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: A Wolf In Sheep's Clothing
english.objectives: Use the old sheepskin anywhere in the Skyrange or Kunzen Village, then kill Krungko.
english.description: AAAIIIIEEUUGGHHHH!!!! This is the last straw!$B$BThose stupid hozen on the mountain killed my SHEEPIE!$B$BI know exactly who did this, and it is time for REVENGE.$B$BIf you are willing to help me, take this old sheepskin.$B$BUse it to disguise yourself anywhere on the mountain to the north, wait for that little dooker Krungko to come out of hiding, and then break his bones!
english.completion: Thank you, $n. It will not bring my Sheepie back, but at least this way, no more sheep will be lost.
english.completed: Return to Chee Chee at Chee Chee's House or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 尊严来自实力
text.objectives: 杀死狂之煞。
text.description: 你已经在战斗中证明了自己。$B$B但是，如果你愿意继续帮助我们，我不得不再让你做一些事情。$B$B狂之煞在封印之厅等待着挑战。如果想要得到我的尊重，就去消灭它吧。
text.completion: You have defeated the Sha of Violence and saved the monastery. You have my respect.$B$BPerhaps we were wrong about your people, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Master Snowdrift at the Grove of Falling Blossoms in the Shado-Pan Monastery.
text.giverWindow: 雪流大师让你杀死这个邪恶的怪物。

english.title: The Path to Respect Lies in Violence
english.objectives: Kill the Sha of Violence.
english.description: You have proven yourself in battle.$B$BStill, if you would aid us further, I must ask something else of you.$B$BThe Sha of Violence awaits beyond within the Sealed Chambers. Destroy it if you would earn my respect.
english.completion: Ты $gпобедил:победила; Ша Жестокости и $gспас:спасла; монастырь. Прими же мою благодарность.$B$BБыть может, мы неправильно судили о твоем народе, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Master Snowdrift at the Grove of Falling Blossoms in the Shado-Pan Monastery.
english.giverWindow: Master Snowdrift has asked you to slay this vile creature.

text.title: 跟踪事件：兴奋的农夫老方
跟踪事件：兴奋的玉儿·采苇
跟踪事件：兴奋的吉娜·泥爪
跟踪事件：兴奋的郝瀚·泥爪
跟踪事件：兴奋的醉鬼贾古

english.title: Tracking Event: Jogu the Drunk Exalted

text.title: 跟踪事件：兴奋的老农山掌
跟踪事件：兴奋的迪娜·泥爪
玛祖的奖赏
text.objectives: 去闷水壶的冒险码头和钓鱼大师句连谈一谈。
text.description: 你和船长所做的一些事情让人惊叹不已，$p！能够得到你的加盟，真是万分荣幸。$B$B哦！句连活下来了！就在你用鱼叉捕鱼的时候，他游到了岸边。他正在兴高采烈地向人介绍某种巨型的蛋或随着狡一起被冲到岸边的东西。$B$B你愿意去他那里看一下吗？他现在可能已经把那个东西弄出水面了。
text.completion: Hey there!$B$BOh, I'm fine. I've had worse spills than that after a night at the Chum Bucket.$B$BBut would you look at this thing? I spotted it peeking out of the sea floor when I went under - Jiao must have dredged it up while he was thrashing around.$B$BNot really sure what to do with it, but it looks valuable. Seeing as how you pretty much saved all our hides, I think we owe you this catch.
text.completed: 去闷水壶的冒险码头和钓鱼大师句连谈一谈。

english.title: Mazu's Bounty
english.objectives: Speak with Master Angler Ju Lien in Soggy's Gamble.
english.description: That was some amazing work you and the captain did out there, $p! It's an honor to have you on the crew.$B$BOh! And Ju Lien survived! He swam ashore just after you started letting the harpoons fly. He was raving about some kind of gigantic egg or something that washed in with Jiao.$B$BGo check up on him, will you? He's probably hauled it out of the water by now.
english.completion: Hey there!$B$BOh, I'm fine. I've had worse spills than that after a night at the Chum Bucket.$B$BBut would you look at this thing? I spotted it peeking out of the sea floor when I went under - Jiao must have dredged it up while he was thrashing around.$B$BNot really sure what to do with it, but it looks valuable. Seeing as how you pretty much saved all our hides, I think we owe you this catch.
english.completed: Speak with Master Angler Ju Lien in Soggy's Gamble.

text.title: 回复玉之纯净
text.objectives: 帮助贤者马里、刘·焰心和游学者石步解决煞魔的问题。
text.description: $C，你能帮助我们吗？$B$B寺庙的清净已经遭到了破坏。现在，三位大师正在苦苦摆脱他们的疑惑。$B$B求你帮帮我们吧，前去帮助贤者马里、刘·焰心和游学者石步战胜煞魔。
text.completion: While I am sad to hear the fates of Wise Mari and Priestess Flameheart, you have my heartfelt thanks.
text.completed: Speak with Priestess Summerpetal in the Temple of the Jade Serpent.

english.title: Restoring Jade's Purity
english.objectives: Assist Wise Mari, Liu Flameheart, and Lorewalker Stonestep with their sha problems.
english.description: $C, will you aid us?$B$BThe temple's purity has been jeopardized. Even now the three masters struggle against their doubts.$B$BPlease, I beg you, head in and help Wise Mari, Liu Flameheart, and Lorewalker Stonestep in their fight against the sha.
english.completion: То, что случилось с Мудрым Марисом и жрицей Пламенное Сердце, очень печально. Но все равно – благодарю тебя от всей души.
english.completed: Speak with Priestess Summerpetal in the Temple of the Jade Serpent.

text.title: 深虑与睿智
text.objectives: 杀死疑之煞。
text.description: 在熊猫人中流传着这样一句古老的格言：“睿智出于深虑。”$B$B疑之煞已经感染了寺庙的青龙之心。必须将它消灭。$B$B我敢说，你将变得更加智慧过人，$c。
text.completion: I never doubted you. Funny though, you don't look any wiser.$B$B<The master winks.>
text.completed: Speak with Master Windstrong in the Temple of the Jade Serpent.
text.giverWindow: 清除寺庙的疑虑。

english.title: Deep Doubts, Deep Wisdom
english.objectives: Kill the Sha of Doubt.
english.description: There is an ancient pandaren saying that states, "With deep doubts comes deep wisdom."$B$BThe Sha of Doubt has infested the Heart of Jade within the temple. It must be destroyed.$B$BI dare say that you are about to become all the wiser, $c.
english.completion: Я никогда в тебе не сомневался. Но почему-то мудрости в тебе не прибавилось.$B$B<мастер подмигивает>
english.completed: Speak with Master Windstrong in the Temple of the Jade Serpent.
english.giverWindow: Rid the temple of doubt.

text.title: 四王的遗物
text.objectives: 收集巫王提安的提灯、疯王蒙恩的天平、战王齐昂的《战争之道》和匪王速不台的迅捷之弓。
text.description: 魔古族已经再次崛起，并且威胁到了整个潘达利亚的和平。他们即将变得更加危险。$B$B历史上曾经出现过四位传奇的魔古王者：永影之提安、暴虐之蒙恩、无情之齐昂和迅弓之速不台。他们的四件神器被秘密埋藏在地下的古王陵墓里。$B$B你必须在魔古族发现这些遗物之前取回它们，否则一切就太迟了。
text.progress: We must retrieve the lantern, balance, scroll, and bow before Xin and his clans uncover them.
text.completion: I will find a better hiding place for the four relics.$B$BPandaria is indebted to you, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Sinan the Dreamer in Mogu'shan Palace.

english.title: Relics of the Four Kings
english.objectives: Collect the Lantern of the Sorcerer King, Mad King Meng's Balance, Qiang's "The Science of War", and Subetai's Bow of the Swift.
english.description: The mogu have reawakened and are a threat to all of Pandaria. They are on the cusp of becoming even more dangerous.$B$BThere are four great mogu kings of legend: Zian of the Endless Shadow, Meng the Demented, Qiang the Merciless, and Subetai the Swift. Four artifacts of these kings are secreted away in the Vault of Kings Past, below.$B$BYou must retrieve these relics before the mogu discover them and become unstoppable.
english.progress: We must retrieve the lantern, balance, scroll, and bow before Xin and his clans uncover them.
english.completion: Я найду, где спрятать эти реликвии.$B$BПандария перед тобой в неоплатном долгу, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Sinan the Dreamer in Mogu'shan Palace.

text.title: 恐虫密语者
text.objectives: 杀死神谕者希斯尔和10名泥鳞部落成员。
text.description: 要和科沃克真正建立起联系，需要在身体上和精神上挑战他。你必须尊重他的力量和智慧；只有这样才能对他进行训练。$b$b你可以用泥鳞部族来充分测试他的能力，有你在那里，他不会身临险境的。$b$b此外，这也可以帮助我们削弱蜥蜴人部族在盐碱泥滩的力量。
text.completion: I am most impressed with your progress, Wakener. Kovok's training is coming along nicely and he seems to be fond of you.$B$BI have no doubt that you are the best choice to assist me in training him.
text.completed: Speak with Kaz'tik the Manipulator in Klaxxi'vess.
text.giverWindow: 泥鳞部族的高阶神谕者。

english.title: The Kunchong Whisperer
english.objectives: Kill Oracle Hiss'ir and 10 Muckscale tribe members.
english.description: To really connect with Kovok you need to challenge him mentally and physically. You must respect his strength and intelligence; only then will he allow you to really train him.$b$bThe muckscale tribe may provide an adequate test of his abilities and with you there he shouldn't be in danger.$b$bAdditionally, this will allow us to decrease their numbers in the Briny Muck.
english.completion: I am most impressed with your progress, Wakener. Kovok's training is coming along nicely and he seems to be fond of you.$B$BI have no doubt that you are the best choice to assist me in training him.
english.completed: Speak with Kaz'tik the Manipulator in Klaxxi'vess.
english.giverWindow: High oracle to the Muckscale tribe.

text.title: 给大师上一课
text.objectives: 杀死武器大师席恩。
text.description: 魔古族有了一个新国王：武器大师席恩。$B$B他以一人之力征服了许多魔古族部落，现在他们和他们的新首领都甘愿为他效力。$B$B我从未见过或听说过有人能在战斗中与他匹敌。不要小看席恩，$n。$B$B我们的命运就掌握在你的手中。
text.completion: Truly a fight for the ages.$B$BI'm glad that you're on our side, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Sinan the Dreamer in Mogu'shan Palace.
text.giverWindow: 杀死魔古族的新国王。

english.title: A New Lesson for the Master
english.objectives: Kill Xin the Weaponmaster.
english.description: A new king of the mogu has arisen: Xin the Weaponmaster.$B$BHe single-handedly subjugated the mogu clans, and now they and their new leaders vie for his favor.$B$BI've never seen or read of any who are his equal in battle. Do not underestimate Xin, $n.$B$BOur fate rests in your hands.
english.completion: Это была поистине великая битва.$B$BХорошо, что ты на нашей стороне, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Sinan the Dreamer in Mogu'shan Palace.
english.giverWindow: Slay the new king of the mogu.

text.title: 最后一块拼图
text.objectives: 在青龙瞭望台上的周家神龛使用周氏传家宝。$b$b和米师谈一谈，她会负责把你送到那里去。
text.description: 我必须承认，$n，虽然锦鱼人与猢狲不时会有些小冲突，但我还从未见过他们如此好战。$b$b这让我倍感困扰。但是，这件事我们必须以后再谈。我此行是来请求你的帮助。$b$b我们上次谈到的壁画，已经快要重见天日了。我很确定其中包含着某种古老的智慧，就是皇帝希望我们找回的知识。$b$b我独自一人进行冥想可能不足以领悟其中的含义。请将这个传家宝带到我祖先的神龛。我将请求他们的帮助。
text.completion: <Lorewalker Cho shudders, in spite of himself.>$b$bThe legends... they're true!
text.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at The Overlook.

english.title: Last Piece of the Puzzle
english.objectives: Use Cho's Heirloom at Cho's Family Shrine on Serpent's Overlook.$b$bSpeak with Mishi for transportation.
english.description: I must say, $n, despite their skirmishes with the hozen, I've never seen the jinyu so militant.$b$bThis troubles me. We must discuss it another time, however. I have come to ask for your assistance.$b$bThe fresco, where last we spoke, is nearly unveiled. I am certain that it holds ancient wisdom - knowledge that the emperor would have us remember.$b$bMy meditations alone may not be enough to discern its meaning. Please, take this heirloom to the shrine of my ancestors. I shall require their assistance.
english.completion: <Lorewalker Cho shudders, in spite of himself.>$b$bThe legends... they're true!
english.completed: Speak with Lorewalker Cho at The Overlook.

objectiveDetails.description: 将传家宝放入周家神龛

text.title: 照亮前路
text.objectives: 点燃长城烽火。
text.description: 我们需要增援！必须得有人冲破阻碍点燃长城烽火。$B$B现在就看你的了，$c。不要有压力或其他想法。
text.completion: Outstanding, $n. Your timing couldn't have been better!
text.completed: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Gate of the Setting Sun.

english.title: Lighting the Way
english.objectives: Light the Signal Flame.
english.description: We need reinforcements! Someone has to fight through and light the signal flame.$B$BIt's all up to you, $c. No pressure or anything.
english.completion: Потрясающе, $n. Очень вовремя!
english.completed: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Gate of the Setting Sun.

text.title: 巨虫来袭！
text.objectives: 杀死莱公。
text.description: 螳螂妖有一个被称为莱公的东西。它们就是用这巨虫来攻破城墙的大门！$B$B不要让那东西进入谷内！
text.completion: If I didn't see it with my own eyes, I wouldn't have believed it.$B$BGreat job, $n!
text.completed: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Gate of the Setting Sun.
text.giverWindow: 不要让它冲进来！

english.title: That's a Big Bug!
english.objectives: Kill Raigonn.
english.description: The mantid have something they call Raigonn. It's a giant bug they're using to bust down the wall's gates!$B$BLet's keep that thing from getting into the vale!
english.completion: I can't believe it! Thank you, $n!
english.completed: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Gate of the Setting Sun.
english.giverWindow: Keep it from busting through!

text.title: 营救俘虏
text.objectives: 营救12名影踪派囚徒。
text.description: 我派了最优秀的部下渗入螳螂妖的包围圈。$B$B结果一个都没回来。$B$B既然你准备与螳螂妖面对面交手，你刚好有机会解救那些不幸被抓住的人。$B$B你愿意救出他们吗？
text.completion: Thirteen thanks I give to you; twelve for those you rescued and my own as well.$B$BHere's something else I give to you in gratitude.
text.completed: Speak with Shado-Master Chum Kiu at the Siege of Niuzao Temple.

english.title: Somewhere Inside
english.objectives: Rescue 12 Shado-Pan Prisoners.
english.description: I sent a dozen of my best men ahead to infiltrate the mantid siege.$B$BNone have returned.$B$BSince you are taking the fight directly to the mantid, you will be in a position to free any who had the misfortune to be captured.$B$BYou will do this?
english.completion: Thirteen thanks I give to you; twelve for those you rescued and my own as well.$B$BHere's something else I give to you in gratitude.
english.completed: Speak with Shado-Master Chum Kiu at the Siege of Niuzao Temple.

text.title: 消灭翼虫首领
text.objectives: 杀死翼虫首领尼诺洛克。
text.description: 螳螂妖一直在攻击砮皂寺。$B$B即使是现在，翼虫首领尼诺洛克和他的军队仍然在努力跨过最后一道峡谷。$B$B你必须在他们重新搭建桥梁之前阻止他。
text.completion: The wing leader lies dead and the siege is broken.$B$BYou've saved the temple, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Shado-Master Chum Kiu at the Siege of Niuzao Temple.
text.giverWindow: 去桥的另一侧杀掉翼虫首领。

english.title: Take Down the Wing Leader
english.objectives: Kill Wing Leader Ner'onok.
english.description: The mantid have lain siege to Niuzao Temple.$B$BEven now, Wing Leader Ner'onok and his forces work to cross the final chasm.$B$BYou must stop him before they reconstruct that bridge.
english.completion: The wing leader lies dead and the siege is broken.$B$BYou've saved the temple, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Shado-Master Chum Kiu at the Siege of Niuzao Temple.
english.giverWindow: Take him down over the bridge.

text.title: 游学者
text.objectives: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。
text.description: 这么说你想了解更多有关于这片土地的知识？$B$B很好！你应该去和闻道之座的游学者周卓谈一谈。$B$B你可以在魔古山宫殿入口上方的房间里找到他。和米师谈一谈，让他载你一程。
text.completion: Ah yes, I can see by your face that you are an eager seeker of stories. You have come to the right place.

english.title: The Lorewalkers
english.objectives: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: So you are interested in learning more of the lore of this land?$B$BVery well! You should speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.$B$BHe can be found in the room above the entrance to the Mogu'shan Palace. Speak with Mishi for a ride.
english.completion: Ah yes, I can see by your face that you are an eager seeker of stories. You have come to the right place.

text.title: 游学者
text.objectives: 去锦绣谷的闻道之座和游学者周卓谈一谈。
text.description: 这么说你想了解更多有关于这片土地的知识？$B$B很好！你应该去和闻道之座的游学者周卓谈一谈。$B$B你可以在魔古山宫殿入口上方的房间里找到他。和米师谈一谈，让他载你一程。
text.completion: Ah yes, I can see by your face that you are an eager seeker of stories. You have come to the right place.

english.title: The Lorewalkers
english.objectives: Speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
english.description: So you are interested in learning more of the lore of this land?$B$BVery well! You should speak to Lorewalker Cho at the Seat of Knowledge.$B$BHe can be found in the room above the entrance to the Mogu'shan Palace. Speak with Mishi for a ride.
english.completion: Ah yes, I can see by your face that you are an eager seeker of stories. You have come to the right place.

text.title: 垂钓翁
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的渔人码头和渔夫海涛谈一谈。
text.description: 如果你想要探索深海的所有秘密并捕几条大鱼，请到卡桑琅丛林的渔人码头去和海涛谈一谈。$B$B我敢肯定，他很乐意教你几手钓鱼技巧！
text.completion: You ready to catch some FISH?

english.title: The Anglers
english.objectives: Speak to Fisherman Haito at the Anglers Wharf in the Krasarang Wilds.

text.description: 远在西边的砮皂寺遭到了螳螂妖的袭击。$B$B天神目前还能抵挡住他们，但仅凭一己之力，他无法支撑太久。$B$B快去支援那些防御者，$c。寺庙不能失守！

text.objectives: 去锦绣谷的残阳关卫戍营和安济·秋光谈一谈。
text.description: 数个世纪以来，金莲教一直守护着这片山谷，保护它免遭任何伤害。$B$B近来发生的事件使我们神圣的山谷被可怕的阴影笼罩，但金莲教的盟友们仍在顽强对抗，以期让和平重现。$B$B如果你想要帮忙，最好到残阳关卫戍营加入他们。
text.completion: Well met, $R. You look capable. Glad to know we have a decent $C on our side.

text.description: 我们影踪派于数个世代以来首次集结了麾下的部队。$B$B恨之煞已经逃出蟠龙脊，我们肩负着再次将它囚禁的神圣使命。$B$B我们的军中都是精兵强将，但人数太少了。我们不会拒绝来自一名强大$c的帮助。$B$B如果你希望加入这场进攻，去螳螂高原和祝踏岚谈一谈。

english.title: The Shado-Pan Offensive
english.objectives: Speak to Taran Zhu at Longying Outpost in the Townlong Steppes.
english.description: We Shado-Pan have amassed our forces for the first time in many ages.$B$BThe Sha of Hatred has escaped beyond the Serpent's Spine, and it is our sacred duty to imprison it once more.$B$BHowever, our warriors are great, but our numbers too few. Help from a capable $c may not be turned away.$B$BIf you wish to join the offensive, speak to Taran Zhu in the Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 初识影踪派
text.objectives: 在金莲教阵营达到崇敬声望。
text.description: 影踪派是潘达利亚最古老的守护者之一。$B$B我们年复一年地在位于昆莱之巅的那座白雪皑皑的禅院中训练，完善着我们祖先传下来的武术秘诀。$B$B我们的人数看来或许不多，但一名影踪派门人就能抵得上一百名训练有素的士兵。$B$B要想加入影踪派，就必须经历一段充满艰辛的旅程。如果你也想走上这条道路，那就必须先证明你的价值。$B$B眼下我们就有一个紧急任务。我要你去帮助金莲教守卫锦绣谷。
text.completion: Ah yes. $n. Your name has traveled to us from the east.$B$BWe have seen your efforts in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Already you have earned the esteem of the Golden Lotus.$B$BYes, we are interested to learn more about you.

If this is the path you seek, then you must first prove your worth.$B$BThere is urgent work to be done here. Help the Golden Lotus defend the Vale.

text.title: 白虎寺
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的白虎寺和安度因·乌瑞恩谈一谈。
text.description: 你听到消息了吗，旅行者？有人对我们最为神圣的锦绣谷发起了攻击！$b$b即使是现在，一位人类王子仍在白虎寺中争论着你们和其他来自迷雾另一端的种族是否应该获准进入。$b$b那个寺庙就在昆莱的东北方。也许你能说服白虎放你进去？$b$b我只希望山谷还没有被彻底摧毁……
text.completion: $C, I'm glad you're here! The Pandaren tell of a legendary place, the "Vale of Eternal Blossoms." It's a place of great healing, if the locals are to be believed.$B$BBetween the destruction of the Cataclysm and the horrors of this light-forsaken war, the Vale may be our best hope for healing the wounds of the world.$B$BWe need to get in there!

english.title: Temple of the White Tiger
english.objectives: Speak to Anduin Wrynn at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description: Have you heard the news, traveller? There's been an attack at one of our most sacred places, the Vale of Eternal Blossoms!$b$bEven now, there's a human prince within the White Tiger Temple arguing that you and the other races from beyond the mists should be allowed within.$b$bThe temple is in the northeast of Kun-Lai. Maybe you can convince the White Tiger to allow you inside?$b$bI only hope the Vale has not been utterly destroyed...
english.completion:
$c, it's good to have you here! The Pandarens speak of a legendary place, the Eternal Blossom. According to the locals, it has great healing power.

But the Chief of the Horde has done something terrible to the bone.

We need to get there now!

text.title: 白虎寺
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的白虎寺找德兹科谈一谈。
text.description: 你听到消息了吗，旅行者？有人对我们最为神圣的锦绣谷发起了攻击！$b$b即使是现在，一位人类王子仍在白虎寺中争论着你们和其他来自迷雾另一端的种族是否应该获准进入。$b$b那个寺庙就在昆莱的东北方。也许你能说服白虎放你进去？$b$b我只希望山谷还没有被彻底摧毁……
text.completion: Hello, $C! The human prince from Stormwind has been granted an audience with the White Tiger. He seeks to gain admittance into the Vale of Eternal Blossoms... for both the Alliance and the Horde.$B$BThe Vale is a sacred place. I believe my wife Leza saw it in a vision - it's what brought my people to Pandaria. Perhaps we will find shelter there.$B$BDo you think we will be allowed inside?

english.title: Temple of the White Tiger
english.objectives: Speak to Dezco at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description: Have you heard the news, traveller? There's been an attack at one of our most sacred places, the Vale of Eternal Blossoms!$b$bEven now, there's a human prince within the White Tiger Temple arguing that you and the other races from beyond the mists should be allowed within.$b$bThe temple is in the northeast of Kun-Lai. Maybe you can convince the White Tiger to allow you inside?$b$bI only hope the Vale has not been utterly destroyed...
english.completion:
Приветствую, $c! Мы добились аудиенции у Белого Тигра. Недавно наш вождь вторгся в Вечноцветущий дол, и мы просим, чтобы для оказания помощи в восстановлении туда впустили и Альянс и Орду.

Это священное место. Скорее всего, именно оно привиделось моей жене Лезе, и поэтому мой народ оказался в Пандарии. Мы обязаны спасти Вечноцветущий дол!

Как думаешь, нас пропустят?

text.title: 神圣体验
text.objectives: 和雪怒谈一谈，完成他的试炼。
text.description: 没有至尊天神的准许，任何人都不能进入锦绣谷。白虎雪怒似乎还愿意听我的陈情。$b$b可影踪派的祝踏岚在这一切发生后，就不愿意让联盟或部落接近锦绣谷了。$b$b<安度因摇了摇头。>$b$b或许你可以帮我达成目标。代表我们和白虎谈一谈。小心！他可能会为你设下重重挑战……
text.completion: You did it, $n!$B$BThe White Tiger has agreed to allow us to accompany the Pandaren into the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. We can set up an Alliance outpost in there to act as our embassy with the Pandaren.
text.completed: Speak to Anduin Wrynn in the Temple of the White Tiger.

english.title: A Celestial Experience
english.objectives: Speak to Xuen and complete his tests.
english.description: Nobody is allowed into the Vale without the approval of the August Celestials. Xuen, The White Tiger, appears ready to listen to me.$b$bBut Taran Zhu of the Shado-Pan is reluctant to let the Alliance or Horde anywhere NEAR the Vale after all that's happened.$b$b<Anduin shakes his head.>$b$bMaybe you can help me make my case. Speak to the White Tiger on our behalf. Be careful! He may set a number of challenges before you...
english.completion:
Молодец, $n!

Белый Тигр разрешил нам сопроводить пандаренов в Вечноцветущий дол. Там уже появился аванпост Альянса. Можно начинать работу над восстановлением!
english.completed: Speak to Anduin Wrynn in the Temple of the White Tiger.

text.title: 神圣体验
text.objectives: 和雪怒谈一谈，完成他的试炼。
text.description: 那个人类小鬼在替我们据理力争。他口才很好，我现在总算明白为什么贝恩·血蹄对这位王子的评价那么高。$b$b但是，争辩进行得很不顺利。我说话没什么分量，但你是部落的英雄。或许你可以为我们说点好话？$b$b快去找白虎为我们求求情吧，$r。$b$b多加小心！他可能会为你设下重重挑战……
text.completion: You did it, $n!$B$BThe White Tiger has agreed to allow us to accompany the Pandaren into the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.$B$BWhere the Alliance Prince failed, a hero of the Horde prevailed.
text.completed: Speak to Sunwalker Dezco in the Temple of the White Tiger.

english.title: A Celestial Experience
english.objectives: Speak to Xuen and pass his tests.
english.description: The human calf is arguing on our behalf. He is well-spoken; I can see why Baine Bloodhoof regards the prince so highly.$b$bStill, the argument does not go well. I am of little consequence, but you are a hero of the Horde. Perhaps you can intercede in our favor?$b$bSpeak with the White Tiger and plead our case, $r.$b$bBe careful! He may set a number of challenges before you...
english.completion:
Молодец, $n!

Белый Тигр разрешил нам сопроводить пандаренов в Вечноцветущий дол.

Там, где потерпел неудачу принц Альянса, удача улыбнулась посланнику Орды.

Там уже появился аванпост Орды. Можно начинать работу над восстановлением.
english.completed: Speak to Sunwalker Dezco in the Temple of the White Tiger.

text.title: 四分五裂
text.objectives: 把发光的琥珀交还给操纵者卡兹提克。
text.description: 为什么蜥蜴人会有琥珀？更重要的是，为什么神谕者希斯尔会如此重视它？$b$b这块琥珀不像是来自于守卫森严的扎尼维斯，那么它是从哪里来的？$b$b或许卡拉克西知道事情的来龙去脉。
text.progress: Where did you find this?
text.completion: You were wise to bring this to us. This is a piece of another paragon's encasing amber.$B$BThe damage suggests the paragon may be in trouble.$B$BI will speak with the council to decide what should be done next.

english.title: Falling to Pieces
english.objectives: Return the Glowing Amber to Kaz'tik the Manipulator.
english.description: Why would the saurok have amber? More importantly, why would Oracle Hiss'ir be so protective of it?$b$bIt is unlikely this came from the heavily guarded Zan'vess, so where did it come from?$b$bPerhaps the Klaxxi will know what to make of it.
english.progress: Where did you find this?
english.completion: You were wise to bring this to us. This is a piece of another paragon's encasing amber.$B$BThe damage suggests the paragon may be in trouble.$B$BI will speak with the council to decide what should be done next.

text.title: 旗帜——失踪探险者的随身物品
旗帜——里克提克的除虱器
旗帜——科里维斯硬化树脂
旗帜——一箱被丢弃的货物
旗帜——玛里克的坚固长矛
旗帜——觅血者的狂乱钉锤

english.title: FLAG - Hammer of the Poisoned Mind

text.title: 释放信号
text.objectives: 唤醒暮根沼泽的英杰。
text.description: 珀光裂谷的信标似乎被干扰了。就在信号被切断之前，卡拉克西瓦收到了附近另一个英杰的信号。$b$b他们相信他就藏在那个凄凉的小沼泽——暮根沼泽里。$b$b在我修复珀光裂谷的信标之前，我将和你一起前往沼泽，建立一个临时信标。$b$b你要唤醒那名英杰，然后再回来帮我。
text.completion: It seems my work will begin immediately. You have come to a dangerous place, Wakener.
text.completed: Speak with Hisek the Swarmkeeper in Duskroot Fen.

english.title: Dropping Our Signal
english.objectives: Awaken the paragon in Duskroot Fen.
english.description: The beacon in Amberglow Hollow seems to have been tampered with. Right before the signal cut out the Klaxxi'va picked up a signal for another paragon nearby.$b$bThey believe he is hidden in that wretched little swamp, Duskroot Fen.$b$bI will meet you in the fen to set up a temporary beacon until I can get Amberglow operational again.$b$bYou will wake the paragon and then you will help me.
english.completion: It seems my work will begin immediately. You have come to a dangerous place, Wakener.
english.completed: Speak with Hisek the Swarmkeeper in Duskroot Fen.

text.title: 四部古籍
text.objectives: 摧毁四部古籍——《光明下的阴影》、《克尔苏加德的深层知识》、《禁忌咒文及其他死灵仪式》和《黑暗法典》。
text.description: 通灵学院在研究关于邪恶的死灵法术方面的四部古籍：《光明下的阴影》、《克尔苏加德的深层知识》、《禁忌咒文及其他死灵仪式》和《黑暗法典》。$B$B我们要前往这个被诅咒的地方，找到并摧毁这四部书籍，以免其他蠢货再去寻找这些书，并且学习其中的邪恶秘密。
text.completion: Thank you, $n.$B$BWith the destruction of the tomes I'll go to my final rest knowing that those books will never again haunt a living soul.
text.completed: Speak with the Talking Skull in Scholomance.

english.title: The Four Tomes
english.objectives: Destroy the four tomes: "In the Shadow of the Light", "Kel'Thuzad's Deep Knowledge", "Forbidden Rites and other Rituals Necromantic" and "The Dark Grimoire".
english.description: There are four tomes of great necromantic evil studied in Scholomance: "In the Shadow of the Light", "Kel'Thuzad's Deep Knowledge", "Forbidden Rites and other Rituals Necromantic" and "The Dark Grimoire".$B$BAs we make our way through this cursed place, find and destroy each book so that no other fool can come along later and learn their vile secrets.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.$B$BWith the destruction of the tomes I'll go to my final rest knowing that those books will never again haunt a living soul.
english.completed: Speak with the Talking Skull in Scholomance.

text.title: 深层腐化
text.objectives: 击败暮根沼泽的叛徒。
text.description: 今天，你明白了战争时期没有人可以相信，唤醒者。即使是卡拉克西最亲近的人也可能变得堕落。$b$b我们不知道这个叛徒已经被腐化了多久。必须杀死他！$b$b你似乎有些困惑。你没有看出来我们这里谁是叛徒？让我来教你如何识别。
text.completion: You will see more of this. War is never pretty.$B$BThe empresses' corruption is far reaching and hard to detect.$B$BThere is much work to be done. We need to start repairing the damage Kor'ik did.
text.completed: Speak with Hisek the Swarmkeeper in Duskroot Fen.

english.title: Corruption Runs Deep
english.objectives: Defeat the traitor in the Duskroot Fen.
english.description: Today you learn that no one can be trusted in times of war, Wakener. Even those closest to the Klaxxi are susceptible to corruption.$b$bWho knows how long this traitor has been corrupted. He must be destroyed!$b$bYou appear confused. Do you not see the traitor in our midst? Allow me to adjust your vision.

text.title: 飞行虎皮丝足鱼
text.objectives: 把飞行虎皮丝足鱼交给渔人码头的纳特·帕格。
text.description: 你捕到了一条罕见的鱼……带翅膀的。或许应该咨询一下渔人码头的纳特·帕格，听取他的专业意见。
text.progress: Flying fish?
text.completion: Is that a flying tiger gourami?$b$bThis little fish is a rare mutation of the tiger gourami that can fly, and are consequently caught in any freshwater here in Pandaria.$b$bLocal legend states that good luck comes to the person who eats it, and local tradition states that only royalty can eat them.  To be caught breaking this "tradition" is a death sentence.$b$bWith that in mind, I'll make sure it gets to the right person.
text.completed: Bring the Flying Tiger Gourami to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
text.giverWindow: 也许纳特知道这种罕见的鱼类？

english.title: Flying Tiger Gourami
english.objectives: Bring the Flying Tiger Gourami to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
english.description: You've caught a unique fish... with wings.  Perhaps it deserves the expert opinion of Nat Pagle in Anglers Wharf.
english.progress: Flying fish?
english.completion: Is that a flying tiger gourami?$b$bThis little fish is a rare mutation of the tiger gourami that can fly, and are consequently caught in any freshwater here in Pandaria.$b$bLocal legend states that good luck comes to the person who eats it, and local tradition states that only royalty can eat them.  To be caught breaking this "tradition" is a death sentence.$b$bWith that in mind, I'll make sure it gets to the right person.

english.giverWindow: Maybe Nat would know more about this rare catch?

text.title: 霸王刺皮鱼
text.objectives: 把霸王刺皮鱼交给渔人码头的纳特·帕格。
text.description: 你捕到了奇怪的东西。看起来非常具有侵略性。$b$b或许渔人码头的纳特·帕格知道关于它的更多知识？
text.progress: Strange fish?
text.completion: That's not what I think it is, is it?  Oh wow, a spinefish alpha, one of Pandaria's deadliest predators.$b$bSpinefish are malformed abominations created by the sha presence, and these big ones are simply terrifying.  An alpha will often eat other spinefish, even though there isn't a single part of them that's edible.$b$bLuckily for both of us, they are very interesting to alchemists.
text.completed: Bring the Spinefish Alpha to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
text.giverWindow: 也许纳特知道这种罕见的鱼类？

english.objectives: Bring the Spinefish Alpha to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
english.description: You have fished up something special.  It looks pretty aggressive.$b$bMaybe Nat Pagle at the Anglers Wharf might know more about it?

text.title: zzOld
text.objectives: 去卡桑琅丛林的渔人码头和渔夫海涛谈一谈。
text.description: 如果你想探寻深海的奥秘，或是抓一两条大鱼，就去跟我的哥哥海涛谈一谈，他就在卡桑琅丛林的渔人码头。$B$B我肯定他会很乐意向你传授一两个绝招的！

english.title: zzOld
english.objectives: Speak to Fisherman Haito at the Anglers Wharf in the Krasarang Wilds.
english.description: If you want to explore all the secrets of the deep ocean, and catch some big fish, speak to my brother Haito at the Anglers Wharf in Krasarang Wilds.$B$BI'm sure he'd love to show you a thing or two about reeling!

text.title: 拟态章鱼
text.objectives: 把拟态章鱼交给渔人码头的纳特·帕格。
text.description: 你可能还不清楚，但你捕到了一种极其罕见的软体动物。渔人码头的纳特·帕格可能会对这种东西感兴趣。
text.progress: Camouflage octopus?
text.completion: Is that a mimic octopus?  A buddy of mine caught one of these off the coast of Zandalar a few years back.  He barely made it back alive, actually.  Pesky trolls, but great fishing!$b$bAnyhow, they aren't as rare as you might think because they use camouflage to hide amongst rocks and plants; only a very skilled fisherman has any hope of catching this elusive, and delicious, morsel.
text.completed: Bring the Mimic Octopus to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
text.giverWindow: 也许纳特知道这种罕见的鱼类？

english.title: Mimic Octopus
english.objectives: Bring the Mimic Octopus to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
english.description: You aren't sure how, but you've caught an extraordinary cephalopod.  Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf would be very interested to see it.

Pesky trolls, but great fishing!$b$bAnyhow, they aren't as rare as you might think because they use camouflage to hide amongst rocks and plants; only a very skilled fisherman has any hope of catching this elusive, and delicious, morsel.

text.title: 苦难的终结
text.objectives: 杀死黑暗院长加丁。
text.description: 要解除这个地方的诅咒，关键在于杀死黑暗院长加丁。$B$B杀掉他，$p，让他也尝一尝受苦的滋味！
text.completion: Behold my true form.$B$BI owe you a debt, one which I can never repay. But, I thank you for lifting the curse off of my family.$B$BKel'Thuzad, the Lich King, and now Darkmaster Gandling -- all are dead.$B$BPerhaps now I too can find some semblance of peace.
text.completed: Speak with the Spirit of Lord Alexei Barov in Scholomance.
text.giverWindow: 杀死黑暗院长，解除诅咒。

text.title: 新的命运
text.objectives: 和尚喜师父的灵魂谈一谈，然后选择加入联盟，还是部落。
text.description: 这些新盟友告诉了我们一件重要的事：不光是神真子开始变得衰弱，在云之彼端，整个世界都开始分崩离析。世界需要治愈，而我认为你正是合适的人选之一。$B$B我要你跟季，还有艾莎走出这里，把你们的力量与智慧带给外面的世界。这些联盟和部落虽然理念不同，但他们内心深处都有着高尚的意志。$B$B我会让你自由选择你想加入的阵营。
text.completion: And so it is done... here we are, in our new home.
text.completed: Speak to Ji or Aysa.

english.title: A New Fate
english.objectives: Speak to the Spirit of Master Shang Xi, and choose whether you leave with the Alliance or the Horde.
english.description: These new allies have shed light on a great and important truth: it is not just Shen-zin Su that is ailing, but all of the land beyond the clouds. The world needs healing, and I think that you should be the ones to heal it.$B$BI would like you, Ji, and Aysa to leave and bring your strength and wisdom to the world. These Alliance and Horde have different ideals, but at the core of both lies noble intent.$B$BI will leave the choice of who you wish to accompany to you.
english.completion: And so it is done... here we are, in our new home.
english.completed: Speak to Ji or Aysa.

text.title: 失踪的商人
text.objectives: 去昆莱山的墨鳃潭和商人施禄谈一谈。
text.description:
通常情况下，商人施禄都会来到昆莱山和锦鱼、土地精进行交易。我们听说他没有去滨岸村，也没有见到他来这里………

我担心他发生了什么事情。你能去一趟墨鳃潭看他是否在那里吗？
text.completion: My son! They took my son... Can you help me?

english.title: The Missing Merchant
english.objectives: Speak with Merchant Shi at Inkgill Mere in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.description:
Usually, Merchant Shi comes through Kun-Lai Summit to trade with the Jinyu and Grummle. We've heard word that he hadn't been seen at Binan, and we haven't seen him here...

I'm worried something has happened to him. Can you go to the Inkgill Mere and see if he's there?
english.completion: My son! They took my son... Can you help me?

text.title: 影踪派
text.objectives: 去火树村的影踪别院和影踪派翀大师谈一谈。
text.description:
我们的新兵一直在小声议论一群被称为“影踪派”的熊猫人。他们显然非常强大，而且极其神秘。

很明显，无论昆莱山发生什么事情，与这些影踪派结盟都是我们在潘达利亚立足的关键所在。

那就是要用到你的地方了。有传言说他们在东南方向，靠近火树村附近的地方有一个营地。

我要你前往那个地方，博取他们的好感。为了部落！
text.completion: Who are you? Can you fight? If so, we can use your help.

english.title: The Shado-Pan
english.objectives: Speak to Shado-Master Chong at Shado-Pan Fallback in Firebough Nook.
english.description:
Our new recruits have spoken in hushed tones about a group of Pandaren they call the "Shado-Pan". They are apparently very strong, and secretive.

It's clear that, no matter what happens here in Kun-Lai, making an alliance with these Shado-Pan will be critical to our foothold in Pandaria.

That's where you come in. Rumor is they have a base of operations to the southeast, near Firebough Nook.

You will go there, and curry their favor. For the Horde!
english.completion: Who are you? Can you fight? If so, we can use your help.

text.title: 创造传奇
text.objectives: 和拉希奥喝一杯。他请客。
text.description: 我们的世界走到了十字路口。接下来的几个月中将会发生各种各样的事情——假如我们还有未来的话。$b$b啊！我好像有点跑题了，还是说回眼前的事吧。来，和我喝一杯。我们来讨论一下艾泽拉斯的未来。
text.completion: Of course, I must ask your discretion regarding what we just talked about.$B$BWe wouldn't want to alarm anyone who is, shall we say, less capable than yourself.
text.completed: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mist in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: A Legend in the Making
english.objectives: Share a drink with Wrathion. He's buying.
english.description: Our world finds itself at a crossroads. The next few months will shape everything to come - presuming we are to have a future at all.$b$bAh! But I am getting ahead of myself. Let me back up. Come, share a drink with me. Let's talk about the future of Azeroth.
english.completion: Of course, I must ask your discretion regarding what we just talked about.$B$BWe wouldn't want to alarm anyone who is, shall we say, less capable than yourself.
english.completed: Speak with Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mist in the Veiled Stair.

text.description:
我们的新兵低声谈论过被称为“影踪派”的熊猫人。他们明显非常强大，而且极其神秘。

那就是你要去的地方。有传言说他们在东南方向有一个基地，那个地方在火树村附近。你应该以联盟使节的身份前往那里。向他们提供所需的任何帮助。

text.title: 麝香爪牧场
text.objectives: 前往昆莱山的麝香爪牧场，和老麝香爪谈一谈。
text.description:
除了这里，还有另一个熊猫人村落，麝香爪牧场。我不知道他们是否还好，不知道在遭到野牛人入侵之后近况如何。

你对我们很有帮助——不知道你能否前去看望他们，我的朋友！
text.completion: Wha? Who the heck are you? What are you doin' here?$B$BOh, you wanna help?

english.objectives: Travel to Muskpaw Ranch in Kun-Lai Summit and speak with Lao Muskpaw.
english.description:
There's another Pandaren settlement out here, Muskpaw Ranch. I don't know if they're alright, what with everything that's been going on with the Yaungol invasion.

You've been so helpful - you should go check up on them, friend!

text.title: 减少损失
text.objectives: 杀死5名伊克提克耳语者，停用凯帕圣树·伊克信标。
text.description: 几周以来，科尔里克一直在向女皇发送信号。女皇知道卡拉克西所做的每一件事情。$b$b现在不会这样了！$b$b凯帕圣树·伊克将会首先收到科尔里克的死讯。这对我们有利，我们可以确保消息不会再传到女皇那里。$b$b在女皇采取行动之前，摧毁那里的耳语者和信标可以帮助我们赢得时间。
text.progress: Information is power, Wakener. Those with the most information always have the most power.
text.completion: Excellent work! This should allow us the time to repair the damage Kor'ik caused.$B$BYou may have just shifted the tide of war in our favor.
text.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Damage Control
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Ik'thik Whisperers and deactivate the Kypari Ik Beacon.
english.description: Kor'ik has been sending signals to the empress for weeks. Everything the Klaxxi have done, the empress knows about.$b$bThat stops now!$b$bKypari Ik will be the first to receive news of Kor'ik's demise. It would benefit us to make sure that message does not make it to the empress.$b$bDestroying the whisperers and beacon there will buy us enough time to come up with a plan before the empress can act.
english.progress: Information is power, Wakener. Those with the most information always have the most power.
english.completion: Excellent work! This should allow us the time to repair the damage Kor'ik caused.$B$BYou may have just shifted the tide of war in our favor.
english.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper in Klaxxi'vess.

text.objectives: 去昆莱山的酒坛集和游学者周卓谈一谈。
text.description:
有个土地精来过这里，说游学者周卓请你过去。你应该出发去见见他，他可能有些重要的事情要告诉你。

土地精说他在北面的酒坛集。

One of those grummles came by and said that Lorewalker Cho sent for you. You should go ahead and meet up with him, he might have something important to say.

The grummel said he's at Onekeg, to the north.

text.title: 获取答案
text.objectives: 从凯帕圣树·伊克的伊克提克聚生虫身上收集6块浸毒颚骨。
text.description: 凯帕圣树·伊克只是女皇夏柯希尔的众多子嗣居住地中的一个。他们在幼年期时，总是十分冲动鲁莽，并且难以管教。同时，他们也是致命的。$B$B聚生虫出生时带着剧毒的毒液，随着其年岁的增长，毒液的效力才逐渐减低。只要沾上这种毒液，即便是最强壮和经验最丰富的战士也会变得无力。$B$B我想请你帮我带一些这种毒液回来。
text.progress: Swarmborn venom will not only give us an additional weapon, it will also help us figure out what stage the swarm is in.
text.completion: This venom is in its advanced stages, but doesn't seem to be losing it's potency...$B$BThis is very curious. The Klaxxi will want to know immediately. Thank you, Wakener.
text.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Extracting Answers
english.objectives: Collect 6 Venom-Coated Mandibles from the Ik'thik Swarmborn in Kypari Ik.
english.description: Kypari Ik is just one of many locations that houses some of Empress Shek'zeer's offspring. In their juvenile state the young are reckless and difficult to control. They are also deadly.$b$bSwarmborn are hatched with a highly toxic venom that diminishes in potency with age. The venom can incapacitate even the strongest and most skilled fighter if it hits flesh.$b$bI would like you to bring me some of this venom.
english.progress: Swarmborn venom will not only give us an additional weapon, it will also help us figure out what stage the swarm is in.
