text.title: 虎虎生威
text.objectives: 从烧烤大师那里学习碳烤虎肉排的食谱，然后制作5份碳烤虎肉排给他。
text.description: 通过烧烤，你可以将生虎排制作成可口的食物，吃了会让你变得更强壮。从我这学习碳烤虎肉排的食谱，然后露两手给我瞧瞧。
text.progress: Learn the recipe from me and demonstrate what you have learned.
text.completion: Strength and good health! This is the Way of the Grill.
text.completed: Give 5 Charbroiled Tiager Steaks to the Master of the Grill.

english.title: Strong as a Tiger
english.objectives: Train the recipe for Charbroiled Tiger Steak from the Master of the Grill, then give him 5 Charbroiled Tiger Steaks.
english.description: With the grill, you can transform those raw tiger steaks into food that makes you stronger. Learn the recipe for charbroiled tiger steaks from me. Show me what you can do.
english.progress: Learn the recipe from me and demonstrate what you have learned.
english.completion: Strength and good health! This is the Way of the Grill.
english.completed: Give 5 Charbroiled Tiager Steaks to the Master of the Grill.

text.title: 黑王子的试炼
text.objectives: 在黑王子阵营中达到“尊敬”声望。击败锦绣谷、螳螂高原和恐惧废土的90级魔古族和螳螂妖都可以获得声望。
text.description: 我完全有理由相信，你是勇士中的勇士。但如果你不介意我这个小小的恶趣味，我还是想亲自检验一下你的勇气。$b$b攻打锦绣谷的魔古族，居住在山泽岛魔古族爪牙，还有围攻恐惧废土的染煞螳螂妖……对于你来说，这些敌人可以构成足够的挑战。$b$b向我证明你的能力吧。不用着急——我想你需要花费一些时间才能完成这个任务。
text.completion: Marvelous. That did not take long at all.$B$BWord of your many achievements has been the talk of the Vale!$B$BVery well, I will take you under my wing.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mist in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Trial of the Black Prince
english.objectives: Earn an Honored Reputation with the Black Prince. Level 90 mogu and mantid in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, Townlong Steppes and the Dread Wastes will earn reputation.
english.description: I have on good authority that you are a champion among champions, but if you'll permit me this indulgence, I would like to test your mettle for myself.$b$bThe mogu who assault the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, the mogu minions who inhabit Shan'ze Dao, and the sha-corrupted mantid swarming the Dread Wastes... these may provide an adequate challenge for one of your stature.$b$bProve yourself to me. No rush - I expect this to take you some time.
english.completion: Marvelous. That did not take long at all.$B$BWord of your many achievements has been the talk of the Vale!$B$BVery well, I will take you under my wing.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mist in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 敌人的力量
text.objectives: 从魔古山宝库、恐惧之心或永春台的团队首领处收集10个力量印记和10个智慧印记。
text.description: 出色的领袖必须拥有能够决定人民命运的力量，以及做出正确决策的智慧。潘达利亚从不缺乏强大的力量和古代的智慧，但这两种素质很少出自同一个人身上。$b$b让我们来看看你我能不能改变这个现象。$b$b前往魔古山宝库、恐惧之心或永春台收集逝去英雄的智慧和力量印记。我们能比现在的拥有者更好地利用它们。
text.progress: Sigils of wisdom will often be found on practitioners of the arcane arts, while sigils of power are usually found on those who favor brute strength.$B$BThis is not always true, but it may help you find what you need.
text.completion: My friend - you do not disappoint!$B$BWe will put these to good use.
text.completed: Bring the Sigils to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.objectives: Collect 10 Sigils of Power and 10 Sigils of Wisdom from raid bosses in the Mogu'shan Vaults, Heart of Fear, or Terrace of Endless Spring.
english.description: Great leadership requires the power to shape the destiny of your people, and the wisdom to make the right decisions. Pandaria boasts great power and ancient wisdom, but rarely in the same place.$b$bLet's see if you and I can change that!$b$bAcquire sigils of power and wisdom from fallen foes in the Mogu'shan Vaults, the Heart of Fear, or the Terrace of Endless Spring. We will put them to a much better use than their current owners.

text.title: 冥思之汤
text.objectives: 从炖煮大师那里学习迷雾汤的食谱，然后制作5份迷雾汤给他。
text.description: 盯着这口锅，你会有很多时间去思考的。让我煮个迷雾汤给你尝尝，你就会明白我的意思了。
text.progress: If you want to learn the Way of the Pot, you have to start with swirling mist soup.
text.completion: Intellect is a gift you must hone with time.
text.completed: Give 5 Swilring Mist Soup to the Master of the Pot.

english.title: The Soup of Contemplation
english.objectives: Train the recipe for Swirling Mist Soup from the Master of the Pot, then give her 5 Swirling Mist Soup.
english.description: Watching over the pot, you get a lot of time to think. Let me show you how to make swirling mist soup and you'll know what I mean.
english.progress: If you want to learn the Way of the Pot, you have to start with swirling mist soup.
english.completion: Intellect is a gift you must hone with time.
english.completed: Give 5 Swilring Mist Soup to the Master of the Pot.

text.title: 蒸烧之道
text.objectives: 带5只巨型螳螂虾给蒸烧大师。
text.description: 一顿美餐能振奋你的精神，而没有什么能比蒸烧之道烹制的食物更加美味有效了。带一些巨型螳螂虾给蒸烧大师，他就会为你展示。你可以在海里钓取巨型螳螂虾。
text.progress: If you want to learn the Way of the Steamer, you'll need some shrimp.
text.completion: Fine ingredients.
text.completed: Give 5 Giant Mantis Shrimp to the Master of the Steamer.

english.title: Way of the Steamer
english.objectives: Bring 5 Giant Mantis Shrimp to the Master of the Steamer.
english.description: A great meal can lift your spirits, and none more so than food from the Way of the Steamer. Bring the Master some giant mantis shrimp and he will show you. You can fish for giant mantis shrimp in the ocean.
english.progress: If you want to learn the Way of the Steamer, you'll need some shrimp.
english.completion: Fine ingredients.
english.completed: Give 5 Giant Mantis Shrimp to the Master of the Steamer.

text.title: 烹饪的精要
text.objectives: 从蒸烧大师那里学习虾饺的食谱，然后制作5份虾饺给他。
text.description: 当我用蒸汽进行烹饪时，我会向食物倾注我的爱意。让我来教你如何做虾饺。
text.progress: Let me teach you how to make shrimp dumplings.
text.completion: Spirits are lifted by good food.
text.completed: Give 5 Shrimp Dumplings to the Master of the Steamer.

english.title: The Spirit of Cooking
english.objectives: Train the recipe for Shrimp Dumplings from the Master of the Steamer, then give him 5 Shrimp Dumplings.
english.description: When I cook with steam, I infuse the food with my love. Let me teach you the recipe for shrimp dumplings.
english.progress: Let me teach you how to make shrimp dumplings.
english.completion: Spirits are lifted by good food.
english.completed: Give 5 Shrimp Dumplings to the Master of the Steamer.

text.title: 持之以恒
text.objectives: 从烘焙大师那里学习香烤野雉的食谱，然后制作5份香烤野稚给他。
text.description: 听说鹤通过在它们群落守卫的嘴里放石头的方式来选择哨兵，如果有守卫睡着了，石头就会掉下来，守卫就会醒来。要熟练使用烤箱，必须具有耐心和恒心。学会香烤野雉的食谱，然后让我瞧瞧你都明白了些什么。
text.progress: Learn the recipe for wildfowl roast from me and let's see what you can do.
text.completion: Stamina and endurance are needed for mastering anything. To slave over a hot oven takes patience, but the results are very much worth the effort.
text.completed: Give 5 Wildfowl Roast to the Master of the Oven.

english.title: Endurance
english.objectives: Train the recipe for Wildfowl Roast from the Master of the Oven, then give her 5 Wildfowl Roast.
english.description: They say that the crane appointed sentry by its flock stands guard with a stone in its beak, so that, should it fall asleep, the stone drops and it awakens. To be skilled with the oven, you need to have endurance and patience. Learn the recipe for wildfowl roast and show me that you understand.
english.progress: Learn the recipe for wildfowl roast from me and let's see what you can do.
english.completion: Stamina and endurance are needed for mastering anything. To slave over a hot oven takes patience, but the results are very much worth the effort.
english.completed: Give 5 Wildfowl Roast to the Master of the Oven.

text.title: 烘焙之道
text.objectives: 带5份野雉胸肉给烘焙大师。
text.description: 如果你想来一顿能够让你饱足并增进耐力的丰盛大餐，那你就应该寻求烘焙之道的帮助。带一些野雉胸肉给烘焙大师，她会教你烘焙的知识。在四风谷和翡翠林有很多仙鹤，但你也可以从其他鸟类的身上获取野雉胸肉。
text.progress: If you want to make wildfowl roast, you need to obtain wildfowl breasts.
text.completion: We can work with these.
text.completed: Give 5 Wildfowl Breasts to the Master of the Oven.

english.title: Way of the Oven
english.objectives: Bring 5 Wildfowl Breasts to the Master of the Oven.
english.description: If you are looking for a hearty meal that will sustain you and increase your stamina, you should seek out the Way of the Oven. Bring some wildfowl breasts to the Master of the Oven and she will teach you. There are plenty of cranes in the Valley of the Four Winds and in the Jade Forest, but you can obtain wildfowl breasts from other birds as well.
english.progress: If you want to make wildfowl roast, you need to obtain wildfowl breasts.
english.completion: We can work with these.
english.completed: Give 5 Wildfowl Breasts to the Master of the Oven.

text.title: 酿造之道
text.objectives: 带一根人参给酿造大师。你可以在孙行·铁掌那里买到人参。
text.description: 熊猫人的酿造之道……好吧，我会让酿造大师解释给你听的。给他带些人参过去，他会倾囊相授的。
text.progress: You'd like to learn the Way of the Brew?
text.completion: This is a fine example of good ginseng. Would you like to learn how to make tea with it?
text.completed: Give 1 Ginseng to the Master of the Brew.

english.title: Way of the Brew
english.objectives: Bring 1 Ginseng to the Master of the Brew. Ginseng can be bought from Sungshin Ironpaw.
english.description: The Pandaren Way of the Brew produces... Well, I'll let the Master of the Brew explain it. Bring him some ginseng and he will show you the way.
english.progress: You'd like to learn the Way of the Brew?
english.completion: This is a fine example of good ginseng. Would you like to learn how to make tea with it?
english.completed: Give 1 Ginseng to the Master of the Brew.

text.title: 喝一杯吧
text.objectives: 从酿造大师那里学习人参茶的食谱，然后制作一杯人参茶给他。
text.description: 我的兄弟姐妹们太严肃了。我认为人生苦短，何苦那么较真呢。让我们坐下来喝杯茶吧，我会教你如何泡制人参茶。
text.progress: Let me teach you how to make ginseng tea.
text.completion: Well done. This is delicious.
text.completed: Give 1 Ginseng Tea to the Master of the Brew.

english.title: Have a Drink
english.objectives: Train the recipe for Ginseng Tea from the Master of the Brew, then give him 1 Ginseng Tea.
english.description: My siblings are so serious. I think life's too short to be so serious all the time. Let's have some tea together. Let me teach you how to make ginseng tea.
english.progress: Let me teach you how to make ginseng tea.
english.completion: Well done. This is delicious.
english.completed: Give 1 Ginseng Tea to the Master of the Brew.

text.title: 恐惧
text.objectives: 在永春台击败惧之煞并获得恐惧奇美拉。
text.description: 我在这里的这段时间，学习了一些熊猫人的智慧。我尤其喜欢这句话：$b$b“自卑者忧难；怯懦者畏难；勇者克难而后怕。”$b$b这句话有没有道理呢？我们来试试吧。$b$b惧之煞已经潜入了永春台。去那里找到它、击败他并抽出他的灵魂——假如它有灵魂的话。$b$b你的勇敢将会得到丰厚的奖赏的。
text.progress: Another bit of pandaren wisdom: "Fear is not a criminal we must lock away. It is a teacher we must seek to understand." In facing our fears, we gain great strength.$B$BHave you faced your fears, $n?
text.completion: You have done it!$B$BSome put their faith in magic or steel. But in my experience, fear is the most powerful weapon one can wield. Use it properly, and your enemies cannot bring themselves to fight you.
text.completed: Bring the Chimera of Fear to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Fear Itself
english.objectives: Defeat the Sha of Fear in the Terrace of Endless Spring and acquire the Chimera of Fear.
english.description: I've picked up a few motes of pandaren wisdom during my time here. I particularly enjoy this one:$b$b"The timid feel fear before trouble starts; the cowards feel fear as trouble happens. The bravest among us feel fear only after the troubles have been taken care of."$b$bIs that true? Let's find out.$b$bThe Sha of Fear has fled into the Terrace of Endless Spring. Pursue it there, defeat it, and rip out its spirit - presuming it has one.$b$bYour bravery will be handsomely rewarded.
english.progress:
Another bit of pandaren wisdom: "Fear is not a criminal we must lock away. It is a teacher we must seek to understand."  In facing our fears, we gain great strength.

Have you faced your fears, $n?
english.completion: You have done it!$B$BSome put their faith in magic or steel. But in my experience, fear is the most powerful weapon one can wield. Use it properly, and your enemies cannot bring themselves to fight you.
english.completed: Bring the Chimera of Fear to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 黑龙王子之息
text.objectives: 前往石阶顶端的石匠之愚，在那里会见拉希奥并接收你的奖励。
text.description: <拉希奥那血红的锐利眼睛盯着你。>$b$b你这种人很罕见，$n。$b$b你正是我要找的人——一个有能力影响全局的人。$b$b来吧，我答应过给你奖励，你有资格收下它！酒馆的东面有一条石阶，通往当地人称之为“石匠之愚”的瞭望台。我们到那里再见吧。
text.completion: You have earned this, $n! Use it well.$B$BPlease understand, I mean to pay off my father's debts. I will stop at NOTHING to defend this world. In the future, if you are ever uncertain, you are welcome to question my means. But never question my motives. The safety of this world is my primary concern.$B$BNow then, let's talk about current events.
text.completed: 和拉希奥谈一谈。

english.title: Breath of the Black Prince
english.objectives: Go to the top of the stone steps at Mason's Folly and meet Wrathion there to accept your reward.
english.description: <Wrathion's piercing red eyes fixate on you.>$b$bYou are among a rare breed, $n.$b$bYou are just what I am looking for - an individual with the potential to shape events on a global scale.$b$bCome now, I promised you a reward, and you shall have it! East of this tavern is a series of stone steps leading up to a vista that the locals have named "Mason's Folly." Meet me there.
english.completion: You have earned this, $n! Use it well.$B$BPlease understand, I mean to pay off my father's debts. I will stop at NOTHING to defend this world. In the future, if you are ever uncertain, you are welcome to question my means. But never question my motives. The safety of this world is my primary concern.$B$BNow then, let's talk about current events.
english.completed: Speak with Wration.

text.title: 即将到来……
text.objectives: 当你的海军舰队在潘达利亚南部海岸登陆之后，联系拉希奥。
text.description: 熊猫人的战争才刚刚开始！我们现在得把注意力集中到联盟和部落之间的冲突上了。$b$b我在拉文霍德的联络人告诉我，联盟第七军团和大规模的部落侵略部队正在向潘达利亚南部海岸进发。无论你是否愿意，潘达利亚很快就会变成一个战场。$b$b我们可以暂时蛰伏，但我希望你能在你们的舰队达到之后联系我。然后……我们将采取行动！
text.completion: They're here!$B$B<Wrathion claps his hands and rubs them together, excitedly.>$B$BOh $n. Things are about to get exciting.
text.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mist in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Incoming...
english.objectives: Contact Wrathion once your naval fleet makes landfall on the southern coast of Pandaria.
english.description: The Pandaren campaign is only beginning! We turn our attention now to the ongoing conflict between the Alliance and the Horde.$b$bMy contacts in Ravenholdt tell me that the Alliance 7th Legion and a considerable Horde invasion force are converging toward Pandaria's southern shores. Like it or not, Pandaria may soon become a battlefield.$b$bWe are done for now, but I want you to contact me when your fleet arrives. Then... together we will spring into action!
english.completion: They're here!$B$B<Wrathion claps his hands and rubs them together, excitedly.>$B$BOh $n. Things are about to get exciting.
english.completed: Return to Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mist in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 未使用
text.objectives: 向廚藝鬼才學習溏心蛋的食譜並做出五份給她。
text.description: 我不像我的兄弟姊妹是個主廚。然而，我是個很棒的老師。無論你是不是毫無經驗，只要你願意花時間，我就能釋放你在烹飪技藝方面的潛力。$b$b如果你有心向我學習，讓我看看你的活力吧。跟我學習溏心蛋的配方，煮五份，然後帶來給我。我有新鮮的蛋可以用合理的價格賣給你。
text.completed: 帶5份溏心蛋給廚藝鬼才。

english.title: UNUSED
english.objectives: Learn the recipe for Soft-Boiled Eggs from the Guide to the Ways and make 5 of them for her.
english.description: I am not a master chef like my siblings. What I am is a great teacher. If you are dedicated, I can unlock your hidden potential, no matter how inexperienced you are.$b$bIf you wish to learn, show me you can at least follow basic instructions. Learn the recipe for soft-boiled eggs, make five of them and bring them to me.  I have fresh eggs which I will sell to you at a token price.
english.completed: Give the 5 Soft-Boiled Eggs to the Guide to the Ways.

objectiveDetails.description: Give 5 Soft-Boiled Eggs to the Guide to the Ways

text.title: 我对烹饪所有了解
text.objectives: 把信交给孙行·铁掌。她在半山市集教授厨艺。
text.description: 很高兴你喜欢我的食物。你对这些食谱感兴趣吗？如果感兴趣，你可以向我的老师学习这些食谱。他们在半山市集。我所有的厨艺都是从他们那里学到的。$b$b如果你正好经过那里，可不可以帮我把这封信交给孙行·铁掌？她是我最喜欢的老师，我想让她知道我很想她。
text.progress: You have a letter for me?
text.completion: My, that's so thoughtful. I love hearing from my old students.
text.completed: Deliver the Letter to Sungshin Ironpaw. She teaches in Halfhill Market.

english.title: Everything I Know About Cooking
english.objectives: Deliver the Letter to Sungshin Ironpaw. She teaches in Halfhill Market.
english.description: I'm so glad you enjoy my food. Are you interested in the recipes?  If so, you should learn them properly, from my teachers in Halfhill Market.  Everything I know about the kitchen, I learned from them.$b$bSay, if you happen to pass through there, would you deliver this note to Sungshin Ironpaw for me? She was my favorite teacher, and I want her to know that I miss her.
english.progress: You have a letter for me?
english.completion: My, that's so thoughtful. I love hearing from my old students.
english.completed: Deliver the Letter to Sungshin Ironpaw. She teaches in Halfhill Market.

text.title: 声波干扰
text.objectives: 在夏柯希尔之巢杀死4只惊怖恐虫和6个夏柯希尔操纵者。声波干扰音叉可以削弱和迷惑恐虫。
text.description: 依靠声波低语操纵恐虫只是我研究的最初阶段，可是帝国似乎已经完全采用了这种方法。夏柯希尔的操纵者们没有耐心和他们的恐虫建立正确的联系。$B$B懒惰会让他们付出惨重的代价。$B$B敲击虫巢中惊怖恐虫附近的音叉——看那些恐虫如何变得混乱不堪然后对它们的主人发动致命攻击。这个办法可以利用敌人的弱点，对他们迎头痛击。
text.completion: Let this be a reminder - the kunchong should be feared and respected.
text.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Sonic Disruption
english.objectives: Kill 4 Dread Kunchong and 6 Shek'zeer Manipulators in the Clutches of Shek'zeer. The Sonic Disruption Fork will weaken and confuse the kunchong.
english.description: Relying on sonic whispers to manipulate the kunchong was only the most primitive stage of my research, and yet the Empire seems to have adopted the practice wholly. The manipulators of the Shek'zeer are too impatient to form a proper bond with their kunchong.$B$BTheir laziness will cost them dearly.$B$BStrike this tuning fork near the dread kunchong in the clutches - watch as they reel in confusion and lash out at their masters. Use this to your advantage and put them down.
english.completion: Let this be a reminder - the kunchong should be feared and respected.
english.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 异乡的陌生人
text.objectives: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆找到“黑王子”。
text.description: 对不起，$c。你是$n吗？$b$b一个披着黑色斗篷的人让我把这个交给你。和你一样，她也是来自迷雾之外的旅行者，但是——我不相信她。$b$b这个消息来自雾纱栈道的酒馆。我会把信交给你的……但是你在去那里的时候一定要小心提防！
text.progress: So, my note found its way to you!
text.completion: My people have done their job and brought you to me. Wonderful.
text.completed: Seek out "The Black Prince" at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

english.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
english.objectives: Seek out "The Black Prince" at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
english.description: Excuse me, $c. Is your name $n?$b$bA figure in a dark cloak asked that I give this to you. She was a traveler from beyond the mists, like yourself, but - well, I didn't trust her.$b$bThe message comes from a tavern in the veiled stair. I'll give you the note but... you should watch your back if you venture up there!
english.progress: So, my note found its way to you!
english.completion: My people have done their job and brought you to me. Wonderful.
english.completed: Seek out "The Black Prince" at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 异乡的陌生人
text.objectives: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆找到拉希奥。
text.description: 对不起，$c。你是$n吗？$b$b一个披着黑色斗篷的人让我把这个交给你。和你一样，她也是来自迷雾之外的旅行者，但是——我不相信她。$b$b她提到了“拉希奥”这个名字。这有没有让你想起什么？$b$b我会把信交给你的……但是你在去那里的时候一定要小心提防！
text.progress: So, we meet again!
text.completion: My people have done their job and brought you to me. Wonderful.
text.completed: 在雾纱栈道的迷雾酒肆找到拉希奥。

english.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
english.objectives: Seek out Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.
english.description: Excuse me, $c. Is your name $n?$b$bA figure in a dark cloak asked that I give this to you. She was a traveler from beyond the mists, like yourself, but - well, I didn't trust her.$b$bShe mentioned the name "Wrathion." Does that ring any bells for you?$b$bI'll give you the note but... you should watch your back if you're going to deal with these people.
english.progress: So, we meet again!
english.completion: My people have done their job and brought you to me. Wonderful.
english.completed: Seek out Wrathion at the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair.

text.title: 所有成员
text.objectives: 在血色大厅击败50个血色十字军的成员。
text.description: 首要的事情：让我们收拾那些血色十字军。$B$B当我说收拾掉血色十字军，我的意思是把他们彻底消灭干净，彻底摧毁这个组织。
text.completion: Great start, $n!$B$BIt won't be long now before the Scarlet Crusade is nothing more than an ugly footnote in the annals of history.
text.completed: Speak with the Hooded Crusader in the Scarlet Halls.

english.title: Rank and File
english.objectives: Kill 50 members of the Scarlet Crusade within the Scarlet Halls.
english.description: First things first; let's kill us some crusaders.$B$BAnd when I say kill the Scarlet Crusade, I mean wipe them out, root and branch, rank and file.
english.completion: Отличное начало, $n!$b$bСкоро от Алого ордена останется лишь безобразная строчка в анналах истории.
english.completed: Speak with the Hooded Crusader in the Scarlet Halls.

text.title: 力量火炬
text.objectives: 带着力量火炬去白虎寺的大门，别让它熄灭。
text.description: 雪怒认为这个挑战有助于“提升力量”。相对于我们其他人而言，我开始觉得“力量”这个词对他有着特殊的意义。$b$b拿着，将这个火炬放到寺庙大门上方。如果到达那里后火炬没有熄灭，你便赢得挑战。$b$b无论如何，不要拿着火炬骑在坐骑上。这样火炬会被风吹灭。相信我。
text.completion: Wow! You made it. Usually I get stopped by one of those gusts of wind.
text.completed: Speak with Lin Tenderpaw at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Torch of Strength
english.objectives: Carry the Torch of Strength to the gates of the Temple of the White Tiger without it extinguishing.
english.description: Xuen has this challenge he says helps "refine strength." I am starting to think the word "strength" means something different to him than the rest of us.$b$bHere, take this torch to the top of the gates of the temple. If you can get it there without the torch being extinguished, you pass the challenge.$b$bWhatever you do, do not try carrying the torch on a mount. It will blow out if you do. Trust me on that one.
english.completion: Wow! You made it. Usually I get stopped by one of those gusts of wind.
english.completed: Speak with Lin Tenderpaw at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 当然，只是为了保管
text.objectives: 收集十字军圣典。
text.description: 在大厅里，有一本书对我很有价值。$B$B可惜，它在织焰者孔格勒手中。我曾经试着去接近他，但都没有得手。$B$B你也许会比我幸运。不过要小心，我听说他确实丧失理智且变得很疯狂。织焰者打算把图书馆里所有的书籍都烧掉。$B$B他可能也会把血色大厅一起烧掉。
text.progress: It's imperative that I get my hands on the codex.
text.completion: Ah yes!$B$B<The Hooded Crusader rubs her hands together gleefully at the sight of the codex.>$B$BAnd now, I have a checklist with the name of every Scarlet Crusader on it!$B$BYou know... just in case any of them are unaccounted for. I don't like loose ends.
text.completed: Speak with the Hooded Crusader in the Scarlet Halls.
text.giverWindow: 他有十字军圣典。在他把它烧成灰烬前得到它。

english.title: Just for Safekeeping, Of Course
english.objectives: Collect the Codex of the Crusade.
english.description: There is a book of great value to me here in the halls.$B$BUnfortunately, it's in the possession of Flameweaver Koegler. I've tried to get close to him before, but it's never quite worked out.$B$BYou might have better luck. Just watch out -- I hear that he's gone well and truly insane. The Flameweaver plans to burn every tome they have in the library.$B$BHe'll probably burn the Scarlet Halls down in the process.
english.progress: It's imperative that I get my hands on the codex.
english.completion: О да!$B$B<Рыцарь в капюшоне радостно потирает руки при виде кодекса.>$B$BТеперь у меня есть перечень всех имен крестоносцев Алого ордена!$B$BА то, знаешь... мало ли, вдруг с кем-то из них еще не рассчитались. Не люблю быть должной.
english.completed: Speak with the Hooded Crusader in the Scarlet Halls.
english.giverWindow: He has the Codex of the Crusade. Get it from him before he burns it to ashes.

text.title: 逃出虫巢
text.objectives: 在夏柯希尔之巢打开恐虫笼子，释放8只恐虫幼体。
text.description: 夏柯希尔操纵者正在把年幼的恐虫捕捉到那个虫巢，让它们受到可怕能量的影响，扭曲它们的意志并加速它们的生长。$B$B恶心至极！我不允许这样的事情发生！$B$B打开牢笼，释放那些刚孵化出来的恐虫。
text.completion: Yes, I could see them rising up from the clutches. Beautiful!
text.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Free From Her Clutches
english.objectives: Break open Kunchong Cages to release 8 Kunchong Hatchlings in the Clutches of Shek'zeer.
english.description: The Shek'zeer manipulators are corralling young kunchong into that clutch and exposing them to raw fear energies, twisting them and accelerating their growth.$B$BDisgusting! I will not allow it!$B$BBreak open the cages and set those hatchlings free.
english.completion: Yes, I could see them rising up from the clutches. Beautiful!
english.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 所有成员
text.objectives: 在血色大厅击败50个血色十字军的成员。
text.description: 首要的事情：让我们收拾那些血色十字军。$B$B当我说收拾掉血色十字军，我的意思是把他们彻底消灭干净，彻底摧毁这个组织。
text.completion: Great start, $n!$B$BIt won't be long now before the Scarlet Crusade is nothing more than an ugly footnote in the annals of history.
text.completed: Speak with the Hooded Crusader in the Scarlet Halls.

english.title: Rank and File
english.objectives: Kill 50 members of the Scarlet Crusade within the Scarlet Halls.
english.description: First things first; let's kill us some crusaders.$B$BAnd when I say kill the Scarlet Crusade, I mean wipe them out, root and branch, rank and file.
english.completion: Great start, $n!$B$BIt won't be long now before the Scarlet Crusade is nothing more than an ugly footnote in the annals of history.
english.completed: Speak with the Hooded Crusader in the Scarlet Halls.

text.title: 帝国精华采样
text.objectives: 在恐惧之心外面的皇家采集器附近使用4次树脂罐，把它加满。
text.description: 凯帕圣树的树脂中蕴含的奇迹让我惊喜不断。在它数不清的特性和用途之中，有一项是可以提炼成既有营养又美味可口的药剂。$B$B无论你走到帝国的哪个角落，都无法找到比皇宫里出产的更好的佳酿了。当然，效忠者家里的采集器里盛满了这种甜美的甘露。$B$B在他们的采集器旁边灌满这个罐子，然后交给我。我真希望再尝一口皇室琼浆的味道。
text.completion: Ah, yes, hand it over! Quickly now! My forelegs are trembling with anticipation.
text.completed: Return to Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Sampling the Empire's Finest
english.objectives: Use the Sap Jar at Imperial Feeders outside the Heart of Fear 4 times to fill it.
english.description: The wonders of the kypari sap never cease to amaze me. Among its numerous properties and applications, the sap can be refined into a nutritious and extremely delectable elixir.$B$BNowhere in the Empire will you find a finer execution of this brew than the palace itself. Surely, the homes of the loyalists have feeders brimming with this sweet nectar.$B$BFill this jar at their feeders and return it to me. I long to sample the imperial ambrosia once more.
english.completion: Ah, yes, hand it over! Quickly now! My forelegs are trembling with anticipation.
english.completed: Return to Korven the Prime at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 当然，只是为了保管
text.objectives: 收集十字军圣典。
text.description: 在大厅里，有一本书对我很有价值。$B$B可惜，它在织焰者孔格勒手中。我曾经试着去接近他，但都没有得手。$B$B你也许会比我幸运。不过要小心，我听说他确实丧失理智且变得很疯狂。织焰者打算把图书馆里所有的书籍都烧掉。$B$B他可能也会把血色大厅一起烧掉。
text.progress: It's imperative that I get my hands on the codex.
text.completion: Ah yes!$B$B<The Hooded Crusader rubs her hands together gleefully at the sight of the codex.>$B$BAnd now, I have a checklist with the name of every Scarlet Crusader on it!$B$BYou know... just in case any of them are unaccounted for. I don't like loose ends.
text.completed: Speak with the Hooded Crusader in the Scarlet Halls.
text.giverWindow: 他有十字军圣典。在他把它烧成灰烬前得到它。

The Flameweaver plans to burn every tome they have in the library.$B$BHe'll probably burn the Scarlet Halls down in the process.
english.progress: It's imperative that I get my hands on the codex.
english.completion: Ah yes!$B$B<The Hooded Crusader rubs her hands together gleefully at the sight of the codex.>$B$BAnd now, I have a checklist with the name of every Scarlet Crusader on it!$B$BYou know... just in case any of them are unaccounted for. I don't like loose ends.

text.title: 摔绊
text.objectives: 在夏柯希尔之巢，从夏柯希尔挑衅者身上收集24个刺针翅膀。
text.description: 这个年代的年幼飞虫很不可思议。它们的灵活性和耐久性都很出色，在我那个年代，只有非常娴熟或成熟的飞虫才可以做到这一点。$B$B这似乎应该归功于翅膀结构的进化……或者是训练所带来的进步？诱发的基因突变？优良的品种培育？$B$B哼！如果没有完整的组织样本，是无法真正确定原因的。$B$B给我带一些翅膀来！收集样本的时候不要弄坏了翅膀，知道吗？我需要完整的翅膀！
text.progress: Do you have the specimens?
text.completion: Excellent, these are in fine shape.
text.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Wing Clip
english.objectives: Collect 24 Needler Wings from Shek'zeer Needlers in the Clutches of Shek'zeer.
english.description: The young fliers of this era are fascinating. Their exceptional agility and endurance were, in my time, the feats of incredibly skilled or mature fliers.$B$BThis would seem to indicate some kind of evolution in wing structure... Or perhaps a result of advancements in training? Induced genetic mutation? Selective breeding?$B$BGah! There's no way to know for certain without tissue samples.$B$BBring me their wings! And try not to ruin them in the process, will you? I need them intact!
english.progress: Do you have the specimens?
english.completion: Excellent, these are in fine shape.
english.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 欲速则不达
text.objectives: 在恐惧之心外面杀死巢卫纳卡尔。
text.description: 帝国的效忠者之中有一个战士，巢卫纳卡尔，他的力量不是来自于经验或进化，而是来自于基因改造。他注定要成为未来螳螂妖的样本，这种病态的观点认为我们生来就可以无比强壮，而不需要后天做任何训练。$B$B他是对我工作的一种嘲讽！基因增强只不过是在培养大批成熟的老兵而已！$B$B干掉他。或许这可以给大女皇夏柯希尔一个教训：欲速则不达。
text.completion: My enhancements are tools for experienced warriors. Not toys for these fool children!
text.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Shortcut to Ruin
english.objectives: Kill Vess-Guard Na'kal outside the Heart of Fear.
english.description: There is a champion among the loyalists, Vess-Guard Na'kal, whose strength comes not from experience or development, but from genetic modification. He was meant to be an example of the future of mantid - the sick idea that we can be born strong, without earning it.$B$BHe's a mockery of my work! Gene augmentation was meant for mature, post-swarm veterans ONLY!$B$BEnd him. Perhaps it will serve as a lesson to Grand Empress Shek'zeer that taking shortcuts leads to ruin.
english.completion: My enhancements are tools for experienced warriors. Not toys for these fool children!
english.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 销毁军械
text.objectives: 废除夏柯希尔之巢和恐惧之心周围的8个信息素地雷。
text.description: 如果大女皇的间谍仍然执行我那个年代的安全标准，他们应该在虫巢周围埋藏了强力的信息素地雷。$B$B她只需要简单的低语，就可以同时引爆所有信息素地雷，埋没整个皇宫，让攻城军队无计可施。$B$B如果我们想要在大规模的对峙中取胜，就必须废掉这些地雷。我们……见面时送给你的“礼物”可以帮你找到这些地雷。扰乱它们，然后躲到安全的地方。
text.completion: You weren't exposed to the pheromones were you? That could lead to... well, perhaps I shouldn't worry you with the details.
text.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

english.title: Ordnance Disposal
english.objectives: Disable 8 Pheromone Mines around the Clutches of Shek'zeer and the Heart of Fear.
english.description: If the Grand Empress's agents are still operating under security standards from my time, they would have hidden powerful pheromone mines all around the clutches.$B$BWith mere whisper she could detonate them all simultaneously, engulfing the palace and rendering entire siege armies powerless.$B$BIf we hope to have any success in a large scale standoff, we need to disable those mines. My... "gift" to you when we met will allow you to see the mines. Disturb them and get to a safe distance.
english.completion: You weren't exposed to the pheromones were you? That could lead to... well, perhaps I shouldn't worry you with the details.
english.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper at Klaxxi'vess in the Dread Wastes.

text.title: 巢穴卫士的职责
text.objectives: 在扎尼维斯杀死巢卫维克阿兹。
text.description: 巢卫维克阿兹指挥着扎尼维斯的守卫部队。他在战斗中抵得上10只螳螂妖，他的出现会鼓舞在扎尼提克作战的螳螂妖。$B$B不用多说，我们要杀死他。$B$B他在岛上中心部位的住宿区巡视。
text.completion: One by one, her champions fall.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Vess-Guard Duty
english.objectives: Kill Vess-Guard Vik'az in Zan'vess.
english.description: Vess-Guard Vik'az co-ordinates the defense forces at Zan'vess. He is worth ten mantid in battle, and his presence inspires the Zan'thik who fight alongside him.$B$BNeedless to say, we need him dead.$B$BHe patrols the housing area at the center of the island.
english.completion: One by one, her champions fall.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 统治者的镣铐
text.objectives: 在扎尼维斯，从被操控的矿工和被操控的蛮兵身上搜集6个扎尼提克镣铐。
text.description: 扎尼提克雇佣了一大批……受到束缚的劳工。$B$B野牛人被特殊的镣铐控制着，这种镣铐可以增强和延长音波操控的效果。扎尼提克的操控者正是使用了这种技术，以便命令如此众多的奴隶不分昼夜地在矿场辛苦工作。$B$B我要研究一下这些镣铐。
text.progress: Surely this is something you can handle, is it not?
text.completion: Ingenious devices, really. I have a feeling they will prove useful.
text.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Shackles of Manipulation
english.objectives: Collect 6 Zan'thik Shackles from Thought-Bound Miners and Thought-Bound Brutes in Zan'vess.
english.description: The Zan'thik employ a sizable force of... indentured labor.$B$BYaungol are bound in special shackles which enhance and prolong the effects of sonic manipulation. It is this technology that allows the Zan'thik manipulators to command such large quantities of thralls to endlessly toil for them in the quarries.$B$BI would like to study these shackles.
english.progress: Surely this is something you can handle, is it not?
english.completion: Ingenious devices, really. I have a feeling they will prove useful.
english.completed: Return to Kaz'tik the Manipulator in Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 熔解
text.objectives: 在扎尼维斯杀死6只扎尼提克毒刺虫。使用柯尔凡的实验手雷熔解它们的护甲层。
text.description: 扎尼维斯的毒刺蝎子从小就吃一种树脂，这会导致一种惊人的变异，它们的天然护甲层中会被注入琥珀。防护效果显著，它是有机的凯帕琥珀，与锻造帝国的大部分武器和盔甲时使用的物质相同。$B$B我想我找到了分解凯帕琥珀的化学方法了，但还需要测试一下。对扎尼提克的毒刺虫使用这种手榴弹，然后观察有什么效果。
text.completion: The kyparite ignited, did it? Fascinating!$B$BNot exactly what I was hoping for, but it's something.
text.completed: Return to Korven the Prime in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Meltdown
english.objectives: Slay 6 Zan'thik Venomstings in Zan'vess. Use Korven's Experimental Grenade to counter their armor plating.
english.description: The venomsting scorpions on Zan'vess are fed sap from a young age, causing a fascinating mutation in which their natural armor plating becomes infused with amber. Effectively, it's organic kyparite, the same substance used in forging most of the empire's weapons and armor.$B$BI think I've found a way to chemically break down kyparite, but it needs testing. Use these grenades on the Zan'thik venomstings and observe the results.
english.completion: The kyparite ignited, did it? Fascinating!$B$BNot exactly what I was hoping for, but it's something.
english.completed: Return to Korven the Prime in Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 样本需求
text.objectives: 从盐碱泥滩的污泥挖掘者身上收集6片凯帕琥珀碎片。
text.description: 为了模仿周围的环境，凯帕琥珀虫显示出了极强的适应性。他们能速度长出巨大的体型，这是其他大多数生物所不具备的。$B$B它们的生理机能可以为进一步突变提供宝贵的借鉴。$B$B从扎尼维斯附近浅滩的污泥挖掘者身上收集一些碎片样本交给我。
text.progress: Do you have the specimens?
text.completion: Well look at that, you actually got it done. I half expected to be scooping your remains out of the muck with a jar.
text.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Specimen Request
english.objectives: Collect 6 Kyparite Shards from Muck Tunnelers in The Briny Muck.
english.description: Kyparite worms have shown extreme adaptations in order to mimic the environment around them. They can also grow to immense sizes at rates which are nearly unheard of for most creatures.$B$BTheir physiology could provide valuable insight into further mutations.$B$BBring me sample shards from the muck tunnelers in the shallows near Zan'vess.
english.progress: Do you have the specimens?
english.completion: Well look at that, you actually got it done. I half expected to be scooping your remains out of the muck with a jar.
english.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector in Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 落地生根
text.objectives: 在扎尼维斯和盐碱泥滩摧毁15个恐怖孢子鳞茎。
text.description: 即使女皇夏柯希尔被推翻，她的疯狂妄行仍将流毒无穷。在未来的许多年里，我们将要努力奋斗来治愈我们的土地，但即便如此，我们的努力也可能徒劳无功。$B$B一种被煞能扭曲的新植物已经开始在扎尼维斯附近扎根了。快去摧毁你能找到的所有这种植物，但是小心——我们还不知道有什么样的邪恶力量在守护着它们。
text.completion: This species is interesting, but the risks associated with keeping it around for study are too high.
text.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Fear Takes Root
english.objectives: Destroy 15 Dreadspore Bulbs in Zan'vess and The Briny Muck.
english.description: The fallout from Shek'zeer's madness will continue long after her reign has ended. We will struggle to heal our lands for many years to come, and even then our efforts may prove fruitless.$B$BA new species of sha-twisted flora has begun taking root near Zan'vess. Destroy any that you find, but beware - there is no telling what kind of sinister defenses it may have.
english.completion: This species is interesting, but the risks associated with keeping it around for study are too high.
english.completed: Return to Rik'kal the Dissector at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 现在闭嘴
text.objectives: 在扎尼维斯的低语之石使用扎尼提克共鸣水晶，激怒副官赛克特并杀掉他。
text.description: 低语之石坐落于扎尼维斯的西南角。跟这里的塔很类似，它们是远距离传输声波信号的关键仪器。$B$B女皇的一位副官在操纵着那些石头，好让她与扎尼提克军队保持联系。快去破坏掉信号，然后让他闭上嘴。
text.completion: It must drive her further into paranoia and madness, losing contact with Zan'vess.$B$BGood. Let her suffer.
text.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Quiet Now
english.objectives: Interact with the Zan'thik Resonating Crystal at the Whispering Stones in Zan'vess to incite Adjunct Sek'ot, then slay him.
english.description: On the southwestern corner of Zan'vess lie the Whispering Stones. Much like the towers here, they are critical in transmitting long-range sonic signals.$B$BAn adjunct of the Empress operates the stones, keeping her in communication with the Zan'thik forces. Disrupt the signal, then silence him.
english.completion: It must drive her further into paranoia and madness, losing contact with Zan'vess.$B$BGood. Let her suffer.
english.completed: Return to Hisek the Swarmkeeper at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 历史见证
text.objectives: 去天神之门和烈日行者德兹科谈一谈。
text.description: 我将召集其他牛头人朝圣者一起奔赴锦绣谷。$b$b去昆莱山南麓的天神之门与我会合，我们好好谈一谈。
text.completion: Thank you for coming so quickly.$B$BFor thousands of years, the Golden Lotus has kept the Vale safe from those who would seek its power.$B$BUnfortunately, that time is past, and we need your help.
text.completed: Speak to Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: A Witness to History
english.objectives: Speak with Sunwalker Dezco at the Gate of the August Celestials.
english.description: I will gather up the other Tauren pilgrims and we will travel into the Vale together.$b$bMeet me at the Gate of the August Celestials at the southern edge of Kun-Lai Summit and speak with me there.
english.completion: Thank you for coming so quickly.$B$BFor thousands of years, the Golden Lotus has kept the Vale safe from those who would seek its power.$B$BUnfortunately, that time is past, and we need your help.
english.completed: Speak to Madam Vee Luo at the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

objectiveDetails.description: 与天神之门的德兹科交谈

text.title: 历史见证
text.objectives: 去天神之门和安度因·乌瑞恩谈一谈。
text.description: 天神允许我们返回山谷了！这将是无比盛大的场面。$b$b我们不该浪费时间，赶快前往昆莱山南麓的天神之门，与我谈一谈。
text.completion: Thank you for coming so quickly.$B$BFor thousands of years, the Golden Lotus has kept the Vale safe from those who would seek its power.$B$BUnfortunately, that time is past, and we need your help.
text.completed: Speak to Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

english.title: A Witness to History
english.objectives: Speak with Anduin Wrynn at the Gate of the August Celestials.
english.description: The celestials are allowing us back into the Vale! This will be a sight to behold.$b$bWe shouldn't waste any time. Head to the Gate of the August Celestials at the southern edge of Kun-Lai Summit and speak with me there.
english.completion: Thank you for coming so quickly.$B$BFor thousands of years, the Golden Lotus has kept the Vale safe from those who would seek its power.$B$BUnfortunately, that time is past, and we need your help.
english.completed: Speak to Matron Vi Vinh at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

objectiveDetails.description: 与天神之门的安度因交谈

text.title: 圣化长剑
text.objectives: 收集两把圣化长剑。
text.description: 血色十字军的问题是，即使死后，他们会不断死灰复燃。$B$B大检察官怀特迈恩在幕后控制着这些死尸的复活。如果她死了，十字军也将随之覆灭。$B$B让她彻底死亡，我们需要传说中的两把剑，每一把都有着残缺但传奇的历史。$B$B我很幸运……呃，这两把圣化长剑就在修道院内放着。$B$B去寻找这两把剑。一旦你击败了怀特迈恩，就使用圣化长剑的力量净化她，使她安息。
text.progress: <With one blade already in your possession, you move to take the other.>$B$B<An inscription on the statue behind the sword reads, "The Hand of Providence".>
text.completion: <The second anointed blade floats just in front of the wet statue. Steam rises from the sword.>$B$B<You get the uncanny feeling that the Hand of Providence has been waiting for you.>
text.completed: Find the second Blade of the Anointed in the Scarlet Monastery.

english.title: Blades of the Anointed
english.objectives: Collect the two Blades of the Anointed.
english.description: The problem with the Scarlet Crusade is that they keep coming back, even after death.$B$BBehind those resurrections is High Inquisitor Whitemane. With her death, so goes the Crusade.$B$BTo give her the final rest, we need two swords of legend, each with a lost but storied history.$B$BLuckily for me... er, us, these two blades of the anointed are at rest here within the monastery.$B$BFind them and once you've killed Whitemane, plunge the blades into her corpse to make the death permanent.
english.progress: <You have already taken possession of one sword and are going to take another.>$B$B<Behind the sword is a statue, the inscription on which reads "The Will of Providence.">
english.completion: < The second sword of the anointed soars in the air just before the wet statue. Steam rises from the sword.$B$B< You somehow feel that the Will of Providence is waiting for you. >
english.completed: Find the second Blade of the Anointed in the Scarlet Monastery.

text.title: 人本尘身，终归尘土
text.objectives: 使用两把圣化长剑净化大检察官怀特迈恩，令她永远安息。
text.description: <第二把圣化长剑，你感受一下这两把宝剑传递给你的力量。>$B$B<还有最后一件事要做。正如神秘的蒙面女子所说，要结束血色十字军的统治，你必须使用两把圣化长剑的力量净化大检察官怀特迈恩。
text.completion: With Whitemane gone for good, the Scarlet Crusade is finished. It's just a matter of sweeping up the refuse.$B$BThank you, $n. Not just for myself, but for everyone opposed to mindless hatred and bigotry.$B$BAnd, thank you for these two new blades. Anointed anew in her blood, they should serve me well as I take the fight to Scholomance and deal with Darkmaster Gandling.$B$BI bid you adieu for now.
text.completed: Speak with Lilian Voss in the Scarlet Monastery.
text.giverWindow: 使用圣化长剑的力量净化她，终结血色十字军的暴政统治。

english.title: Unto Dust Thou Shalt Return
english.objectives: Use the Blades of the Anointed on the corpse of High Inquisitor Whitemane to send her permanently to her final rest.
english.description: <You take the second anointed blade in hand and feel the power of both swords course through you.>$B$B<There is but one thing left to do. As the mysterious, hooded woman explained, to put an end to the Scarlet Crusade, you must thrust both blades into the corpse of High Inquisitor Whitemane.>
english.completion: Теперь, когда Вайтмейн больше нет, Алому ордену настанет конец. Теперь осталось убрать мусор.$B$BСпасибо тебе, $n. Не только от меня, но от всех, кто противостоял их злобе и ненависти.$B$BИ позволь поблагодарить за новые мечи. Они послужат мне верой и правдой в Некроситете, когда я буду сражаться с темным магистром Гандлингом.$B$BДо скорой встречи.
english.completed: Speak with Lilian Voss in the Scarlet Monastery.
english.giverWindow: Thrust the anointed blades into her corpse and bring a final end to the tyranny of the Scarlet Crusade.

text.title: 与恶霸抗争
text.objectives: 击败烁奴夫。
text.description: 我们崇尚力量，而非暴力。不幸的是，一些慕名而来的挑战者忽略了这一点。$b$B我曾经驱逐过这样一个挑战者。他为了报复我，洗劫了银影村。$b$b前往寺院东南边的银影村，去挑战“烁奴夫”。让他见识一下真正的力量。
text.completion: I commend your victory and thank you for dealing with that ruffian.
text.completed: Speak with Xuen at the Tiger Temple in Kun-Lai Summit.
text.giverWindow: 舞火“大师”。

english.title: Contending With Bullies
english.objectives: Defeat Shonuf.
english.description: We honor strength here, not brutality. It is unfortunate but there are some who come to my doorstep oblivious to this distinction.$b$BI have turned away one such challenger. In retaliation, he sacked the village of Yinying.$b$bGo to Yinying Village southeast of the temple, and face this "Shonuf." Give him a lesson in true strength.
english.completion: I commend your victory and thank you for dealing with that ruffian.
english.completed: Speak with Xuen at the Tiger Temple in Kun-Lai Summit.
english.giverWindow: The "Master" of Fireweaving.

text.title: The Vale of Eternal Blossoms
text.objectives: Speak to Anduin at the Gate of the August Celestials.
text.description: It's been many lifetimes since the gates to the valley were open, $n.$b$bI wouldn't miss this for the world, and neither should you!$b$bMeet me at the southen edge of Kun-Lai Summit. I'll wait for you there.

text.title: 艰难的挑战：破桶而出的炎诛
text.objectives: 完成风暴烈酒酿造厂挑战。
text.description: $n，我要你去召集一支亲友队伍，前往风暴烈酒酿造厂。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，并击败破桶而出的炎诛。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
text.completion: You have my sincerest thanks, $n. Without fine Stormstout brews to lighten the drudgery of the day, the world would be a dull place indeed.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的双月殿找挑战者吴立。

english.title: A Worthy Challenge: Yan-zhu the Uncasked
english.objectives: Complete the Stormstout Brewery Challenge Mode.
english.description: $n, I need you to assemble a hearty group and lead them into Stormstout Brewery. Activate the Challenger's Orb therein, and evaporate Yan-zhu the Uncasked.$B$BReturn to me when you've completed this challenge, and I shall reward you handsomely.
english.completion: You have my sincerest thanks, $n. Without fine Stormstout brews to lighten the drudgery of the day, the world would be a dull place indeed.
english.completed: Return to Challenger Wuli in the Shrine of Two Moons in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

objectiveDetails.description: Complete the Stormstout Brewery Challenge Mode

text.objectives: 完成青龙寺挑战。
text.description: $n，我要你去召集一支队伍，前往青龙寺。你要激活那里的挑战者的宝珠，并击败疑之煞。$B$B完成这个挑战后，你再回来找我。我会好好奖赏你的。
text.completion: You have my gratitude, $n. You've displayed great valor today, and the speed at which you completed the challenge surely will impress your friends and intimidate your foes.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的双月殿找挑战者吴立。

text.title: 成为大师
text.objectives: 制作黑胡椒牛排、海雾米线、魔古鱼汤、清蒸肥蟹、春卷和疯酒师的早餐，然后回去找引路人。
text.description: 将来有一天，你会掌握所有我们教给你的东西。当那天到来时，将轮到你去传授别人。当你证明自己已经掌握所有方法时，回来和我谈谈。
text.completion: You have been a great student. Now you should share your knowledge with others. I hope you will speak with the Stock Master and take on an apprentice as soon as you can.
text.completed: Return to the Guide to the Ways.

english.title: To Be a Master
english.objectives: Make Black Pepper Steak, Sea Mist Rice Noodles, Mogu Fish Stew, Steamed Crab, Chun Tian Spring Roll and Mad Brewer's Breakfast, then return to the Guide to the Ways.
english.description: There will come a day when you have mastered all that we have to teach you. When that day comes, it will be time for you to teach others in turn. When you have proven to yourself that you have mastered all the Ways, come back and speak with me.
english.completion: You have been a great student. Now you should share your knowledge with others. I hope you will speak with the Stock Master and take on an apprentice as soon as you can.
english.completed: Return to the Guide to the Ways.

text.completion: Many blessings upon you, $n. Driving hatred from this world so quickly deserves rich reward.
text.completed: 去锦绣谷的双月殿找挑战者吴立。

text.title: 任务：杀掉兔妖
text.objectives: 击败12只弹尾兔妖。
text.description: 我被派往四风谷保护汇风岭，应对那些潜在的威胁。$B$B我发现了一个重要目标。弹尾兔妖钻入了农场上方的悬崖中。$B$B这些家伙数量不明，而且将来可能会增加，他们会找到通向农田的道路。$B$B必须消灭他们。
text.completion: The targets are eliminated? Well done, $C.
text.completed: Return to Sho at Kunzen Village or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Mission: Culling The Vermin
english.objectives: Kill 12 Springtail vermin.
english.description: I was sent to this valley to protect The Heartland from any potential threats.$B$BI've identified a high priority target. The Springtail vermin burrow into the mountain cliffs, high above the farmlands.$B$BLeft unchecked, their numbers will multiply, and they will make their way down to the fields below.$B$BThey must be eliminated.
english.completion: The targets are eliminated? Well done, $C.
english.completed: Return to Sho at Kunzen Village or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 任务：一打猢狲
text.objectives: 击败12只弹尾兔妖。
text.description: 从到达营地后，我就一直监视着猢狲。我不喜欢在猢狲营地所看到的活动规律。$B$B几十个猢狲在夜幕的掩护下，偷偷爬下山去，掠夺农田里的东西。$B$B我们必须阻止他们这种肆意盗窃的行为。我已经尽力减少他们的数量，但一个人势单力薄。$B$B我需要你的帮助。尽量多杀死几只猢狲。
text.completed: 回四风谷的昆森村或半山市集找阿烁。

english.title: Mission: The Hozen Dozen
english.objectives: Kill 12 Springtail vermin.
english.description: I've been watching the hozen since I arrived, and I don't like the pattern of activity that I'm seeing in their camp.$B$BMultiple hozen travel down the mountain under the cover of night, pillaging supplies from the farmlands below.$B$BWe must stop their rampant theft. I have been thinning their numbers when I can, but one soldier alone is not enough.$B$BI need your help. Kill as many of the hozen as you can.
english.completed: Return to Sho at Kunzen Village or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 任务：艾黎的威胁
text.objectives: 击败12只峭壁猛鸢。
text.description: 我发现了另一个高危目标，这是个大多数人都不会去怀疑的事情。$B$B峭壁猛鸢在大山东边翱翔是非常危险的。$B$B我看到猛鸢在没有人看护的时候，俯冲到农场中，掠走了谷物和种子。我们必须削减它们的数量。
text.completion: I knew you would carry out the mission without any problems. Well done, $n.
text.completed: Return to Sho at Kunzen Village or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Mission: Aerial Threat
english.objectives: Kill 12 Cliff Kites.
english.description: I've identified another high risk target, one that most people would not suspect.$B$BThe cliff kites soaring above the hills to the east are quite dangerous.$B$BI have seen them swooping down to the farms, snatching grain and seed when no one is looking.$B$BIn order to protect the farms, we must thin their numbers.
english.completion: I knew you would carry out the mission without any problems. Well done, $n.
english.completed: Return to Sho at Kunzen Village or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 任务：悬崖掠食者
text.objectives: 击败巨型峭壁猛鸢。
text.description: 上午，我在山区例行巡逻时，发现了一只硕大的白鸟俯冲到农田中。$B$B它用利爪掠走了一只牦牛，然后消失在悬崖之间。$B$B今天一只牦牛，明天就是一个雇农啊！$B$B我们必须在它选择下一个猎物之前，将其剿杀。
text.completion: You did it, $n! I feel at ease knowing the Valley safer now, because of you.
text.completed: Return to Sho at Kunzen Village or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Mission: Predator of the Cliffs
english.objectives: Kill the Great Cliff Hawk.
english.description: During my routine patrol of the mountains this morning, I spotted a huge white bird diving down to the farmlands.$B$BIt lifted an entire yak in its talons and disappeared among the cliffs.$B$BToday a yak, tomorrow a farmhand!$B$BWe must eliminate this bird before it chooses its next victim.
english.completion: You did it, $n! I feel at ease knowing the Valley safer now, because of you.
english.completed: Return to Sho at Kunzen Village or the Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: The Perfect Feather
text.objectives: Bring the feather to Old Hillpaw at Old Hillpaw's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
text.description: This beautifully pristine feather is unlike any you have seen before in the Valley.$B$BThere is one person who might be interested in seeing this feather.

english.title: The Perfect Feather
english.objectives: Bring the feather to Old Hillpaw at Old Hillpaw's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: This beautifully pristine feather is unlike any you have seen before in the Valley.$B$BThere is one person who might be interested in seeing this feather.

text.title: 初学者酿的酒
text.objectives: 去郝瀚·泥爪那里找一个甘甜湖瓜，问吉娜·泥爪要一个毛桃，向玉儿·采苇拿一个黑樱桃，从农夫老方那里取一个红萝卜。
text.description: 你能保守秘密吗，$n？$B$B我已经开始尝试动手酿酒了。我所有的仅仅是这个破旧的手工蒸馏器，但是它依然运转如故。$B$B我有一个酿造新酒的想法，但是还需要一些原料。$B$B我遇到镇民时非常害羞，但是我看见你四下结交朋友。$B$B你愿意问农夫要一些原料给我吗？
text.progress: I don't know what it is. Maybe it's staring at that brewery day in and day out, but I just feel... like I want to brew the best beer in the Valley... no... all of Pandaria!$B$BOh, it's a silly dream, isn't it?
text.completion: You got them! This is wonderful, $n!$B$BI'll get started on the brew as soon as I can.
text.completed: Return to Ella at Ella's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: The Beginner's Brew
english.objectives: Collect 1 Sweet Lakemelon from Haohan Mudclaw, 1 Fuzzy Peach from Gina Mudclaw, 1 Black Cherries from Fish Fellreed, and 1 Red Radish from Farmer Fung.
english.description: Can you keep a secret, $n?$B$BI've been trying my hand at brewing. All I've got is this old hand-made still, but it still works pretty good.$B$BI've got an idea for a new brew, but I need some ingredients.$B$BI'm awful shy around the townsfolk, but I've seen you making friends all around.$B$BWould you be willing to ask the farmers for some ingredients for me?
english.progress: I don't know what it is. Maybe it's staring at that brewery day in and day out, but I just feel... like I want to brew the best beer in the Valley... no... all of Pandaria!$B$BOh, it's a silly dream, isn't it?
english.completion: You got them! This is wonderful, $n!$B$BI'll get started on the brew as soon as I can.
english.completed: Return to Ella at Ella's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 赞助食堂
text.objectives: 给纳姆·铁掌带去一包食材。食材包可以在商贩程合处买到。
text.description: 来自潘达利亚各处的人们向铁掌家族学习烹饪。我们不仅为自己是最好的厨师，也为能将我们的技艺传授给他人而感到无比自豪。这就是我们尽量收取低额烹饪课费用的原因。$b$b这意味着，不管怎样，我们常常发现用于上烹饪课的原料不足。你愿意为学校捐款，帮助那些付不起学费的学员吗？
text.progress: It's hard to learn how to cook if you don't have ingredients to cook with.
text.completion: Your help is very much appreciated. This will make a great difference for some of our students.
text.completed: Give a Bundle of Groceries to Nam Ironpaw.

english.title: Replenishing the Pantry
english.objectives: Bring Nam Ironpaw a Bundle of Groceries. Bundles of Groceries can be created by using containers sold by Merchant Cheng.
english.description: People come from all over Pandaria to learn cooking from the Ironpaw family.  We take great pride not only in being the best chefs, but also in passing what we know onto others.  That's why we try to charge as little as possible for cooking lessons.$b$bThis means, however, that we often find ourselves in shortage of cooking ingredients for the lessons.  Would you donate some to the school, to help out students who cannot afford it?
english.progress: It's hard to learn how to cook if you don't have ingredients to cook with.
english.completion: Your help is very much appreciated. This will make a great difference for some of our students.
english.completed: Give a Bundle of Groceries to Nam Ironpaw.

text.title: 保持新鲜
text.objectives: 带一个空的生虎排包装给纳姆·铁掌。
text.description: 为了最大程度地保持新鲜，烹饪材料需要妥善保存。还好，那边的商贩程合就出售上好的容器。我实在不愿意让你屈尊去办这么卑微的差事，但能否帮我买一个空的生虎排包装来呢？
text.progress: Ingredients will spoil if not stored properly.
text.completion: Ah, good. Now these ingredients will stay fresh until we're ready to cook.
text.completed: Give Nam Ironpaw the Empty Tiger Meat Basket.

english.title: Preserving Freshness
english.objectives: Bring Nam Ironpaw an Empty Tiger Meat Basket.
english.description: To preserve maximum freshness, cooking ingredients need to be stored properly. Fortunately, Merchant Cheng over there sells good containers.  I hate to send you on such a menial errand, but would you go purchase an empty tiger meat basket for me?
english.progress: Ingredients will spoil if not stored properly.
english.completion: Ah, good. Now these ingredients will stay fresh until we're ready to cook.
english.completed: Give Nam Ironpaw the Empty Tiger Meat Basket.

text.title: 艾拉的鉴赏品尝
text.objectives: 问问醉鬼贾古、博布·铁掌、农夫老愚和娜娜·泥爪觉得艾拉的酒怎么样。
text.description: 好，终于酿制好了，但是在某些人品尝之前，我不知道它到底如何。$B$B你愿意拿着我酿的酒去半山市集，看看那里的人对酒的评价吗？$B$B我……我不敢面对他们。
text.completion: Really? That's what they really said? Wow!
text.completed: Return to Ella at Ella's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Ella's Taste Test
english.objectives: Ask Jogu the Drunk, Bobo Ironpaw, Farmer Yoon, and Nana Mudclaw what they think of Ella's Brew.
english.description: Well, I finally got the brew made, but I won't know if it's any good unless some people taste it.$B$BWould you take my brew and see what the folks in Halfhill think?$B$BI... I couldn't face them myself.
english.completion: Правда? Они прямо так и сказали? Ну надо же!
english.completed: Return to Ella at Ella's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 物有所值的酒
text.objectives: 让陈·风暴烈酒尝尝艾拉的酒。
text.description: 还需要最后一个人品尝一下我的酒。$B$B我听说他去过很多地方，品尝过世界各地的酒。$B$B他刚好来到镇子里，我想知道他怎么评价我的技艺。
text.completion: You aren't pulling my leg are ya, $n? If he really said that, well... I guess... I guess it means I can do it, after all!$B$BThank you, $n. You've really helped me gain confidence in myself.
text.completed: Return to Ella at Ella's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: A Worthy Brew
english.objectives: Ask Chen Stormstout to taste Ella's Brew.
english.description: There's one final person who needs to taste my brew.$B$BI've heard that he's traveled far and wide, and tasted drinks from all over the world.$B$BHe happens to be in town, and I'd like to know what he thinks of my skills.
english.completion: You aren't pulling my leg are ya, $n? If he really said that, well... I guess... I guess it means I can do it, after all!$B$BThank you, $n. You've really helped me gain confidence in myself.
english.completed: Return to Ella at Ella's House or Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 精美的杰作
text.objectives: 创作一幅委托的画作，并将其交给翡翠林百木园的墨水大师魏。你可在铭文面板下的任务列表中找到配方。
text.description: 我们生活在一个魔法世界。我们当中的某些人可以将魔法注入到我们的工艺品当中，赋予其能量。这些东西都非常有价值。$b$b但是，能够创造出那种不靠魔力，而是靠本身的艺术性而流传千古的艺术珍品的人则更少。$b$b青龙寺正好委托我们创造这样一件物品，我相信你是我们中最能胜任的。你愿意接受委托吗？
text.progress: This is a grand project. It will take much time and effort, even from a craftsman such as you.
text.completion: This... This is beyond my wildest expectations. This will be treasured and preserved for generations to come.
text.completed: Bring the Commissioned Painting to Inkmaster Wei.

english.title: A Thing of Beauty
english.objectives: Craft a Commissioned Painting and bring it to Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
english.description: We live in a world of magic.The few among us who are skilled can imbue this magic into the things we craft and give them power. Such things are valued.$b$bFewer still, however, are those among us who can create things that are cherished through the ages not because they are imbued with power, but because of their great beauty.$b$bThe Temple of the Jade Serpent has commissioned us for such a work, and I believe you are the worthiest among us.  Will you accept the commission?
english.progress: This is a grand project. It will take much time and effort, even from a craftsman such as you.
english.completion: This... This is beyond my wildest expectations. This will be treasured and preserved for generations to come.
english.completed: Bring the Commissioned Painting to Inkmaster Wei.

text.title: 天禅院的法杖
text.objectives: 打造3根幽冥杖和2根雨粟杖，并将其交给翡翠林百木园的墨水大师魏。
text.description: 今年天禅院似乎培养了很多武僧。我们已经收到大量法杖的制作委托任务。而且，这个大量指的是非常巨大的量。$b$b你能承担此项委托任务吗？我感激不尽。当然，你将得到应得的回报。
text.progress: So many staves! How many monks do they have?!
text.completion: Fine craftsmanship. The monks will appreciate these.
text.completed: Return to Inkmaster Wei.

english.title: Staves for Tian Monastery
english.objectives: Craft 3 Ghost Iron Staves and 2 Rain Poppy Staves. Bring them to Inkmaster Wei at the Arboretum in the Jade Forest.
english.description: It seems like the Tian Monsatery is training a lot of monks this year. We've received a huge commission for staves. And by huge, I mean HUGE.$b$bCould you take on part of the commission? I'd very much appreciate it. You will receive the rewards for your portion, of course.
english.progress: So many staves! How many monks do they have?!
english.completion: Fine craftsmanship. The monks will appreciate these.
english.completed: Return to Inkmaster Wei.

text.title: 玉雕
text.objectives: 制作一块铭文玉碟，并将其交给翡翠林百木园的墨水大师乔波。你可在铭文面板下的任务列表中找到配方。
text.description: 邝大师是我们这个时代最伟大的诗人之一。他为一位绝世美女作了一首诗，而半山市集的一位商人想将这些字刻在石头上，以便自豪地在她家中展示。她要求让技巧精湛的人承接这项工作。你愿意接受委托吗？
text.progress: How is it coming along?
text.completion: Beautiful. This will be cherished.
text.completed: Give the Engraved Jade Disc to Inkmaster Jo Po.

english.title: Set in Jade
english.objectives: Craft an Engraved Jade Disc and bring it to Inkmaster Jo Po at the Arboretum, in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
english.description: One of the greatest poets of our time is Master Kwang. He has composed a poem of great beauty, and a merchant in Halfhill would like to have these words inscribed in stone, to display proudly in her home. She has requested a scribe of great skill to take on this job. Will you accept the commission?
english.progress: How is it coming along?
english.completion: Beautiful. This will be cherished.
english.completed: Give the Engraved Jade Disc to Inkmaster Jo Po.

text.title: 血红墨水
text.objectives: 要想调出墨水大师格伦苏想要的色彩，需要采用非常规的颜料。他的描述令你想到了鲜血的颜色——尤其是虎血……$b$b制作5份血红墨水。你可在铭文面板下的任务列表中找到配方。
text.description: 练习书法是潘达利亚的古老习俗。我正想创作一幅有关古代战争的作品，但首先要寻找适合这个题材的墨水。$b$b我已经尝试了数种不同深浅色调的颜色，但都无法令我满意。你能帮我找到颜色适合的墨水吗？
text.progress: I cannot find the right color!
text.completion: Where did you... How did you... This is perfect!
text.completed: Give 5 Incarnadine Ink to Inkmaster Glenzu.

english.title: Incarnadine Ink
english.objectives: To attain the color Inkmaster Glenzu is seeking will require an unconventional source of pigment. His description evokes in your mind the color of blood - specifically the blood of tigers...$b$b Craft 5 Incarnadine Ink. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
english.description: The practice of caligraphy is an old custom in Pandaria. I am working on a piece about an ancient war, so I seek an ink that is suitable to the subject matter.$b$bI have searched high and low for the right hue, but it eludes me. Can you think of  a way to achieve the color I am seeking?
english.progress: I cannot find the right color!
english.completion: Where did you... How did you... This is perfect!
english.completed: Give 5 Incarnadine Ink to Inkmaster Glenzu.

text.title: 女士肖像
text.objectives: 绘制一幅郭雅夫人的肖像画，并将其交给翡翠林百木园的墨水大师格伦苏。你可在铭文面板下的任务列表中找到配方。
text.description: 许多伟大的艺术作品源自于伟大的爱情。半山集市的一位商人希望以他挚爱的肖像画作为生日礼物。你愿意接受这份委托吗？
text.progress: It is a wonderful thing to see a man so in love.
text.completion: A fine painting.
text.completed: Return to Inkmaster Glenzu.

english.title: Portrait of a Lady
english.objectives: Paint a Portrait of Madam Goya and bring it to Inkmaster Glenzu at the Arboretum, in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
english.description: Many great pieces of art are results of great love.  A merchant in Halfhill wishes to have a portrait made for his beloved, as a birthday present.  Will you accept this commission?
english.progress: It is a wonderful thing to see a man so in love.
english.completion: A fine painting.
english.completed: Return to Inkmaster Glenzu.

text.title: 死者的纪念
text.objectives: 制作一块铭文纪念石碑，并将其交给翡翠林百木园的墨水大师乔波。你可在铭文面板下的任务列表中找到配方。
text.description: 万物有始亦有终——即便是好人也一样。昆莱有个家族已经委托我们为他们最近刚辞世的敬爱的族长制作一块纪念石碑。你愿意接受这份委托吗？
text.progress: Respect for the dead is part of our traditions.
text.completion: A fine work to honor a fine man.
text.completed: Return to Inkmaster Jo Po.

english.title: A Tribute to the Dead
english.objectives: Create an Inscribed Monument Stone and bring it to Inkmaster Jo Po at the Arboretum, in the Jade Forest. The recipe can be found in your Inscription pane under Quests.
english.description: All things must come to an end - even the life of a good man.  A family in Kun Lai has commissioned a monument for their beloved patriarch who has passed on recently.  Will you accept the commission?
english.progress: Respect for the dead is part of our traditions.
english.completion: A fine work to honor a fine man.
english.completed: Return to Inkmaster Jo Po.

text.title: 驯服宠物
text.objectives: 赢得一场宠物战斗。
text.description: 既然你是一名宠物训练师，那么考验你技术的时候到了！$b$b前往峡谷并挑选一只战斗宠物进行决斗。赢了之后回来找我，我会继续你的训练。祝你好运！
text.completion: Nice work, $n! You're better with those pets than I thought!
text.completed: Return to Grady Bannson in Kharanos and notify him of your victory!

english.title: Learning the Ropes
english.objectives: Win a pet battle.
english.description: Now that you are a pet trainer, it's time to test your skills!$b$bHead out into the valley and pick a fight with a battle pet.  Come back to me after you have won and I will continue your training.  Good luck!
english.completion: Nice work, $n! You're better with those pets than I thought!
english.completed: Return to Grady Bannson in Kharanos and notify him of your victory!

text.title: 治疗宠物
text.objectives: 拜访兽栏管理员谢尔比·石火，治疗你的宠物。
text.description: 既然你已经赢得了一场战斗，我们就需要治疗你的宠物，这样它们才能继续战斗！拜访一下我们这里的兽栏管理员谢尔比·石火，来治疗和复活你的宠物。
text.completion: Now those look like some healthy pets, $n. Remember, you can heal and revive your entire collection of pets at any time by visiting a stable master.
text.completed: Return to Grady Bannson in Kharanos.
text.giverWindow: 这里的兽栏管理员谢尔比·石火可以治疗和复活你的宠物。

english.title: On The Mend
english.objectives: Heal your pets to full health by visiting Shelby Stoneflint the Stable Master.
english.description: Now that you have won a battle, we need to heal up your pets so they can fight another day!  Visit Shelby Stoneflint, our local stable master, to heal and revive your pets.
english.completion: Now those look like some healthy pets, $n. Remember, you can heal and revive your entire collection of pets at any time by visiting a stable master.
english.completed: Return to Grady Bannson in Kharanos.
english.giverWindow: Shelby Stoneflint, the local Stable Master, can heal and revive your pets.

text.title: 捉到一只！
text.objectives: 捕获一只战斗宠物。
text.description: 你的表现到目前为止都很不错，$n。你在不知不觉中已经成了一个宠物方面的专家，现在是时候去抓一个属于你自己的宠物了！$b$b去外面找一个战斗宠物并与其交战，当它体力不支时抛出你的陷阱。一旦你完成后，记得把捕获的宠物带给我瞧瞧。$b$b记住，你至少要有一个宠物达到了3级才能使用陷阱！
text.completion: I see... an excellent choice. You're on your way to building up a great team!$B$BRemember, you have the opportunity to catch any pet you can fight, so go ahead and try to get as many as you can during your adventures.
text.completed: Return to Marcus Jensen in Goldshire and show him what you caught!

english.title: Got one!
english.objectives: Catch a battle pet.
english.description: Great work so far $n.  You are going to be a pro at this pet stuff before you know it.  Now it's time to catch a pet of your own!$b$bHead back out and find a battle pet to fight, engage it in battle and throw your trap once it's low on health.  Bring your catch back for me to see once you are finished.$b$bRemember, you need at least one pet at level 3 to use your trap!
english.completion: Что ж, прекрасный выбор. Рано или поздно ты соберешь отличную коллекцию!$b$bПомни, любого питомца, с которым можно драться, можно и поймать, так что не упускай такую возможность, если она вдруг появится.
english.completed: Return to Marcus Jensen in Goldshire and show him what you caught!

text.objectives: 把巨型恐虫颚骨交给卡拉克西维斯的琥珀匠师齐克。
text.description: <卡拉克西维斯的某些人应该很重视恐虫主母卡兰诺希的巨大颚骨。>
text.completion: I recognize those mandibles. Karanosh ate my brother, you know.$B$BOf course, I have millions of brothers.$B$B<Zikk cackles.>
text.completed: 把巨型恐虫颚骨交给卡拉克西维斯的琥珀匠师齐克。

text.title: Assault on Zan'vess
text.objectives: Complete the Assault on Zan'vess scenario. Speak with Klaxxi'va Vor or use the Looking For Dungeon tool to begin.
text.description: The island settlement of Zan'vess is the last hope for the future of my kind. Although the mantid there are loyal to Shek'zeer, the kypari itself has been spared the sha corruption that has befallen the mainland.$B$BStill, under imperial orders, the Zan'thik are draining sap at an unsustainable rate.$B$BYou have proven yourself a capable asset. The council wants you to lead an assault on the island. Disrupt their operations and keep the kypari healthy.$B$BSpeak with me when you are ready to begin.
text.completed: Return to Klaxxi'va Vor at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 扎尼提克的发现
text.objectives: 在扎尼维斯的琥珀采掘场找到被挖出的英杰。
text.description: 我们刚刚从一名扎尼维斯副官那里截获了一个消息。野牛人劳工在岛上另一边的琥珀采掘场挖出了一名英杰。$B$B赶快过去，在扎尼提克杀害他之前把他救出来！
text.completion: <From the looks of it, this mantid was just recently broken out of his chamber. He lets out a hacking cough.>$B$B...Diss-ec...tor... has... returned...
text.completed: 在扎尼维斯的琥珀采掘场找到被挖出的英杰。

english.title: The Zan'thik Dig
english.objectives: Locate the unearthed paragon in the Amber Quarry on Zan'vess.
english.description: We have just intercepted a message from an adjunct on Zan'vess. Yaungol laborers there have unearthed a paragon in the amber quarry on the back side of the island.$B$BGet there immediately and free him before the Zan'thik destroy him!
english.completion: <From the looks of it, this mantid was just recently broken out of his chamber. He lets out a hacking cough.>$B$B...Diss-ec...tor... has... returned...
english.completed: Locate the unearthed paragon in the Amber Quarry on Zan'vess.

text.title: 切割者觉醒
text.objectives: 在里卡尔苏醒时阻挡扎尼提克的攻击。
text.description: 你……和其他人不太一样……$B$B我听到了卡拉克西的召唤……<咳咳>$B$B我需要一点时间。
text.completion: Look at you! Many parts and pieces... yes... and all of them so good at killing. Fascinating.$B$BI must pick your brain some time. Muhahah.
text.completed: Speak with Rik'kal the Dissector on Zan'vess or in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: The Dissector Wakens
english.objectives: Hold off the Zan'thik while Rik'kal wakens.
english.description: You are... not like the others...$B$BI hear the Klaxxi calling... <cough>$B$BI just need a moment.
english.completion: Look at you! Many parts and pieces... yes... and all of them so good at killing. Fascinating.$B$BI must pick your brain some time. Muhahah.
english.completed: Speak with Rik'kal the Dissector on Zan'vess or in Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 夏柯希尔之怒
text.objectives: 击败阿卡隆、夏克提克、惊怖具象和25只螳螂妖征服者以击溃螳螂妖虫群。
text.description: 剩下的几位英杰还分散在恐惧之心各处，与螳螂妖虫群作战。他们需要你的帮助！
text.completion: The siege is broken, for now.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

english.objectives: Rout the Mantid Swarm by slaying Akkolon, Shox'tik, the Manifestation of Terror, and 25 mantid subjugates.
english.description: The rest of the freed paragons are scattered around the Heart of Fear, fighting off the mantid swarm. They may need your help!
english.completion: The siege is broken, for now.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 昆莱劲酒
text.objectives: 保护酿月祭。
text.description: 你参加过酿月祭吗？$b$b那是滨岸村的善良村民举办的盛大活动。既然你在这里，那么今天晚上的庆典就由你来负责投酒吧。$b$b我正在酿制我最拿手的昆莱劲酒！$b$b你愿意来参加我们的庆典吗？那将会是一个非常轻松愉快的活动，不会有任何危险。
text.completion: So I may have underestimated how safe it is to brew these days.
text.completed: Speak with Brewmaster Boof at either the Brewmoon Festival or Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

english.title: The Kun-Lai Kicker
english.objectives: Protect the Brewmoon Festival.
english.description: Have you ever seen the Brewmoon Festival?$b$bThe good folks of Binan Village host quite a party. And tonight's festivities are brew-catered by none other than your's truly here.$b$bI am making my famous Kun-Lai Kicker!$b$bThink you might come and join us for the festivities? It should be a completely relaxing event with absolutely no danger whatsoever.
english.completion: So I may have underestimated how safe it is to brew these days.
english.completed: Speak with Brewmaster Boof at either the Brewmoon Festival or Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit.

text.title: 帝国的阴影
text.objectives: 陪同掠风者克尔鲁克进入卡拉克西维斯下面的密室。
text.description: 你只了解了我们组织的部分情况。你是个外来者，而我们也一直是这么对待你的。$b$b可现在再对你隐瞒我们的秘密就不合适了。有些东西你应该看一下。
text.completion: <Kil'ruk gives you a strange glance.>$B$BThe Klaxxi'va may never accept you fully. Their xenophobic minds are closed to the possibility of a useful $R.$B$BI, for one, have been proud to fight by your side, $C. Your presence, and your assistance, do us great honor.
text.completed: Speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Shadow of the Empire
english.objectives: Accompany Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver into the chamber below Klaxxi'vess.
english.description: You only understand part of our order. You are an outsider, and have been treated as such.$b$bIt is no longer appropriate that we keep our secrets from you. There is something you should see.
english.completion: <Kil'ruk gives you a strange glance.>$B$BThe Klaxxi'va may never accept you fully. Their xenophobic minds are closed to the possibility of a useful $R.$B$BI, for one, have been proud to fight by your side, $C. Your presence, and your assistance, do us great honor.
english.completed: Speak with Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 烈性绿石佳酿
text.objectives: 帮助防守绿石村。
text.description: 我正要做一批我最拿手的烈性绿石佳酿。$b$b这种酒非常适合用来对付最近出现在矿山附近的小流氓和淘气的元素生物。$b$b我说，如果你能召集一些朋友，让他们来试一下怎么样？$b$b第一份免费送给你了。
text.completion: I see you put my Volatile Greenstone Brew to good use. Well done, $C!
text.completed: Speak with Brewmaster Tzu in Greenstone Village of the Jade Forest.

english.title: Volatile Greenstone Brew
english.objectives: Aid in the defense of Greenstone Village.
english.description: I am working on a batch of my famous Volatile Greenstone Brew.$b$bShould be superb in countering the rascals and mischievous elementals we have been seeing around the mines lately.$b$bTell you what, how about you round up some of your friends and bring them back here to try out a round.$b$bFirst one's on the house!
english.completion: I see you put my Volatile Greenstone Brew to good use. Well done, $C!
english.completed: Speak with Brewmaster Tzu in Greenstone Village of the Jade Forest.
