english.title: Roll Club: Serpent's Spine Tracking Quest

text.title: 通往锦绣谷的大门打开
南方的威胁
text.objectives: 去蟠龙脊和女射手李琪薇谈一谈。
text.description: 随着恨之煞的消亡，这片土地上最大的威胁已被消灭，但是，我们沿着南部边境的巡视时发现，恐惧废土的螳螂妖大军显然已经开始行动，并且我们可能无法抵挡太长时间。$B$B如果你希望继续协助影踪派，我建议你向蟠龙脊的女射手李琪薇报到。她正在将恐惧废土的恐惧与我们富饶的东部土地隔离开的长城上警戒。
text.completion: A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.$B$BPleased to meet you.
text.completed: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine.

english.title: The Threat in the South
english.objectives: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine.
english.description: With the Sha of Hatred dead, the greatest threat to this land is vanquished, but our travels along the southern border have made it exceedingly clear that the mantid forces in the Dread Wastes are on the move, and likely won't be held back for long.$B$BIf you wish to continue to aid the Shado-Pan, I would recommend reporting in to Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine. She oversees the great wall that separates the terrors in the Dread Wastes from our bountiful lands to the east.
english.completion: A volunteer for Dread Wastes duty? I think you might be the first.$B$BPleased to meet you.
english.completed: Speak with Bowmistress Li on the Serpent's Spine.

text.title: 虫群不宜
text.objectives: 在夏柯希尔之巢杀死30只夏柯希尔聚生虫。
text.description: 新孵出来的螳螂妖只有两个本能：杀戮和进食。他们会相互攻击，吞食弱者，只留下最强者活到成熟期。$B$B而那些成群孵化的螳螂妖——我们称为聚生虫——则会被驱赶着走上前线，对付我们的敌人。$B$B夏柯希尔之巢的聚生虫已经被污染了。它们出生于暗影和梦魇之中，被恐惧而非饥饿所左右。$B$B它们不适合虫群。它们必须被净化。
text.completion: Their eggs should have basked in the warmth of the sun and the song of a million wings for ten more years.$B$BThe Empress will pay for her crimes.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: Not Fit to Swarm
english.objectives: Slay 30 Shek'zeer Swarmborn in the Clutches of Shek'zeer.
english.description: Newly hatched mantid have only two instincts: kill and feed. They turn on one another, devouring the weak and leaving the strongest to mature.$B$BThose hatched during a swarm - the swarmborn - are turned loose on our enemies instead.$B$BThe swarmborn in the Clutches of Shek'zeer have been tainted. They are born into shadows and nightmares. Driven by terror, not hunger.$B$BThey are not fit to swarm. They must be purged.
english.completion: Their eggs should have basked in the warmth of the sun and the song of a million wings for ten more years.$B$BThe Empress will pay for her crimes.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 恐惧力量之源
text.objectives: 把染煞水晶带给卡拉克西维斯的琥珀匠师齐克。
text.description: <虫巢守卫们似乎将这些炫目的白水晶当作魔法焦镜来用。往里看，你发现有浓厚的黑烟在水晶中心旋转。卡拉克西维斯的工人中说不定有人更懂这种材料，并且知道为什么这片废土会盛产这种水晶。>
text.completion: Do you have any idea what this is? It's amber!$B$BBut it is polluted with fear.$B$BI would not expect an outsider like you to understand the consequences of this.
text.completed: 把染煞水晶带给卡拉克西维斯的琥珀匠师齐克。

english.title: A Source of Terrifying Power
english.objectives: Bring the Sha-Haunted Crystal to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess.
english.description: <The clutch-keepers seem to be using these blinding white crystals as magical foci. Peering inside, you see thick tendrils of black smoke swirling in the center. One of the workers at Klaxxi'vess may know more about this material and why it is so abundant in the wastes.>
english.completion: Do you have any idea what this is? It's amber!$B$BBut it is polluted with fear.$B$BI would not expect an outsider like you to understand the consequences of this.
english.completed: Bring the Sha-Haunted Crystal to Ambersmith Zikk at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 垂钓客的请求
text.objectives: 阅读纳特的垂钓日志。
text.description: 该日志记载了关于纳特·帕格伟大冒险的回忆片段。通过简单的阅读可以使你对钓鱼有更加深刻的了解。

english.title: An Angler's Quest
english.objectives: Read Nat's Fishing Journal.
english.description: This journal provides a hazy recollection of Nat Pagle's grand adventures.  Simply reading it will undoubtedly provide a useful insight into fishing.

text.title: 小试牛刀
text.objectives: 在日歌农场种植一棵绿色卷心菜。你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里购买种子。
text.description: 爷爷常说，想要判断一个人是不是真正的农夫，就看他卷心菜种得好不好。每次镇上来了新的农夫，他都要买几棵卷心菜来看看他们的实力。$b$b现在，轮到我成了新农夫了，这可是我证明自己的好机会。你能帮我种一些卷心菜吗？
text.completion: Wait until they try these cabbages. Then they'll know I'm the real deal.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: The Cabbage Test
english.objectives: Plant a Green Cabbage in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: Grandpa always said that the bellweather of a true farmer lies in the quality of his cabbage. Any time a new farmer came into town, he'd buy a few heads of cabbage to see what they knew.$b$bNow, I'm the new farmer, and this is my big chance to prove myself. Could you plant some cabbage for me?
english.completion: Wait until they try these cabbages. Then they'll know I'm the real deal.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 美味的胡萝卜
text.objectives: 在日歌农场种植一棵爽脆胡萝卜。你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里购买种子。
text.description: 爷爷常说：“胡萝卜除了用来招待兔妖外，没别的用处。”我好像从来没见他种过一棵胡萝卜。$b$b这一次，我不同意爷爷的说法。我喜欢住在山脊边，还有，我也喜欢吃胡萝卜。$b$b你能帮我弄些种子并为我种一棵胡萝卜吗？
text.completion: I can't wait to get my paws on those carrots. Thank you, $n. See you again tomorrow?
text.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: That Dangling Carrot
english.objectives: Plant a Juicycrunch Carrot in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: Grandpa always said, "Carrots ain't nothin but a welcomin' mat for virmen." I don't think I ever saw him grow a single carrot.$b$bFor once, I disagree with Grandpa. I like to live on the edge. Plus, I like to eat carrots.$b$bI like to eat carrots on the edge.$b$bCould you get some seeds and grow one for me?
english.completion: I can't wait to get my paws on those carrots. Thank you, $n. See you again tomorrow?
english.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 为什么是葱？
text.objectives: 在日歌农场种植一棵葱。你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里购买种子。
text.description: 我听郝瀚说他今天准备种葱了。我不敢肯定今天是不是种葱的好日子，但我希望他知道自己在做什么，毕竟他是阡陌客的首领。$b$b你能帮我种一棵葱吗？
text.completion: I can already smell those scallions from over here. Can't wait to pick 'em and sell 'em tomorrow. Thanks!
text.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Why Not Scallions?
english.objectives: Plant a Scallion in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: I heard Haohan mentioning that he was going to plant scallions today. I'm not sure if today's the best day for scallions, but I'd like to hope that he knows what he's doing. He is the head of the Tillers' union, after all.$b$bCould you plant a scallion for me?
english.completion: I can already smell those scallions from over here. Can't wait to pick 'em and sell 'em tomorrow. Thanks!
english.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 南瓜香水
text.objectives: 在日歌农场种植一棵魔古南瓜。你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里购买种子。
text.description: 我在市集上听到一个传言，说吉娜·泥爪喜欢南瓜花的香味。如果我在农场里种些南瓜，或许她会拜访得更勤快些。$b$b你能帮我种一棵南瓜吗？
text.completion: And now, we play the waiting game...$B$BSorry, that sounded a little creepy. Forget I said that.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: A Pumpkin-y Perfume
english.objectives: Plant a Mogu Pumpkin in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: I heard a rumor around the market that Gina Mudclaw loves the smell of pumpkin blossoms. Maybe if I grow some pumpkins in my farm, she might come and visit a little more often.$b$bCould you plant a pumpkin for me?
english.completion: And now, we play the waiting game...$B$BSorry, that sounded a little creepy. Forget I said that.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 一物降一物
text.objectives: 在日歌农场种植一棵红韭花。你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里购买种子。
text.description: 爷爷曾经告诉我说，韭菜的味道会让鳄鱼敬而远之。我想他肯定没错……他总是在种韭菜，而我也从来没在他的农场附近见过鳄鱼。$b$b虽然我们离水域很远……但我觉得小心驶得万年船。
text.completion: I'd like to see any crocolisks attack my farm now!$B$BHa HA!
text.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: Red Blossom Leeks, You Make the Croc-in' World Go Down
english.objectives: Plant a Red Blossom Leek in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: Grandpa once told me that the smell of leeks will keep crocolisks off of your property. He must have had a point... he always grew leeks, and I never saw a crocolisk anywhere NEAR his farm.$b$bWe're pretty far from the water... but I suppose you can never be too sure.
english.completion: I'd like to see any crocolisks attack my farm now!$B$BHa HA!
english.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 迎难而上
text.objectives: 在日歌农场种植一棵粉色芜菁。你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里购买种子。
text.description: 老农山掌跟我打赌说我的地里不可能种出粉色芜菁。$b$b我倒要让他开开眼，我的地里将会种出老农山掌这辈子见过的最大、最粉的芜菁！
text.completion: Hah! That'll show Hillpaw.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: The Pink Turnip Challenge
english.objectives: Plant a Pink Turnip in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: Old Hillpaw bet me that my land couldn't grow a pink turnip.$b$bI'll show him. My land will grow the biggest, pinkest turnip that old coot's ever seen!
english.completion: Hah! That'll show Hillpaw.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 白色芜菁的妙用
text.objectives: 在日歌农场种植一棵白色芜菁。你可以从半山市集的商人绿野那里购买种子。
text.description: 爷爷常说：“只有保持抽屉整洁，才能使其远离灰尘。”听上去像是玩笑话，但他说的没错。$b$b蔬菜的根须会污染土壤……但一棵又大又好的白色芜菁能立马把那些东西清理干净。你能帮我种一棵白色芜菁吗？
text.completion: Look at that dirt. Practically sparkling.$B$BGrandpa would be proud.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

english.title: The White Turnip Treatment
english.objectives: Plant a White Turnip in Sunsong Ranch. You can purchase seeds from Merchant Greenfield in the Halfhill Market.
english.description: Grandpa often told me to "Keep my drawers clean and my dirt cleaner." It sounds like a joke, but he makes a good point.$b$bVegetables tend to leave behind bits of root that can contaminate your soil... but a nice, big, white turnip will clean that gunk right up. Think you could plant a white turnip for me?
english.completion: Look at that dirt. Practically sparkling.$B$BGrandpa would be proud.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Yoon at Sunsong Ranch in the Valley of the Four Winds.

text.title: 远古复仇
text.objectives: 在格尔桑平台杀死6个格萨尼复仇之灵。
text.description: 我能听到他们愤怒地嚎叫……那些我很久以前杀掉的格萨尼魔古族的灵魂。他们游荡在这荒废的平台，寻觅复仇的机会。$B$B如果他们发现我处在虚弱状态，我可就在劫难逃了。去吸引他们的注意力，然后干掉他们。$B$B平息因我而起的事端，然后我会告诉你我是谁。
text.completion: We have a common enemy in the mogu. And perhaps others.$B$BWe shall see.
text.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in the Terrace of Gurthan.

english.title: Ancient Vengeance
english.objectives: Slay 6 Vengeful Gurthani Spirits in the Terrace of Gurthan.
english.description: I can hear them howling in rage... The spirits of the Gurthani mogu I slayed so long ago. They wander this ruined terrace, seeking vengeance.$B$BIf they find me in this state, I will not have the strength to fend them off. Draw their attention and put them down.$B$BFinish what I started, and I will tell you who I am.
english.completion: We have a common enemy in the mogu. And perhaps others.$B$BWe shall see.
english.completed: Return to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver in the Terrace of Gurthan.

text.title: 军阀的骨灰
text.objectives: 将格尔桑军阀骨灰带给卡拉克西维斯的掠风者克尔鲁克。
text.description: <掠风者克尔鲁克在几个世纪以前就击败了军阀格尔桑，但这位魔古族兽王的灵魂一直游荡于他原来的要塞附近。$B$B拿出你战胜这个灵魂的证明来，或许能让你获得卡拉克西的青睐。>
text.completion: Gurthan was a coward who trained beasts to do the fighting for him and, in the face of death, chose to suspend his spirit in that urn.$B$BNow we can have the pleasure of killing him as many times as we like.$B$BWell done.
text.completed: 将格尔桑军阀骨灰带给卡拉克西维斯的掠风者克尔鲁克。

english.title: The Warlord's Ashes
english.objectives: Bring the Ashes of Warlord Gurthan to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.
english.description: <Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver defeated Warlord Gurthan centuries ago, but the mogu beastmaster's spirit continues to haunt the ruins of his old stronghold.$B$BShowing proof of your victory over this spirit may gain you favor in the eyes of the Klaxxi.>
english.completion: Gurthan was a coward who trained beasts to do the fighting for him and, in the face of death, chose to suspend his spirit in that urn.$B$BNow we can have the pleasure of killing him as many times as we like.$B$BWell done.
english.completed: Bring the Ashes of Warlord Gurthan to Kil'ruk the Wind-Reaver at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: Extending Our Coverage
text.objectives: Activate the Resonating Beacon in Amberglow Hollow.
text.description: The Klaxxi'va hear another paragon. His cries are weak and lost in darkness. The signal must be strengthened.$b$bThere is a tower in Amberglow Hollow that has been silent for many years. It must sing; the Klaxxi demand it!$b$bThis time I will go with you. You will help me repair it.$b$bTake the resonating crystal and meet me in Amberglow.
text.completed: Speak with Ker'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

You will help me repair it.$b$bTake the resonating crystal and meet me in Amberglow.

objectiveDetails.description: Use the Resonating Crystal on the Idle Beacon

text.title: 罪与罚
text.objectives: 在刺芒小径杀死8个琥珀收割者。
text.description: 刺芒小径里种植着年轻的凯帕圣树。女皇很早就开始吸收这些树苗了，外来者。在其琥珀能够被采摘之前，它们必须要继续生长。$b$b卡拉克西瓦要求对这一罪行进行惩罚！如果你能杀死那些琥珀收割者们，卡拉克西瓦会非常满意的。
text.completion: The Klaxxi are pleased with our work, outsider. You have proven to be more resourceful than we thought.
text.completed: Speak with Zer'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

english.title: Crime and Punishment
english.objectives: Kill 8 Amber Harvesters on the Stinging Trail.
english.description: The Stinging Trail nurtures young Kypari trees. The empress drains the saplings too early, outsider. They must grow before the amber can be taken.$b$bThe Klaxxi'va demand punishment for this crime! It will please them if you rain death on the Ik'thik harvesters.
english.completion: The Klaxxi are pleased with our work, outsider. You have proven to be more resourceful than we thought.
english.completed: Speak with Zer'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

text.title: 越陈越香
text.objectives: 在刺芒小径从琥珀采集器上收集7个装满琥珀的罐子。
text.description: 收割年幼的凯帕圣树是犯罪，但浪费琥珀更是罪大恶极。$b$b嫩琥珀不够强劲，但卡拉克西也需要它来保持战斗力。我们要给他们送去更多琥珀，而他们将颂扬我的义举！$b$b去收集嫩琥珀。我们可以把它存起来，直到它变得成熟可食为止。
text.progress: I would go with you to gather amber, but my talents are more useful here.
text.completion: Even this raw amber will be of use. We can't afford to be picky in times like these.$B$BThe Klaxxi'va will be glad I thought of this. I will tell them you helped!
text.completed: Speak with Zer'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

english.title: Better With Age
english.objectives: Gather 7 Amber-Filled Jars from the Amber Collectors on the Stinging Trail.
english.description: It is a crime to harvest the young trees, but a much bigger crime to waste the amber.$b$bYoung amber is not as strong, but the Klaxxi need it to continue the fight. We will bring them more and they will sing my praises!$b$bGather the young amber. We will store it until it is aged and can be consumed.
english.progress: I would go with you to gather amber, but my talents are more useful here.
english.completion: Even this raw amber will be of use. We can't afford to be picky in times like these.$B$BThe Klaxxi'va will be glad I thought of this. I will tell them you helped!
english.completed: Speak with Zer'ik in Amberglow Hollow.

text.title: 大海的庇佑，一去不返
text.objectives: 对海水侵蚀的岩石使用卡拉克西音叉来唤醒英杰。
text.description: 卡拉克西瓦在对我低语，外来者。在盐碱泥滩藏匿着一位英杰，他的位置已经暴露了。$b$b蜥蜴人包围了他，决不能让英杰落入他们手中。$b$b你得找到他，你得唤醒他。搞不定就别回来见我！$b$b如果你能办到，卡拉克西会对我们另眼相看的。
text.completion: What... what sort of creature are you?$B$BHow have you awoken me?
text.completed: Speak with Kaz'tik the Manipulator.

english.title: By the Sea, Nevermore
english.objectives: Use the Klaxxi Tuning Fork on the Ocean-Worn Rocks to awaken the paragon.
english.description: The Klaxxi'va have spoken to me, outsider. The paragon is hidden in the Briny Muck only, he is not so hidden anymore.$b$bThe lizard men surround him. He cannot fall into their scaley hands.$b$bYou will find him; you will awaken him. Do not return without him!$b$bIf you do this the Klaxxi will be pleased with us.
english.completion: What... what sort of creature are you?$B$BHow have you awoken me?
english.completed: Speak with Kaz'tik the Manipulator.

text.title: 四风谷
text.objectives: 传送至四风谷并和列兵蒂姆·P·拉瑞谈一谈。
text.description: 没错，翡翠林正经历一些粗暴的重建，但四风谷正适合探险。你准备好出发时就跟我说一声，我可以载你去你想去的地方。跟我旁边的同伴谈一谈，他会给你一些路上用得着的装备。
text.completion: Welcome to Pandaria, $C. I have a selection of equipment that you may find useful on your journey.

english.title: Valley of the Four Winds
english.objectives: Teleport to Valley of the Four Winds and speak to Private Tim P. O'Rary.
english.description: Yarr, the Jade Forest be goin through some violent reconstruction, but the Valley of the Four Winds is ripe for explorin.  Talk with me when ye be ready to go and I can give ye a ride ta where ya need to go.  Talk to me cohort on the other side 'ta get some equipment to aid ya on yer journey.
english.completion: Welcome to Pandaria, $C. I have a selection of equipment that you may find useful on your journey.

objectiveDetails.description: Speak with Private Tim P. O'Rary in Valley of the Four Winds

text.title: 削弱希克提克
text.objectives: 杀死12个希克提克螳螂妖。
text.description: 尽管我们努力将螳螂妖控制在恐惧废土一带，但还是有一些闯了进来，意图染指砮皂寺。我的人试图在西边希克维斯压制他们，但没有成功。如果你有祝踏岚所说的$c的一半实力，或许你去对付他们更好些。$B$B向西走，杀死你沿途遇见的任何希克提克螳螂妖。记住，没时间悲天悯人了，砮皂寺里的人可就指望我们了。
text.completion: The mantid are relentless. Fortunately for us, you have a dedication that surpasses even theirs.$B$BIt is good to have you walk these roads, $C.
text.completed: Return to Rensai Oakhide at Rensai's Watchpost in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: Thinning the Sik'thik
english.objectives: Kill 12 Sik'thik mantid.
english.description: For all our efforts to keep the mantid in the Dread Wastes, some have broken through, seemingly intent on Niuzao Temple. My men have been attempting to extinguish their presence to the west, at Sik'vess, but to no success. If you're half of the $c Taran paints you to be, maybe you will fare better.$B$BHead west, and kill any Sik'thik mantid you find. And remember, this is no time for mercy. There are lives at the temple depending on us.
english.completion: The mantid are relentless. Fortunately for us, you have a dedication that surpasses even theirs.$B$BIt is good to have you walk these roads, $C.
english.completed: Return to Rensai Oakhide at Rensai's Watchpost in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 寻找冷恒
text.objectives: 搜寻希克提克囚笼，找到焦躁的冷恒。
text.description: 我手下最好的斥候——冷恒，在希克维斯另一头的任务中失踪了。我真心希望他是被俘，而不是被杀。但螳螂妖被煞魔腐蚀之深……恐怕希望渺茫。$B$B无论如何，你能去调查一下希克维斯周围的牢笼吗？我本该派更多的人去寻找他的，但南部战线实在是抽调不出更多的人手。$B$B求你了，$c，即便他已经牺牲了，也请让我知晓他最终的命运。
text.completion: Leng told me of your heroics. He is in your debt, as am I.
text.completed: Return to Rensai Oakhide at Rensai's Watchpost in Townlong Steppes.

english.title: The Search for Restless Leng
english.objectives: Search Sik'thik Cages for Restless Leng.
english.description: One of my best scouts, Restless Leng, went missing during a mission on the other side of Sik'vess. I'm hopeful that he was captured rather than killed, but with the mantid corrupted so heavily by sha, it doesn't seem likely.$B$BStill, can you investigate the cages around Sik'vess? I owe him a more thorough search than even this, but I have no men to spare without allowing our southern lines to break.$B$BPlease, $c, even if there's no life left in him, find him that I might know his fate.
english.completion: Leng told me of your heroics. He is in your debt, as am I.
english.completed: Return to Rensai Oakhide at Rensai's Watchpost in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 惧誓者
text.objectives: 在凯帕圣树·沃尔杀死6个沃提克惧誓者。
text.description: 卡拉克西看到了很多，也听到了很多。他们将自己的所见所闻与我分享。$B$B沃提克投靠了煞魔，他们利用煞魔的力量来为自己的虫群提供能量。他们的战士以被污染的琥珀为食，并称呼自己为惧誓者。$B$B他们的路走到头了，他们只不过是些需要被清除的败类。$B$B当你到达凯帕圣树·沃尔的时候，你要为我们清理门户。
text.completion: In disciplined hands, the spear is the perfect weapon. Only the weak would augment it with sorcery.$B$BAnd we have no need for the weak.
text.completed: Return to Malik the Unscathed at Klaxxi'vess.

english.title: The Dreadsworn
english.objectives: Slay 6 Vor'thik Dreadsworn at Kypari Vor.
english.description: The Klaxxi see far and hear much. They have shared their insight with me.$B$BThe Vor'thik embrace the sha, using its power to fuel their march in this false swarm. Their warriors consume tainted amber and call themselves dreadsworn.$B$BThere is no future for them. They are waste which needs disposing.$B$BAnd YOU will begin that process for us when you reach Kypari Vor.
english.completion: In disciplined hands, the spear is the perfect weapon. Only the weak would augment it with sorcery.$B$BAnd we have no need for the weak.
english.completed: Return to Malik the Unscathed at Klaxxi'vess.

text.title: 铭文白虎杖
text.objectives: 把你的铭文白虎杖带给百木园里的墨水大师格伦苏。
text.description: 这件武器威力如此强大，以至于使你认识到你将无法驾驭它。当时机成熟的时候，百木园里的墨水大师会很感兴趣从你这里把它拿走的。
text.progress: Yes?
text.completion: This is a weapon of great beauty and power. If you are certain you wish to part with it, I would be happy to take it from you.
text.completed: Give the Inscribed Tiger Staff to Inkmaster Glenzu.

english.objectives: Bring your Inscribed Tiger Staff to Inkmaster Glenzu in the Arboretum.
english.description: As powerful it is, at some point you know you will outgrow this staff.  When that time comes, one of the Inkmasters in the Arboretum would most likely be interested in taking it from you.

text.description: 这件武器威力如此强大，以至于使你认识到你将无法驾驭它。当时机成熟的时候，百木园里的墨水大师会很感兴趣从你这里把它拿走的。

text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败茱莉亚·史蒂文斯。
text.description: 你觉得你这次还能赢？
text.completion: Ouch, you really are a good pet trainer! I guess you're the exception.
text.completed: Speak to Julia Stevens.

english.objectives: Defeat Julia Stevens in a pet battle.
english.description: Think you can take me again?
english.completion: Ouch, you really are a good pet trainer! I guess you're the exception.
