text.title: 城墙之外
text.objectives: 去螳螂高原的龙影岗哨和祝踏岚谈一谈。
text.description: 我们收到消息说影踪派已经开始对螳螂高原进行反击了，他们好像正沿着野牛人入侵的方向行进。$b$b熊猫人已经有数千年之久没踏足过螳螂高原了。影踪派的弟子虽然勇猛顽强，但同样也刚愎自用，他们需要像你这样的英雄帮助。你能前往西北方的冬花关吗？找到影踪派的首领并提供你的经验和帮助？
text.completion: Welcome to Townlong Steppes. If you insist on wandering in to the darkest places of Pandaria then far be it from me to not put you to good use.
text.completed: 去螳螂高原的龙影岗哨和祝踏岚谈一谈。

english.title: Beyond the Wall
english.objectives: Speak with Taran Zhu at the Longying Outpost in Townlong Steppes.
english.description: We received word the Shado-Pan have begun a counter attack in to Townlong Steppes. It sounds like they are going after the root of the yaungol invasion.$b$bThe pandaren have not traveled in force in to Townlong for thousands of years. The Shado-Pan are strong and brave, but they are also proud and few. They will need help from heroes like yourself. Can you travel through the Gate of Winter's Blossom in the northwest? Find the Shado-Pan leaders and lend your help and experience?
english.completion: Welcome to Townlong Steppes. If you insist on wandering in to the darkest places of Pandaria then far be it from me to not put you to good use.
english.completed: Speak with Taran Zhu at the Longying Outpost in Townlong Steppes.

text.title: 养虎为患
text.objectives: 杀死8只临风幼虎或临风猛虎。
text.description: 过去的几个季节风调雨顺、生机盎然。因此，临风岛上野生老虎的数量有了较大的增幅。$B$B这种残暴的食肉动物几乎猎杀了周围所有的生物，并开始威胁到云端翔龙的巢穴了。$B$B道理很简单，老虎的数量越多，云端翔龙的数量便会随之减少。$B$B要是我们放任自流的话，这些掠食者会把云端翔龙给彻底灭绝的。$B$B我们必须得削减老虎的数量了，$r。
text.completion: You have carried out the task to the letter, $n.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Thinning The Pack
english.objectives: Kill 8 Windward Tigers or Windward Alphas.
english.description: The past few seasons have been plentiful, and as a result, the wild tiger population on Windward Isle has exploded.$B$BThe savage creatures have hunted out all the nearby game, and are beginning to encroach upon the cloud serpent nests.$B$BAs a result, as the tigers thrive, the cloud serpents decline.$B$BIf we are not careful, the predatory cats could completely wipe them out.$B$BWe must thin the tigers' numbers, $r.
english.completion: You have carried out the task to the letter, $n.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 林精恐惧症
text.objectives: 击败7个影妖骗子。
text.description: 真讨厌，这下我该如何完成我的任务呢？$B$B天荆教头要我去临风岛猎杀些老虎，但我听说那地方到处都是林精！$B$B啊！我讨厌林精！看到他们我就起鸡皮疙瘩！$B$B他们那么小，还……还……还会跳到你身上……还有……还有……他们那冰冷腐坏且黏糊糊的小爪子！$B$B噢！你得帮帮我，$n。帮我除掉那些鬼东西吧，求你了！
text.completion: You have put the sprites in their place, $n. They should cause no more trouble for a while.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Sprite Fright
english.objectives: Kill 7 Shadowfae Tricksters.
english.description: Oh bother, how am I supposed to get my tasks done, now?$B$BInstructor Skythorn asked me to go kill some tigers at Windward Isle, but I heard the area was overrun with sprites!$B$BUgh! I hate sprites! They totally give me the creeps!$B$BThey're so small, and... and... they jump on you and... and... they have cold, dead little stick hands!$B$BAuuugh! You have to help me, $n. Get rid of those things, please!
english.completion: You have put the sprites in their place, $n. They should cause no more trouble for a while.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 穿错鞋
text.objectives: 重新夺回14只失窃的靴子。
text.description: 我恨林精！有一次，其中一个讨厌的家伙整天跟着我，在我的茶里放土，在我的头发里放虫子。$B$B我说，正常人谁会干出这种事来！？$B$B好吧，我想是时候报复一下了。你知道临风岛上的林精最爱什么吗？$B$B没错，你猜对了，是靴子！$B$B这回我们要偷靴子，他们肯定会抓狂的！哈哈哈！$B$B那个……我是被林精吓坏了，所以这得由你来做了，$n。
text.progress: Did you see the looks on their faces? Were they mad?
text.completion: I see you and Ningna have been up to some mischief. Unfortunately, this type of behavior is not condoned by the Order--$B$BWait, where did you find those shoes? I've been looking for that pair of moleskin riding boots for ages!$B$BWell... I suppose I will let this slide... this time. Hmph.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: The Shoe Is On The Other Foot
english.objectives: Re-steal 14 Stolen Boots.
english.description: I loathe sprites! One time, one of those nasty buggers followed me all day, putting dirt in my tea and bugs in my hair.$B$BI mean, who does that!?$B$BWell, I think it's time for a little payback. Do you know what the sprites up at Windward Isle love more than anything in the world?$B$BYeah, you guessed it. Shoes!$B$BAnd we're going to steal them. Won't that make them mad! Hah!$B$BWell, I'm scared to go near sprites, so you'll have to do it, $n.
english.progress: Did you see the looks on their faces? Were they mad?
english.completion: I see you and Ningna have been up to some mischief. Unfortunately, this type of behavior is not condoned by the Order--$B$BWait, where did you find those shoes? I've been looking for that pair of moleskin riding boots for ages!$B$BWell... I suppose I will let this slide... this time. Hmph.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 残暴的女猎手
text.objectives: 击败临风女猎手。
text.description: 我听说一头凶狠残暴的野兽——临风女猎手，让临风岛西北面的森林陷入到恐慌之中。$B$B她已经杀死了几条翔龙，并击伤了数个前去讨伐的翔龙骑士。$B$B我们得赶在她造成更大的威胁之前，彻底消灭她。你能执行这项任务吗？
text.completion: Thank you, $n. You are proving to be quite a reliable student.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
text.giverWindow: 女猎手的洞穴就在临风岛的西北部。

english.title: Dark Huntress
english.objectives: Kill the Windward Huntress.
english.description: I have learned that a vicious beast, a Windward Huntress, terrorizes the wood on the northwest side of the island.$B$BShe has already slain several serpents, and injured more than one serpent rider sent to subdue her.$B$BShe must be removed before she can pose a danger to anyone else. Can you perform this task?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. You are proving to be quite a reliable student.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
english.giverWindow: The huntress's den is in the northwestern part of Windward Isle.

text.title: 心头大患
text.objectives: 击败临风刃豹。
text.description: 我收到报告说，一头巨型的白色猛兽正在临风岛西北边的林子里游荡。$B$B这个残暴的家伙是临风女猎手的配偶，而且已经杀死了数条成年的云端翔龙龙母。$B$B我们可不能放任这么危险的掠食者在临风岛逍遥快活。$B$B去给我干掉那头野兽，让我们瞧瞧你是否学有所成。
text.completion: I see you have vanquished the beast. Quite a promising student, you are.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
text.giverWindow: 临风岛之王。

english.title: On The Prowl
english.objectives: Kill the Windward Saber.
english.description: I have heard report of a great white beast that stalks the wood on the northwestern side of the wild serpent island.$B$BThis savage creature is mate to the Windward Huntress, and already he has taken down several of the adult cloud serpent matriarchs.$B$BWe cannot have such a fearsome predator roaming the island unchecked.$B$BGo and deal with this creature. Let us see if your training has paid off.
english.completion: I see you have vanquished the beast. Quite a promising student, you are.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
english.giverWindow: The king of the island.

text.title: 狂徒的末日
text.objectives: 杀死影妖狂徒。
text.description: 我还有个任务必须要你去做。$B$B林精的首领是个叫影妖狂徒的家伙。$B$B如果说有什么阴谋诡计，那么他一定就是幕后的策划者。$B$B我们没时间再跟这些傲慢无礼、阴险狡诈的林精周旋了。去干掉影妖狂徒，速战速决。
text.completion: Good riddance. With everything that is worrying us these days, it is good to have one less problem to worry about.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
text.giverWindow: 木精的首领。小心他的诡计。

english.title: Madcap Mayhem
english.objectives: Kill the Shadowfae Madcap.
english.description: There is another task I must ask of you.$B$BThe leader of the woodland sprites is the Shadowfae Madcap.$B$BIf there is trouble brewing, he is the mastermind pulling the puppet strings.$B$BWe do not have time to deal with the sprites' tiresome pranks and insolence. Take out the Shadowfae Madcap, and be quick about it.
english.completion: Good riddance. With everything that is worrying us these days, it is good to have one less problem to worry about.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.
english.giverWindow: The leader of the wood sprites. Beware his tricks.

text.title: 清理粪便
text.objectives: 收集5小袋粪便。
text.description: <翔龙注意到你在盯着它看，害羞地把头扭了过去。>$B$B你看得出来，某人忍不住制造了一起“事故”。$B$B其实这也没啥，翔龙总是不停地吃，吃完的东西势必也要从另一头……排泄出来。$B$B你最好在翔龙大师发现之前，找到雏龙排出的粪便并清理干净。
text.progress: <The hatchling watches you innocently.>
text.completion: The hatchling plays contentedly, oblivious to your efforts. Sigh... sometimes, the life of a serpent trainer is quite thankless.
text.completed: Return to the hatchling at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Pooped
english.objectives: Collect 5 Tiny Bags of Poop.
english.description: <Your serpent catches your gaze and ducks its head bashfully.>$B$BYou can tell that someone has gotten out of its pen and had "an accident."$B$BWell, at the rate that the hatchling's been eating, it had to come out the other end... somewhere.$B$BYou had better find the serpent's poop and clean it up before the Serpent Masters find out.
english.progress: <The hatchling watches you innocently.>
english.completion: The hatchling plays contentedly, oblivious to your efforts. Sigh... sometimes, the life of a serpent trainer is quite thankless.
english.completed: Return to the hatchling at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 引蜂出洞
text.objectives: 在百木园北面的空地上使用蜂蜜，然后杀死果园钉刺者。
text.description: 百木园是我们的家，也是我们抚养雏龙、训练弟子的避风港。$B$B可不幸的是，其他一些更加危险的生物也想把这里当成家。$B$B在越过河向北的地方，我们看到一只大黄蜂以花蜜为食。$B$B这家伙已经蛰伤了好几个弟子。$B$B用这蜂蜜把大黄蜂引出来，然后在它继续伤人之前消灭它。
text.completion: The poisonous wasp is dead? Good. Where so many other students failed, you have succeeded, $n.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Needle Me Not
english.objectives: Use the honey at the northern clearing in The Arboretum, and then kill the Orchard Needler.
english.description: The Arboretum is our home, a safe haven where we raise young hatchlings and train our students.$B$BUnfortunately, there are other, more dangerous creatures who wish to make this their home as well.$B$BTo the north, beyond the river, we have seen a great wasp feeding on the nectar blossoms.$B$BThis creature has already stung several of our students.$B$BUse this honey to lure the wasp out of hiding. Then, destroy it before it harms anyone else.
english.completion: The poisonous wasp is dead? Good. Where so many other students failed, you have succeeded, $n.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 悲泣寡妇蛛
text.objectives: 杀死7只悲泣寡妇蛛。
text.description: 香里拉村附近的蜘蛛变得越来越具有攻击性，它们对沿海一带以钓鱼为生的垂钓翁造成了极大的威胁。$B$B为了他们的安全着想，我要你去蛛泣洞穴消灭那些悲泣寡妇蛛。$B$B你可以沿着海岸线向北，找到该洞穴。
text.completion: Instructor Skythorn updated me on the situation at The Widow's Wail. You have done well.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Weeping Widows
english.objectives: Kill 7 Weeping Widows.
english.description: The spiders near Sri-La Village have grown very aggressive. They pose a severe problem to the anglers who fish along the coast.$B$BFor their safety, I need you to go and eliminate the Weeping Widows in The Widow's Wail.$B$BYou can find the cave along the coast to the north.
english.completion: Instructor Skythorn updated me on the situation at The Widow's Wail. You have done well.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 致命蛛网
text.objectives: 摧毁寡妇蛛网，救出5个香里拉村民。
text.description: 我们从香里拉村的渔民那里得到一个令人不安的消息，$n。$B$B他们那儿有很多村民失踪了。据目击者称，他们被抓到蛛泣洞穴去了，就在沿海岸线向北的地方。$B$B那些受害者被蛛丝包裹得严严实实，并被拖进了黑暗的深渊，以作为蜘蛛们的下一顿晚餐。$B$B我们相信其中有一部分人还活着，还来得及去救他们！我要你去营救那里的村民，越多越好。
text.completion: You have done a great deed today, $n. This is the duty of the Order of the Cloud Serpent - to protect the people of The Jade Forest.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: A Tangled Web
english.objectives: Destroy Widow's Webs to free 5 Sri-La Villagers.
english.description: We have had a disturbing report from the Anglers fishermen of Sri-La Village, $n.$B$BMany of their villagers are missing, taken by the spiders who live in The Widow's Wail, a cave along the coast to the north.$B$BThe victims are dragged into the dark depths, wrapped in cocoons, and left to become the spiders' next meal.$B$BWe believe that some of the people may still be alive. There is still time to save them! I need you to go and rescue as many villagers as you can find.
english.completion: You have done a great deed today, $n. This is the duty of the Order of the Cloud Serpent - to protect the people of The Jade Forest.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 龙鳞菇
text.objectives: 收集25个龙鳞菇。
text.description: 我看到你已经拥有了自己的雏龙，$r。$B$B你有没有正确地喂养它、清洁它、陪它玩耍呢？只有这样，你的雏龙才会健康茁壮地成长。$B$B现在让我来教你一个秘诀。去北边的蛛泣洞穴，你会在那里找到一种名叫“龙鳞菇”的菌菇。$B$B龙鳞菇很难得，但其营养丰富且富含各种维生素。虽然味道不怎么样，你的翔龙不会喜欢的，但又有谁喜欢吃蔬菜呢？
text.progress: <Your serpent greets you happily.>
text.completion: <Your serpent sniffs the mushrooms and makes a horrible face. It tries to escape, but you hold it gently and coax it to eat the spongy morsels.>
text.completed: Return to your hatchling at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Serpent's Scale
english.objectives: Collect 25 Serpent's Scale.
english.description: I see you have gained your own hatchling, $r.$B$BHave you been feeding it, cleaning after it, and playing with it properly? Only by doing so will it become strong and healthy.$B$BNow let me tell you a trainer's secret. To the north, in The Widow's Wail, you can find a mushroom known as Serpent's Scale.$B$BIt is difficult to acquire, but this mushroom has powerful properties and important nutrients. Your serpent won't like eating it, but who likes eating their vegetables?
english.progress: <Your serpent greets you happily.>
english.completion: <Your serpent sniffs the mushrooms and makes a horrible face. It tries to escape, but you hold it gently and coax it to eat the spongy morsels.>
english.completed: Return to your hatchling at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 疑云密布
text.objectives: 在蛛泣洞穴对煞能干扰使用煞能协调器。沿着海岸线向北可以找到蛛泣洞穴的入口，就在香里拉村的南面。
text.description: 我听说北边的蛛泣洞穴近来有些异常。$B$B我和紫兰曾去调查过，我敢肯定那里存在着煞魔出现的迹象。$B$B我造了这个装置，用以测量煞能的感染级别。$B$B如果你打算去那儿的话，你能帮我测量一下煞能干扰吗？$B$B煞能干扰看起来就像是黑白相间的煞能水流，不断从地面喷涌而出。
text.completion: Thank you for bringing me this report, $n. Big Bao is quite right to be concerned.$B$BThe sha is a subtle and deadly enemy. We must work to expel their dark energy from this land.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Lingering Doubt
english.objectives: Use the Sha Attunement Device at the Sha Disturbances in The Widow's Wail. The entrance to The Widow's Wail can be found to the north along the coast, south of Sri-La Village.
english.description: I heard that there has been some strange behavior down at The Widow's Wail to the north.$B$BHyacinth and I went to investigate, and I am certain that some presence of the sha has found its way into the cavern.$B$BI created this device to measure sha energy levels.$B$BIf you are going that way, would you mind taking measurements of any sha disturbances?$B$BThe disturbances look like streams of white and black sha energy pouring from the ground.
english.completion: Thank you for bringing me this report, $n. Big Bao is quite right to be concerned.$B$BThe sha is a subtle and deadly enemy. We must work to expel their dark energy from this land.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 风味美食
text.objectives: 收集100只小蜘蛛眼。
text.description: 当你走近时，你的翔龙张着嘴巴开始流口水了。自从你上次离开后，小家伙变得非常饥饿。$B$B从它不停啜泣和拍打小尾巴的动作来看，小家伙不想随随便便填饱肚子，而是想来点比较特别的美食。$B$B你的翔龙喜欢嚼小蜘蛛眼，但这东西只有小寡妇蛛身上有，沿着海岸线向北可以找到洞穴。$B$B那么，你还在等什么呐？赶紧出发吧。
text.progress: Your serpent perks up at your return.
text.completion: Your serpent nudges your hand affectionately, then proceeds to devour the treats!
text.completed: Return to the serpent at The Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Tiny Treats
english.objectives: Collect 100 Tiny Spider Eyes.
english.description: As you near, your serpent opens its mouth and begins drooling. It looks quite hungry since you last left it.$B$BFrom the way it whimpers and slaps its tail, you can tell it is not looking for just any treat, but a special favorite snack.$B$BYour serpent loves to munch on tiny spider eyes, but this delicacy comes only from the Widowspawn spiders in the cave along the coast to the north.$B$BWell, what's a rider to do? Your serpent is waiting.
english.progress: Your serpent perks up at your return.
english.completion: Your serpent nudges your hand affectionately, then proceeds to devour the treats!
english.completed: Return to the serpent at The Arboretum in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 疑虑之种
text.objectives: 消灭疑虑之种。
text.description: $r，疑之煞的麻烦在于，他的触角无处不在。$B$B一旦播下了疑虑之种，他就会像杂草一样疯狂生长。$B$B北边的蛛泣洞穴里就种有一颗疑虑之种。就跟对付杂草一样，我们得快刀斩乱麻。$B$B我要你赶在其祸害更多的人之前，消灭疑虑之种。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. I "doubt" that this enemy is truly gone. Until we can be sure, we must stay vigilant.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: The Seed of Doubt
english.objectives: Kill the Seed of Doubt.
english.description: The problem with the sha of doubt, $r, is its deceitful pervasiveness.$B$BOnce the seed of doubt is planted, it can grow like an unwelcome weed.$B$BSuch a seed has been planted in The Widow's Wail to the north, and like a weed, we must extinguish its presence immediately.$B$BI need you to destroy the lingering fragment of doubt before it can infect any more victims.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. I "doubt" that this enemy is truly gone. Until we can be sure, we must stay vigilant.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 顽劣的猴子
text.objectives: 杀死13只乌拿猢狲。
text.description: 我们在香里拉村听到了奇怪的传闻。$B$B看来有支猢狲部族在乌拿猴洞里过得很舒坦，猴洞就在渔村南边的海岸一带。$B$B事实上，这些家伙过得太舒坦了。猢狲们开始偷窃和抢夺沿海一带的物资。$B$B我们得给他们上一课……敬酒不吃吃罚酒。他们已经快活得太久了。
text.completion: The hozen presence is quite troubling. You did well to follow Instructor Skythorn's instructions.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Monkey Mischief
english.objectives: Kill 13 Oona hozen.
english.description: Strange tales have reached our ears from Sri-La Village.$B$BIt seems that a hozen tribe has made itself comfortable in Oona Kagu, a cave along the coast south of the fishing village.$B$BToo comfortable, in fact. The tribe members are stealing and pillaging resources all along the coast.$B$BWe must teach them a lesson... one that can only be taught by force. They have already overstayed their welcome.
english.completion: The hozen presence is quite troubling. You did well to follow Instructor Skythorn's instructions.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 无酒不欢
text.objectives: 收集100桶香里拉烈酒。
text.description: 这简直就是一场灾难，$n！$B$B我昨天想去龙舞楼喝两杯，结果被告知没酒了。他们说从香里拉村运来的酒都被偷了。被偷了！$B$B事实证明是那群乌拿猢狲把码头搞得一团糟，其中就包括了把偷来的酒带回乌拿猴洞。$B$B我离开酒活不过两天，没酒喝的日子不过也罢！$B$B得有个人站出来把酒找回来啊！
text.progress: Is the brew recovered yet? I'm... I'm starting to lose it...
text.completion: Oh, thank the Stormstouts! You are my hero!
text.completed: Return to Ace Longpaw at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: The Big Brew-haha
english.objectives: Collect 100 Sri-La Stout.
english.description: It's a disaster, $n!$B$BWhen I went to visit the Dancing Serpent Inn yesterday, they were all out of brew. They said the shipment from Sri-La Village had been stolen. STOLEN!$B$BTurns out those Oona hozen have been making all kinds of trouble down at the docks, including taking all the brew to their cave at Oona Kagu along the coast.$B$BI can't handle a dry spell. A life without brew is not a life worth living!$B$BSomeone needs to go and save the brew!
english.progress: Is the brew recovered yet? I'm... I'm starting to lose it...
english.completion: Oh, thank the Stormstouts! You are my hero!
english.completed: Return to Ace Longpaw at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 拯救翔龙
text.objectives: 收集10条得救的翔龙。
text.description: 那些乌拿猢狲太过分了。$B$B你知道他们在对野生翔龙做什么吗？他们强迫被抓的雏龙在牢笼里决斗，而这一切只是为了娱乐消遣。$B$B暴徒！$B$B如果这些雏龙在这么小的年纪就学会了杀戮，那么它们长大成年后也将变得腐化和暴戾。残暴的云端翔龙可不是我们想要的结果。$B$B我们必须拯救这些雏龙。
text.progress: The Order of the Cloud Serpent has worked for centuries to make the cloud serpents into loyal companions. Our kindness brings out the best in these creatures.$B$BUnfortunately, violence and anger can quickly turn them into destructive monsters.
text.completion: Ah yes, these hatchlings look quite tired. They have been through a great ordeal, but thanks to you, they are safe now.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Saving the Serpents
english.objectives: Collect 10 Rescued Serpents.
english.description: Those Oona hozen have gone too far this time.$B$BDo you know what they are doing with wild cloud serpents? Captured hatchlings are forced to fight one another in the pits, for nothing more than the Oona's amusement.$B$BSavages!$B$BIf the young hatchlings learn such aggressive behavior at a young age, they may become violent and corrupted adults. A malicious cloud serpent is not something we want to deal with.$B$BWe must save the hatchlings.
english.progress: The Order of the Cloud Serpent has worked for centuries to make the cloud serpents into loyal companions. Our kindness brings out the best in these creatures.$B$BUnfortunately, violence and anger can quickly turn them into destructive monsters.
english.completion: Ah yes, these hatchlings look quite tired. They have been through a great ordeal, but thanks to you, they are safe now.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 海上魔王
text.objectives: 杀死乌拿头领。
text.description: 乌拿猢狲的首领是一个叫乌拿头领的强盗匪徒。$B$B我听说过某些关于这个横行海上的船长和他船员的恐怖传闻。他的部族所到之处，生灵涂炭。$B$B乌拿猢狲将他们的船驶进肥沃的土地，疯狂掠夺当地的村民，烧杀抢掠无恶不作，接着再征服下一个土地。$B$B我们不能容许如此暴行在我们的领地发生，至少在我的任职期内。$B$B我需要某个人去帮我消灭他，就是现在。
text.completion: The leader is dead, then? Good. Perhaps now the hozen will leave the villagers in peace.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: The Big Kah-Oona
english.objectives: Kill Lord Oona.
english.description: The leader of the Oona hozen is a brigand by the name of Lord Oona.$B$BI have heard fearsome tales of this roaming sea captain and his crew. Everywhere he takes his tribe, destruction follows.$B$BThe Oona land their boats on fertile soil, pillage the local villages, and drain the land dry before moving on to their next conquest.$B$BWe shall not allow the same to occur on our shores, not while I am still in charge.$B$BI need someone to go eradicate him now.
english.completion: The leader is dead, then? Good. Perhaps now the hozen will leave the villagers in peace.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 清理粪便
text.objectives: 收集5大袋粪便。
text.description: <当你走近小窝时，翔龙突然跳进墙角躲了起来。>$B$B从它害羞的眼神里，你看出来某个家伙从围栏里跑了出来，还制造了一起……事故。$B$B其实这也没啥，翔龙总是不停地吃，吃完的东西势必也要从另一头……排泄出来。$B$B你最好在翔龙大师发现之前，找到雏龙排出的粪便并清理干净。
text.progress: <The hatchling watches you in amusement.>
text.completion: The hatchling plays contentedly, oblivious to your efforts. Sigh... sometimes, the life of a serpent trainer is quite thankless.
text.completed: Return to the serpent at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Pooped
english.objectives: Collect 5 Big Bags of Poop.
english.description: <As you approach the pen, the serpent zips into a corner and hides.>$B$BAs it looks at you with bashful eyes, you can tell that someone has gotten out of its pen and had... an accident.$B$BWell, at the rate that the serpent's been eating, it had to come out the other end... somewhere.$B$BYou had better find the serpent's poop and clean it up before the Serpent Masters find out.
english.progress: <The hatchling watches you in amusement.>
english.completion: The hatchling plays contentedly, oblivious to your efforts. Sigh... sometimes, the life of a serpent trainer is quite thankless.
english.completed: Return to the serpent at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 训练师的试炼：王牌飞行员长爪
text.objectives: 和王牌飞行员长爪谈一谈，然后击败他。
text.description: 你把我们弟子的水准又提上了一个新台阶，$n。$B$B就像一把宝剑需要千锤百炼，我们的弟子也得互相挑战，获取实战经验。$B$B今天，你将和我们中最出色的一名弟子——王牌飞行员长爪进行对决。要想击败他，你得好好利用你的防守能力。$B$B去训练之环和他谈一谈，开始挑战。祝你好运。
text.completion: Well done, $C. The sword that is hammered and folded produces a keen blade.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Ace Longpaw
english.objectives: Speak to Ace Longpaw, then defeat him.
english.description: You are rising up the ranks of our students, $n.$B$BJust as a sword must be forged through fire, so must our students test themselves against one another.$B$BToday, you will spar against one of our brightest disciples, Ace Longpaw. In order to defeat him, you will need to make use of your defensive capabilities.$B$BSpeak to him in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.
english.completion: Well done, $C. The sword that is hammered and folded produces a keen blade.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 训练师的试炼：大宝
text.objectives: 和大宝谈一谈，然后击败他。
text.description: 准备好下一轮试炼了吗，$n？$B$B今天，你将挑战大宝。他的决心就和他的体型一样大，除非被彻底击败，否则他绝不会放弃的。$B$B要想击败他，你也得坚持到底。$B$B去训练之环和他谈一谈，开始挑战。祝你好运。
text.completion: Both of you persevered to the end. Well done, my student.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Big Bao
english.objectives: Speak to Big Bao, then defeat him.
english.description: Are you ready for another lesson, $n?$B$BToday, you will spar against Big Bao. He is large of stature and of heart, and he will not give up until he is wholly beaten.$B$BIf you wish to defeat him, you will need to persevere.$B$BSpeak to him in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.
english.completion: Both of you persevered to the end. Well done, my student.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 训练师的试炼：宁纳·黑轮
text.objectives: 和宁纳·黑轮谈一谈，然后击败她。
text.description: 你天赋异禀，$n。但天赋这东西一旦失去了戒律和谦卑的支撑，就会变得不堪一击。$B$B今天，你将面对的是宁纳·黑轮。她的天然优势使她成为了我们这里最具天赋的弟子之一。$B$B要想击败她，你就得严格把控自己。$B$B去训练之环和她谈一谈，开始挑战。祝你好运。
text.completion: A fight against Ningna will quickly reveal one's strengths and weaknesses. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Ningna Darkwheel
english.objectives: Speak to Ningna Darkwheel, then defeat her.
english.description: You show much promise, $n. However, talent is worth little without discipline and humility.$B$BToday, you will face Ningna Darkwheel. Her natural strength makes her one of our most talented students. $B$BIf you hope to defeat her, you will need to act with the utmost control.$B$BSpeak to her in the training ring to begin the challenge. Good luck.
english.completion: A fight against Ningna will quickly reveal one's strengths and weaknesses. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 训练师的试炼：蜜糖苏琪
text.objectives: 和蜜糖苏琪谈一谈，然后击败她。
text.description: 今天，你将在训练之环挑战蜜糖苏琪。尽管她外表看上去很甜美，但她绝对是个难缠的对手。$B$B她的攻击迅捷且犀利，但随着时间的流逝，也会成强弩之末。$B$B要想击败她，就得趁她虚弱时穷追猛打。$B$B和苏琪谈一谈，开始对决。祝你好运。
text.completion: Your focus was excellent, $n. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Suchi the Sweet
english.objectives: Speak to Suchi the Sweet, then defeat her.
english.description: Today you will face Suchi the Sweet in the training ring. Despite her sweet exterior, she is a tough opponent.$B$BShe attacks swiftly and surely, but such potent attacks can become tiring over time.$B$BIf you hope to defeat her, you will need to concentrate your damage when she is weakened.$B$BSpeak to Suchi to begin the duel. Good luck.
english.completion: Your focus was excellent, $n. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 训练师的试炼：奎陆·白眉
text.objectives: 和奎陆·白眉谈一谈，然后击败他。
text.description: 奎陆·白眉被公认为是骑士团里最优秀的弟子。$B$B他看上去几乎无懈可击。他聪慧过人、身强体健、训练刻苦，且天赋异禀。$B$B当你在训练之环挑战他时，你便是在挑战我们最强的弟子。$B$B和他谈一谈，开始对决。无论结果如何，你都会从中获益良多。
text.completion: Your skills are remarkable, $n. When I see such promising students as yourself, I know that The Order will pass into good hands.
text.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

english.title: The Trainer's Challenge: Qua-Ro Whitebrow
english.objectives: Speak to Qua-Ro Whitebrow, then defeat him.
english.description: Qua-Ro Whitebrow is commonly considered the best student of the Order.$B$BHe seems quite without weakness. He is quick of intellect, strong of arm, hard-working, and talented.$B$BWhen you face him in the training ring, you will be testing yourself against our best.$B$BSpeak to him to begin the duel. No matter the outcome, you will learn much from challenging him.
english.completion: Your skills are remarkable, $n. When I see such promising students as yourself, I know that The Order will pass into good hands.
english.completed: Return to Elder Anli at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 四风谷
text.objectives: 和四风谷的列兵蒂姆·P·拉瑞谈一谈。
text.description: 没错，翡翠林正经历一些粗暴的重建，但四风谷正适合探险。如果你想去那里探险，我可以送你一程。记得查看一下我的货物，拿些旅途上用得着的装备。

english.title: Valley of the Four Winds
english.objectives: Speak to Private Tim P. O'Rary in the Valley of the Four Winds.
english.description: Yarr, the Jade Forest be goin through some violent reconstruction, but the Valley of the Four Winds is ripe for explorin.  I can help ye on yer way if ye wants to explore it.  Be sure to check out me wares for some equipment that may help ye on yer journey.

objectiveDetails.description: Speak with Private Tim P. O'Rary in Valley of the Four Winds

text.title: 老马当劳
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败老马当劳。
text.description: 你已经足够强大，可以开始实战了！$b$b我所有的战斗本领都是老马当劳教的。与他交战，一定能令你获益匪浅！$b$b老马当劳就在通往西部荒野的桥对面。可别被他的一把年纪所迷惑了，他已经击败了很多像你这样的后起之秀。
text.completion: Well, I can't argue with results like those. You've got a real gift, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Old MacDonald.

english.title: Old MacDonald
english.objectives: Defeat Old MacDonald in a pet battle.
english.description: You're tough for just starting out!$b$bOld MacDonald taught me everything I know about battling. I think fighting him would be a great learning experience for you!$B$BHe can be found just across the bridge leading to Westfall. Don't let his age fool you, he's already beaten quite a few up-and-coming trainers like yourself.
english.completion: Well, I can't argue with results like those. You've got a real gift, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Old MacDonald.

text.title: 林塞
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败林塞。
text.description: 你做好展示自己实力的准备了吗？在赤脊山中有个小女孩，能在战场上呼风唤雨。$b$b去止水湖营地的码头找林塞。她或许看起来很年轻，但她到目前为止的骄人战绩可不容忽视啊！
text.completion: You're mean! Why didn't you let me win? Everyone always lets me win!
text.completed: Speak to Lindsay.

english.title: Lindsay
english.objectives: Defeat Lindsay in a pet battle.
english.description: Are you ready to show off what you can do? There's a little girl up in Redridge Mountains that has made a real storm on the battle scene.$b$bFind Lindsay at the dock at Camp Everstill. She may be young, but her impressive record is nothing to be scoffed at!
english.completion: You're mean! Why didn't you let me win? Everyone always lets me win!
english.completed: Speak to Lindsay.

text.title: 埃里克·戴维森
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败埃里克·戴维森。
text.description: 我所有的朋友都对一位名叫埃里克·戴维森的恐怖狼人谈论不休，他就在暮色森林，没人敢带着宠物去那里挑战他。$b$b我敢打赌，要是你能找到并击败他，那新的热门人物就是你了！
text.completion: Not only do you not fear me or my home, you have defeated me honorably. I'm impressed.
text.completed: Speak to Eric Davidson.

english.title: Eric Davidson
english.objectives: Defeat Eric Davidson in a pet battle.
english.description: I heard all my friends talking about a scary worgen called Eric Davidson in Duskwood that nobody ever fights with their pets.$b$bI bet if you found and beat him, people might talk about you instead!
english.completion: Not only do you not fear me or my home, you have defeated me honorably. I'm impressed.
english.completed: Speak to Eric Davidson.

text.title: 放手一搏
text.objectives: 去恐惧废土的闷水壶的冒险码头和甲板长官阿林谈一谈。
text.description: 想要赢得这场战争，我们就不能放过任何一个细节，外来者。$b$b沿着海岸那里有一场骚乱，需要调查清楚。那里没有我们的同类，对我们也没什么价值，但他们的补给品还是很有用的。$b$b如果那里有什么有价值的东西，我们就得抢在女皇前面得到它。
text.completion: So the bugs have taken an interest in us have they? Well if they want somethin' from us they'll have to come and earn it themselves!$B$BYou work for what you get here. That means you too!

english.title: Gambling Problem
english.objectives: Speak with Deck Boss Arie at Soggy's Gamble in Dread Wastes.
english.description: If this war is to be won we cannot afford to leave anything unchecked, outsider.$b$bThere is a disturbance along the coast that needs to be investigated. The presence there is not our kind and are of no value to us. However, their supplies could prove very valuable.$b$bIf there is anything of use there we must get to it before the empress.
english.completion: So the bugs have taken an interest in us have they? Well if they want somethin' from us they'll have to come and earn it themselves!$B$BYou work for what you get here. That means you too!

text.title: 比尔·巴克勒
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败海盗比尔。
text.description: 我的老朋友——臭名昭著的酒鬼宠物训练师比尔·巴克勒在荆棘谷海角向有备而来的训练师们发出了公开挑战！$b$b你应该响应他的召唤，让自己的技能接受实战的考验。他通常在荆棘谷海角南边的路上徘徊。
text.completion: I demand a do-over ...hic! That washn't fair! There was two of ye!
text.completed: Speak to Bill Buckler.

english.title: Bill Buckler
english.objectives: Defeat Bill the Pirate in a pet battle.
english.description: My longtime friend, fellow trainer, and infamous drunkard Bill Buckler of the Cape of Stranglethorn, has issued an open challenge to prepared trainers!$b$bYou should answer his call and really put your skills to the test. He tends to wander the southern roads of the Cape.
english.completion: I demand a do-over ...hic! That washn't fair! There was two of ye!
english.completed: Speak to Bill Buckler.

text.title: 史蒂文·里斯班
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败史蒂文·里斯班。
text.description: 如果你认为我是个难缠的对手，那就做好准备吧。前面的路会更加难走。$b$b你可以在北荆棘谷的南部找到史蒂文·里斯班，他正在那儿四处游荡。找到他，瞧瞧谁才是真正的驯宠大师！
text.completion: What a show! A most excellent skirmish indeed.
text.completed: Speak to Steven Lisbane.

english.title: Steven Lisbane
english.objectives: Defeat Steven Lisbane in a pet battle.
english.description: If you thought I was tough, prepare yourself. The road only gets harder from here.$b$bFind Steven Lisbane wandering the roads in the southern parts of Northern Stranglethorn. Seek him out and see who the superior tamer is!
english.completion: What a show! A most excellent skirmish indeed.
english.completed: Speak to Steven Lisbane.

text.title: 不那么友好的请求
text.objectives: 去恐惧废土的落日酒坊和树脂大师吴暮谈一谈。
text.description: 斥候报告说在库尔维斯附近出现了非螳螂妖生物。通常他们的入侵及偷盗琥珀的行为会被及时制止，但我们的部队腾不出手来。$b$b这项任务看起来很适合你，唤醒者。你要试着说服他们离开这片土地，否则你就以卡拉克西瓦之名消灭他们。
text.completion: So they want us to leave do they? What a selfish request! We're only taking amber from one tree.$B$BWell, I'm not going anywhere! I have brew to make.$B$BIf you help us maybe we can all come to a mutually beneficial agreement. I give them some brew, they stop trying to kill us.

english.title: A Not So Friendly Request
english.objectives: Speak with Sapmaster Vu at The Brewgarden in Dread Wastes.
english.description: Scouts have reported a non-mantid presence near Kor'vess. Their intrusion and their theft of amber would normally be dealt with swiftly, but our forces are needed elsewhere.$b$bThis task seems suited to you, Wakener. You will convince them to leave this land, or you will destroy them in the name of the Klaxxi'va.
english.completion: So they want us to leave do they? What a selfish request! We're only taking amber from one tree.$B$BWell, I'm not going anywhere! I have brew to make.$B$BIf you help us maybe we can all come to a mutually beneficial agreement. I give them some brew, they stop trying to kill us.

text.title: 天火降临
text.objectives: 驾驶天火号旋翼机击败60个加尔鲁什尔士兵并摧毁8台加尔鲁什尔粉碎者，然后击沉刃拳掠夺者号和冥河疤痕号。
text.description: 只要我还有一口气在，我就绝不会让部落在这里有半点立足之地！如果你想过来帮把手，我还有一架备用的旋翼机，就在跑道尽头那里。这轮进攻已经开始了，你所要做的就是集中火力、不停射击。$B$B让这些该死的兽人下地狱吧！
text.completion: A proper welcome for the Horde to this new land!
text.completed: Speak to Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Unleash Hell
english.objectives: Use a Skyfire Gyrocopter to slay 60 of the Garrosh'ar troops and destroy 8 Garrosh'ar Shredders, and then sink the Bladefist Reaper and Stygian Scar.
english.description: I will NOT let the Horde gain a foothold on these shores before we do! If you're looking to jump into the fray, I've got a spare gyrocopter for you at the end of the runway. An attack run is already programmed in, all you have to do is concentrate on shooting.$B$BUnleash hell upon these orcs!
english.completion: A proper welcome for the Horde to this new land!
english.completed: Speak to Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in the Jade Forest.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死加尔鲁什尔部落成员

text.title: 天降神兵
text.objectives: 使用天火号降落伞降落至加尔鲁什尔前哨站，然后和“腌菜”苏利·麦克莱利谈一谈。
text.description: 他们的营地分崩离析，他们的士兵乱作一团。我要每一个能战斗的人现在降落至地面去消灭他们。$B$B去船舷拿上一包降落伞，然后空降至地面！
text.completion: 'Bout time you showed up, $Gladdy:lassie;! Let's do some damage!
text.completed: Speak to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary in Garrosh'ar Point.

english.title: Touching Ground
english.objectives: Use a Skyfire Parachute to touch ground in Garrosh'ar Point, then speak to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary.
english.description: Their town is burning and their men are scattered and broken. I need every available man on the ground NOW to finish them off.$B$BGrab one of the parachutes on the edge of the ship and get down there!
english.completion: 'Bout time you showed up, $Gladdy:lassie;! Let's do some damage!
english.completed: Speak to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary in Garrosh'ar Point.

objectiveDetails.description: 装备一顶天火号降落伞

text.title: 摧毁战车
text.objectives: 用苏利的信号枪摧毁5辆部落战车。
text.description: 你瞧见那些部落战车的块头儿了吗？它们载满了炸药，我真搞不懂部落到底是想占领这片土地，还是想把它炸成碎片！$B$B我们得赶在那些部落战车离开加尔鲁什尔前哨站之前，摧毁它们。$B$B给，拿上我的小型信号弹。用它们来攻击部落战车，然后你就等着看烟火吧！
text.completion: With those wagons out of commission, we can turn our attention to the commander.
text.completed: Report to Rell Nightwind in Garrosh'ar Point.

english.title: Welcome Wagons
english.objectives: Use Sully's Flaregun to destroy 5 Horde War Wagons.
english.description: Did you see the size of those war wagons? They're packing so many explosives, I cannae tell if the Horde is here to take over this continent or just blow it out of the sea!$B$BWe need to neutralize those wagons before they leave Garrosh'ar Point.$B$BHere, take me pocket flares. Fire 'em into a wagon and watch the fireworks!
english.completion: With those wagons out of commission, we can turn our attention to the commander.
english.completed: Report to Rell Nightwind in Garrosh'ar Point.

text.title: 物尽其用
text.objectives: 用苏利的信号枪清除路障，然后在码头的尽头直面加图尔。
text.description: 我侦查过该区域，没有发现任何有关王子殿下和海军上将泰勒的线索。我们得快点儿拿下这个基地，并开始进一步的搜索。$B$B这里领头的是一个兽人术士，名叫加图尔。他在码头设置了路障，并试图通过恶魔法阵逃走。$B$B再次使用信号枪，把那些路障轰上天！我先帮你断后。当你到加图尔那边的时候，我会过来帮忙的。
text.completion: We'll catch up with him again. I'm sure of it.
text.completed: Speak with Rell Nightwind in Garrosh'ar Point.

english.title: The Right Tool For The Job
english.objectives: Use Sully's Flaregun to clear out the barricades and confront Ga'trul at the end of the dock.
english.description: I've scouted the area and found no leads on the prince or Admiral Taylor. We need to neutralize this base quickly and continue our search elsewhere.$B$BOperations here are being led by an orc warlock; Ga'trul. He's barricaded the dock and is trying to escape through a demonic circle.$B$BPut that flaregun to work again and blow those barricades! I'll cover your back and move in when you reach Ga'trul.
english.completion: We'll catch up with him again. I'm sure of it.
english.completed: Speak with Rell Nightwind in Garrosh'ar Point.

text.title: 联盟使节
text.objectives: 找到并会见坡东村的首领。
text.description: 基地北面是一座樱树果园，后面还藏着一个村落。在我们计划下一步行动之前，我们得先驻扎在那里进行恢复、休整。$B$B前往那个村落，并和当地的首领取得联系。我和米希卡特工会到指定地点与你会合的。$B$B记得要有礼貌，$n！你可代表了我们整个联盟的形象。$b$b我打赌像你这样实力强劲的联盟英雄一定会给当地人留下好印象的。
text.completion: When the mist fell, we knew it would only be a matter of time before visitors arrived.$B$BWe could not have predicted it would be like this.
text.completed: Speak with Sunke Khang in Paw'don Village.

english.title: Envoy of the Alliance
english.objectives: Find and meet with the leader of Paw'don Village.
english.description: North of this base is a cherry blossom orchard and a village tucked away behind it. We will need to quarter there and tend to our wounded while we plan our next move.$B$BHead to that village and make contact with the native leader. Agent Mishka and I will rendezvous with you there.$B$BBe courteous, $n! I am authorizing you to represent the entire Alliance here.$b$bI'm banking that seeing a powerful Alliance hero like you should make a favorable impression.
english.completion: When the mist fell, we knew it would only be a matter of time before visitors arrived.$B$BWe could not have predicted it would be like this.
english.completed: Speak with Sunke Khang in Paw'don Village.

text.title: 战争的代价
text.objectives: 杀死加尔鲁什尔前哨站里的$1oa个徘徊煞魔和5个煞魔先驱。
text.description: 整个地方都被熊熊燃烧的烈焰所吞噬，天火号报告说又有更多的……暗影从地下爬出来。得让我们的人赶紧离开这里。$B$B穿过基地，向北杀出一条血路，然后赶往村子里。我会在那里与你会合。
text.completion: I am glad you took responsibility for your actions. Left unchecked, negative emotions can quickly overwhelm an individual here, just as they started to overwhelm the one you call "Rell."
text.completed: Speak with Taran Zhu in Paw'don Village.

english.title: The Cost of War
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Sha Haunts and 5 Sha Harbingers in Garrosh'ar Point.
english.description: This whole place is going up in flames and the Skyfire is reporting that more of those... shadows are crawling up out of the ground. We need to get our people out of here.$B$BClear a path through the base on your way north and head for the town. I will rendezvous with you there.
english.completion: I am glad you took responsibility for your actions. Left unchecked, negative emotions can quickly overwhelm an individual here, just as they started to overwhelm the one you call "Rell."
english.completed: Speak with Taran Zhu in Paw'don Village.

text.title: 表明诚意
text.objectives: 击败12个双塔工头或双塔劳工。
text.description: 我们村子怎么成战场了？$B$B在西边，你们的部落敌人在砍伐我们珍贵的果园。没有了苹果树，我们就没有了收成，没有了食物，也没有了生计。$B$B如果你们真跟那些部落有什么不一样，那就证明给我们看！干掉那些乱砍乱伐的家伙，保护我们的果园。
text.completion: Our orchard is one of our village's greatest treasures. For saving our harvest, we are truly grateful.
text.completed: Return to Sunke Khang at Paw'don Village in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Pillaging Peons
english.objectives: Kill 12 Twinspire Taskmasters or Twinspire Peons.
english.description: How did my village become a battlefield?$B$BTo the west, your Horde enemies cut down our precious orchard. Without our apple trees, we will have no harvest, no food, and no livelihood.$B$BIf you are truly different than this Horde, show us! Help us protect our grove by killing those who defile the land.
english.completion: Our orchard is one of our village's greatest treasures. For saving our harvest, we are truly grateful.
english.completed: Return to Sunke Khang at Paw'don Village in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 最优先事项！
text.objectives: 收集6桶苹花甜酒。
text.description: 那些“兽人”杂碎洗劫了酿酒厂，还偷走了几桶我们家上好的苹花果酒。$B$B我知道现在是战争时期，但我可不是那种看着自家美酒被一群卑鄙无耻的家伙痛饮时还无动于衷的酿酒师。$B$B这回该轮到“部落”吃点苦头了。为什么不用你的武器好好教训他们，并帮我找回苹花果酒呢？
text.completion: I see that you two have been busy. Thank you for recovering our kegs.
text.completed: Speak to Lin Applebloom at Paw'don Glade in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Priorities!
english.objectives: Collect 6 Applebloom Cider.
english.description: Those "orc" things ransacked the brewery and made off with my family's finest barrels of cider.$B$BI know there is a war out there, but I am not a brewer who will stand idly by while his prized vintage is chugged by undeserving lips.$B$BThe "Horde" will likely put up some resistance. Why don't you put that weapon to good use and help me recover my cider?
english.completion: I see that you two have been busy. Thank you for recovering our kegs.
english.completed: Speak to Lin Applebloom at Paw'don Glade in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 丧失理智的扣扣
text.objectives: 击败扣扣。
text.description: 我们还有比酒窖更需要担心的事情。$B$B我们心爱的穆山兽——扣扣发疯了！瞧瞧他！$B$B我尝试过哄他、求他、呵斥他，安抚他，但这一切都无济于事。$B$B我恐怕他现在已经失去理智了。现在只有一个办法能够拯救他和我们的酿酒厂。$B$B动作干净利索些，这样他就感觉不到什么痛苦了。
text.completion: You did well to help the Brewers and bring this news to me.$B$BFrom what you have told me, it sounds as if Koukou was possessed by some dark energy. Could it be...?$B$BNo. That is impossible.
text.completed: Return to Sunke Khang at Paw'don Village in The Jade Forest.

english.title: Koukou's Rampage
english.objectives: Kill Koukou.
english.description: We have more than just our cellars to worry about.$B$BKoukou, our beloved mushan, has gone crazy! Just look at him!$B$BI've tried cajoling and pleading and yelling and soothing, but nothing has worked.$B$BI'm afraid he is no longer of his own mind. There is only one way to save him, and our brewery.$B$BStrike swift and sure. He will not feel a thing.
english.completion: You did well to help the Brewers and bring this news to me.$B$BFrom what you have told me, it sounds as if Koukou was possessed by some dark energy. Could it be...?$B$BNo. That is impossible.
english.completed: Return to Sunke Khang at Paw'don Village in The Jade Forest.

text.title: 双塔堡垒
text.objectives: 在双塔堡垒杀死15个部落士兵。
text.description: 我不信任部落。他们使用污秽的魔法，而且显然不怀好意。我们不能忍受他们出现在双塔堡垒，离我们坡东村太近了。$b$b我请求你，冒险者：在他们对这个村子造成威胁之前，削减他们的数量。
text.completion: One heck of a bloody mess y'made down there, kid.$b$bNice work.
text.completed: Report to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary at Twinspire Keep in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Twinspire Keep
english.objectives: Slay 15 Horde troops in Twinspire Keep.
english.description: I do not trust this Horde. They wield foul magic, and their intentions are clearly malevolent. We can no longer stand their presence in Twinspire Keep, so close to Paw'don.$b$bI beg you, visitor: thin their numbers before they do something awful to this village.
english.completion: One heck of a bloody mess y'made down there, kid.$b$bNice work.
english.completed: Report to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary at Twinspire Keep in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 内讧
text.objectives: 杀死达尔甘和贝兰德拉·邪风。
text.description: 部落目前的混乱局面让我们的任务变得更加简单了。他们相互之间的明争暗斗使得他们的营地分成了两块：西边的兽人，和东边的亡灵。$b$b兽人听命于他们的指挥官达尔甘，而亡灵则效忠于一个名叫贝兰德拉·邪风的强大术士。希望他们之间的争执足以影响到对你的关注，以便你能够潜入营地并把他们俩都干掉。苏利已经渗透进废墟里面了，当你完成后进去找他。
text.completion: That's some fine and fancy killin', $c.$b$bNow, with those two all done 'n' taken care of, all that's left is the big fella in the hall behind me.
text.completed: Report to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary at Twinspire Keep in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Fractured Forces
english.objectives: Slay Dalgan and Bellandra Felstorm.
english.description: The Horde have made our jobs easier for us. Their infighting and segregation have split their camp in two: orcs in the west, and undead in the east.$b$bThe orcs obey their commander Dalgan, while the undead follow Bellandra Felstorm, a powerful warlock. Hopefully, their internal squabbles will be enough of a distraction that you'll be able to sneak in there and kill both of them. Sully has already infiltrated the ruins; find him inside when you are done.
english.completion: That's some fine and fancy killin', $c.$b$bNow, with those two all done 'n' taken care of, all that's left is the big fella in the hall behind me.
english.completed: Report to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary at Twinspire Keep in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 空中打击
text.objectives: 使用联盟信号弹，对成堆的军火、双塔投石车、野鬼还有克胡达葛布召唤一次空中打击。
text.description: 苏利报告说在北边侦测到了部落设施，还看到了成堆的爆炸物，随同一小股粉碎者在一起，且更不用提那些术士们召唤出来的恶魔了。$b$b幸好，我们也是有备而来。天火号可以给我们提供空中支援，我们只需给飞行员指明攻击点便可。$b$b<利尔递给你一个信号弹，跟你点了点头。>
text.completion: Me lads up in the sky bring the heat, don't they? Ha ha ha!
text.completed: Report to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary at Twinspire Keep in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Smoke Before Fire
english.objectives: Use the Alliance Flare to call in an airstrike on the Pile of Munitions, the Twinspire Demolishers, the Wild Imps, and Xhu'daggab.
english.description: Sully scouted the Horde establishment to the north, and he reports seeing a large pile of explosives, along with a small force of demolishers. That's not to mention the demons that their warlocks have summoned.$b$bLuckily, we came prepared. We've got air support from the Skyfire. We just need to show our pilots where to strike.$b$b<Rell hands you a smoke flare, and gives you a knowing nod.>
english.completion: Me lads up in the sky bring the heat, don't they? Ha ha ha!
english.completed: Report to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary at Twinspire Keep in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 不公平的交易
text.objectives: 杀死双塔堡垒处负责看守的恶魔之眼，释放8个被俘的熊猫人幼崽。
text.description: 虽然我们刚认识不久，但我们有一个共同的敌人：这伙人叫“部落”。$b$b几天前，他们的首领想和我们做笔交易。当我们拒绝后，他的手下竟然绑架了好几个熊猫人幼崽，以此来要挟我们。$b$b我们曾向影踪派寻求帮助，但他们在昆莱山，远水救不了近火。你能出手相助吗？
text.completion: Aye, I seen the wee ones, too. Busted a few out on m'way up here.$b$bYe've done good, $glad:lass;. Those cubs might have some nasty nightmares, but they'll grow up some day, thanks to you.
text.completed: Report to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary at Twinspire Keep in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Unfair Trade
english.objectives: Free 8 Captive Pandaren Cubs from Twinspire Keep by slaying the demonic eyeballs that watch over them.
english.description: Though we have only just met, we have a common enemy: this group called the "Horde."$b$bSeveral days ago, their leader made us a trade offer. When we refused, his servants abducted several of our cubs as bargaining chips.$b$bWe have called in the Shado-Pan to help, but they are in Kun-Lai Summit, a journey of several days. Can you come to our aid?
english.completion: Aye, I seen the wee ones, too. Busted a few out on m'way up here.$b$bYe've done good, $glad:lass;. Those cubs might have some nasty nightmares, but they'll grow up some day, thanks to you.
english.completed: Report to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary at Twinspire Keep in the Jade Forest.

objectiveDetails.description: 释放被俘的熊猫人幼崽

text.title: 继往开来
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的坡东村向罗杰斯上将报到。
text.description: “煞能”？要当心，$n——这片大陆杀机四伏。$b$b我们会留下来料理那些部落余孽，但我们需要你来继续执行主要任务：营救泰勒上尉，以及找回安度因王子。$b$b我们的空中侦察兵在坡东村附近发现了旗舰的残骸。你去那里向罗杰斯上将报到，她会给你进一步的指示。$b$b你可以用我的旋翼机过去。
text.completion: Excellent work, $c. I can see why you came so highly recommended.

english.title: Onward and Inward
english.objectives: Report to Admiral Rogers at Paw'don Village in the Jade Forest.
english.description: "Sha" energy, hm? Tread carefully, $n - there's a hidden darkness to this continent.$b$bWe'll stay behind to mop up the rest of the Horde, but we need you to continue with the main mission: the rescue of Captain Taylor, and the retrieval of Prince Anduin.$b$bOur aerial scouts think we've found the wreckage of the flagship near Paw'don Village. Go there and report to Admiral Rogers for instructions.$b$bYou are welcome to use my gyrocopter.
english.completion: Excellent work, $c. I can see why you came so highly recommended.

text.title: 布林顿4000
text.completion: I am pleased to offer this gift to you, $r $c.  According to my calibrations, it will invoke feelings of enjoyment and gratitude.$b$bHave a nice day.

english.title: Blingtron 4000
english.completion: I am pleased to offer this gift to you, $r $c.  According to my calibrations, it will invoke feelings of enjoyment and gratitude.$b$bHave a nice day.

text.title: 炮火连天
text.objectives: 摧毁7门韶天火炮。
text.description: 那些金色阶梯上的魔古火炮正从远距离轰击我们。如果它们以某种方式被毁掉的话，那当然再好不过了，你觉得呢？
text.completion: It's a bit more quiet out now. My ringing ears appreciate your hard work.$B$BThanks!
text.completed: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找奎·秋光。

english.title: Cannonfire
english.objectives: Destroy 7 Shao-Tien Cannons.
english.description: Those mogu cannons up on the Golden Stair are bombarding us from a distance. Sure would be nice if they somehow spontaneously broke, don't you think?
english.completion: It's a bit more quiet out now. My ringing ears appreciate your hard work.$B$BThanks!
english.completed: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 残暴行径
text.objectives: 营救5名金莲卫士或雾临村民。
text.description: 我能听到那些被俘的战士和村民们发出来的哀号，就在金色阶梯那里。魔古族正在折磨他们！$B$B求求你，快去救救他们！
text.completion: My heart rests a little easier knowing what you've done. Thank you, my dear.
text.completed: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找孙·柔心。

english.title: Acts of Cruelty
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Golden Lotus Guards or Mistfall Villagers.
english.description: I can hear the screams of the captured soldiers and villagers up on the Golden Stair. They're torturing them!$B$BPlease, please, you have to save them!
english.completion: My heart rests a little easier knowing what you've done. Thank you, my dear.
english.completed: Return to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 阻止风暴
text.objectives: 摧毁引风杖。
text.description: 金色阶梯上的魔古族正试图通过法术引来一场风暴。可想而知，魔古族和风暴结合在一起，可不是什么好事。要我说我们得阻止他们。$B$B通过那些引风杖所散发出来的巨大电弧，你应该很容易就能找到它们。能不能帮我去毁掉它们？回头我肯定能睡个好觉了。
text.completion: It's a lot brighter out! And not just thanks to your sunny smile.$B$BWay to go!
text.completed: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找奎·秋光。

english.title: High Chance of Rain
english.objectives: Destroy the Stormcaller staves.
english.description: The mogu are conjuring some kind of sinister storm upon the Golden Stair. Generally, mogu and lightning are not a particularly pleasant mix. I say we stop them.$B$BYou should be able to find their Stormcaller staves pretty easily, considering the giant arcs of lightning extending up from them. Mind knocking them over or destroying them or something for me? I sure would sleep better.
english.completion: It's a lot brighter out! And not just thanks to your sunny smile.$B$BWay to go!
english.completed: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 获释的灵魂
text.objectives: 击败12个获释的灵魂。
text.description: 韶天放出了那些被他们俘虏且饱受摧残的灵魂，冲着我们来了。他们如洪水般从金色阶梯上涌出来，似乎无穷无尽。$B$B尽可能多杀些获释的灵魂。他们虽然不堪一击，但如果你掉以轻心，会很容易被他们淹没。$B$B祝你好运。
text.completion: The spirits still come, but our guards can hold them back. The Shao-Tien cannot keep this up for ever.$B$BThank you, $C.
text.completed: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。

english.title: Unleashed Spirits
english.objectives: Kill 12 Unleashed Spirits.
english.description: The Shao-Tien have unleashed their captive tortured spirits upon us. They flood down from the Golden Stair, with no end in sight.$B$BKill as many of these unleashed spirits as you can. They are fragile, but if you are not alert, they can easily overrun you.$B$BGood luck.
english.completion: The spirits still come, but our guards can hold them back. The Shao-Tien cannot keep this up for ever.$B$BThank you, $C.
english.completed: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 又被抓了
text.objectives: 营救劳·软足。
text.description: 劳·软足又被抓了……这次是在金色阶梯。我不想为他找任何借口，这家伙实在是太差劲了。$B$B可我们也不能把他丢在那儿不管不顾，你能救他回来吗？
text.completion: You're a good man, helping that silly rogue out more than he deserves.
text.completed: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找奎·秋光。

english.title: Laosy Scouting
english.objectives: Rescue Lao Softfoot.
english.description: Lao Softfoot got himself captured again up on the Golden Stair. I'm not going to make any excuses for him, he's a lousy rogue.$B$BWe probably shouldn't just leave him there though. Could you go find him?
english.completion: You're a good man, helping that silly rogue out more than he deserves.
english.completed: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: [援救金蓮小隊]
text.completed: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。

english.title: [RESCUE GOLDEN LOTUS SQUAD] [GET RID OF THIS?]
english.completed: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 先发制人
text.objectives: 阻止魔古族启动韶天巨兽。
text.description: 魔古族正在金色阶梯上启动某种石像巨兽。毫无疑问，他们想拿它来对付我们。$B$B不如你去跟他们“表达”一下我们的态度？要确保我们的观点直击要害。
text.completion: How went the diplomacy? I hope you didn't go easy on them.
text.completed: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。

english.title: Striking First
english.objectives: Stop the Shao-Tien Behemoth from being empowered.
english.description: The mogu are empowering some giant stone monstrosity up on the Golden Stair, with the sure intent of unleashing it upon us.$B$BHow about you go and let them know our opinion on the matter? Make sure the point strikes home.
english.completion: How went the diplomacy? I hope you didn't go easy on them.
english.completed: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 崩裂的巨兽
text.objectives: 摧毁韶天巨兽。
text.description: 魔古族成功启动了一头凶猛无比的石像巨兽，意图用它来对付我们。$B$B作为回应，我决定派你去对付它。$B$B它就在金色阶梯附近。去征服它吧……
text.completion: Glorious. They will learn to fear us.
text.completed: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。

english.title: Crumbling Behemoth
english.objectives: Destroy the Shao-Tien Behomoth.
english.description: The mogu have succeeded in empowering an enormous stone statue with the intent of unleashing it upon us.$B$BIn response, I would like to unleash you upon it.$B$BIt approaches from the Golden Stair. Bring it to its knees...
english.completion: Glorious. They will learn to fear us.
english.completed: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: [殺死巨大蛟龍]
text.completed: 回锦绣谷的鎏金亭找安济·秋光。

english.title: [KILL GIANT SERPENT] [GET RID OF THIS?]
english.completed: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

text.title: 血染滩头！
text.objectives: 利用炮舰炮台杀死80个雷霆要塞士兵，并摧毁9座雷霆要塞加农炮。
text.description: 他们打中了我们的引擎，我们不得不漂浮在这里——这里！就在敌人的集火位置上！$b$b你知道该怎么做，$n。快去下层甲板操作那些炮台！$b$b让联盟渣滓们明白，他们也在我们的集火位置上！
text.completion: Superior Horde firepower at its finest!$B$B...and you did okay too I guess.
text.completed: Speak to Rivett Clutchpop aboard the Hellscream's Fist in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Paint it Red!
english.objectives: Use a Gunship Turret to kill 80 Thunder Hold troops and destroy 9 Thunder Hold cannons.
english.description: They shot out our engines and we floated here - HERE! Right in the firing line of the enemy!$b$bYou know what to do, $n. Get below decks and man those guns!$b$bShow these scum that they're in OUR line of fire!
english.completion: Superior Horde firepower at its finest!$B$B...and you did okay too I guess.
english.completed: Speak to Rivett Clutchpop aboard the Hellscream's Fist in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 天降神兵
text.objectives: 使用垂降绳索降落至地面。
text.description: 纳兹戈林将军在指挥地面作战，他要求你马上出发，立刻去见他。$B$B我们在炮台附近设有几条垂降绳索。那是你降落至地面的最快方式了，其他方式的结果可就不好说了。
text.completion: There you are!$B$BI was starting to worry we'd have to charge in and have all the fun without you.
text.completed: Speak to General Nazgrim at Honeydew Glade in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Touching Ground
english.objectives: Use a Rappelling Rope to reach the ground.
english.description: Nazgrim has taken command of the ground assault and has requested that you be sent to meet up with him immediately.$B$BWe have several rappelling ropes setup near the guns. Fastest way down you're going to find, save the one that ends poorly.
english.completion: There you are!$B$BI was starting to worry we'd have to charge in and have all the fun without you.
english.completed: Speak to General Nazgrim at Honeydew Glade in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 干掉他们！
text.objectives: 击败15个雷霆要塞士兵。
text.description: 我们已经成功削弱了他们，现在是时候给他们致命一击了！$b$b必须将那座堡垒里的联盟清理干净，我们也没地方关押什么俘虏了。$b$b<纳兹戈林的脸上露出一丝狞笑。>$b$b你知道该做什么，$n。只有懦夫，才会逮着机会就脚下抹油。$b$b你可不会！
text.completion: Good work, $C! We have them on their heels!
text.completed: Speak with General Nazgrim in Thunder Hold.

english.title: Finish Them!
english.objectives: Slay 15 Thunder Hold troops.
english.description: We've softened them up. Now it's time to finish them off!$b$bThat fortress must be cleansed of Alliance, and we've got nowhere to keep any prisoners.$b$b<The hint of a smile crosses Nazgrim's face.>$b$bYou know what to do, $n. The cowards will run if you give them the chance.$b$bSee that you don't!
english.completion: Good work, $C! We have them on their heels!
english.completed: Speak with General Nazgrim in Thunder Hold.

text.title: 火总是那么管用
text.objectives: 烧毁10堆雷霆要塞军火。
text.description: 光消灭他们的部队还远远不够，绝不能给他们留下任何喘息的机会！$b$b拿上这把信号枪，去把他们的军火储备点着。连个渣也别留下！
text.completion: Haha! Good work, $n.$B$BLeave 'em nothing!
text.completed: Speak with General Nazgrim in Thunder Hold.

english.title: Fire Is Always the Answer
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Stacks of Thunder Hold Munitions.
english.description: It's not enough that we destroy their forces. Nothing must be left for them to salvage!$b$bTake this flare-gun and fire it into their munitions stockpiles. Leave them nothing!
english.completion: Haha! Good work, $n.$B$BLeave 'em nothing!
english.completed: Speak with General Nazgrim in Thunder Hold.

text.title: 致命一击！
text.objectives: 杀死雷霆要塞里的多伦上尉。
text.description: 听说他们的上尉用路障把自己封死在上面。$b$b这个懦夫让部下出来送死，自己却躲起来逍遥快活！典型的联盟杂碎！没关系，今天就是他的死期了。$b$b你带人冲上斜坡正面进攻，我会带领我的陆战队扫描墙壁。用你手上的信号枪引爆路障附近的军火，杀出一条路来。$b$b我们在顶上会合，一起送这个可悲的懦夫上黄泉路！
text.completion: An air base - they had a hidden airbase here this entire time! Had I know I would've kept more men on the guns, I would've - Uaaghh -$B$B<The color drains from Nazgrim's face, and his body begins to exude a mysterious dark energy.>
text.completed: Speak with General Nazgrim in Thunder Hold.

english.title: The Final Blow!
english.objectives: Slay Captain Doren in Thunder Hold.
english.description: We've learned that their captain has barricaded himself in above us.$b$bThe coward allowed his forces to die while he hid from our fury! Typical Alliance! No matter. He cannot delay his fate any longer.$b$bI will scale the walls with my marines while you lead a frontal assault up the ramps. Use your flare gun on munitions near the barricades to blast your way through.$b$bWe will meet you up top and destroy this pathetic excuse for a captain together!
english.completion: An air base - they had a hidden airbase here this entire time! Had I know I would've kept more men on the guns, I would've - Uaaghh -$B$B<The color drains from Nazgrim's face, and his body begins to exude a mysterious dark energy.>
english.completed: Speak with General Nazgrim in Thunder Hold.

text.title: 要么服从要么……
text.objectives: 尝试取得蜜露村村长的帮助。
text.description: 我们需要附近村落的帮助，这点很有必要，$p。$b$b我们需要村子来重整部队、治疗伤员。$b$b或许在目睹联盟的暴行后，村民们会加入我们。$b$b你将作为我们部落的使节，确保他们的村长会乖乖合作。别让我失望！
text.completion: Your fighting has brought about much destruction for our tiny village!$B$BWe have no interest in your war, but we will not turn your injured away.
text.completed: Speak with Mayor Honeydew in Honeydew Village.

english.title: You're Either With Us Or...
english.objectives: Attempt to enlist the help of Mayor Honeydew in Honeydew Village.
english.description: The assistance of the nearby village has now become a necessity, $p.$b$bWe will need to use the village to regroup and tend to our wounded.$b$bPerhaps the villagers will join our cause after seeing the brutality unleashed by the alliance.$b$bYou will act as envoy for the Horde. Ensure the cooperation of their leader. Do not disappoint me!
english.completion:
Your strife has brought devastation to our little village!

We are not interested in your war, but we will not drive the wounded away.
english.completed: Speak with Mayor Honeydew in Honeydew Village.

text.title: 自食恶果
text.objectives: 杀死20个徘徊煞魔和7个煞魔先驱。
text.description: 我不明白你们之间为什么会爆发战争，我也不感兴趣。但毫无疑问，这片土地开始散发出负面能量。你们所带来的憎恨、疑惑还有暴力对潘达利亚来说就好像流血不止的伤口。$b$b你们的行为给这些废墟带来了灾难和毁灭！去清理一下，然后到下面的村子里见我——我会把事情的来龙去脉跟你们娓娓道来。
text.completion: I am glad you took responsibility for your actions. Left unchecked, negative emotions can quickly overwhelm an individual here, just as they started to overwhelm the one you call "Nazgrim."
text.completed: Speak with Taran Zhu in Honeydew Village.

english.title: Face to Face With Consequence
english.objectives: Kill 20 Sha Haunts and 7 Sha Harbingers.
english.description: I do not know the history of this war that you fight, and I am not interested. This land responds to negative energy in kind. The hatreds, doubt, and violence you have brought here now ooze out of Pandaria like blood from an open wound.$b$bYour actions have wrought havoc all over these ruins! Clean up after yourself and meet me in the village below - I will do my best to explain what is happening here.
english.completion: I am glad you took responsibility for your actions. Left unchecked, negative emotions can quickly overwhelm an individual here, just as they started to overwhelm the one you call "Nazgrim."
english.completed: Speak with Taran Zhu in Honeydew Village.

text.title: 酒最珍贵！
text.objectives: 在蜜露林地里找回6桶蜜酒。
text.description: 瞧瞧这儿，真是一团糟！所有的酒都浪费了！$b$b祝踏岚警告我们说不要跟你们这些陌生人讲话，但眼下我也顾不了那么多了。$b$b当时我们正把酒送到晨芳园，结果半路上遇袭了。现在所有的酒都丢了！$b$b你想跟我们和解吗？那就帮我们找回一些还未破损的蜜酒酒桶吧，这样就能减少些损失了。
text.completion: Well, it's not as much as I would have hoped, but it will have to do. I guess there is no sense in cryin' over spilled brew.
text.completed: Return to Ellie Honeypaw in Honeydew Village.

english.title: Priorities!
english.objectives: Find 6 Barrels of Honeybrew in Honeydew Glade.
english.description: Just look at this mess! All that brew gone to waste!$b$bTaran Zhu warned us against speaking to you outsiders, but I'll take any help I can get.$b$bWe were on our way to Dawn's Blossom when the fighting broke out. Now all of our brew has been lost!$b$bYou want to make it up to us? Maybe you can find some of our Honeybrew barrels that haven't been broken. Then it wouldn't be a complete loss.
english.completion: Well, it's not as much as I would have hoped, but it will have to do. I guess there is no sense in cryin' over spilled brew.
english.completed: Return to Ellie Honeypaw in Honeydew Village.

text.title: 徘徊者危机
text.objectives: 在蜜露林地消灭10只染煞徘徊者。
text.description: 所有的动物都发疯了！$b$b通常徘徊者会避开村民，但现在换成我们对其敬而远之了！我以前从未看它们如此疯狂过！$b$b村长叫了影踪派的人过来帮忙，但他们人还没来全。你能不能在那些徘徊者伤害我们的农夫之前，消灭它们呢？
text.completion: Ah, so your conflict at the ruins is beginning to pollute the local wildlife? This is very troubling - I have never seen a reaction so intense.$B$BThank you for protecting the village, but it is a tragedy that those poor animals had to die.
text.completed: Return to Taran Zhu in Honeydew Village.

english.title: Prowler Problems
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Sha-Infested Prowlers in Honeydew Glade.
english.description: The animals have all gone crazy!$b$bNormally the prowlers steer clear of the village, but now we can't seem to keep them away. I've never seen them act this way before!$b$bThe mayor has summoned in the Shado-Pan, but they're not all here yet. Can you take care of those prowlers before they maul one of our farmers?
english.completion: Ah, so your conflict at the ruins is beginning to pollute the local wildlife? This is very troubling - I have never seen a reaction so intense.$B$BThank you for protecting the village, but it is a tragedy that those poor animals had to die.
english.completed: Return to Taran Zhu in Honeydew Village.

text.title: 寻找金祖恩
text.objectives: 在旋风高地的某个地方找到金祖恩。
text.description: 利维特声称他看到金祖恩和其他幸存者一起弃船逃生了，这意味着他还在某个地方。$b$b我们不能丢下他不管。他可能受伤了，也可能……被捕了！$b$b快去找到金祖恩，把他给我带回来。
text.completion: <Zin'Jun is grievously wounded, but senses that you're friendly.>$B$BMonkey-tings! Everywhere dere be dese monkey-tings!
text.completed: 和旋风高地的金祖恩谈一谈。

english.title: Seeking Zin'jun
english.objectives: Locate Zin'jun somewhere in the Ascent of the Swirling Winds.
english.description: Rivett claims to have seen Zin'jun abandon ship with the rest of the survivors. That means he's still out there somewhere.$b$bWe can't leave him behind. He could be injured or worse yet, captured!$b$bGo track down Zin'jun and bring him back.
english.completion:
<Zin'June is seriously injured, but he feels you're in a friendly mood. >

Damn monkeys! Those things are all over the place!
english.completed: Speak with Zin'jun in the Ascent of the Swirling Winds.

text.title: 突袭机坪
text.objectives: 在铁腕机坪击败15个铁腕士兵。
text.description: $n，我找到了他们的秘密空军基地：铁腕机坪。那里并不难找，挤满了联盟的地方就是。$b$b<纳兹戈林狠狠地啐了一口。>$b$b他们妄图把我们消灭光，但我们是部落！我们会战斗到最后一刻……有时死后还会继续战斗。让他们尝尝我们的斧头！
text.completion: The best thing about killing Alliance in Pandaria? It'll be months before they get any reinforcements.$B$BThis land will belong to the Horde, $C. We're nearly finished.
text.completed: Return to General Nazgrim at Nook of Konk in Jade Forest.

english.title: Assault on the Airstrip
english.objectives: Slay 15 Strongarm troops at Strongarm Airstrip.
english.description: I have found their hidden airfield, $n: the Strongarm Airstrip. It wasn't hard to spot, it's swarming with Alliance.$b$b<Nazgrim spits.>$b$bThey think they've wiped us out, but we're Horde! We fight until we're corpses... and sometimes even afterwards. Let them taste our steel!
english.completion:
Знаешь, что самое приятное в уничтожении войск Альянса в Пандарии? Пройдут месяцы, прежде чем они получат подкрепление.

Эти земли будут принадлежать Орде, $c! Мы почти закончили.
english.completed: Return to General Nazgrim at Nook of Konk in Jade Forest.

text.title: 铁腕战术
text.objectives: 杀死杰克逊·希尔瓦下士、莫格斯·凶斧、首席技师克格斯温还有陀螺技师拉文德普。
text.description: 关于铁腕机坪的侦查报告已经出来了，我罗列了几个重要目标供你参考。$b$b有两个侏儒技师一直在维护着联盟旋翼机的起降。干掉这两个家伙，旋翼机的数量就会大大减少。$b$b还有一个矮人死亡骑士在他们周围徘徊。他跟你一样，是个冒险者——喜欢独来独往且极其强悍。$b$b最后这一位我认识：杰克逊·希尔瓦下士。他是联盟的英雄，十字弓耍得非常了得。$b$b祝你好运，$n。
text.completion: Blood and thunder, $n. Blood and thunder.
text.completed: Return to General Nazgrim at Nook of Konk in Jade Forest.

english.title: Strongarm Tactics
english.objectives: Slay Corporal Jackson Silver, Morgus Grimhatchet, and Master Mechanic Cogswing and Gyro-Engineer Lavenderp.
english.description: Scouting reports from the Strongarm Airstrip are in, and I've underlined a few high-priority targets for you.$b$bTwo gnomish mechanics have been keeping Alliance gyrocopters in the air. Take out the mechanics, and the gyrocopters' numbers will dwindle.$b$bA dwarven death knight wanders their perimeter. He's an adventurer like yourself - loosely allied and highly dangerous.$b$bFinally, a name I recognize: Corporal Jackson Silver. He's a hero of the Alliance and a deadshot with a crossbow.$b$bGood luck, $n.
english.completion: Кровь и гром, $n. Кровь и гром!
english.completed: Return to General Nazgrim at Nook of Konk in Jade Forest.

objectiveDetails.description: 击败首席技师克格斯温和陀螺技师拉文德普

text.title: 土制火箭筒
text.objectives: 拾取铁腕机坪里被征用的烟花发射器，然后用它们来击落12架铁腕旋翼机。
text.description: 我在过来的路上发现了一些肩扛式火箭发射器。$b$b它们或许是某种烟火装置，我也不清楚。我本假设它们就是肩扛式火箭发射器，结果证明我错了。$b$b重点是，在你这种技巧娴熟的$c手中，或许能用它们把旋翼机打下来。如果你在周围发现这些家伙，试着用它们来对付那些叮叮咣咣的旋翼机吧。
text.completion: I hope those ding-dongs enjoyed the party you threw for them!
text.completed: Return to Rivett Clutchpop at Nook of Konk in Jade Forest.

english.title: Choppertunity
english.objectives: Pick up Requisitioned Fireworks Launchers in Strongarm Airstrip, then use them on 12 Strongarm Gyrocopters.
english.description: I spotted some shoulder-mounted rocket launchers on the way over here.$b$bThey mighta been fireworks. I dunno. I'm just going to assume that they were shoulder-mounted rocket launchers until I'm proven wrong.$b$bPoint is, in the arms of a skilled $c like you, they could probably take down a chopper. If you find any lying around, try pointing them at those poorly-built gyrocopters.
english.completion: Надеюсь, им понравился наш "фейерверк".
english.completed: Return to Rivett Clutchpop at Nook of Konk in Jade Forest.

text.title: 是敌非友
text.objectives: 鼓励12个熊猫人志愿者离开铁腕机坪。
text.description: 联盟刚来的时候，我们还把他们当朋友，我们有些村民还自愿帮他们修建机坪。但最近一系列的情况表明，他们在修建一座军事基地，和我们的村子近在咫尺。$b$b更糟的是——我怕某些村民是被联盟强迫劳役的。$c，如果你发现了他们，就让他们赶快回家吧。
text.completion: Although I can't understand why you chose to bring your war to our land, I can clearly see which side is more virtuous.$B$BThank you for your aid, $R.
text.completed: Return to Merchant Zin at Nook of Konk in Jade Forest.

english.title: Unreliable Allies
english.objectives: Encourage 12 Pandaren Volunteers to leave the Strongarm Airstrip.
english.description: We originally welcomed the Alliance as friends. Several of our villagers volunteered to help them build an airstrip. Only recently, however, did it become clear to us that they were building a war base, within shouting distance of our village.$b$bWhat's worse - I fear that some villagers are being held against their will. If you find them, $c, let them know that it is time to come home.
english.completion: Although I can't understand why you chose to bring your war to our land, I can clearly see which side is more virtuous.$B$BThank you for your aid, $R.
english.completed: Return to Merchant Zin at Nook of Konk in Jade Forest.

text.title: 掘地三尺
text.objectives: 击败多伦上尉。
text.description: 你在那里没有发现多伦上尉，是吗？$b$b那个爱哭鼻子的联盟指挥官肯定躲在哪里了。他要是不在机坪，就在附近什么地方。彻底搜查周边区域——特别是主机坪西南处的洞穴。我要把这里的联盟都赶回老家！
text.completion: The Alliance have been routed. You, Nazgrim, Kiryn, Gorrok, Shokia, and Rivett need a base of operations.$B$BThese flags will have to be changed.$B$BFor the Horde!
text.completed: Adjust the flagpole in the center of the Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest.
text.giverWindow: 整个铁腕机坪都听命于多伦上尉的指挥。给我拿下他！

english.title: The Darkness Within
english.objectives: Slay Captain Doren.
english.description: You didn't see Captain Doren while you were out there, did you?$b$bThat sniveling Alliance leader must be in hiding somewhere. If he wasn't in that airbase, he can't be far. Search the perimeter - try searching the cave southwest of the main airfield. I want the Alliance gone from here!
english.completion:
The alliance is retreating. Now you, Nasgrim, Kirin, Gorrok, Shokia and Rivett, will need a base of sorties.

We need to change these flags.

For the Horde!
english.completed: Adjust the flagpole in the center of the Strongarm Airstrip in the Jade Forest.
english.giverWindow: The entirety of Strongarm Airstrip reports to Doren. Take him down!

text.title: 老马当劳
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败老马当劳。
text.description: 这次我可不会再轻易输给你了！
text.completion: I guess I still have a lot to learn.
text.completed: Speak to Old MacDonald.

english.title: Old MacDonald
english.objectives: Defeat Old MacDonald in a pet battle.
english.description: I won't be such a pushover this time around!
english.completion: I guess I still have a lot to learn.
english.completed: Speak to Old MacDonald.

text.title: 林塞
text.objectives: 在宠物战斗中击败林塞。
text.description: 你觉得你这次还能赢？我随时奉陪！
text.completion: That wasn't fun at all!
text.completed: Speak to Lindsay.

english.title: Lindsay
english.objectives: Defeat Lindsay in a pet battle.
english.description: Think you can take me again?  I'm always up for challenge!
english.completion: That wasn't fun at all!
english.completed: Speak to Lindsay.

text.title: 颠覆
text.objectives: 与卡拉克西维斯的卡拉克西瓦·沃尔交谈。
text.description: 议会已经协调一致了，唤醒者。$b$b我们的仪式将终结女皇的生命，并拯救我们伟大帝国的未来。$b$b看看卡拉克西的力量吧！
text.completion: We are... undone, wakener.$B$BYour efforts appear to have become imperative to our cause.$B$BOn behalf of the remaining council, I implore you to continue in your assistance.

english.title: Overthrone
english.objectives: Speak to Klaxxi'va Vor in Klaxxi'vess.
english.description: The council is in harmony, wakener.$b$bOur ritual will bring about the demise of the empress and allow us to secure the future of our great empire.$b$bBehold the power of the Klaxxi!
english.completion: We are... undone, wakener.$B$BYour efforts appear to have become imperative to our cause.$B$BOn behalf of the remaining council, I implore you to continue in your assistance.

text.title: 升级！
text.objectives: 将一个宠物提升至3级。
text.description: 很好，很好。让宠物保持健康以随时应对战斗，这是非常重要的。$b$b我给你安排的下一个任务是，参加几场对决，将一只宠物升到3级。等你做到之后就回来见我，我会告诉你如何捕捉属于你自己的宠物！
text.completion: Great job $n. Next up, catching your own pets!
text.completed: Return to Marcus Jensen in Goldshire.

english.title: Level Up!
english.objectives: Raise a pet to level 3.
english.description: Good, good. It's important to keep your pets healthy and ready for battle.$b$bMy next task for you is to fight a few battles and raise a pet to level 3.  Once you do that, come back and see me and we can talk about catching your own pets!
english.completion: Great job $n. Next up, catching your own pets!
english.completed: Return to Marcus Jensen in Goldshire.

text.title: 古朴的叛军的镣铐
text.objectives: 将神器进行展览。
text.description: 这件神器的恢复状况极为良好。或许你该把它放在闻道之座进行展览，好让那些游学者和考古学家们进行研究。
text.progress: Remove the clutter and put the artifact on display.
text.completion: This will aid lorewalkers and archaeologists in understanding the history of Pandaria.
text.completed: Put the artifact on display at the Seat of Knowledge.

english.title: Pristine Manacles of Rebellion
english.objectives: Put the artifact on display.
english.description: This artifact has been restored to a remarkably excellent condition.  Perhaps you will put it on display at the Seat of Knowledge, so that lorewalkers and archaeologists can study it.
english.progress: Remove the clutter and put the artifact on display.
english.completion: This will aid lorewalkers and archaeologists in understanding the history of Pandaria.
english.completed: Put the artifact on display at the Seat of Knowledge.

english.completed: Put the artifact on display at the Seat of Knowledge.

text.objectives: 将神器进行展览。
text.description: 这件神器的恢复状况极为良好。或许你该把它放在闻道之座进行展览，好让那些游学者和考古学家们进行研究。
text.progress: Remove the clutter and put the artifact on display.
